title: Bliv pædagog et sted hvor leg, relationer og fællesskab kommer først
description:
Forestil dig en arbejdsdag, hvor børnene mødes af voksne, der har tid til at være nysgerrige, følge legen og skabe trygge relationer. Hvor kolleger hjælper hinanden, deler idéer og griner sammen. Hvor faglige refleksioner er en naturlig del af hverdagen, fordi vi ved, at vi bliver dygtigere sammen.

Vi søger en pædagog, der har lyst til at blive en del af et integreret børnehus med tre vuggestuegrupper og tre børnehavegrupper. Her bliver du en del af et engageret arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi er optaget af at skabe de bedste betingelser for børns trivsel, udvikling og læring gennem leg, nærvær og stærke fællesskaber.

Hos os er relationerne det vigtigste, Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst, når de oplever at høre til. Derfor arbejder vi hver dag for, at alle børn går hjem med følelsen af at have været en betydningsfuld del af fællesskabet.

Det betyder, at vi prioriterer tid til nærvær, leg og gode relationer. Vi er nysgerrige på børnenes perspektiver og tilrettelægger læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn oplever deltagelsesmuligheder og bliver mødt med respekt.

En arbejdsplads, hvor du ikke står alene
Hos Skuldshøj ved vi, at god pædagogik skabes i fællesskab. Derfor hjælper vi hinanden, deler erfaringer og bruger refleksion som en naturlig del af vores praksis.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer: et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, faglig sparring og refleksion, kompetenceudvikling, medindflydelse på den pædagogiske retning, en nærværende og tryghed.

Som ny kollega bliver du mødt af medarbejdere, der gerne vil samarbejde, sparre og udvikle sig sammen med dig.
Vi tror på, at medarbejdere, der trives og udvikler sig, skaber de bedste rammer for børnene.

I Frederikssund Kommune arbejder vi med ICDP (International Child Development Programmet) som en fælles faglig tilgang til samspillet med børn. Som pædagog får du mulighed for at blive uddannet i ICDP og bliver en del af en fælles pædagogisk referenceramme, der styrker vores arbejde med relationer, børneperspektiver og udviklende læringsmiljøer.

Mangfoldighed er en styrke
Skuldshøj er et hus med mange kulturer og sprog. Det ser vi som en stor ressource, der giver børnene mulighed for at møde forskellige perspektiver og lære af hinanden.

Vi ønsker, at både børn, forældre og medarbejdere oplever, at de bliver mødt med nysgerrighed, respekt og anerkendelse.

Vi håber, at du er uddannet pædagog, brænder for relationer, leg og fællesskaber, ser forskellighed som en styrke, arbejder inkluderende og har blik for alle børns deltagelse, tager ansvar og samtidig trives i et tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger og har lyst til at udvikle både dig selv og den pædagogiske praksis.

Har du lyst til at være med?
Vi vil meget gerne fortælle mere om vores hus og vise dig rundt, så du kan mærke stemningen og møde nogle af dine kommende kolleger.
Kontakt Tarab på telefon 23 72 03 90 for en uforpligtende snak eller en rundvisning.

title: Senior Network Engineer (Engineering Change Proposals)
description:
Competitive Range partners with the government to plan and deploy complex, IT-enabled, and mission-essential capabilities. Our goal is to help you develop and expand your professional capabilities while working on challenging, exciting projects in a collaborative, congenial environment.

Competitive Range Solutions requires the expertise of a talented and experienced Senior Network Engineer to assist in the direction and management of the program’s executive support group. The candidate must reference their ability and experience working in a Department of Defense (DoD) customer environment and effective integration with a government multi-contractor team.

The Senior Network Engineer plays a crucial role in the planning, developing, and implementing Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs) related to IT infrastructure and network architecture enhancements. This position requires a deep understanding of network design, optimization, and modernization efforts within a complex IT environment. The Senior Network Engineer will be instrumental in evaluating customer requirements, designing technical solutions, and ensuring the successful execution of network upgrades, system transitions, and technology refreshment projects.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Develop and design innovative network solutions as part of the ECP process.

Collaborate with the project execution team to develop around 800 ECPs manually. This involves clarifying requirements, providing technical expertise for the ECP Catalog, and creating detailed network designs that meet specific project types (No-Cost, Small, Medium, large, and Complex ECPs).

Conduct thorough analyses of existing network architectures and propose modifications or upgrades to enhance performance, reliability, and security.

Engage in transport network modernization and optimization initiatives.

Assist in managing network-related projects from conception to closeout, ensuring timely delivery and compliance with all technical and security requirements. Provide input for project management plans, schedules, and work breakdown structures.

Serve as technical liaison between the project team, customers, and government representatives. Ensure clear communication regarding network design, project status, and technical challenges.

Responsible for delivering high-quality network designs and technical solutions for ECPs and contributing to project documentation such as Engineering Installation Plans (EIPs) and Circuit Installation Plans (CIPs).

Qualifications/Experience:

Active TS/SCI Clearance

2+ years as senior or lead engineer in planning, designing, and building software-defined networks.

3+ years DoD environment

Outstanding mathematics and IT abilities

Configuring and installing various network devices and services

Monitoring network performance and resource utilization, trending, capacity planning

Use of current and emergent network design principles and protocols

Experience with network virtualization technologies.

Experience with multi-tenant network architectures.

Familiarity with a wide variety of network routing and switching equipment devices from multiple vendors.

Scripting languages and coding for network threshold events

Education/Certifications:

Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Engineering or Equivalent

Master's degree preferred.

One nationally recognized certification for senior network administrators/engineers/architects tied to the proposal solution's routers and switches.

IAT Level III in accordance with DoD 8570.01-M

IAT Level III certification

title: Pastry Kitchen Commis
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

title: Kätilöitä Synnytysyksikköön
description:
Koetko paloa synnytyssalikätilön työhön Suomen suurimmassa synnytyssairaalassa? Oletko kehitysmyönteinen ja kaipaat haasteita työssäsi?

Haemme kolmea kätilöä vakituiseen työsuhteisiin HUS Naistenklinikalle Helsinkiin. Kätilönä työskentelet osana moniammatillista tiimiä. Kätilötyötämme ohjaavat perhekeskeisyys sekä asiakaslähtöisyys. Kehitämme toimintaamme Lean-hengessä ja toimimme myös opetussairaalana.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen, haastavan ja palkitsevan työn kansainvälisesti korkeatasoisessa yliopistosairaalassamme. Meillä sinua arvostetaan sekä kannustetaan kehittymään ammatissasi. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä ja alkaa26.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Toiveemme

Arvostamme muutosvalmiutta, joustavaa ja positiivista asennetta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta kätilötyön kehittämiseen. Työssäsi sinua auttavat hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot. Monipuolinen kokemus kätilön työstä katsotaan eduksesi. Meillä työskentelet osana moniammatillista tiimiä, jossa jokaisella on tärkeä rooli. Työskentelyssämme näkyvätHUSinarvot;kohtaaminen,edelläkävijyysja yhdenvertaisuus. Tavoitteenamme on tarjota joka päivä jokaiselle potilaalle yhä parempaa hoitoa.

Voit seurata meitä myös Instagramissa: @hus_nklsynnytykset

Tietoa tulevasta työpaikastasi

Naistenklinikan synnytysyksikössä syntyy vuosittain yli 9000 lasta. Synnytysyksikössämme hoidetaan niin terveitä kuin korkean riskin synnyttäjiä. Työtä tehdään moniammatillisessa tiimissä, vahvalla ammattitaidolla aina synnyttäjää kunnioittaen. Synnytysyksikkömme on jaettu kahteen yksikköön Luotsi ja Aallokko.

Luotsissa hoidamme korkean riskin synnytyksiä ja esimerkiksi kaikki erittäin ennenaikaiset synnytykset koko ERVA-alueelta ja tiettyjen riskisynnytysten hoito on valtakunnallisesti keskitetty Naistenklinikalle. Meillä on ensimmäisenä yliopistollisena sairaalana erillinen matalan riskin synnytysyksikkö Aallokko. Pyrimme keskittämään matalanriskin synnyttäjien hoidon tähän kätilövetoiseen yksikköömme.

Näiden lisäksi synnytysyksikössämme on kolme leikkaussalia sekä perheheräämö, joka mahdollistaa äidin ja vastasyntyneen katkeamattoman varhaisen kontaktin syntymän jälkeen. Halutessasi voit kouluttautua perheheräämökätilön tehtävään. Synnytysyksikössämme hoidetaan myös loppuraskauden vastaanottoja kuten yliaikaisuuskäynnit sekä synnytyksen käynnistykset. Synnytyspelkovastaanotoilla toimivat kätilömme hoitavat synnytyspelkoisia potilaita yksilövastaanotoilla, digihoitopolulla sekä pienryhmissä.

Naistenklinikan synnytysyksikössä työskentelee n. 140 kätilöä. Kaikki kätilöt toimivat molemmissa synnytysyksiköissä; Luotsi ja Aallokko. Olemme panostaneet lähiesihenkilötyöhön. Synnytysyksikössämme työskentelee kolme osastonhoitajaa sekä kaksi apulaisosastonhoitajaa. Jokaiselle työntekijälle nimetään työsuhteen alussa oma lähiesihenkilö.

MeHUSissatuemme työhyvinvointia liikunta- ja kulttuurieduilla sekä työsuhdematkaedulla. Tarjoamme sairaan lapsen hoitopalvelua sekä mahdollisuuden hankkia työsuhdeasunto ja vuokrata henkilöstöhintaan lomamökkejä.HUSistasaat itsellesi savuttoman työpaikan.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3 342,53 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.

Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä.HUSissaolet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu kätilö tai laillistettu sairaanhoitaja ja erikoissairaanhoitajan tutkinto äitiyshuollon ja naistentautien opintolinjalla.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Yhteystiedot

Kerromme mielellämme lisää, ota rohkeasti yhteyttä.

Provide technical refreshment and senior engineering support for installation and integration of equipment for a Classified Satellite System for the Department of War program. This work shall be comprised of on and off-site engineering support and services locally and via temporary duty locations in support of the Secretary of Defense Communications Office. Tasks shall be of varying nature and includes troubleshooting, engineering design support, circuit status reporting, and integration support with DOW/DISA Classified programs support, operational test and evaluation, and network (including associated equipment) assessment to achieve operational status for the executive transport aircraft. The Contractor shall provide engineering recommendations to the Aircraft Management Offices (PMO’s) concerning network architecture issues and technology insertion initiatives to improve or upgrade network capabilities. The contractor shall track changes in classified DOW Classified Satellite System Network and/or system including but not limited to configurations of equipment, operational capabilities, and operating procedures. The contractor shall periodically update and publish associated engineering documents so the community of interest with the most up to date with the DOW system network configuration, system description or architecture. This task area may provide an evaluation of commercially available products that may be utilized to support the DOW system's network requirements.

title: Vil du stå i spidsen for Børn og Unge Støtte i Familiecentret?
description:
Tror du på, at de bedste resultater for børn og unge opstår, når medarbejdere oplever tydelig ledelse, faglig udvikling og et stærkt fællesskab?

Så kan du være den tilbudsleder, vi leder efter.


I forbindelse med omorganiseringen i Familiecentret søger vi nu en tilbudsleder i en fast stilling til vores Børn og Unge Støtte – Dag og Døgn Aflastningstilbud.

Vi søger en leder, der kan stå stærkt i både den faglige og menneskelige ledelsesopgave, og som ønsker at bidrage aktivt til den fortsatte udvikling af vores tilbud.


Om tilbuddet

Vores aflastningstilbud er placeret på Torvegade og Bakkevej i hverdagen samt i Marbæk i weekenderne.

Vi arbejder med børn og unge, der ofte har oplevet komplekse livsvilkår. Derfor er vores arbejde funderet i en mentaliserende tilgang, hvor vi møder barnet bag adfærden og skaber trygge, forudsigelige rammer for udvikling og trivsel.

Formålet med indsatsen er at understøtte børn og unge uden for hjemmet i perioder, hvor familien eller plejefamilien har behov for aflastning og støtte.


Indsatsen bidrager blandt andet til:

  • At understøtte barnets eller den unges sundhed, trivsel og udvikling
  • At styrke sociale, personlige og emotionelle kompetencer
  • At skabe tryghed, stabilitet og positive udviklingsmuligheder
  • At understøtte familiers og plejefamiliers ressourcer og trivsel


Du bliver en del af Familieområdet under Social & Barn-Ung i Esbjerg Kommune og indgår i et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab med de øvrige tilbudsledere i Familiecentret.


Du overtager ikke blot et tilbud – du bliver en vigtig del af den faglige udvikling på døgnområdet og i Familiecentret.

På døgnområdet arbejder vi målrettet med at skabe et fælles fagligt fundament, hvor mentalisering, relationer og høj faglig kvalitet er bærende elementer. Som tilbudsleder får du mulighed for både at videreføre et stærkt fundament og bidrage til udviklingen af vores samlede indsats for børn, unge og familier.


Vi søger en leder

som tror på, at god ledelse handler om både at sætte retning og skabe følgeskab gennem relationer, faglighed og tydelig kommunikation.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en pædagogisk grunduddannelse
  • Har erfaring fra døgn- eller socialområdet og indsigt i arbejdet med børn og unge i komplekse livsvilkår
  • Har erfaring med ledelse af fagprofessionelle medarbejdere og et solidt ledelsesmæssigt fundament. Du har en lederuddannelse eller motivation til at videreudvikle dine ledelseskompetencer.
  • Arbejder mentaliserende og anerkendende i din ledelsesstil
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og beslutningsdygtig
  • Kan skabe engagement, motivation og udvikling i medarbejdergruppen
  • Har erfaring med eller forståelse for vagtplanlægning og vikardækning
  • Har økonomisk forståelse og kan arbejde struktureret med administrative opgaver
  • Kan indgå konstruktivt i samarbejdet med tillidsrepræsentanter og arbejdsmiljøorganisationen
  • Trives i en politisk styret organisation og ser værdi i tværfagligt samarbejde

Derudover trives du med at stå i krydsfeltet mellem børn og unges behov, medarbejdernes arbejdsmiljø, familiers forventninger, faglige ambitioner og organisatoriske rammer.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

Som tilbudsleder får du ansvar for både den daglige drift og den fortsatte udvikling af tilbuddet i samspil med centerchef og lederkolleger.


Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i den pædagogiske indsats
  • Varetage daglig personaleledelse med fokus på trivsel og udvikling
  • Understøtte en mentaliserende faglig kultur
  • Planlægge bemanding, vagtplaner og vikardækning
  • Bidrage til økonomistyring og administrative opgaver i samarbejde med centerchef og økonomikonsulent
  • Indgå i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige tilbudsledere i Familiecentret
  • Understøtte supervision, kompetenceudvikling og læringsmiljøer
  • Samarbejde med forældre, netværk, myndighedsrådgivere, skoler og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af Familiecentrets fælles faglige retning og værdigrundlag


Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

Vi investerer i vores lederfællesskab og prioriterer faglig sparring, åben dialog og fælles udvikling. Du bliver en del af et ledelsesteam, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, udfordrer hinanden og lykkes sammen.

Vi er ambitiøse på børnenes og de unges vegne, men ved også, at holdbare resultater skabes gennem stærke relationer og samarbejde.


Du får:

  • Ansvar for to engagerede personalegrupper
  • Et stærkt og hjælpsomt lederfællesskab
  • En centerchef og lederkolleger, der hepper på hinanden
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den fortsatte udvikling af tilbuddet
  • En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og plads til refleksion
  • Gode muligheder for lederudvikling og kompetenceudvikling
  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor ledelse gør en reel forskel for børn, unge og medarbejdere


Og ja – vi tager vores opgave alvorligt, men vi tror også på, at humor, nysgerrighed og gode relationer er en vigtig del af arbejdslivet.


Vi søger ikke den perfekte leder

Til gengæld søger vi en leder, der er nysgerrig på mennesker, som kan skabe følgeskab og faglig troværdighed, og som har mod på både at gå forrest og lykkes sammen med andre.

En leder, der kan navigere i en hverdag med både drift, udvikling og uforudsigelighed – og som samtidig formår at skabe ro, retning og arbejdsglæde omkring sig.

Kan du se dig selv i den beskrivelse, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.


Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Esbjerg – på flere matrikler. Derfor er det nødvendigt at have kørekort og egen bil til rådighed.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. august 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler: 20. august 2026

Tiltrædelse: 1. september 2026

Der indhentes straffe- og børneattest ved ansættelse.

Går du videre efter ansættelsessamtale, vil der blive indhentet referencer fra nuværende og/eller tidligere arbejdsgiver, hvis du fortsat er i betragtning til stillingen.

Du vil blive informeret inden der bliver indhentet referencer.


Har du spørgsmål?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Familiecenterchef Susanne Kokholm Gade

📞 40 20 80 42

✉️ skg@esbjerg.dk

I Esbjerg Kommune arbejder vi tillidsbaseret og ser menneskelig forskellighed som en styrke. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede uanset køn, alder eller etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

title: Executive Publisher
description:
Are you energised by shaping portfolio direction, driving growth, and leading strategic programmes across a matrix organization?

Do you enjoy building long-term partnerships with editors, societies, and research leaders worldwide?

About the Team

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

About the Role

We are looking for an Executive Publisher to lead a portfolio of approximately 12 physics journals and take a senior role in shaping team strategy, journal development, and key external partnerships.

The role has a strong international focus and will involve working closely with researchers, editors, institutions, and societies across multiple regions. The primary hiring location is China, although applications are welcome from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds and nationalities.

The position is full time and may be based in China or, for an exceptional candidate, one of our other key publishing locations in the UK, the Netherlands, or the United States. Hybrid working arrangements are available in line with local policy.

Responsibilities

  • Journal development: Balance the stewardship of a high-performing portfolio with opportunities to accelerate content growth, strengthen journal positioning, and advance open-access ambitions.

  • Editor appointments: Lead the identification and appointment of editors, building editorial structures that are scientifically strong, internationally representative, diverse, and positioned for future growth.

  • Strategic partnerships: Develop and deepen relationships with learned societies, editorial boards, institutions, and other influential partners, translating community insight into effective publishing strategy.

  • Community engagement: Represent the team externally through conferences, institutional visits, editorial meetings, and other community activities. Build strong relationships across the global physics community and identify emerging needs and opportunities.

  • Regional development: Support the continued growth and visibility of the portfolio in key research markets, including China and the wider Asia-Pacific region. Candidates with experience working with Chinese research institutions, established regional networks, or knowledge of the local academic environment will be particularly well placed to contribute in this area.

  • Brand visibility: Champion the reputation and visibility of the journal portfolio, monitor the competitive landscape, and ensure effective engagement with authors, editors, reviewers, and readers.

  • Team leadership: Act as a mentor and role model within the team, support colleagues’ development, lead collaborative initiatives, and contribute to the wider strategy and culture of the Physics Journals team.

Requirements

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills

  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience; a background in physics or a related discipline is desirable but not essential

  • Significant experience in scholarly publishing, ideally including responsibility for a journals portfolio

  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage strategic relationships with editorial, academic, institutional, or society partners

  • Strong leadership presence and a track record of mentoring and supporting colleagues

  • A proactive, adaptable, and collaborative approach

  • The ability to work effectively across cultures, locations, and levels of seniority

  • Willingness to travel internationally and engage directly with research communities

Desirable Experience

  • Experience working with the Chinese or wider Asia-Pacific research community

  • Strong knowledge of the academic and institutional landscape in China

  • Existing relationships with researchers, editors, societies, or institutions in the region

  • Mandarin-language capability

  • Experience developing open-access journals, launching new titles, or establishing strategic publishing partnerships

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working for you

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Medical and Life Insurance: Coverage for Medical and life risk.

  • Long-Service Award: Recognition for loyalty and dedication.

  • Marriage and New Baby Gifts: Celebratory tokens for special life events.

  • Festivals and Birthday Gifts: Spreading joy on occasions that matter.

  • Annual Medical Check-up: Prioritizing employee well-being through regular health check-ups.

  • Flexible Benefits via CIIC Platform: Personalized benefits accessible through a user-friendly platform.

  • Paid Time Off: Annual Leave, Flex Family Care Leave, Birthday Leave, Marriage Leave, Compassionate Leave, Medical and Hospitalization Leave, Examination Leave Gazetted Public Holiday

  • Family Care leave (Maternity/Paternity Leave and Adoption Leave)

About the Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: Food & Beverage Server | Treyburn Country Club
description:

Full-time positions offer outstanding benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, 401(k), paid time off, and a daily complimentary staff meal.

_________ Country Club is a McConnell Golf Property. To learn more about the club, please visit our website at ___________. To learn more about McConnell Golf, please visit www.mcconnellgolf.com.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

• Sets up side station and performs assigned side (prep) work.

• Provides immediate attention to all members and guests upon seating.

• Makes sure that children are in the appropriate type of seat and are safe and secure.

• Distributes food and wine menus; answers questions.

• Fills glasses with ice water and suggests menu items.

• Ensure that the correct account numbers and names are given for billing.

• Efficiently serves food and drinks in a friendly and courteous manner, offers suggestions on daily specials and wine selections.

• Places orders with kitchen; informs cooks about any special cooking instructions.

• Assembles food on tray; procures items from each station as necessary.

• Serves meals; places dishes by courses in front of each person.

• Checks back to ensure member and guest satisfaction; replenishes water and butter as necessary.

• Removes soiled dishes. Clears tables after each course and resets them with appropriate silverware.

• Presents dessert menus, suggests and serves dessert, coffee and after-dinner drinks.

• Verifies accuracy of prices, state and federal taxes, tips and other charges on all checks.

• Presents the bill.

• Handles all member charge and credit card charges as prescribed by standard operating procedures.

• Keeps dining room and bus station areas clean.

• Clears, cleans and resets tables that have been vacated.

• Advises supervisor of any complaints as soon as they occur.

• Performs clean-up and closing duties as assigned by manager.

• Attends pre-meal meetings as requested by the Dining Room Manager or other Food and Beverage Manager.

• Turns in signed tip declaration form as appropriate.

• Thanks members and guests; invites them to return.

• Consistently follows local and state laws and the club’s policies and procedures for the service of alcoholic beverages to members and guests.

• Performs other appropriate duties assigned by Dining Room Manager or other Food and Beverage Manager.

Qualifications

Education and/or Experience

• Grade 12 education.

• Two years of comparable wait service experience preferred.

• The ability to read, write and execute basic math skills.

Job Knowledge, Core Competencies and Expectations

• Greet and acknowledge members and guests.

• Is knowledgeable about the menu, buffet and wine list.

• Ability to time the service of each course.

• Learns members’ names and their special preferences.

• Knowledge of wines and spirits.

• Knowledge of and ability to perform required role during emergency situations.

Licenses and Special Requirements

• Food safety certification.

• Of legal age to serve alcoholic beverages.

• Alcoholic beverage certification.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

• Required to stand for long periods and walk, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, bend, stretch and twist or reach.

• Push, pull or lift up to 50 pounds.

• Continuous repetitive motions.

• Work in hot, humid and noisy environment.

Salary Range

USD $14.00 - USD $16.00 /Hr.

title: Ikke uddannet personale til overvejende rengøringsopgaver søges til Team Nord
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel hos de ældre borgere og hjælpe dem i hverdagen? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et tværfagligt team med højt til loftet, sammenhold og fokus på det gode arbejde? Så er det måske lige dig, vi mangler i Team Nord!

Team Nord søger netop dig, som vægter det faglige arbejde højt og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

Hvad gør denne stilling attraktiv?

Du skal søge stillingen, hvis du først og fremmest kan trives med at komme i borgerhjem og hjælpe med primært rengøringsopgaver, men vi ser også gerne, at du har mod på at hjælpe med f.eks. at servere morgenmaden eller andre lettere plejeopgaver i borgerens hjem.

Rengøring indbefatter også dokumentation i omsorgssystemet KMD Nexus.

Du skal arbejde i dagtimerne - typisk mellem kl. 7-16 og har fri i weekenderne.

Hvem er vi?

Team Nord er et af de større udekørende hjemmeplejeteams. Vi er engageret og arbejder meget tværfagligt. Vi dækker både by og land – inklusive øerne Fejø, Femø og Askø.
I dag består vi af 47 medarbejdere plus beredskab fordelt på SSA’er, SSH’er, planlæggere og en sygeplejefaglig koordinator.

Vi har et klart fokus på vores kerneopgave: At yde den bedst mulige pleje og omsorg for vores borgere med høj faglighed, selvstændighed og samarbejde.

Vi arbejder aktivt med vidensdeling og tværfaglighed, og du får rig mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Vores base er på Lykkeseje plejecenter i Søllested, tæt på både bus og tog.

Hvorfor vælge os?

Du bliver en del af et dedikeret og ambitiøst team.
  • Du får en arbejdsplads i positiv udvikling, hvor der er plads til at dygtiggøre dig.
  • Vi prioriterer vidensdeling og faglig sparring.
  • Du får gode, støttende kollegaer.
  • Den nye ældrelov åbner for spændende muligheder – Vil du med på rejsen?
Som ny kollega får du en grundig introduktion til både teamet og organisationen Ældre & Sundhed i Lolland Kommune.

Vi forventer, at du:
  • Er ansvarsbevidst, stabil, fleksibel, men også loyal over for de fælles og ledelsesmæssige beslutninger.
  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og tværfagligt.
  • Bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Har gode IT-kundskaber (kendskab til KMD Nexus er en fordel, ikke et krav).
  • Kan tale dansk.
  • Har et gyldigt kørekort (Krav).
  • Har noget erfaring indenfor området, men det er ikke et krav.

Du får en leder der:
  • Vægter fagligheden højt - så det er også vigtigt for mig, at du også gør det.
  • Har følgende kerneværdier: Tillid, ordentlighed, ærlighed, åbenhed og respekt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen kan være 37 timer eller andet efter aftale.

Løn efter gældende overenskomst og efter principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Der medfølger mange rettigheder og fordele ved at være ansat i det offentlige, som fx overenskomstforhandlet løn, gode pensionsordninger, 6. ferieuge, særlig feriegodtgørelse, barsel med løn, 2 årlige omsorgsdage pr. barn under 7 år og overenskomstbestemte seniordage.

Eksempel på løn: Social- og sundhedspersonale, der ikke har en social- og sundhedsfaglig uddannelse.
Grundløn: Løntrin 13
Startløn ved 37 timer (Trin 13) kr. 24.991,33.
Pension 14%. Fritvalg 1,29%.

Tiltrædelsesdato er pr. 1 september eller hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfrist er d. 13 august 2026.

Dato for samtaler er ikke fastlagt, men vi kontakter dig, hvis du kommer i betragtning.

Yderligere information

Kontakt Teamleder Monika Sørensen på tlf.: 20 27 47 59.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

title: : Property and Administration Officer, TSVH
location: NSW - Sydney, CBD, Inner West and Eastern Suburbs
description:
Job Description:

Role title: Property and Administration Officer, TSVH

Role type: Max term contract full time (until Mid-August 2027)

Role grade: Health Services Manager Grade 1

Department and location: Finance, St Vincent’s Public Hospital, Sydney

Salary: $87,813.00 - $116,824.00 + super + salary packaging

Welcome to St Vincent’s Hospital Sydney

An opportunity has arisen for the position of Property and Administration Officer, Trustees of St Vincent’s Hospital (TSVH) at St Vincent’s Hospital Sydney. The Property and Administration Officer, TSVH, will report to and provide support to, the Senior Manager, Project and Property Assets, TSVH.

The position is responsible for supporting the operations of TSVH in accordance with the Mission and Values of St Vincent’s Hospital Sydney.

Join a team built on a proud legacy of world-class care, true compassion, and deep community roots.

Founded by the Sisters of Charity and powered today by St Vincent’s Health Australia, the Sisters' legacy of compassionate service is our living heartbeat. As Sydney’s premier and iconic inner-city public hospital, we serve the entire population, providing world-class care to all people, including the most vulnerable in our community. Across our renowned precinct, we feature cutting-edge programs and surgery infrastructure, fostering clinical excellence and professional growth.

Located in the vibrant heart of Darlinghurst, we are positioned just minutes from Kings Cross station, with direct, high-frequency bus connections from the east, and seamless links from Gadigal and Museum stations right to our doorstep.

Read on to explore this exciting role and the fantastic perks waiting for you here.

About the role

  • Manage property and lease administration for the TSVH property portfolio – Coordinate lease and licence agreements, monitor tenant compliance, maintain lease registers, and manage CPI, rent reviews and insurance documentation.

  • Keep operations running smoothly – Provide high-level administrative support, including diary management, meeting coordination, reports, document control, purchase orders, invoices and finance administration.

  • Support a diverse TSVH property portfolio – Assist with property projects, inspections, maintenance coordination and operational activities across St Vincent's property assets.

  • Coordinate TSVH car parking services – Manage parking applications, approvals, payroll deductions, invoicing, customer enquiries and the annual staff car park ballot.

  • Build strong stakeholder relationships – Work closely with tenants, contractors and internal teams to deliver responsive customer service and ensure efficient day-to-day property operations.

About you

  • Experience in property, facilities or office administration, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Highly organised, proactive and able to work independently while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and work effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Strong administration, customer service and financial administration experience, with a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint), with the ability to quickly learn new systems and technologies.

What we can offer you

  • Exceptional Rewards: Competitive pay and not-for-profit salary packaging to maximise your income

  • Seamless NSW Health Mobility: Smooth transfer of your qualifying service and leave entitlements

  • World-Class: Be part of a renowned precinct alongside the Garvan & Victor Chang institutes

  • Excellence: Premier heart/lung transplant program, advanced robotics, & pioneering HIV/AIDS initiatives

  • Cutting-Edge Oncology: Deliver advanced cancer care and trials at the renowned Kinghorn Cancer Centre

  • Community: Support vital programs for First Nations, homelessness, mental health, & drug and alcohol care

  • Professional Advancement: Accelerate your career with study leave and Curran Foundation scholarships

  • Health & Wellbeing: Fitness Passport, discounted private health, & cultural recognitions and celebrations

Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

Please note, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For this role you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or have an Australia visa that grants you the work rights necessary for the role.

Equal opportunity

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone.

As part of our commitment to reconciliation, we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply and join us in delivering care that heals body, mind, spirit and community.

How to apply

The closing date for applications is 14 August 2026. Shortlisting for this position will commence immediately. We encourage you to apply promptly as the advertisement may close early should a suitable applicant be sourced.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting how your interest, skills, and experience align with each of the things listed in the About You section of this job advert.

Respectfully, this role is not open to recruitment agencies.

title: Airside Experience Leader
description:
As an Airside Experience Leader, you guide and support the Airside Experience team, ensuring services for aircraft, crew, cargo, and guests are delivered with precision, safety, and exceptional care. You are not only a hands-on contributor; you’re also a hospitality-focused leader, helping your team create seamless and welcoming experiences for every guest in our facilities.

You’ll provide oversight of airside operations, step in to resolve guest concerns, and act as the primary escalation point when support is needed beyond the scope of Airside Experience Specialists or Associates. With a strong understanding of company policies and a proactive approach, you lead your team to maintain operational excellence while keeping guest satisfaction front and center.

This role requires a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, and the ability to work in outdoor environments near active aircraft and equipment. If you’re passionate about safety, service, and leading with professionalism in a dynamic setting, this is a powerful next step in your hospitality career.

(Other duties may be assigned)

  • Monitor the performance of Airside Experience Specialists and/or Associates to ensure technical accuracy, demeanor, and adherence to Company policies and procedures. Correct performance as needed and alert management to any ongoing concerns.
  • Coordinate, assign duties, and provide shift supervision to qualified Airside Experience Specialists and/or Associates on shift.
  • Provide on-the-job training and assistance to Airside Experience Specialists and/or Associates.
  • Serve as a resource on all guest service matters and as an escalation point for guest inquiries.
  • Work as part of a team to conduct airside operations safely and efficiently in accordance with established policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) ensuring efficient and accurate communication through various methods to accomplish operational tasks.
  • Collaborate, cooperate, and work closely with all team members, guests, clients, vendors, and aircraft crewmembers to ensure service needs are always met. Services include, but not limited to, cargo service operations, fueling, de-icing, lavatory, ground power and potable water services, parking, marshalling, wing walking, delivering catering and towing.
  • Proactively prepare for arriving/departing aircraft, identify and perform open job tasks, and immediately speak up and/or point out observed safety concerns to all stakeholders.
  • Operate and drive ground service equipment such as fuel trucks, de-icing trucks, ground power units, tugs, stair trucks, and other freight handling equipment.
  • Load and unload luggage and other cargo into/out of aircraft and from/into the private aviation terminal (PAT), guest vehicles, or other modes of transportation.
  • Provide professional and friendly guest service while showing a positive and helpful attitude to everyone at all times ensuring our guests always receive an exceptional experience.
  • Offer safe, convenient, and courteous transportation when driving shuttle vehicle with guests, luggage and cargo.
  • Maintain safe, clean, and secure ramps and operations.
  • Fuel handling, including fuel quality control, fuel receipt, inventory and maintaining accurate related documentation.
  • Understand, comply with, and enforce all operational, safety, and guest service requirements for all aspects of the job.
  • Stop work when an unsafe condition or act is likely to cause harm to people, the environment, our assets, or to our reputation if the work continues. Report concerns to the appropriate manager and cooperate in addressing the unsafe act or condition.
  • Abide by emergency response procedures when/if critical events occur.
  • Understand, comply with, and enforce all security (physical, cyber and data) protocols as dictated by both Signature Aviation and the airport.
  • Create accurate records pertaining to time worked and activities and services performed.

Minimum Education and/or Experience:

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
  • One (1) to two (2) years of experience and/or training in aviation or cargo operations or an equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
  • Trained and signed off to perform specialty responsibilities (e.g. oil and oxygen service for aircraft) and other required certifications (e.g. towing, deicing) as required by base specific operations.
  • Minimum of 18 years of age.
  • Ability to pass company background checks (criminal and motor vehicle), drug tests, meet airport background check requirements to receive and maintain an airport security badge, and be insurable by the Company's applicable insurance policies.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the jurisdiction of employment.
  • Excellent vision and coordination to move and/or direct aircraft and visually inspect aircraft fuel.
  • Ability to pass a color vision test for purposes of inspecting aviation fuel.
  • Must possess a valid state driver’s license. In some locations a commercial driver’s license (CDL) is required as dictated by local regulations and business needs.
  • Must be able to exercise good judgment and follow directions/directives from supervisor/management.

Additional essential knowledge and essential skills:

  • Hospitality Skills: Excellent guest service skills with an energetic, outgoing, and guest-obsessed personality. Must be able to anticipate and act on guest needs and prioritize guest requests and job responsibilities by exhibiting a keen ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. Must be able to maintain professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Leadership Skills: Ability to assign tasks wisely, provide feedback to improve performance, and motivate others.
  • Language Skills: Ability to read and comprehend documents such as safety rules, operating instructions, and procedure manuals, and for safety-sensitive tasks, in English. Clearly communicate in English with others in person, via telephone, radio communicators, and in writing. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Math Skills: Ability to perform simple arithmetic (e.g., addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, fractions, angles, degrees, time).
  • Communication Skills: Able to use telephone, fax, two-way radio, email, and text messaging to contact guests, crew members, team members, or emergency personnel. Ability to speak effectively before groups of guests or team members and present information and respond to inquiries.
  • Physical Ability: Must be able to physically enter/exit and operate motor vehicles and ground support equipment such as fuel trucks, vans, tugs, freight handling equipment, and cars. Must be able to perform various functions safely and efficiently (e.g., fueling, de-icing) from elevated heights.
  • Critical Thinking / Reasoning Ability: Ability to use rational thought to analyze and evaluate information, and to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Ability to get along and work well with others. Excellent interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with team members and service to guests.
  • Multitasking: Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Computer Skills: Ability to use a computer and email, including pass computer-based training modules, and ability to learn company software.
  • Task Management: Ability to successfully and timely complete Signature’s training programs.

title: QC Specialist, Kemi – ALS Odense
location: Lille Tornbjerg Vej 24, 5220 Odense SØ, Danmark
description:
Bliv QC specialist hos ALS Odense
Er du nysgerrig på analytisk kemi og motiveres af at sikre kvaliteten af analysedata? Har du interesse for instrumentelle analyser som ICP, AAS, GC og HPLC, og trives du med faglige vurderinger i et GMP-reguleret miljø? Så kan du være den QC Specialist, vi søger til Team Instrumental Analyses hos ALS Odense. Hos os bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø med varierede opgaver og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.


ALS Odense er et veletableret GMP-kontraktlaboratorium med over 30 års erfaring. Vi tilbyder mikrobiologiske og kemiske analyser samt stabilitetsstudier og understøtter dermed kvalitetskontrol af kundernes lægemidler gennem hele produktets livscyklus - fra udvikling til frigivelse. Vi er cirka 35 medarbejdere og råder over 3.200 m² moderne laboratorie- og kontorfaciliteter.


Om stillingen
Du bliver en del af Team Instrumental Analyses, som har ansvar for udførelse, vurdering og rapportering af instrumentelle kemiske analyser. Teamet sikrer samtidig, at laboratoriets aktiviteter og analyser udføres i overensstemmelse med gældende GMP-krav. Analyserne omfatter blandt andet ICP, AAS, GC og HPLC og udføres primært efter farmakopémetoder fra Ph. Eur. og USP samt metoder udviklet og valideret hos ALS Odense.
Som QC specialist er dine opgaver at:


•Godkende data fra QC-analyser og rapportere til kunder.
•Fortolke og implementere kemiske farmakopémetoder i samarbejde med teamet.
•Vedligeholde og kvalificere laboratorieudstyr, herunder ICP-, AAS-, GC- og HPLC-systemer.
•Udarbejde og behandle OOS-sager, afvigelser, ændringssager og CAPA’er relateret til analyser og udstyr.
•Bidrage til løbende forbedring og optimering af laboratoriets processer.

Stillingen giver dig mulighed for at kombinere analytisk kemi, GMP og faglig problemløsning i en rolle med ansvar for både analyser, dataevaluering og laboratorieudstyr.
Du bliver en del af et kompetent team bestående af fire laboranter og en anden QC Specialist og får et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens øvrige QC specialister samt QA-afdelingen. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af fagområder og bruger aktivt hinanden som sparringspartnere, når komplekse problemstillinger skal løses.


Din profil
Du er farmaceut, cand.scient. i kemi eller anden relevant naturvidenskabelig uddannelse. Erfaring fra den farmaceutiske industri og arbejde under GMP er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi opfordrer også nyuddannede kandidater med interesse for analytisk kemi og et ønske om at udvikle sig fagligt til at søge. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med ICP-, AAS-, HPLC- og/eller GC-analyser, f.eks. fra tidligere ansættelser, projekter eller speciale.
For at få succes i stillingen ser vi gerne, at du:


•Har interesse for instrumentel analytisk kemi og laboratorieudstyr.
•Arbejder systematisk, struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst.
•Kan planlægge og prioritere dine opgaver, så du sikrer fremdrift og overholder deadlines.
•Trives med både rutineprægede opgaver og faglige udfordringer
•Trives med at arbejde indenfor rammerne af et veletableret kvalitetssystem.
•Har en pragmatisk og løsningsorienteret tilgang til komplekse problemstillinger.
•Er åben for dialog og samarbejde med både kolleger og kunder.
•Motiveres af at forstå sammenhænge og bidrage til udvikling af laboratoriets arbejde.


Yderligere oplysninger?
•Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.
•Hvis du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, så kontakt QC Manager Laura Hyrup Møller, på tlf. 29810278 eller mail: laura.moller@alsglobal.com
•Send dit målrettede CV indeholdende en motivation for stillingen som QC Specialist hos ALS Odense på mail til: EUODN.application@alsglobal.com senest 23. August 2026.
•Jobsamtaler afholdes i uge 36.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.


Om ALS
ALS Odense har siden maj 2022 været en del af ALS Global, der har over 430 sites verden, herunder 29 pharma-sites. Det globale netværk med specialister fra andre sites i Norden og resten af verden giver medarbejdere hos ALS Odense ideelle sparrings- og udviklingsmuligheder.
Fakta om ALS (Australian Laboratory Services) kan du finde på https://www.alsglobal.com/en/about.
Fakta om ALS Odense (tidligere DB Lab) kan du finde på https://www.dblab.dk

title: Senior Development Chemist
description:
Senior Development Chemist

. . . . . . .. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

Are you an experienced pharmaceutical scientist with a passion for analytical method development, validation, and solving complex technical challenges? Join a collaborative team where you'll lead complex development projects, support regulatory submissions, and provide technical leadership across a diverse portfolio of products.

  • Full time permanent role
  • Global researcher & manufacturer of animal health pharmaceuticals
  • South Auckland location with onsite parking

We are in the animal health business, partnering with our clients in the areas of Research and Development (R&D) and manufacturing to produce pharmaceuticals for both farm and companion animals. Originally founded in 2006 by a New Zealand chemist with an entrepreneurial mindset, Argenta’s vision is “Healthy Animals. Let’s Make It Happen, Together”. Our recipe for success has been our uniqueness in our vision and our people. Argenta now has operations across 6 sites with locations in New Zealand, the United States, Scotland, Spain, and Germany with over 900 employees globally.

About the role:

With several exciting projects in the pipeline, we have a great opportunity for a Senior Development Chemist to join our CDO team.

This team conducts contract pharmaceutical development of animal health products that involves product development from Proof-of-Concept stage to product registration and is responsible for producing all source documents for regulatory submissions. Having a global client base, Argenta is unique in terms of the incredible variety of projects we undertake, so this role is sure to keep the right person busy and challenged.

You will be dealing with multi-national pharmaceutical companies located all over the world, therefore building and maintaining relationships is absolutely vital.



About you:



Your background will be at least 10+ years in the pharmaceutical industry where you have conducted analysis, development and validation of analytical methods as well as lead previous projects.

You have a proven ability to generate high-quality technical documentation, including validation protocols, method development reports, stability reports, and regulatory support documents. Your attention to detail and commitment to scientific excellence ensure your work is accurate, compliant, and fit for purpose.

By nature, you’ll be an energetic, driven person with a desire to look for ways to do things smarter, more efficiently among the team.


Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting analyses, development and validation of analytical method projects
  • Leading analytical projects from a technical and customer perspective
  • Generating, documenting, and reviewing technical data for clients and regulatory agencies of a high standard
  • Meeting project deadlines and milestones on time
  • Effectively communicate project progress to all stakeholders both internal and external
  • Provide technical training and mentoring to other members of the team

Your background, experience and attributes will include:



  • A tertiary qualification of degree or higher in Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences
  • Strong relationship management and communication skills, both written and verbal (English is essential)
  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry or related field
  • Strong analytical technique knowledge and able to write high quality technical documents
  • Proactive initiative that enjoys working both independently and within a team
  • Approach problems with a solutions-focused mindset but able to manage your time effectively to deliver

Why Join Us?



This is an opportunity to join a unique and fast-growing business where your ideas matter, your skills will grow, and your contribution is genuinely valued. Along with a competitive salary, you’ll enjoy performance based yearly bonus, comprehensive insurance cover, access to EAP support, fresh fruit every week, and regular on-site events that bring people together.

You will also be part of a workplace that truly values its people and encourages collaboration, fresh thinking, and doing great work together. If you are an experienced professional looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we want to hear from you!

To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience and motivation for the role.

title: Student assistant: Statistical Analysis/Data Management for a Longitudinal Research Project on Social Entrepreneurship Education

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
About Clarity RCM

Clarity RCM is the nation’s leading revenue cycle platform for dermatology, partnering with independent practices in over 40 states to improve financial performance, streamline operations, and deliver exceptional patient experiences. We are a profitable, fast-growing company with a fully remote U.S. team and a large in-office operation in India.

The Role

US-Based Candidates only. International applicants will not be considered.

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and execution-focused Credentialing Specialist who will own provider enrollment, credentialing workflows, and payer setup for dermatology practices nationwide. This is a critical role that requires someone who can make sense of complex, disparate information and turn it into clear, repeatable processes.

The ideal candidate thrives in environments that need more structure. You enjoy bringing order to moving parts, synthesizing information from many sources, and building systems where none exist. You take pride in creating workflows, organizing information, documenting steps, and establishing processes that allow the credentialing function to scale.

You should be comfortable with complex requirements, persistent follow-up, and maintaining accurate, audit-ready documentation at all times. You are tech savvy, proactive, and committed to delivering clean, reliable work that enables providers to practice without interruption.

What You Will Do

Credentialing and Provider Onboarding

  • Own the full lifecycle of credentialing for physicians and advanced practice providers, including initial onboarding, primary source verification, re-credentialing, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Verify education, training, licenses, board certifications, malpractice insurance, and work history with complete accuracy.
  • Ensure all credentialing files meet NCQA, TJC, CMS, and payer-specific requirements.

Payer Enrollment and Maintenance

  • Prepare, submit, and track enrollment applications with commercial payers including BCBS, UHC, Aetna, and Cigna, as well as Medicare and Medicaid.
  • Manage CAQH ProView including quarterly attestations and document maintenance.
  • Process Medicare enrollments and updates through PECOS.
  • Verify that providers are correctly linked to group tax IDs to prevent out-of-network billing issues.
  • Track effective dates and panel statuses and communicate updates to internal stakeholders.

Process Building and Workflow Design

  • Create structure in areas that currently have few or inconsistent processes.
  • Organize credentialing inputs from multiple sources and turn them into clear workflows, trackers, and checklists.
  • Identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and implement improvements that enhance accuracy, speed, and consistency.
  • Document processes and maintain updated SOPs that support ongoing team alignment and scale.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal teams to keep credentialing and enrollment workflows moving.
  • Support account managers, operations, and revenue cycle teams by providing accurate status updates and resolving credentialing-related blockers.
  • Partner with billing and AR teams to investigate and resolve claim denials caused by credentialing or enrollment issues.

Data Management and Documentation

  • Maintain accurate provider data across CAQH, PECOS, payer portals, and internal systems.
  • Own a master tracker that includes effective dates, expirables, re-credentialing deadlines, panel statuses, and outstanding items.
  • Keep all credentialing records continuously audit-ready with complete and up-to-date documentation.

Licensing Support

  • Monitor expiring state licenses, DEA registrations, malpractice insurance, and board certifications.
  • Communicate proactively with providers to ensure renewals are completed well before expiration dates.

What You Will Bring

  • Experience: 2 to 3 years of hands-on medical credentialing or payer enrollment experience.
  • Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with CAQH, PECOS, payer portals, and credentialing software. Strong understanding of NCQA, TJC, CMS, and standard credentialing requirements.
  • Structure Building: A track record of bringing order to complex or unstructured environments and building processes that scale.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to identify inconsistencies instantly and maintain clean, accurate files.
  • Follow-Through: Persistent and professional when gathering documentation or resolving gaps.
  • Communication: Clear, concise, and confident written and verbal communication skills.
  • Technology Mindset: Comfortable navigating multiple systems and adopting new tools.
  • Judgment: Ability to handle PHI and sensitive information with complete discretion.
  • Mindset: Process-driven, organized, proactive, resourceful, and committed to continuous improvement.

Additional Details

Location: Fully remote role based in the United States.

Compensation: Competitive salary with benefits, commensurate with experience.

Why Join Clarity RCM

At Clarity, you will join a mission-driven, founder-led organization transforming how independent dermatology practices operate. You will help build a credentialing function known for accuracy, speed, and reliability, and you will be part of a culture that values operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

description:

Shaping the future of real estate for a better world

At JLL, we see a Brighter Way forward for our clients, our people, our planet, and our communities. With over 200 years of real estate experience, we are, and always have been, in continual pursuit of brighter ways of working.

What this opportunity involves:

As a Concierge/Experience Ambassador at JLL, you'll be the vibrant heartbeat of our Auckland workplace, creating exceptional experiences for clients, employees, and visitors from the moment they arrive. Working closely with the Workplace Manager and Guest Experience Lead, you'll blend outstanding hospitality with operational excellence—managing everything from front-of-house services and event coordination to vendor oversight and facility operations. This dynamic role goes far beyond traditional reception duties; you'll be actively engaging with stakeholders at all levels, orchestrating memorable events, and ensuring our workplace runs seamlessly. At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way for our clients, ourselves, and our fellow employees, and as an Experience Ambassador, you'll play a central role in bringing that vision to life every day. You'll also provide crucial support during emergency situations, manage IT assets, oversee procurement processes, and ensure our facilities meet the highest safety and operational standards. With 24/7 emergency call support responsibilities and the opportunity to work autonomously, no two days will be the same in this engaging, multifaceted position.


An overview of the role:

  • Welcome visitors, manage reception duties, handle visitor badges, book meeting rooms, escort guests, set up new employees (badges, parking, laptops, inductions), and manage calls and mail
  • Coordinate workplace events with the team—order catering, set up rooms, send calendar invites, and ensure health and safety compliance
  • Track supplies through regular checks, do daily site inspections to keep areas tidy, and update front desk documents in OneNote and SharePoint
  • Manage vendors and IT equipment to meet quality, timeline, and budget standards while following company procedures and tracking assets accurately
  • Run JLL's risk management program, monitor building operations, suggest improvements, ensure critical requirements are met, and be available for emergency support 24/7


Sounds like you? This is what we are looking for:

  • Proven customer service experience with a professional approach and confidence working with senior staff at all levels
  • Strong organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines in fast-paced environments
  • Understanding of workplace health and safety requirements, including emergency response and business continuity
  • Excellent communication skills—speaking, writing, listening, and presenting to different audiences
  • Self-starter with a positive attitude who works well independently and in teams, builds strong relationships, stays flexible, and balances multiple priorities

On-site –Auckland, New Zealand

The University of Nevada, Reno is recruiting for a Research Administrator, Pre-Award in the Office of Sponsored Projects. Research is a vital mission of the University of Nevada, Reno. The primary responsibilities of the Research Administrators consist of assisting and serving faculty and staff in seeking and managing sponsored funding for research, service projects, and other creative activities. The Research Administrators are responsible for ensuring programmatic and fiscal accountability for stewardship of public funds.

This position also serves as a point of contact for liaison between the University and federal agencies, foundations, private industry, state, and local agencies. The Research Administrator assists faculty with proposal review and processing of Requests for Proposals (RFP) to determine sponsor regulatory requirements, proposal submission methods, certifications and terms. The University of Nevada, Reno is committed to providing a place of work and learning free of discrimination on the basis of a person’s age (40 or older), disability, whether actual or perceived by others (including service-connected disabilities), gender (including pregnancy related conditions), military status or military obligations, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, national origin, race (including hair texture and protected hairstyles such as natural hairstyles, afros, bantu knots, curls, braids, locks and twists), color, or religion (protected classes).

About Us

The University of Nevada, Reno is a leading public research university committed to the promise of a future powered by knowledge. Founded in 1874 as Nevada’s original land-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries.

Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News & World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.”

Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics.

The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as “University Village,” to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty.

Collaborating with world-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry-level software engineers by graduation.

In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada – led by the University of Nevada, Reno – was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state.

Through its commitment to high-impact education, world-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world.

The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience.

Today, the University delivers on its original land-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education.

For more information, please visit the University’s website.

title: Cloud Service Delivery Manager
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Position Summary

The Cloud Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery, reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of enterprise cloud services across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments. This role serves as the primary liaison between Cloud Operations, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to ensure cloud platforms meet service level objectives, operational standards, compliance requirements, and business expectations.

The successful candidate will drive operational governance, incident and problem management, service performance, capacity planning, financial optimization, vendor management, and continuous service improvement while fostering a culture of accountability, automation, resiliency, and customer focus.

Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery & Operations Management

  • Own end-to-end delivery and operational performance of cloud infrastructure and platform services.
  • Ensure services meet or exceed defined SLAs, SLOs, availability targets, and customer expectations.
  • Lead operational governance reviews and service performance reporting with senior leadership.
  • Monitor service health, capacity, utilization, and operational risks across cloud environments.
  • Establish and maintain operational runbooks, service documentation, and support processes.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on stability, automation, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead root cause analysis efforts and ensure corrective actions are implemented for major incidents.
  • Develop and track key operational metrics and KPIs.
  • Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to improve platform reliability.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve service quality.

Incident, Problem & Change Management

  • Serve as the escalation point for major incidents and service disruptions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical issue resolution activities.
  • Lead problem management processes to identify recurring issues and implement permanent fixes.
  • Ensure effective change management practices minimize operational risk and service disruption.
  • Facilitate post-incident reviews and executive communications.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Act as the primary interface between Cloud Operations and internal business stakeholders.

title: Sr Associate Product Manager
description:
Sr Associate Product Manager

Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

  • Human Centered

    • You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature design

    • You'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

  • Business Focused

    • Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needs

    • You’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

  • Technology Driven

    • You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology

    • You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customers

    • You’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

  • Transformational Leadership

    • By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teams

    • You’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

We want you if you are:

  • Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges

  • Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you

  • Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work

  • Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs

  • Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help

  • Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or military experience

  • At least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering

  • 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products

  • 1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences

  • 1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process
