title: Senior Scientific Editor, Cell Reports Medicine
description:
Senior Scientific Editor, Cell Reports Medicine

Do you have a PhD, MD, or equivalent in a relevant scientific or clinical discipline?

Do you have previous editorial experience?

Location: London or Oxford (UK), Amsterdam (The Netherlands), or Shanghai, Beijing or Shenzhen (China).

About Our Team

We are seeking a talented and enthusiastic scientist, physician-scientist, or clinician to join the editorial team of Cell Reports Medicine.Cell Reports Medicine is a premium open access journal at Cell Press, publishing impactful research across the full spectrum of translational and clinical science. Our mission is to advance discoveries that bridge fundamental biology and clinical application, with the potential to directly influence patient care and global health. We welcome applications from candidates with expertise across clinical and biomedical disciplines, with particular interest in immunology, metabolism or AI. We are open to candidates at different career stages and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive editorial team. Previous editorial experience is advantageous but not required.

About The Role:

As a Senior Scientific Editor, you will play a central role in shaping the journal’s scientific direction and content. You will oversee the peer review process, engage closely with authors and reviewers, and contribute to defining and advancing the journal’s editorial strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, recruit, and develop high-impact content across translational and clinical research

  • Evaluate submitted manuscripts and manage the peer review process to ensure rigor, fairness, and efficiency

  • Select and collaborate with expert reviewers

  • Engage closely with authors, providing thoughtful guidance and an excellent author experience

  • Commission and edit Reviews, Perspectives, and other front-matter content

  • Contribute to the journal’s editorial strategy and its positioning within the Cell Press portfolio

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the global scientific and clinical community

  • Represent the journal at conferences and through institutional visits

  • Contribute to digital content, including the journal homepage and social media

Requirements

  • A PhD, MD, or equivalent in a relevant scientific or clinical discipline

  • Previous editorial experience is required

  • Broad interest across translational and clinical research

  • Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to evaluate diverse areas of science and medicine

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international team

  • Strong interpersonal and networking skills

  • Established research networks (preferred, particularly for more senior candidates)

  • Interest in scientific publishing, communication, and emerging digital trends

Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to help you succeed. Here, you will find an inclusive, agile, collaborative, innovative and fun environment, where everyone has a part to play. Regardless of the team you join, we promote a diverse environment with co-workers who are passionate about what they do, and how they do it.

Working for you

  • At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy additional days

  • Health screening, eye care vouchers and private medical benefits

  • Wellbeing programs

  • Access to a competitive contributory pension scheme

  • Long service awards

  • Save As You Earn share option scheme

  • Travel Season ticket loan

  • Maternity, paternity and shared parental leave

  • Access to emergency care for both the elderly and children

  • RE CARES days, giving you time to support the charities and causes that matter to you

  • Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer

  • Access to extensive learning and development resources

  • Access to employee discounts via Perks at Work

About Us

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. title: Auditor - Primm Valley Casino Resorts
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Position Summary

The Auditor is responsible for performing daily audit functions and supporting hotel accounting operations to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and completeness of all financial transactions. This position reconciles revenues, balances cash and electronic payment activity, audits departmental transactions, prepares daily financial reports, investigates discrepancies, and ensures compliance with company policies and internal controls. The Auditor plays a critical role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting operational and financial compliance across the resort.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Daily Audit Functions

  • Perform the daily audit process and successfully close the business day within the Property Management System (PMS) and other applicable operating systems.
  • Audit hotel, food and beverage, retail, and other departmental transactions to ensure all revenues and charges have been accurately recorded.
  • Verify guest folios, departmental postings, and account balances for completeness and accuracy.
  • Post room charges, taxes, resort fees, miscellaneous charges, and approved adjustments.
  • Review system-generated reports and identify discrepancies requiring correction or follow-up.
  • Maintain complete, organized, and accurate audit documentation in accordance with company standards.

Financial Reconciliation

  • Reconcile and balance daily financial transactions, including cash, credit card, electronic payment, and other revenue activity.
  • Balance guest ledgers and departmental reports against supporting documentation.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies involving guest accounts, deposits, billing, revenue postings, payment processing, and departmental transactions.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting procedures, internal controls, and company financial policies.
  • Prepare daily balancing reports, revenue summaries, and audit documentation.

Reporting and Administrative Responsibilities

  • Generate, compile, and distribute daily operational, occupancy, financial, and management reports.
  • Prepare reports required by Finance, Accounting, and resort leadership.
  • Maintain accurate audit records, reconciliation logs, and financial filing systems.
  • Communicate financial discrepancies, operational concerns, and system issues promptly to management.
  • Assist with month-end closing activities, special projects, and additional accounting assignments as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associate degree or coursework in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Hospitality, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum one (1) year of accounting, auditing, hospitality, finance, cashiering, or related experience preferred.
  • Previous hotel or resort experience preferred.
  • Experience handling cash reconciliation, balancing financial transactions, and account reconciliation preferred.
  • Experience using Property Management Systems (PMS), accounting software, or financial reporting systems preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong mathematical, accounting, auditing, and reconciliation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to accurately identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Working knowledge of accounting principles, audit procedures, financial reporting, and internal controls.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information with integrity.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Ability to work independently while meeting strict deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain all work cards, permits, and certifications required by local, state, and company regulations.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to stand and walk periodically throughout the workday.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to perform repetitive hand and finger movements for keyboard and calculator use.
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, and flexible schedules as business needs require.

Work Environment

  • Fast-paced resort and hospitality environment operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
  • Frequent interaction with Finance, Accounting, hotel departments, management, and guests.
  • Responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of financial records and daily revenue reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Financial Accountability
  • Attention to Detail
  • Integrity and Confidentiality
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Problem Solving
  • Communication
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Time Management
  • Organizational Skills
  • Adaptability
  • Sound Judgment

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Scientific Editor
description:
Scientific Editor, Matter

Cell Press publishes over 50 scientific journals, including flagship titles such as Cell, Joule, and Matter, and a growing portfolio of discipline-leading journals spanning the life, physical, and applied sciences. We bring editorial excellence, a commitment to innovation, unparalleled reach and visibility, and a passion for scientific advocacy to all areas of exploration.


About the Role

Matter is the flagship materials science title from Cell Press, continuing to grow in influence since its launch in 2019, publishing work that reflects the entirety of the materials science community. We are seeking a Scientific Editor to join the Matter team and contribute to its continued development as a leading venue for materials science. Working closely with and reporting to the Editor in Chief of Matter, the new editor will help shape the scientific direction of the journal, expand its community, and represent the fields the growing Matter family of titles serves across the broader Cell Press portfolio. In addition to handling editorial responsibilities for Matter, this editor will play an active role in identifying and routing high-quality manuscripts to other Cell Press journals.


Responsibilities

  • Undertaking editorial evaluation of submissions to ensure the scientific quality and broader significance of published work.
  • Developing a cohesive, impactful, and forward-looking journal that reflects Matter's scope.
  • Coordinating at least one special issue per year in collaboration with the editorial team.
  • Drawing on and expanding a network of leading researchers to attract influential submissions to Matter and the wider Cell Press portfolio.
  • Identifying outstanding materials science manuscripts suitable for transfer or commissioning across Cell Press journals, and acting as an ambassador for these fields throughout the organization.
  • Traveling to relevant conferences and research institutes to build community, identify emerging science, and promote Matter.
  • Collaborating with colleagues across sales, marketing, and production to support the journal's growth targets and strategic objectives.
  • Fostering productive relationships with other editorial teams across the Cell Press portfolio.


Requirements

  • A PhD in a field relevant to Matter's scope; preferably a strong background in materials science, although candidates with expertise in highly relevant tangential areas (i.e., physical chemistry, condensed matter physics) are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience with emerging AI tools a plus, but not necessary.
  • Prior editorial experience is preferred; exceptional early-career candidates with a strong research background will be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to think conceptually and critically across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.
  • Strong existing networks within materials research communities, with the ability to engage effectively with researchers at all career stages and across international boundaries.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.

title: Cybersecurity Advisor - IAM | Remote, TX, MO, KS, or OK
description:
This position will be remote and can be hired in TX, MO, KS, or OK, ideally near Dallas or Houston.

The Cybersecurity Advisor (or Security Advisor / SA as we call it) plays a critical role in serving as a trusted partner to Optiv’s clients. By combining sales skills and broad security practitioner knowledge, the SA designs security solutions for assigned clients. Aligned with their client's security initiatives and alongside a dedicated sales team, the SA advises and designs solutions for highly defensible and scalable security programs using some of the most advanced security services and technologies. The SA has real-world knowledge and can design pragmatic security solutions tailored to each client’s unique environment and provide clients and sellers with consistent security expertise on all sales opportunities.

The SA will provide expertise in one or more of the following Domains: Data Protection & AI; Cloud Security/DevSecOps; Endpoint Security; Identity; Network Security; Offensive Security; Operations (SOC, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Threat Intelligence). The SA will facilitate thought leadership and inspire cybersecurity solutions powered by our ecosystem of people, products, and partners.

How you'll make an impact

  • Drive the generation services and technologies business to meet or exceed quarterly and annual quota objectives in partnership with the account teams. Following the Optiv Standardized Sales Operating Processes (SOPs) to achieve consistent success.

  • Understand and maintain knowledge of the client’s security environment, business operations, security needs, and risk appetite. Identify their security concerns and how they correlate to Optiv’s strategic solutions across the assigned domains and holistic cybersecurity programs.

  • Actively participate in the Field Center of Excellence for the assigned domain and position Optiv services and our key technology partners and their products to deliver value to clients.

  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities across clients and Optiv's partner relationships. Qualify leads and partner with internal colleagues to determine scope, proposal management, and follow through to closure. Participate in sales opportunities across Optiv's entire portfolio.

title: Få et fleksibelt job og gør en forskel for en ældre i 4500 Nykøbing Sj
description:

Vi søger dig, der har hjertet på rette sted og lyst til at hjælpe den ældre generation.

Som Hjælper får du mulighed for at gøre en stor forskel for andre mennesker, der virkelig har brug for din hjælp – og samtidig får du lidt ekstra ind på bankkontoen.

Du bestemmer selv, hvor meget du ønsker at arbejde, og hvilke arbejdsopgaver du vil påtage dig.

For at blive Hjælper skal du være fyldt 18 år.

Her bliver du klædt på til opgaven og har mulighed for at stille spørgsmål.

title: To pædagoger - én fælles mulighed
description:
To pædagogstillinger – én fælles mulighed for at gøre en forskel

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for børn – hver dag? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor faglighed, trivsel og udvikling går hånd i hånd? Så læs med her!

Vi søger to engagerede pædagoger til Gug Skole og DUS – hver med sin unikke rolle, men med fælles fokus på børns trivsel og udvikling i både undervisning og fritid.

Om stillingerne

Vi tror på, at børn trives bedst, når de bliver mødt med respekt, tydelighed og nærvær. Derfor arbejder vi tæt sammen – på tværs af årgange og faggrupper – for at skabe de bedste rammer for børnenes læring og sociale udvikling.

Du bliver en vigtig del af både skole og DUS, hvor du indgår i et tæt samarbejde med lærere og pædagoger. Du får mulighed for at præge både skoledagen og fritidstilbuddet med dine idéer, din energi og dine kompetencer.

Hos os er du ikke låst i én funktion – vi er en stor skole med mange muligheder, og der kan være mulighed for at blive en del af andre årgange og opgaver fra skoleår til skoleår, alt efter kompetencer, interesser og skolens behov.

Vores DUS er opdelt i 3 afdelinger:

  • Børnehaveklassehuset
  • Væksthuset (1.-2. årgang)
  • Fælleshuset (3.-6. årgang)

Opgaverne for kommende skoleår er placeret hhv. som årgangspædagog i vores Børnehaveklassehus og som årgangspædagog på 5. årgang og derved i Fælleshuset.

Arbejdstiden ligger inden for tidsrummet kl. 6.30–17.00 med enkelte aftenarrangementer. Som en del af Fælleshuset indgår du i et aftenDUS-rul.

Vi leder efter dig, der…

  • er uddannet pædagog og har lyst til at arbejde med børn i skolealderen
  • har stærke relationskompetencer og arbejder inkluderende og anerkendende
  • trives i et samarbejdsorienteret miljø og bidrager aktivt til fælles løsninger
  • er initiativrig og brænder for at skabe inkluderende fællesskaber
  • har mod på at være med til at udvikle både skole- og fritidstilbud
  • ser muligheder og byder ind med idéer

Vi tilbyder…

  • en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, varme kolleger og en ledelse, der støtter op om udvikling
  • muligheden for at sætte dit præg på hverdagen og være med til at forme fremtidens pædagogiske praksis
  • et tæt samarbejde mellem skole og DUS, hvor vi arbejder helhedsorienteret med børns liv
  • en hverdag med plads til både leg, læring, kreativitet og omsorg
  • et arbejdsmiljø med respekt, tryghed, humor og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig – og til at byde dig velkommen i et fællesskab, hvor vi arbejder sammen om at gøre en forskel for børnene.

Begge stillinger er en fast stilling på henholdsvis 30 timer og 34 timer med ansættelsesstart d. 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt herefter. For stillingen på 34 timer gælder, at beskæftigelsesgraden er 34 timer med mulighed for midlertidig opnormering til 37 timer i indeværende skoleår.

For nærmere information om Gug Skole se https://gug-skole.aula.dk/
For yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan leder for DUS og børnehaveklasser Kristina Sandager Boesen eller skoleleder Rikke Høg Zimmer kontaktes på tlf. 99824399


Deadline for ansøgning er mandag d. 17. august. Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 35.
Forud for endelig ansættelse indhentes der børne- og straffeattest, ligesom der trækkes reference

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Efter gældende overenskomst

Send ansøgning
Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Send ansøgning" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.

I Aalborg Kommune tror vi på, at mangfoldighed skaber værdi, og vi bruger det potentiale, der ligger i forskelligheden til at løse vores kerneopgave endnu bedre. Vi behandler alle vores medarbejdere ligeværdigt, og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.

Vores arbejdsplads – kom med på en fantastisk rejse
Som medarbejder i Aalborg Kommune bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab, der tæller 16.000 kollegaer og som hver dag udvikler sig sammen for at skabe de bedste resultater for borgere, virksomheder og foreninger.

Vores kommune – i rivende udvikling
Aalborg vokser hvert år med flere end 1000 nye indbyggere og takket være et handlekraftigt fællesskab, der gør tingene sammen, er der de sidste årtier blevet skabt tusinder af nye arbejds- og studiepladser samt et rigt kultur- og fritidsliv.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
Are you a customer-centric and data-driven individual?

Do you enjoy responding to pricing inquiries and guiding decision-making of our customers?

About Us

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX (http://www.relx.com), a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles (https://stories.relx.com/responsible-ai-principles/index.html).

About the Role

This is a hybrid role. Team members are required to be in the Miamisburg, Ohio office weekly on Wednesday & Thursday.

You will implement our pricing strategy in our Small Law Business Segment. You will respond to pricing inquiries. Furthermore, you will be involved in proposal creation, deal approval, and contracting.

Responsibilities

  • Responding to pricing inquiries and guiding decision-making by developing a deep knowledge of our product

  • Collecting, analyzing and reconciling discrepancies between data, documents and information in order to create initial proposals

  • Collaborating with internal teams to secure renewal targets, understand upsell paths and defend against price reductions

  • Assisting Segment Managers with deal approval by providing pricing guidance, bench marking data and confirming selling rules

  • Completing the business terms in contracts and coordinates contract modifications with Segment, Sales and Legal teams

  • Responding to transactional pricing and cost recovery questions

  • Analyzing pricing data and makes recommendations to more senior level roles to influence pricing strategy

Requirements

  • Have a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Business, Finance or related field

  • Demonstrate solid mathematical aptitude and comfort with numbers

  • Display excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrate an ability to solve routine problems

  • Have excellent organizational skills and ability to manage large sets of information and data

  • Be able to work as part of a team to accomplish mutual team goals

  • Have the ability to manage to key deadlines and balance competing priorities

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, and study assistance, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

title: Vi søger SSA og Sygeplejerske
description:
pt. er det fortrinsvis til dagvagter – men pga. selvvalgt arbejdstid kan det være fleksibelt ift. dine ønsker og behov.

Så hvis du er social- og sundhedsassistent eller sygeplejerske med interesse for demensområdet, så læs endelig videre.

Vi nyder godt af en skøn blanding af faggrupper, der alle har det til fælles, at vi brænder for, at vores demente beboere skal have den allerbedste hverdag. Nogle ansatte er meget erfarne, andre er nyuddannede, hvor alle har stor ekspertise og lærer meget gerne fra sig.

Vores særlige tilbud til dig

Vi mangler kollegaer, der deler vores begejstring for demensområdet og vi lægger os i selen for at sikre både oplæring, løn, gode rammer og personlig udvikling. Vi vil blandt andet tilbyde dig en mentor og du har løbende mulighed for at række ud til ressourcepersoner. Der er altid mulighed for sparring og videndeling, både i din opstart og senere i forløbet har du mulighed for at få supervision både i grupper og individuelt.

For nyuddannede og dig, der endnu ikke er så erfaren på demensområdet

Vi tilbyder oplæring i specialet og har løbende supervisionstilbud. Hele personalegruppen har fået undervisning, så vi sikrer en ensartet tilgang til beboere, pårørende og kollegaer. Vi tager relations-arbejdet meget alvorligt og som nyansat vil du få tilbudt et FFR-kursus. Uddannelsesmæssigt har vi valgt at tage afsæt i de 9 tilgange fra Sundhedsstyrelsen, så vi alle har et fælles fundament.

Lønmæssigt kan vi fremhæve, at alle FOA-medarbejdere får et ekstra løntrin for demensspecialet ved opstart i jobbet og så får du endnu et løntrin efter de første seks måneders ansættelse. Der er ligeledes et tillæg til DSR – medarbejdere.

For dig, der allerede har erfaring

Uanset hvilket erfaringsniveau, du har, sørger vi selvfølgelig for en god introduktion og vi vil meget gerne høre om dine eventuelle ønsker om videreuddannelse inden for demensspecialet. Vi vægter det faglige niveau højt og investerer derfor meget gerne i vores dygtige medarbejdere.

Lønmæssigt tilbyder vi dig mulighed for at blive videns- og ressourceperson med løntillæg, hvis der er vakante stillinger på området.

Dagligdagen i Skovparken

Vi er ca. 50 medarbejdere på vores demensplejehjem, der har 31 faste beboere. Desuden har vi en bolig til ferieophold for hjemmeboende borgere med demenssygdom. Derudover er der i dagtimerne tilknyttet et demensdaghjem med fire pladser.

Fagligt fordeler vi os mellem SSA’ere, SSH’ere, ikke faglærte, sundhedsmedarbejdere, sygeplejersker, kostmedarbejdere, rengøringsassistenter, studerende og vores egne afløsere.

Alle ansatte har selvvalgt arbejdstid, så du vil opleve, at vi sigter efter at give dig så stor indflydelse på arbejdsplanerne som muligt.

Demensområdet er spændende, men da vi også oplever høje følelsesmæssige krav i vores arbejde, sørger vi hele tiden for at støtte hinanden, at tale åbent om både glæder og udfordringer. Vi har vedvarende fokus på trivsel og vi værner om vores gode arbejdsmiljø.

Vores menneskesyn

Vi ser det som vores fornemmeste opgave at skabe tryghed og gode hverdagsøjeblikke sammen med beboerne. De skal mærke, at vi er her for dem. Vi ser personen bag demenssygdommen og stiller derfor ikke krav, men forsøger at finde frem til alt det, der skaber værdi og glæde for den enkelte.

Vores beboere skal have mulighed for at bruge deres sanser, så vi ser det som meningsfyldt beskæftigelse, når de fx går fra afdeling til afdeling eller flytter lidt rundt på tingene.

Vi værner om det gode samarbejde med de pårørende, som vi inddrager på mange forskellige måder.

Fakta om jobbet

Vi forventer at ansætte to social- og sundhedsassistenter eller sygeplejersker. Der er tale om faste stillinger i fortrinsvis i aftenvagt.

Stillingerne er på 37 timer, har du andre ønsker, så taler vi om det.

Du får selvvalgt arbejdstid og booker derfor selv dine ønskede vagter ind i systemet.

Der er ansøgningsfrist den 24. august, men da vi ønsker stillingerne besat snarest muligt, holder vi samtaler løbende - hvis det er muligt, så tøv endelig ikke med at sende os din ansøgning.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker at høre mere, så ring eller skriv endelig til teamleder Else Ladegaard på elad@varde.dk eller på tlf.2151 8630. eller planlægger Dorte F. Pedersen dopc@varde.dk eller på tlf. 20551789

Vi glæder os meget til at læse din ansøgning.

title: Bodymaker/Coch Builder/Body Technician
description:
Salary

£20.06 per hour plus overtime and weekend enhancements, flexible hours will be considered

PCV Body Maker - Stockport Depot

We are looking for an experienced Body Maker to join our Stockport Depot team.

  • Typical annualised earnings of £40,000+ remuneration based on combination of hourly rate, allowances, typical hours and overtime
  • Guaranteed 38 minimum hours with overtime available

You’ll be joining a small team of engineers at Stockport Depot who maintains and repairs a modern and varied fleet of vehicles so our fantastic customers can travel safely and comfortably every day to healthcare and employment, to shopping and leisure, and to see friends and family.

Aside from the satisfaction of being a key worker in your community, there’s loads of reasons for you to join the Stagecoach Manchester team…

  • Great benefits including a generous company pension scheme, 20 days holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 25 days after 5 years service, free travel for you and a companion, free financial education and affordable loans, and finally a range of money-saving opportunities including discounts on holidays and retail, cinema outings, dental insurance, vehicle breakdown cover and hotels and attractions
  • Free travel for you and a companion on our buses – so on your days off you can be off shopping without worrying about parking the car, or heading off for a day in the city or by the seaside without worrying about the cost of fuel or parking
  • Training – don’t worry if you’ve not worked on our vehicles before (or indeed buses!) as we’ll train you on everything you need to know, and you’ll be supported by a great team doing a great job
  • Varied work – interestingly it’s not all depot-based work…you could well find yourself out and about dealing with vehicle issues on the road, so it won’t always be the same four walls you’re looking at. And as one of the UK’s leading transport operators we’re investing heavily in electric vehicles and depot infrastructure, so there’s plenty to keep you interested
  • Plenty of job security from being a key worker at the heart of our communities, where we always need great people servicing our fleet of vehicles, be they Alexander Dennis, Scania, Volvo or Optare
  • A safe environment – we provide boots, overalls and specialist equipment so no need to worry about being safe and protected, or having the right kit for the job
  • UK-wide opportunities whereby if you’re moving out of choice or circumstance, as we run bus companies across the UK, you can transfer to a new location
  • Career development through developing your technical skills on future hybrid and electric vehicles, and career progression to Technician, Master Technician, Engineering Manager and beyond – a good number of our Engineering Directors started their career with us as mechanics and fitters.
  • Secondment opportunities to work elsewhere in the business – either on big events like Silverstone and Cheltenham Festival, or into our head office support functions
  • An employee assistance programme to support health and wellbeing through a confidential service available 24 hours a day which provides specialist guidance and assistance on a range of personal and work-related issues, from dealing with stress and anxiety to managing financial, marital or legal issues. Face-to-face counselling sessions are also offered, alongside telephone and online support.
  • A great working environment with loads of opportunity to make new friends from a bunch of great workmates, managers who work hard to create great places to work, and employee networks building inclusive environments for women, veterans, carers, multicultural and LGBTQ+ colleagues

The recruitment process is simple – you apply with your CV, we’ll have a good read then get you in for an interview and give you a tour of the depot, and that’s it!

There are a few of things we need from you:

  • You need to have an engineering background with a vehicular focus – bus, HGV / LGV, truck, haulage, automotive, plant, rail, farm – if it moves, it’s good experience!
  • You need to want to deliver high standards of engineering maintenance and repair

So if that’s you, and you like what we’re offering, then apply below!

We’re looking for Customer Team Members to join our team at Co-op, join us and play a key role in delivering friendly, helpful service in your local Co-op store.

As a Customer Team Member, you’ll work as part of a friendly team in a fast-moving Co-op store, helping deliver essential services to your community every day. Depending on your store, this could involve working in our post office, or bakery, or helping with online services by picking and packing orders for home delivery. Whatever the day brings, you'll play a key role in making life easier for our customers.

Why this job matters:
You’ll help keep our shelves stocked and support sales, making sure customers can find what they need. You’ll be a familiar face in the community, getting to know your customers and helping us stay connected with local and national charities. Plus, you’ll promote Co-op membership, helping more customers enjoy the benefits of our unique business.

What you'll do:
  • Support the day-to-day running of the store by delivering friendly and thoughtful service, helping to put things right when needed
  • Work with your team to keep the store running smoothly
  • Work hands-on on the shop floor and tills, and in our in-store bakery, and contribute to daily operations to create a great shopping experience
  • Help maintain store performance by keeping shelves stocked and checking prices, dates, and stock accuracy
  • Make sure the store safe and legal – keep the shelves stocked and make sure prices, dates, and temperatures are all as they should be
  • Promote Co-op Membership and support your local community
What you'll bring:
  • A genuine passion for helping people and delivering great customer service
  • The ability to work flexibly across a number of shifts and as part of a team
  • An interest in retail and working in a busy store environment (experience not essential)
Why Co-op?
At Co-op, we're owned by our members. And because we're owned by you, we can do right by you. So, when you join us, you're not just taking a job, you're joining a movement. We're an organisation that puts people and communities first, and we're powered by purpose. We want this to be a place where you can thrive, so you'll also receive:
  • Full training and career development resources
  • 30% discount on all Co-op products in-store
  • Flexible access to your pay as you earn it
  • A pension scheme with up to 10% employer contributions
  • 31 days of holiday (including bank holidays, pro rata for part time colleagues)
  • 24/7 access to GP appointments, and colleague support programme
  • Cycle-to-work scheme
  • Market-leading policies to help you through life's big moments
A place you'll belong:
We’re building diverse and inclusive teams that reflect the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and are committed to creating a workplace where colleagues can feel like they belong, supported by our inclusive policies and the ways we work.
We’re proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme and offer interviews to disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria for a job. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, we’ll support you.
Learn more about our recruitment process at jobs.coop.co.uk/apply-process and our inclusion commitments at jobs.coop.co.uk/diversity-inclusion
As part of the application process for this job, you’ll need to complete two online assessments. It will take 15- 20 minutes to complete these tests.
We reserve the right to remove a vacancy before the scheduled closing date.

title: Sommerjob med mening – bliv vikar i hjemmeplejen
description:
Sommerjob med mening – bliv vikar i hjemmeplejen

Vil du have et sommerjob, hvor du tjener penge, får erfaring, og gør en forskel for andre mennesker?
Er du studerende, i sabbatår, uddannet inden for sundhed – eller bare nysgerrig på at arbejde med mennesker? Så er hjemmeplejen i Haderslev lige noget for dig!

Vi lover dig gode kolleger og et job, du går glad hjem fra.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?
Som sommerferievikar hjælper du borgere i deres eget hjem med:

  • praktisk hjælp i hverdagen
  • personlig pleje (du får oplæring)
  • omsorg, nærvær og god kontakt.

Du arbejder selvstændigt, men aldrig alene – vi hjælper hinanden og bakker dig op hele vejen.

Ingen erfaring? Intet problem.
Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og møde mennesker med respekt.

Hvem er vi?
Hjemmeplejen i Haderslev Kommune er opdelt i:

  • Haderslev Øst – Haderslev by + nord/syd for fjorden (3 distrikter)
  • Haderslev Vest – Vojens og Gram (2 distrikter)

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab i vores tværfaglige team med:

  • social- og sundhedshjælpere
  • social- og sundhedsassistenter
  • sygeplejersker og terapeuter.

Fælles for os alle: Vi passer på hinanden – og vores borgere.

Det får du hos os:

  • grundig introduktion – vi lærer dig godt op
  • søde, engagerede kolleger
  • et job med mening og ansvar
  • 20–37 timer om ugen i ugerne 26–34 og hvis muligt også i september
  • løn efter overenskomst (også som studerende)
  • mulighed for at fortsætte som vikar – eller få en uddannelsesaftale.

I Haderslev by er der ruter, hvor du kan gå eller cykle.
I andre distrikter skal du have kørekort (skriv det gerne i ansøgningen).

Hvem er du?
Vi håber, at du:

  • er fyldt 18 år
  • har en positiv indstilling og møder folk med respekt
  • har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker
  • er nysgerrig og klar på at lære nyt
  • Kan arbejde i størstedelen af ugerne 26–34.

Erfaring er ikke et krav – din indstilling er det vigtigste.

Send en kort ansøgning/videoansøgning, hvor du fortæller:

Ansøgningen skal sendes via ansøgningsknappen snarest muligt.

Vi ansætter løbende.

Om Haderslev Kommune
Vi er en organisation med ambitioner for både Haderslev Kommune og os selv. Vi arbejder målrettet og nytænkende, skaber resultater sammen og tør sigte højt. Hos os er dialog og fællesskab nøglen til udvikling – på tværs af fag, borgere, erhvervsliv, foreninger og politikere. Derfor er vores ambition, at vi inden 2030 har 250 flere i uddannelse, 500 flere indbyggere og 1.000 flere arbejdspladser. Alt det kan du blive en del af med et job hos os.

title: Therapist- IOP/PHP
description:
New Employee Retention Bonus
*$2,000.00 retention bonus available! (In-training licensure)
*$4,000.00 retention bonus available! (Fully licensed)
(New Employee is defined as someone who has not been employed with Rogers for more than six months)

Schedule: Monday through Friday
Typical shift: 8:00am to 4:30pm CST

The therapist leads the collaboration among an interdisciplinary team to develop, coordinate, and facilitate all direct social services interventions to patients assigned to their caseload and their support systems. The therapist utilizes empirically supported therapeutic techniques, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), or family therapy, to aid in the stabilization and recovery of individuals with mental and behavioral health concerns. The therapist creates a safe and supportive environment where patients gain insight into the relationship between their thoughts, feelings, and behaviors, and work towards achieving their goals. Therapist may be responsible for other duties as directed by their manager/clinical operations supervisor to support direct patient care as well as system initiatives. The Therapist will work in an acute care setting that includes inpatient, residential, partial hospitalization and/or intensive outpatient services.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Conduct individual, group, and family therapy sessions: Providing one-on-one therapy, group therapy, and family therapy sessions to address patients' specific needs and goals.
  • Assessing patients' needs: Conducting comprehensive assessments to identify patients' mental health concerns, strengths, and challenges.
  • Developing treatment plans: Creating individualized treatment plans based on patients' needs and goal; provide guidance in the implementation of clinical interventions, including but not limited to facilitating treatment team meetings.
  • Providing counseling and support: Incorporating evidence-based therapeutic techniques to help patients manage their symptoms and improve their overall well-being within sessions and in-the-moment as needed in the milieu.
  • Educating patients: Teaching patients about their mental health and/or substance use condition, self-care strategies, and treatment options to support patients in reviewing the costs and benefits of treatment engagement and aftercare plans.
  • Documenting patient progress: Maintaining detailed records of therapy sessions, including patient progress, goals, and interventions. Complete all documentation within required time.
  • Collaborating with other professionals (both internally and externally): Working with other members of the treatment team, such as psychiatrists, social workers, and case managers, to coordinate care and ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Adhering to ethical guidelines: Following ethical codes of conduct and maintaining confidentiality in all interactions with patients.
  • Continuing education: Participating in ongoing professional development to stay updated on the latest research and best practices in the field of mental health.
  • Report and document suspected cases of physical, sexual abuse and/or neglect according to the law in the state of employment and according to System policy and procedure.
  • Conduct self in a professional manner.
    • Demonstrate strong interdisciplinary approach and collaboration among departments.
    • Communicate assertively and accurately.
    • Receive feedback in a productive manner to further personal & professional development.
  • Support changes in staffing/scheduling assignment when program and patient care needs require.
  • Participate in clinical initiatives, projects, and activities to support system-wide continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrate understanding of Joint Commission, State, and other regulatory agency compliance regulations.
  • Provide for patient safety and the safety of the facility.
  • Performs other duties as assigned. These may include but are not limited to: Maintaining a current knowledge base of department processes, protocols, and procedures, pursuing self-directed learning, and continuing education opportunities, and participating on committees, task forces, and work groups as determined by management.

Education & Experience:

  • Master’s Degree in Social Work, or related field, from an accredited school of Social Work, Professional Counseling, or Family Therapy with experience in health care and in a psychiatric setting, preferred.
  • At minimum, an in-training as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC-IT), Marriage and Family Therapist Training License (MFT-TL), Advance Practice Social Work (APSW) or equivalent in state practicing.
  • If working in a program requiring substance use credentialing, a SAC-IT, SAC, or CSAC required in Wisconsin. A substance use specialty authorization applicable to the state hired in is required.
  • Working knowledge of therapeutic intervention and techniques for all age groups, as well as the dynamics of human growth and behavior.

Required on-the-job Training

  • Compliance with Residential Care Center (RCC) and Community Based Residential Facility (CBRF) (Required for Residential Inpatient programs, preferred for all levels of care).
  • American Heart Association CPR certification within thirty (30) days of hire. Bi-annual re-certification is required.
  • Training in Nonviolent Crisis Intervention (NCI) within sixty (60) days of hire/transfer. Annual re-certification is required.
  • Attend all mandatory in-services and other in-services relevant to the position.
  • Be responsible for all educational requirements and related obligations pertaining to the license of the program/unit license regulatory requirements governing the program(s).
  • For Residential programs – Must hold a current and active driver's license and be in good standing (preferred for all levels of care).

The System also includes Rogers Behavioral Health Foundation, which supports patient care, programs, and research; and Rogers InHealth, an initiative that works to eliminate the stigma of mental health challenges.

title: Plejecenter Solgaven i Hobro søger nattevagt
description:
Er du en natteravn og søger en meningsfuld nattevagt?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet social og sundhedshjælper eller social og sundhedsassistent, og som evner struktur og bevarer det fulde overblik, når de andre sover.
På Plejecenter Solgaven har vi en ledig stilling på 37 timer som nattevagt, med arbejde hver anden weekend og med tiltrædelse den 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Lidt om os
Solgaven er et af Mariagerfjords større plejecentre og er beliggende meget naturskønt ved Østerskoven i Hobro. Vi har 57 plejeboliger og 10 afklaringspladser.
Vi har mange fagligt dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, der sammen med beboere, pårørende og frivillige er med til at skabe en hverdag, hvor beboerne støttes i at leve et værdigt liv med højest mulig livskvalitet ved at bruge deres egne ressourcer. Vi har køkkenpersonale og rengøringspersonale til at hjælpe i dagvagt.

Vi arbejder vi ud fra den nye ældrelov, som indeholder værdierne selvbestemmelse, tillid og samarbejde med familie/venner og civilsamfundet. Vi skaber og går vejen sammen med borgeren, begyndende ved indflytning, i hverdagen og ved livets afslutning.

Du vil komme til en arbejdsplads hvor….

  • beboeren altid er i centrum
  • vi tilstræber en høj faglig kvalitet i opgaveløsningen og arbejder fokuseret med personcentreret omsorg
  • det tværfaglige samarbejde og dialogen vægtes højt
  • vi ser en styrke i hinandens forskelligheder
  • vi har fokus på at alle er ansat til- og bidrager til faglighed og fagligt samarbejde

På Plejecenter Solgaven bliver du en del af et fast nattevagtsteam, hvor du vil have en makker.
Vi ser en stor vigtighed i, at du får et godt introduktionsforløb, der tager udgangspunkt i dine personlige og faglige kompetencer, så du får en start, hvor du føler dig tryg i de opgaver, du skal udføre.

Vi søger dig der:

  • Trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og i fællesskabet
  • Er god til skabe overblik og bevare roen i udfordrende og komplekse situationer
  • Tager initiativ, reflekterer og er aktiv i faglig sparring
  • Vægter humor og ærlighed højt
  • Du skal være villig til at lære ”nye trin”, da vi er optaget af faglig udvikling
  • Du har kendskab til og er fortrolig med IT eller mod på at lære det. Vi arbejder i omsorgssystemet KMD Nexus
  • Du kan skabe gode, konstruktive relationer til beboere, pårørende og kolleger

Samarbejde og fællesskab
I Ældre og Omsorg i Mariagerfjord Kommune er vi ansat til to ting: faglighed og samarbejde. Som social- og sundhedsassistent og social- og sundhedshjælper skal du være med til at insistere på begge dele – og hjælpe med til at skabe en kultur, hvor faglig udvikling, arbejdsglæde og fælles ansvar går hånd i hånd.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker på overenskomstmæssige vilkår, hvor lønnen aftales med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Der indhentes straffeattest, og ansættelsen er betinget af, at denne kan godkendes.

For at være ansat i Mariagerfjord Kommune skal du have MitID.

Hvis du vil vide mere

Kontakt Kristina Helenius Dalsgaard på telefon 97115301, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Kan du se dig selv hos os?
Så send din ansøgning til Mariagerfjord Kommune via vores hjemmeside.

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. september eller snarest derefter.

Der er ansøgningsfrist til stillingen 16. august 2026.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 34.

Om Mariagerfjord Kommune
Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen.

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge job hos os, uanset personlig baggrund.

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Work model: onsite {#LI-onsite} from our Stonehouse location

Benefits

ABB offers a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond.

  • Competitive salary

  • Competitive contributory pension scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Flexible benefits scheme (Includes options to buy/sell holidays, health checks, dental, eye care, gym memberships, cycle to work, gadget discounts and more)

For the 6th consecutive year ABB UK has been recognised as a Top Employer in UK. Being certified as a Top Employer showcases an organisation’s dedication to a better world of work and exhibits this through excellent HR policies and people practices.

More about us

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the world’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analyzers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analyzing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement.

title: Plejecenterleder med øje for, hvilken retning vi skal.
description:
Er du klar til at tage et plejecenter under dine vinger og vise, hvordan kompetencer og fagligheder vokser i en frugtbar hverdag?

-Så lad din karriere blomstre videre på Trollehøj Plejecenter, hvor en sektionslederstilling venter på at stå i fuldt flor.

Hvad tilbyder vi i stillingen?
Trollehøj er et velfungerende plejecenter med cirka 50 kompetente og engagerede medarbejdere, der hver dag summer af engagement for et fagligt, tværfagligt og professionelt samarbejde for at skabe det bedste hjem for borgerne.
Plejecentret består af 36 plejeboliger, der ligger i naturskønne omgivelser i den østlige del af Svendborg.

På Trollehøj er der et stærkt fællesskab og stor villighed og lyst til at løse opgaverne.

Vi har et succesfyldt samarbejde med frivillige fra lokalområdet, som vi ønsker at udvide.

I sektionen er der fokus på medarbejdernes kompetencer i forhold til borgernes behov, og der er et tæt samarbejde med blandt andet læger, terapeuter, demenskonsulenter, Myndighedsafdelingen samt Hjælpemidler & Hverdagsteknologi. Vi har fokus på borgerperspektivet, og lægger vægt på at understøtte borgerne i at kunne leve det gode liv i hverdagen. Derfor vægter vi et godt samarbejde med borgere og pårørende.


Kollegialt bliver du en del af et velfungerende team med syv lederkollegaer i Plejecenter Øst, som arbejder tæt sammen om at løse opgaverne. Herudover har vi et nært samarbejde med de øvrige lederkollegaer på ældreområdet.


Svendborg Kommune har en visionær ledelsespolitik med fokus på ledelsesudvikling, både på det individuelle og det organisatoriske plan.

I forbindelse med din opstart designer vi et onboarding-program til dig, skræddersyet til dine behov og forudsætninger. Du tilknyttes en mentor og der er kontinuerlig sparring med din områdeleder, som du refererer til.

I det daglige har du et tæt samarbejde med husets sygeplejersker, sosu’er og øvrige medarbejdere, herunder tillidsvalgte og nøglepersoner. Og ikke mindst din kommende assisterende leder, som du vil være med til at ansætte. Den assisterende leder understøtter ledelse og planlægning. Du vil naturligvis også indgå i et tæt samarbejde med borgere, pårørende og plejecentrets frivillige hjælpere.

Du får administrativ assistance fra områdekontoret og fra ældreområdets stab, der bistår dig med eksempelvis udviklingsopgaver, kvalitetssikring og juridiske og faglige spørgsmål. Desuden kan du få sparring af kompetente HR-konsulenter og økonomikonsulenter.

Vi ønsker os at du:

  • At du går forrest og viser vejen med en struktureret ledelse, så alle præsterer bedst muligt i arbejdet.
  • Har blikket der ser og møder medarbejdere med forskellige fagligheder og personligheder.
  • Ihærdigt arbejder med kultur og understøtter det stærke fællesskab.
  • Er synlig, tilgængelig og tydelig i din fremtræden
  • Får øje på de gode historier og hverdagsoplevelser.

Som sektionsleder på Trollehøj er forståelse for ledelsesansvar, samarbejde og sammenhæng i en stor organisation vigtige pejlemærker. Vi ser gerne, at du har en relevant sundhedsfaglig uddannelse og gerne ledelseserfaring. Måske har du allerede diplom i ledelse eller er indstillet på at tage uddannelsen. Det vil også være en stor fordel at du har erfaring med Personcentreret omsorg ud fra Kitt Woods teori om personcentreret omsorg.

Ansøgningen
I din ansøgning vil vi gerne læse konkrete eksempler på hvordan du:

  • Skaber motivation og får andre til at performe.
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og inkluderende i din ledelse.
  • Arbejder struktureret og skaber balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.
  • Reflekterer og kommunikerer i forbindelse med at du skal implementere og udvikle.
  • Har fokus på borgerperspektivet og det gode samarbejde med beboerne, pårørende og andre samarbejdspartnere.

Ældreområdet

Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.
Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældreliv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed.
Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og til din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for.
Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kolleger at dele hverdagen med.

Om Svendborg Kommune
Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.

Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.

Løn og ansættelse

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Områdeleder Tine Hildebrand tlf.: 24 88 69 93

Ved stillingens besættelse skal en aktuel privat straffeattest forvises.

Der vil i rekrutteringsforløbet blive indhentet referencer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 48119,00 og 76333,00 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Ansøgningsfrist den 29.08.26 kl 24.00

Tiltrædelse den 01.11.26 eller efter aftale.

1. samtale forventes afholdt den 09.09.26.

2. samtale forventes afholdt den 25.09.26.

Mulighed for individuel samtale med områdeleder i uge 38 og/eller uge 39.

Der vil være en profiltest mellem 1. og 2. samtale.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration heavy-lift launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to Earth’s orbit and beyond. Engineered with a reusable first stage and a seven-meter payload fairing, New Glenn is building the road to space.

You will work across subsystems and support integrated solutions to achieve our vision of “millions of people living and working in space” and apply system engineering practices across subject areas predicated to a high degree on your technical skills. You will support the development of system engineering processes for the program, ensure consistent implementations across the program, and serve in a system integration capacity working with multi-discipline teams to arrive at technical system solutions. You will support requirements definition, validation, and verification of requirements at all levels of the program using tools like DOORS Next Gen, system lifecycle configuration management tools, and other functional analysis toolsets.

Additionally, this role requires understanding and supporting requirements analysis and traceability, functional analysis, systems analysis, safety analysis, technical performance monitoring, verification planning and closure, test plan development, and operations. You will ensure the alignment and consistent implementation of New Glenn system engineering practices from system to lower-level program tiers. You will also participate in gated reviews, develop health metrics to support insight into program health and tracking to major milestones.

Passion for our mission and vision is required! If you’re passionate about providing near-term value, solving novel problems, learning about interesting topics, and completing challenging activities, please apply!

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum of a B.S. degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial engineering, or a similar technical field
  • 5+ years of systems engineering experience with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity
  • Established expertise across the full SE development cycle (concept, requirements, design, analysis, integration, safety, configuration management, verification and test
  • Familiarity with two or more related functional areas (mechanical, fluids, tanks, structures, avionics, engines, GNC, etc.)
  • Advanced capability in using and setting up SE tools (DOORS/DNG, ETM, Windchill, Cameo)
  • Proven ability to lead cross functional teams and drive multi subsystem integration
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Engineering disciplines, particularly mechanical, aerospace and materials
  • INCOSE CSEP certification
  • Familiarity with NSSL certification requirements and system safety
  • Knowledge of launch vehicle design and requirement
  • System development/integration experience, preferably with aerospace hardware
  • Highly knowledgeable of systems engineering practices and their rightsizing for rapid development programs
  • Experience with verification planning, coordination of verification evidence, and development/delivery of verification closure notices.
  • Experience with project planning and implementation
  • Experience with launch operations
  • Demonstrated understanding of mechanical or fluid system principles, components, and operations
  • Experience with launch vehicles and mechanical aerospace systems (Separation, Fins, TVC, Hydraulic or Electro-Mechanical Actuators and Mechanisms, APU, landing systems)

title: Technical Project Manger
description:
Technical Project Manager

About our Team

Clinical Solutions is a technology & information solutions business focused on helping doctors, nurses, and other health care professionals. Our product portfolio spans market-leading solutions in Clinical Reference, Advanced Clinical Decision Support, Nursing, Patient Engagement and Precision Medicine. Our products aim to optimize care delivery, patient experience, and financial outcomes.

About the Role

As a Technical Project Manager, you will be the driving force behind successful customer deployments for Elsevier’s Mytonomy Cloud for Healthcare platform. Serving as the primary point of coordination throughout the implementation lifecycle, you will partner with health systems to translate clinical, operational, and business requirements into configured, integrated, and scalable solutions that improve patient engagement and healthcare outcomes.

In this highly cross-functional role, you will own end-to-end customer implementations—from project kickoff through go-live—ensuring deployments are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with customer objectives. You will work closely with Customer Success, Clinical, Product, Marketing, and Content teams to configure customer environments, manage technical integrations with EHR systems (primarily Epic), and guide organizations through technical, operational, and clinical readiness activities.

Leveraging your expertise in healthcare technology, interoperability standards, and clinical workflows, you will advise customers on integrations involving HL7, SMART on FHIR, APIs, and related technologies. You will also lead the deployment of Mytonomy Patient Experience Cloud, oversee testing and validation activities, coordinate stakeholder communications and training programs, and ensure clinical teams are prepared for a successful launch.

The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare IT implementation experience, project management discipline, and excellent communication skills with a passion for helping healthcare organizations adopt innovative technology solutions. If you thrive at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and customer success and enjoy leading complex projects that create measurable value for both patients and clinicians, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Strong communication skills to help customers translate business requirements to technical and workflow requirements
  • Strong Project Management skills to drive implementations to successful go-live using internal tools such as Asana
  • Deep understanding of Epic workflows in hospital and ambulatory settings from either the clinical end-user perspective or application-level experience.
  • Advise customers on how to integrate with Mytonomy’s platform via HL7, SMART on FHIR, APIs, and more.
  • Use Mytonomy’s internal tools to configure customer systems and integrations
  • Work with CS and Clinical teams to map content between Mytonomy’s platform and customer EHR systems (primarily Epic).
  • Share feedback and data with the product team to influence product enhancements and new features
  • Coordinate with internal content teams to track the progress of content development and localization for client deployments.
  • Ensure training materials and how-to guides are created and distributed to clinical staff prior to go-live
  • Collaborate with the Customer Success Director during implementation to ensure on-time project delivery and alignment with customer business objectives, maintaining clear documentation throughout the transition to ensure operational continuity.

Requirements

  • 2–5 years of experience in healthcare IT implementation, EHR deployment, or a closely related field
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for clinical and operational audiences
  • Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and drive implementations to successful go-live
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana
  • Strong familiarity with Epic workflows in hospital and ambulatory settings; Epic certification or hands-on configuration experience strongly preferred
  • Experience working with healthcare technology partners and integration tools (e.g., Redox, HL7, SMART on FHIR) is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, scientific, or healthcare-related discipline

Location & Reporting

  • This role can be located in our Bethesda, MD office or remote, with a preference for candidates within 50 miles of the Bethesda office.
  • This position will report to the Senior Customer Success Director.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


About the Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.

title: Computer Scientist
description:
Argonne National Laboratory is seeking a scientist to help advance the emerging field of networked and distributed quantum computing. This position offers the opportunity to shape new architectures, software systems, simulation capabilities, and experimental workflows for connecting quantum devices with classical computing and networking infrastructure. The successful candidate will work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment that brings together expertise in quantum information science, computer systems, networking, high-performance computing, and scientific applications.

The scientist will have access to Argonne’s quantum research capabilities, advanced computing facilities, and the broader Chicago quantum ecosystem. They will establish and lead independent research directions while contributing to multidisciplinary projects and externally sponsored programs. The scientist will produce high-impact research, broadly useful software and systems capabilities, and sustained collaborations within Argonne and with universities, national laboratories, government agencies, and other research organizations.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Conduct independent and collaborative research in quantum networking, distributed quantum computing, quantum-system architectures, or closely related areas.
  • Develop models, algorithms, simulation capabilities, and research software for the design and evaluation of networked quantum systems.
  • Investigate system-level challenges involving architectures, protocols, resource management, scheduling, control, performance, reliability, and integration of heterogeneous quantum and classical resources.
  • Formulate new research directions and contribute to research proposals, sponsor interactions, project planning, and execution of externally funded programs.
  • Publish research findings in peer-reviewed journals and conference proceedings and communicate results through presentations, software releases, technical reports, and other research artifacts.
  • Build collaborations across disciplines and institutions and provide technical leadership within multidisciplinary research teams.
  • Mentor students, postdoctoral researchers, and junior staff and contribute to a collegial research culture that values scientific rigor, collaboration, and professional development.

Position Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • RD3: Ph.D. in computer science, electrical or computer engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or a closely related field, plus at least 4 years of relevant research experience.
  • Demonstrated research contributions in one or more of the following areas:
  • Quantum networking, distributed quantum computing, quantum computer systems or architectures, quantum-network simulation, computer networks or distributed systems, performance modeling of computing or communication systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to define and pursue significant research directions and conduct research with substantial independence.
  • Record of scientific or technical accomplishment demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications, significant research software, technical systems, datasets, patents, or comparable research artifacts.
  • Evidence of professional visibility or external recognition appropriate to career stage, such as invited presentations, widely used software, leadership in collaborative research, professional service, awards, or citations of published work.
  • Experience developing research software using Python, C, C++, or comparable programming languages.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary research teams and communicate technical results clearly through publications, presentations, and interactions with research, sponsor, and broader stakeholder audiences.
  • Ability to model Argonne's core values of impact, safety, respect, integrity and teamwork.

Desired but Not Required Qualifications

  • Experience developing or using quantum-network or distributed-quantum-computing simulators.
  • Knowledge of quantum communication protocols, entanglement generation and distribution, quantum repeaters, quantum memories, or quantum error management.
  • Experience with system architecture, resource allocation, scheduling, control-plane design, or orchestration for distributed or quantum computing systems.
  • Experience integrating quantum-system models with classical networking, high-performance computing, or scientific workflow environments.
  • Experience collaborating with experimental quantum researchers or evaluating software and architectural concepts using experimental systems.
  • Experience leading technical tasks or coordinating research activities across multiple institutions or disciplinary teams.
  • Experience preparing research proposals or contributing to sponsored research programs.
  • Experience mentoring students, postdoctoral researchers, or junior technical staff.
  • Familiarity with open-source software development practices, including collaborative development, testing, documentation, release management, and community engagement.

Job Family

Research Development (RD)

Job Profile

Computer Science 3

Worker Type

Regular

Time Type

Full time
