title: Guest Experience Specialist - HPN
description:
As a Guest Experience Specialist, you are often the first and last impression our guests have – making you an essential part of the Signature Aviation experience. In this highly visible, hospitality-driven role, you’ll warmly welcome guests and crew members with professionalism, care, and a genuine commitment to creating exceptional moments.

Whether you’re greeting a VIP traveler, supporting a flight crew, or coordinating services behind the scenes, you bring grace under pressure and attention to detail that ensures every visit is smooth, comfortable, and memorable. Your reliability and pride in service directly reflect the Signature standard our guests trust.

This is a dynamic, hands-on position that requires flexibility to work varied schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and the ability to operate in both indoor and outdoor environments, often near active aircraft and ground service equipment.

If you love delivering thoughtful service, working in a fast-paced setting, and being part of a high-end hospitality team, you’ll thrive in this role.

(Other duties may be assigned)

  • Meet and greet guests and crews as they arrive at our facility and provide a warm, friendly greeting while escorting them to the front entrance, aircraft, or vehicles.
  • Effectively collaborate, cooperate, and work closely with all team members, guests, and other visitors to ensure services are promptly and correctly handled in a professional and courteous manner. This includes ensuring an efficient and accurate transfer of information through various methods between and among guests, the private aviation terminal (PAT), other Company departments, and external parties.
  • Accurately receive, dispatch, and completely process guest purchases and fuel transactions in accordance with Company procedures. May assist with some general accounting work and financial record keeping.
  • Provide visitors with a wide array of concierge services including arranging reservations for hotel stays, ground transportation or rental cars, catering, and customs appointments as requested.
  • Manage guest, crew, and/or visitor inquiries, resolve requests, handle billing disputes, and address concerns in an efficient and effective manner.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of Signature’s facilities, services, website, surrounding areas, and other information commonly asked about by guests.
  • Monitor arriving and departing flights and communicate with aircraft to coordinate services and assign to the Airside Experience Team. Use real-time system management (SIGops/SIGnet) to log and schedule requested services, change service status, and supervise the operation’s flow by appropriately prioritizing services. Ensure all departing aircraft have all requested amenities such as catering, coffee, ice, and newspaper.
  • Maintain and stock amenities in guest areas and ensure that lobby, pilot facing spaces, and restrooms are clean and free of debris.
  • Promote and sell the Company’s services and products to aircraft passengers and crew.
  • Assist crews and guests with luggage, provide transportation from the facility to commercial terminal, hotel, or other nearby locations as required, and fulfill special requests. Assist pilots with access to weather information, portals, and computers.
  • Identify crewmembers, passengers, visitors, and vendors in accordance with all security procedures.
  • Stop work when an unsafe condition or act is likely to cause harm to people, the environment, Company or guest assets, or the Company’s reputation if the work continues. Report concerns to the appropriate manager and cooperate in addressing the unsafe act or condition.
  • Abide by emergency response procedures during critical events.
  • Understand, comply with, and enforce all Signature and airport security (physical, cyber and data) protocols.
  • Create accurate records pertaining to time worked and activities and services performed.
  • Use the Company contact management system to review, capture, and update customer preferences to provide a more personalized service experience.
  • Assist the Airside Experience team to ensure our guests receive an exceptional experience. Services include without limitation, valeting customer vehicles, wing walking, placing chocks and cones, and positioning stairs/jetway to aircraft.
  • Assist airlines with passenger service functions in certain locations as needed.

Minimum Education and/or Experience:

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
  • At least 1 year of customer experience-related work in retail, hospitality, or sales is preferred.
  • Must possess a valid state driver’s license.
  • Minimum of 18 years of age.
  • Ability to pass company background checks (criminal and motor vehicle), drug tests, meet airport background check requirements to receive and maintain an airport security badge, and be insurable by the Company's applicable insurance policies.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the jurisdiction of employment.
  • Must be able to exercise good judgment and follow directions/directives from supervisor/management.
  • Ability to drive standard and automatic transmission vehicles is preferred.

Additional essential knowledge and skills:

  • Hospitality Skills: Excellent guest service skills with an energetic, outgoing, and guest-obsessed personality. Must be able to anticipate and act on guest needs and prioritize guest requests and job responsibilities by exhibiting a keen ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. Must be able to maintain professionalism and confidentiality. Experience with conflict resolution in a hospitality environment is preferred.
  • Language Skills: Clearly communicate in English with others in person, via telephone, radio communicators, and in writing for purposes of performing certain job duties and safety-sensitive tasks. Ability to read and comprehend documents such as safety rules, operating instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Math Skills: Ability to perform simple arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, and fractions).
  • Communication Skills: Able to use telephone, fax, two-way radio, email, or text messaging to contact guests, crew members, team members, or emergency personnel.
  • Critical Thinking / Reasoning Ability: Ability to use rational thought to analyze and evaluate information, and to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Ability to get along and work well with others. Excellent interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with team members and service to guests.
  • Multitasking: Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail. High level of concentration is required to ensure accuracy in a busy setting.

  • Computer Skills: Ability to use a computer, learn necessary company software and timely complete Signature’s training programs.

Pay ranges vary based on multiple factors, including, without limitation, skill sets, education, shift worked, responsibilities, seniority, geographical market, merit, output, productivity, prior training or experience, and travel. The pay starting rate for this position is $23.00/hour, per the collective bargaining agreement.

description:

title: Manufacturing Engineering Technician III
description:
Job Description:

Job Summary: Operate as a member of multidisciplinary teams to Installs and commissions manufacturing equipment, maintain positive control of project materials, and facilitate the work of contract labor and/or vendor installation teams. The manufacturing engineering technician’s primary responsibility is to execute and facilitate accomplishment of project tasks in accordance with the project schedule

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Continuously drives culture change and acceptance of Lean Manufacturing principles across the organization.

  • Facilitate systematic problem solving and implementing solutions to solve the root-cause of problems related to non-conforming material and corrective action processes.

  • Provide guidance for root cause analysis and corrective action to all levels within the organization.

  • Support manufacturing with the implementation of efficient and reliable Lean Manufacturing processes.

  • Supports and Leads Kaizen, Six Sigma, and 5S workshop activities and events.

  • Inspires and encourages the use of best practices throughout the organization.

  • Engages plant management and employees in conceptualizing, planning, implementing, and sustaining continuous improvement using Lean Manufacturing tools.

  • Frequently follows up with appropriate stakeholders to ensure timely and effective implementation and sustainability of continuous improvement projects.

  • Assist with leadership to include identifying opportunities, defining and financially justifying projects.

  • Collects and monitors activities to assess trends and opportunities to provide proactive recommendations.

  • Assist with establishing the measuring and tracking process for each initiative and provide timely reports to all stakeholders.

  • Install, test, and commission capital equipment ensuring that product design requirements are met per manufacturer and AAON procedures.

  • Provide technical training and cross training on all shifts to process leaders, line mechanics, and operating teams

  • Create and maintain manufacturing routings

  • Perform cycle time and time study analyses

  • Possess detailed knowledge of operations processes, facilities, services, practices, procedures and terminology

  • Possess detailed knowledge of operations machinery, equipment, materials and tools

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Associate of Applied Science (AAS) in Manufacturing Engineering Technology

    License(s): Refrigerant Handling License a plus

    Certification(s): None

  • Minimum of 3 - 5 years in industrial operations setting or equivalent manufacturing experience.

  • Electrical, mechanical, machinist experience

  • Lean 6 Sigma training a plus

  • Additional supervisory or leadership training a plus

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong spoken, written, and listening communications skills

  • Possesses excellent interpersonal relationship skills

  • Exhibits good decision making and analytical problem solving abilities

  • Excellent organization and time management skills

  • Able to effectively prioritize multiple tasks

  • Quick technical comprehension and motivation focused on end use outcomes

  • Effective working individually and within team environments

  • Work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with an extreme sense of urgency Microsoft Office Professional

  • Electrical Equipment

  • Mechanical Equipment

Work Environment:

  • Lift up to 50lbs.

  • Sit or stand for up to 95 percent of work hours.

  • Frequent exposure to manufacturing facility with seasonal hot and cold temperatures, dust, and some chemical fume exposure.

title: 2nd Shift Warehouse Supervisor
description:
Job Description

Pay Range: $76,000 - $95,000 depending on relevant experience and qualifications

MITER Brands™ is a residential window and door manufacturer that provides a leading portfolio of window and door brands for the new construction and replacement segments. MITER Brands, also known as Milgard, MI Windows & Doors and PGTI is one of the nation’s largest suppliers of vinyl windows and patio doors, with plants across the country.

This Warehouse Supervisor is a member of plant leadership team. This position is responsible for the overall supervision of the warehouse and loading operation to include Stockers and Loaders. This position will be overseeing between 20-25 employees, both Lead and regular warehouse employees. Responsible for the safe and efficient day-to-day operation of the warehouse and loading operation.

This position will supervise the 2nd shift which runs Monday – Friday from 4:00pm – 1:00am. Flexibility is required as needed to meet the needs of the business and our customers, and this could include occasional Saturday work.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the loading activities of Milgard products.
  • Responsible for the coordination and scheduling of warehouse activities to meet and exceed customers’ expectations while optimizing loads and minimizing work hours.
  • Review all paperwork in order to plan work activities, schedule appropriate personnel and balance loads.
  • Prior experience handling employee disciplinary issues, including coaching, verbal and written warnings.
  • Effectively communicates with all staff and problem-solves to ensure optimal running of the warehouse.
  • Manage expense accounts for department personnel
  • Support the order fulfillment process by working extensively with inside sales representatives, production personnel, customer service and credit
  • Experience interfacing with other key departments including Production, Delivery, Human Resources and other members of the management team.
  • Create and execute MPS objectives; meet MPS commitments and work within the guidelines of MPS
  • Reflect Milgard business values and Milgard Philosophy in all business interactions
  • Ensure safety of personnel and compliance with all applicable health and safety regulations

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees in this position. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma required; Some college preferred
  • Minimum 2 – 3 years related warehouse experience.
  • Prior warehouse supervision and employee management experience needed
  • Prior Warehouse Supervision experience in a manufacturing environment highly desired.
  • Knowledge of warehouse operations, loading logistics and employee management
  • Knowledge of Continuous Improvement practices desired
  • 5S, Lean Manufacturing practices desired

Essential Abilities

  • Read, write and understand the English language
  • Sense of urgency and self-motivation; ability to work independently
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Computer literacy with ability to learn new computer software programs
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail with strong organizational skills
  • Excellent customer service skills

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged sitting and terminal use
  • Must have the ability to move and lift materials and products weighing up to 100 lbs. as needed
  • Full hand dexterity; fingering required

What We Offer

At MITER Brands, we invest in your health, wealth, and wellness. Our comprehensive benefits package supports you and your eligible spouse/dependents while helping you achieve your personal and professional goals.

We offer competitive pay, a 401(k) with company match, and generous paid time off to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.


Health & Wellness

  • Three comprehensive medical plan options
  • Prescription drug coverage
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Teladoc virtual healthcare services
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Annual Wellness Clinic

Financial Protection

  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance
  • Company-paid Short-Term Disability
  • Company-paid Long-Term Disability
  • Supplemental Hospital Indemnity Insurance
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Accident Insurance

Additional Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Legal Insurance
  • Identity Theft Protection
  • Pet Insurance
  • Team Member Discount Program

MITER Brands, including MI Windows and Doors, Milgard, and PGT Innovations, is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Lead Software Engineer, Full Stack

Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. As a Capital One Lead Software Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving a major transformation within Capital One.

title: Designer
location: Houston, Texas, United States of America
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Electrical Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining accurate electrical design drawings and models to support project goals. Using both 2D and 3D design tools, this role involves creating layouts, schematics, and documentation in accordance with applicable standards and project requirements. The designer collaborates closely with engineers and multidisciplinary teams to ensure coordinated, constructible, and code-compliant designs. Key responsibilities include managing drawing revisions, supporting design reviews, adhering to established workflows, and contributing to problem-solving throughout the design process. The role also involves staying current with industry practices and design technologies to support continuous improvement and project success.


The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to the preparation of specific aspects of design assignments to meet the contractual obligations, adhering to relevant standards, safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.
  • Preparing and maintaining accurate electrical design drawings using 2D and 3D tools.
  • Supporting the development of design concepts into complete documentation sets.
  • Checking and verifying designs for completeness, clarity, and accuracy.
  • Creating and maintaining organized records of design files, revisions, and supporting documentation.
  • Updating design documents throughout project life cycles.
  • Using standard processes and tools and assisting in developing new processes and tools for the reuse of technical solutions.
  • Assisting in the development of design templates, libraries, and symbols / components.
  • Participating in design reviews and incorporate feedback from engineering leads or project managers
  • Mentoring junior designers or drafters in best practices and tool usage where appropriate.
  • Communicating effectively with team members, vendors, and clients to resolve design issues.


Our team dynamics
Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there. .



Qualifications for the role

  • You enjoy working with 2D and 3D modelling software for projects in the industrial market
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical 2D
  • Proficiency in Autodesk Revit 3D
  • Familiarity with electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, and cable routing.
  • Familiarity of electrical codes and standards (e.g., NEC, IEC, IEEE, CSA) is a plus.
  • Ability to generate accurate bills of materials (BOM), reports, and documentation.
  • Certification in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, or SolidWorks Electrical) is a plus.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mechanical or electrical design / drafting, preferably in an industrial, commercial, or construction environment.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., mechanical, structural, and civil designers)
  • Experience interpreting and developing electrical control systems and single-line diagrams.
  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

title: Personal Care Worker
description:
Bolton Clarke Group one of Australia’s largest independent, not-for-profit providers of home care, retirement living and residential aged care, operating nationally and internationally. Bolton Clarke Residential group now has 88 Aged Care Homes across QLD, NSW, VIC, SA & WA, with the inclusion of the Allity, McKenzie & Acacia Living Group.

olton Clarke is Australia’s largest independent, not-for-profit aged care provider shaping the future of positive ageing. With RSL Queensland and the Royal District Nursing Service at the heart of our DNA, we have been caring for Australians since 1885. Today, our exceptional teams support more than 130,000 people to live independently at home and across our 43 retirement living communities and 87 residential aged care homes. Everything we do is dedicated to enabling, celebrating and supporting older Australians to live and age positively.

The Role

As a Personal Care Worker you’ll provide assistance to our residents, ensuring they are supported with services and activities that are centred around their wellbeing, independence, interests and choices.

The key focus of the role will be to:

  • To provide high quality, safe, and timely contemporary personal care; assisting with the functions of daily living according to the individual needs of residents.

  • Support and care for residents as they age and assisting them to maintain their independence and live with dignity, self-determination and comfort.

  • Assist the resident with self-care needs, safe mobility and transfers, and complete documentation.

  • Join a caring community with opportunities to progress your career in nursing or leadership.

  • Ensuring an effective and consumer focused care and service delivery for all residents.

To be successful, you will have:

  • Certificate III in Individual Support & Ageing (or equivalent)

  • Experience in Aged Care highly regarded

  • Valid working rights in Australia (Passport, Birth Certificate etc)

  • Prior to commencement - complete a National Police Check and or a NDIS Workers Check (or willingness to obtain)

About this location:

Located in beautiful, historic Maryborough, Bolton Clarke’s Chelsea provides high-quality aged care in a friendly, secure and comfortable residential environment.

Why Work For Bolton Clarke:

title: Open Rank Professor - Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (College of Dentistry)
description:
The Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery seeks a board-certified or board-eligible Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon to provide clinical instruction and patient care within the predoctoral and graduate educational programs at the University of Tennessee Health Sciences College of Dentistry. This part-time non-tenure Open Rank Professor position will support the department's educational, clinical, and service missions through direct supervision of dental students and residents while participating in the delivery of comprehensive oral and maxillofacial surgical care.

TEACHING AND CLINICAL EDUCATION:

  • Provide direct clinical supervision of D3 and D4 dental students in the predoctoral Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery clinic.
  • Teach principles of dentoalveolar surgery, diagnosis, treatment planning, local anesthesia, management of odontogenic infections, exodontia, and management of surgical complications.
  • Evaluate student competency and provide formative and summative clinical assessments.
  • Promote evidence-based decision making and professionalism in the clinical environment.

GRADUATE EDUCATION:

  • Provide clinical supervision and surgical instruction for OMFS residents (PGY-1 through PGY-4).
  • Participate in resident education through intraoperative teaching, outpatient clinic supervision, case review, and clinical mentoring.
  • Assist faculty with resident evaluation and competency development.
  • Participate in graduate didactic conferences and educational activities as appropriate.

PATIENT CARE:

  • Provide comprehensive outpatient oral and maxillofacial surgical care in support of the educational mission.
  • Supervise patient evaluation, treatment planning, dentoalveolar surgery, implant surgery, management of odontogenic infections, and ambulatory anesthesia procedures consistent with departmental needs.
  • Maintain high standards of patient safety, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance.
  • Participate, as departmental needs dictate, in adult and pediatric facial trauma call coverage at affiliated Level I Trauma Centers.
  • Provide consultation and surgical management of maxillofacial trauma in collaboration with multidisciplinary trauma teams.
  • Participate in emergency call schedules as assigned.
  • Participate in departmental meetings, faculty development, accreditation activities, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary faculty to advance the educational mission of the College of Dentistry.
  • Support recruitment, mentoring, and professional development of students and residents.
  • Direct supervision of D3 and D4 dental students in the predoctoral clinic.
  • Clinical supervision and mentoring of PGY-1 through PGY-4 Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery residents.
  • Oversight of patient care delivered within the educational environment while ensuring compliance with departmental, institutional, CODA, and hospital standards.
  • Clinical instruction of predoctoral dental students.
  • Resident education and surgical mentoring.
  • Direct patient care supporting the educational mission.
  • Participation in scholarly activity, quality improvement, or educational research as appropriate.
  • Participation in continuing education and faculty development.

HOSPITAL AND TRAUMA RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participate, as departmental needs dictate, in adult and pediatric facial trauma call coverage at affiliated Level I Trauma Centers.
  • Provide consultation and surgical management of maxillofacial trauma in collaboration with multidisciplinary trauma teams.
  • Participate in emergency call schedules as assigned.

DEPARTMENTAL SERVICE:

  • Participate in departmental meetings, faculty development, accreditation activities, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary faculty to advance the educational mission of the College of Dentistry.
  • Support recruitment, mentoring, and professional development of students and residents.

SUPERVISORY ROLE:

  • Direct supervision of D3 and D4 dental students in the predoctoral clinic.
  • Clinical supervision and mentoring of PGY-1 through PGY-4 Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery residents.
  • Oversight of patient care delivered within the educational environment while ensuring compliance with departmental, institutional, CODA, and hospital standards.

RESEARCH/TEACHING/PATIENT CARE DUTIES: Clinical instruction of predoctoral dental students.

  • Resident education and surgical mentoring.
  • Direct patient care supporting the educational mission.
  • Participation in scholarly activity, quality improvement, or educational research as appropriate.
  • Participation in continuing education and faculty development.

EDUCATION: DDS or DMD (or international equivalent). Completion of an ADA-accredited Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery residency.

LICENSES: Diplomate of the American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (ABOMS), or board eligible with certification achieved within the required institutional timeframe. Current BLS, ACLS, and PALS certification. Eligible for unrestricted Tennessee dental licensure or Tennessee teaching license. Hospital credentialing eligibility. Eligibility for moderate/deep sedation permits consistent with Tennessee regulations.

DEPARTMENTAL PREFERENCES:

  • Experience supervising dental students and residents in an academic environment preferred. Experience in dentoalveolar surgery, ambulatory anesthesia, implant surgery, and management of medically complex patients. Experience in Level 1 trauma center facial trauma management preferred. Strong interpersonal and teaching skills. Commitment to interprofessional education and patient-centered care.

  • Outpatient oral surgery.

  • Office-based anesthesia.

  • Maxillofacial trauma management.

  • Surgical treatment planning.

  • Digital imaging and contemporary surgical technologies.

  • Electronic health record proficiency.

THE UNIVERSITY OF TENNESSEE HEALTH SCIENCES

The University of Tennessee Health Sciences is a statewide flagship, public, academic health institution in Tennessee. Founded in 1911, the mission of the University of Tennessee Health Sciences is to improve the health and well-being of Tennesseans and the global community by fostering collaborative education, research, scientific discovery, clinical care, and public service. Employing more than 4,600 people on its faculty, staff, and not-for-profit corporation faculty practice groups, and with more than 3,200 students across the state, UT Health Sciences contributes $4 billion to the economy of Tennessee.

Part of the University of Tennessee System, the Health Sciences is headquartered in Memphis and includes all six of UT’s doctoral-degree-granting health science colleges -- Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Graduate Health Sciences, and Health Professions. UT Health Sciences spans the state with its four major, regional clinical health science locations in Memphis, Knoxville, Chattanooga, and Nashville, as well as more than 100 clinical education sites across Tennessee. UT Health Sciences is the largest educator of health care professionals in the state and operates the state’s largest residency and fellowship advanced training programs.

Located in West Tennessee on the banks of the Mississippi River, Memphis is the second-largest city in the state and among the largest cities in the Southeast. The Greater Memphis metropolitan area has more than 1.3 million residents, and the city ranks among those with the lowest cost of living in the country. title: Konsulent til netværk og kompetenceudvikling af tillidsrepræsentanter
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke tillidsrepræsentanterne blandt socialrådgiverne, så de står endnu stærkere i deres rolle?

I stillingen får du mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel for tillidsrepræsentanterne i Dansk Socialrådgiverforening. Du kommer til at udvikle og gennemføre kompetenceforløb, facilitere stærke netværk og give tillidsvalgte redskaber, der styrker dem i lokale lønforhandlinger og i arbejdet med at skabe indflydelse på deres arbejdspladser. Du bliver en del af et team på fem kolleger, der arbejder tæt sammen om at motivere, inspirere og klæde tillidsrepræsentanterne godt på til deres vigtige rolle.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver:
  • at drive og videreudvikle netværk for tillidsvalgte
  • at planlægge og gennemføre uddannelsesforløb og workshops – både fysisk og i digitale læringsmiljøer
  • at støtte og vejlede tillidsvalgte i deres kerneopgaver i praksis, særligt i forbindelse med lokale lønforhandlinger
  • at facilitere møder samt udviklings- og læringsprocesser
Din profil

Vi søger en konsulent, der kan bidrage til faglig retning, facilitere læring og opbygge stærke relationer til tillidsvalgte. Du trives med at omsætte viden til praksisnære forløb, der giver tillidsrepræsentanterne konkrete redskaber til deres hverdag. Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til socialrådgiveres og tillidsrepræsentanters opgaver eller hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i deres virkelighed.

Du har erfaring med facilitering, undervisning eller kompetenceudvikling og kan planlægge og gennemføre læringsforløb, workshops og netværksaktiviteter – både med fysisk fremmøde og i digitale formater.

Du er en stærk kommunikator med gennemslagskraft, og du har en kontakt- og tillidsskabende tilgang, der gør det naturligt for dig at engagere og motivere andre.

Du arbejder struktureret, bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag og kan både løfte opgaver selvstændigt og indgå i tæt samarbejde med kolleger, tillidsvalgte og andre faggrupper.

Har du erfaring med, hvordan digitale læringsværktøjer kan skabe værdi i praksis, er det en fordel.

Det tilbyder vi dig

Hos os bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø med trygge rammer, fleksibel arbejdstid og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. Du får samtidig mulighed for at præge udviklingen på et vigtigt område i Dansk Socialrådgiverforening.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er attraktive og fastsat i en intern overenskomst. Stillingen er på fuld tid med tiltrædelse snarest muligt og senest den 1. oktober 2026. Dit arbejdssted kan være enten Aarhus eller Odense. Stillingen indebærer en del rejseaktivitet. Det er en forudsætning, at du har kørekort og adgang til bil, da netværksmøder og uddannelsesaktiviteter foregår rundt omkring i landet. Du bliver en del af en spændende og udviklingsorienteret afdeling med 18 medarbejdere, der også varetager opgaver med studieindsats, medlemsorganisering og arbejdsmiljø.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV senest den 24. august 2026, kl. 9:00.

Vi afholder første samtale onsdag den 26. august. En eventuel anden samtale finder sted online mandag den 31. august.

Har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Flemming Bach Sørensen (20 32 54 17), som er afdelingschef for ”Organisering, Tillidsvalgte & Arbejdsmiljø”. Her vil du også kunne få tilsendt supplerende materialer om stillingen og arbejdet med understøttelse af de tillidsvalgte.

Om Dansk Socialrådgiverforening

DS er en partipolitisk uafhængig og ambitiøs fagforening for 20.000 socialrådgivere, socialrådgiverstuderende samt ledere og selvstændige inden for socialrådgiverfaget.

title: 2 medarbejdere til det psykosociale område
description:
Om jobbet

Har du lyst til at arbejde med unge mennesker i en spændende organisation med masser af faglig udvikling, og hvor der til stadighed kommer nye opgaver til – så har vi måske jobbet til dig. Overordnet omfatter arbejdet socialpædagogisk støtte i samarbejde med borgere med psykosociale vanskeligheder.

Boligerne Birkerød Parkvej og Bofællesskabet Bregnerødvej er enheder som tilbyder afklaringsforløb og botræning for unge ml. 18 og ca. 30 år. Vi er midt i en spændende proces, hvor vi er i gang med en væsentlig ændring, så de 2 enheder kan blive samlet til et §107 tilbud.

Du skal arbejde med udgangspunkt i at skabe muligheder for udvikling af borgerens personlige og sociale kompetencer. Du skal støtte borgerne i, at finde deres motivation for forandringer og tro på at kunne finde egne ressourcer og se mulighederne for, at skabe sig et selvstændigt og meningsfuldt liv. Borgerne har forskellige psykosociale vanskeligheder, som eksempelvis kan omfatte angst, opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser bl.a. autisme, OCD, depression m.v.

Støtten tager udgangspunkt i den unges håb, ønsker og drømme og tilgangene er bl.a. anerkendende tilgang, relationspædagogik, mentalisering, Åben dialog og Dialektisk Adfærdsterapi.

Om dig

Du skal have en social- eller sundhedsfaglig grunduddannelse fx socialpædagog, socialrådgiver, ergoterapeut, fysioterapeut, social- og sundhedsassistent/sygeplejerske mv. Erfaring indenfor det psykosociale område vil være en fordel. Det er vigtigt, at du har en forståelse for, hvilken betydning psykiske vanskeligheder har for det enkelte menneskes liv – og at du derfor også har tålmodigheden og evnen til at samarbejde indgående med opbygning af relationer og motivation. Herudover er det helt afgørende for os, at du selv tror på og kan indgyde håb hos borgerne om, at det er muligt at få det bedre og komme sig efter psykiske vanskeligheder.

Du skal være i besiddelse af personlig modenhed, ansvarsbevidsthed, fleksibilitet og vi sætter også pris på egenskaber som gåpåmod, humor og positivt livssyn.

Endelig forventer vi, at du har gode kommunikationsevner - både i tale og på skrift.

Om Boligerne Birkerød Parkvej 18 / Bofællesskabet Bregnerødvej 55 - 57

Boligerne Birkerød Parkvej /Bofællesskabet Bregnerødvej er enheder under organisationen Center for Sociale Indsatser, som hører under Social og Sundhed i Rudersdal Kommune. CfSI varetager forskelligartede støtteopgaver for og med borgere med såvel psykosociale vanskeligheder som borgere på handicapområdet.

Boligerne Birkerød Parkvej 18 er et §107 tilbud, som tilbyder afklaringsforløb og botræning for unge ml. 18 og ca. 30 år. Der er plads til 8 unge og der er ansat 4 medarbejdere. Tilbuddet er dækket fra kl. 7-21 i hverdagende og 10-20 i weekenden. den støtte som tilbydes i boligerne er rocoveryorienteret psykosocial rehabilitering. Bofællesskabet Bregnerødvej 55-57 er et botilbudslignende tilbud fra 18 år og op, der er plads til 6 unge. Vi er midt i en spændende proces, hvor vi er i gang med en væsentlig ændring, så de 2 tilbud kan blive et samlet §107 tilbud.

Boligerne Birkerød Parkvej er et nyere byggeri, som rummer otte selvstændige lejligheder samt en stor fællesstue og køkken. Boligerne Birkerød Parkvej ligger 10 minutters gang fra Birkerød bymidte og S-togsstation. Bofællesskabet Bregnerødvej er et ældre hus beliggende 3 min. gang fra Birkerød Parkvej og indrettet på samme måde.

Center for Sociale Indsatser er en organisation, der er præget af høj faglighed, høj personaletrivsel og spændende udviklingstiltag.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdskultur som er præget af hjælpsomhed og fælles ansvar, hvor faglig udvikling og sparring vægtes meget højt.

Du får høj grad af selvstændighed og ansvar samt gode muligheder for at udvikle dig selv og have indflydelse på dine omgivelser. Din hverdag bliver alsidig med mange personlige og faglige udfordringer. Du får engagerede og fagligt velfunderede kolleger, som har en uformel omgangstone og et godt og rummeligt arbejdsmiljø.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingerne er på 37 timer om ugen og med start den 1. oktober 2026.

Der er skiftende arbejdstider mellem kl. 7.00 og 21.00 og weekendarbejde (kl. 10-20) hver 4. weekend. Ansættelse ved Boligerne Birkerød Parkvej / Bregnerødvej er betinget af tilfredsstillende straffeattest. Løn og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst.

title: IT - Lead QA Engineer
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Our IT organization has a critical role in driving extraordinary business results. Through a strong partnership with other areas of our business, we bring innovative thinking to every conversation and deliver with integrity. We’re looking for people who bring great ideas and who make our partners’ ideas better. Intellectually curious advisors (not order takers) who focus on outcomes to creatively solve business problems. People who not only embrace change, but who accelerate it.


Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on QA Lead to drive quality engineering across software applications. In this role, you will lead a team of QA analysts, direct daily manual and automated testing execution, and ensure software releases meet high standards of usability, reliability, and performance.

You will combine leadership with hands-on technical execution—guiding analysts, managing sprint testing deliverables, writing/executing test cases, and building out automated regression testing.

An ideal candidate should have following basic qualifications:

  • Bright, energetic, self-motivated with a track-record of goal-achievement and high performance and a desire and aptitude to manage diverse challenges

  • Propose and contribute to process and project improvements.

  • Lead and coordinate a team of QA analysts, providing clear direction, assigning sprint testing tasks, and ensuring timely completion of test cycles.

  • Mentor and guide team members on test design, exploratory testing techniques, and bug reporting best practices.

  • Review test plans and test cases created by the team to ensure comprehensive scenario coverage and quality standards.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for QA updates, escalating blockers, risk areas, and release readiness to project stakeholders.

  • Review product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to design detailed test plans and test scenarios.

  • Execute functional, exploratory and regression testing.

  • Deep understanding of automated test scripts for web/mobile UI and APIs to reduce manual regression effort over time.

  • Document, log, and track software defects in Jira, collaborating closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.

  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and backlog refinement meetings.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • 6+ years of experience in software QA, with at least 2+ years in a Lead or Senior capacity managing testing execution across small teams.

  • Proven track record of managing task allocation, tracking deliverables, and driving QA teams to complete testing cycles on time.

  • Deep understanding of test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium) using Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Deep understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression management, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

  • Experience with REST API testing using tools like Postman or automated library integrations (e.g., RestAssured).

  • Expertise in writing clear test cases, bug reports, and managing work via Jira and test management tools (e.g., TestRai).

  • Exceptional organizational, analytical, and written/verbal communication skills.

  • AI-Assisted QA: Experience or interest in leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, AI test generators, or GitHub Copilot) to streamline QA workflows—such as auto-generating test cases, writing automation boilerplate code, or drafting edge-case scenarios.


Travel Requirements

None


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Assistant Control Room Operator
description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

As an Assistant Control Room Operator, you will be responsible for the daily operation of the air pollution control (APC) systems and components, turbine generator and associated equipment, boiler feed pumps, condensate pumps, make-up pumps, dump condenser and associated equipment, turbine lube and control oil systems, electrical distribution systems, including breakers, transformers, disconnect switches, inverter, storage batteries, etc., waste water system, treated water system and cooling towers to assure that the facility meets it's operational, environmental, and safety commitments while operating in a safe and environmentally efficient manner.

Position Responsibilities:

· Assisting as needed in the daily operation of the Control Room operation of two 900 TPD boilers and one 62 MW steam turbine generator.

· Operation of fuel feed system including High Angle Conveyor, augers, and fuel feeders.

· Performs inspections, makes effective rounds, and takes appropriate action to maintain APC systems within prescribed limits.

· Performs daily routine inspections of assigned equipment and troubleshooting on equipment and reports all malfunctioning equipment through the issuance of work orders.

· Performs lockout and tag-out of equipment in support of maintenance activities, including confined space permits, hot-work permits, etc..

· Provide guidance Auxiliary, and Back Plant Operators to maintain a safe and efficient operation.

· Effectively monitor power plant operations systems and have strong working knowledge of boiler, turbine, and auxiliary equipment operations

· Manage critical events and prioritize tasks for completion at times during emergency, providing clear directions in operational, safety and environmental tasks.

· Respond to operational alarms, taking immediate corrective action.

· Demonstrate solid understanding of operational best practices, including the ability to problem solve and make sound decisions that supports Facility safety and operational goals.

Position Requirements & Qualifications:

· High School Diploma or equivalent

· Must understand the principles of operation, function of air pollution control system, turbine-generator and associated equipment, balance of plant equipment, wastewater and water chemistry principles, facility electrical distribution and protection.

· Must have taken the municipal waste combustion course within a year upon hire.

· Must be able to work 12 hour rotating shifts.

· Must know, understand and utilize 3-way radio communication.

· Must be able to read, write and verbally communicate in English.

Physical Demands of the Role:

· Ability to walk, stand, sit, and climb

· Ability to lift/carry 50lbs

· Ability to work from heights and in confined spaces

· Qualify to wear a full-face respirator

· Consistently work in various weather conditions

Shift:

· Rotating 12 hour shifts, days and nights.

title: SSH - Bliv en del af et team med høj grad af frihed & ansvar
description:
Vi søger en social- og sundhedshjælper til primær aftenvagt – er det dig, vi mangler?

Din hverdag i Team Maribo

Dit mødested vil være midt i Maribo by, tæt på Naturpark Maribo Søerne og kun få kilometers kørsel fra motorvejen.

Du bliver en del af et udekørende team midt i Maribo by med cirka 140 borgere. Vi er et team bestående af elever, social- og sundhedshjælpere, social- og sundhedsassistenter, en daglig planlægger, en sygeplejefaglig koordinator og en teamleder.

Teamet dækker dag-, aften- og nattevagter, og vi vægter faglighed og godt arbejdsmiljø højt.

Vi arbejder med en rehabiliterende tilgang og helhedspleje, hvor vi har fokus på at støtte borgerne i at bevare og udvikle deres egne ressourcer og selvstændighed. Helhedspleje betyder hos os, at borgeren får den nødvendige hjælp og støtte med udgangspunkt i hele deres situation, så de kan leve et så selvstændigt liv som muligt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på borgerens selvbestemmelse og et tæt samarbejde – både med borgeren selv, de pårørende og på tværs af faggrupper.

Hos os får du medbestemmelse, indflydelse på din vagtplan og en arbejdsdag med plads til grin og udvikling.

Vi forventer, at du:
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper
  • Er fagligt velfunderet
  • Er ansvarsbevidst
  • Evner at arbejde både selvstændigt og tværfagligt
  • Er fortrolig med elektronisk journalføring
  • Arbejder ud fra en anerkendende, rehabiliterende og helhedsorienteret tilgang
  • Har fokus på borgerens selvbestemmelse og inddragelse
  • Bidrager aktivt til samarbejde med kolleger og pårørende
  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og positiv
  • Bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Har gyldigt kørekort til bil

Ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfrist er den 14. august 2026.

Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen er på 28 -32/pr. uge.

Startløn: 27.536,34 kr. pr. måned ved 37 timer (løntrin 19 + grundlønstillæg på 1.578 kr.).

Slutløn: 32.277,92 kr. pr. måned ved 37 timer (løntrin 29 + grundlønstillæg på 3.078 kr.)
.
Hertil kommer pension på 14 % og fritvalgstillæg på 1,29 %.

Derudover giver tillæg for aften-, weekend- og helligdagsarbejde efter gældende overenskomst.

Der medfølger mange rettigheder og fordele ved at være ansat i det offentlige, som fx overenskomstforhandlet løn, gode pensionsordninger, 6. ferieuge, særlig feriegodtgørelse, barsel med løn, 2 årlige omsorgsdage pr. barn under 7 år og overenskomstbestemte seniordage.

Det skal bemærkes, at der inden ansættelse vil blive rekvireret straffeattest.

Spørgsmål?

Hvis du vil høre mere om at arbejde hos os, er du meget velkommen til at tage kontakt til teamleder Camilla Hladka Jensen på tlf: 23 23 99 68.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

Der er tale om en timelønnet stilling med fleksibilitet og vi søger en kollega til 30-37,5t om ugen efter aftale.

title: F&B Service Expert
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Bliv en del af Hos Dodo Restaurant!
description:
Hos Hos Dodo Restaurant & Vin søger vi stadig en engageret, smilende og serviceminded kollega, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Brænder du for at give gæster en fantastisk oplevelse? Elsker du at arbejde med mennesker og trives i et miljø, hvor ingen dage er helt ens? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi er et lille, passioneret team i en restaurant med åbent køkken, hvor nærvær, kvalitet og personlig service er en vigtig del af oplevelsen. Vores mål er, at alle gæster går herfra med et smil –og det kræver medarbejdere, der sætter en ære i god service.

Vi oplever en spændende vækst og søger derfor en ny kollega til en fast stilling ikke kun i højsæsonen, men som en del af vores team på længere sigt.

Vi forventer, at du:

Er smilende, positiv og serviceminded.

Trives med at tale med mennesker og skabe gode relationer.

Er klar til at lære nyt og udvikle dig.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en god holdspiller.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så kig forbi restauranten eller send din ansøgning til kontakt@hosdodo.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Ungekoordinator til spændende stilling inden for ungeområdet
description:
Er du god til at koordinere, og kan du tilrettelægge en sammenhængende indsats for unge med særlige behov? Vil du være den, der samler trådene – og sikrer, at borgere og pårørende oplever én fælles retning
og én plan? Så er det dig, vi søger.

Allerød Kommune søger en ungekoordinator til ungeområdet den 1. oktober 2026.

Hvem er vi?
Du bliver en del af Borgerservice i Allerød Kommune, som både løser klassiske opgaver (pas, kørekort)
og komplekse indsatser på det specialiserede børne- og voksenområde, beskæftigelses- og integrationsområdet. Borgerservice beskæftiger ca. 200 medarbejdere på tværs af myndigheds- og
udfører området.

Vi arbejder ud fra et stærkt helhedssyn:

  • Vi tager altid udgangspunkt i borgerens livssituation, ressourcer og ønsker.
  • Vi understøtter borgerens mestring af hverdag, familie, uddannelse, job og fritid.

Vi arbejder efter tilgangen ”Én borger – én plan”, hvor koordinatoren skaber sammenhæng på tværs
af fagområder og sikrer et samlet overblik for både borger og samarbejdspartnere.

Om stillingen som ungekoordinator
Beskæftigelsesreformen og Ungeløftet sætter endnu mere fokus på ungeområdet end hidtil, og
vi søger derfor dig, der brænder for at arbejde med unge i alderen 16-30-årige, som har særlige behov.
Har du erfaring eller kendskab til ungeområdet fx støtte, rådgivning, botilbud, uddannelses-og beskæftigelsesrettede indsatser, så er det måske lige dig, vi søger.

Som ungekoordinator bliver du en del af Team Social, Uddannelse og Beskæftigelse, der består af
14 engagerede kolleger, som arbejder med indsatser for unge og voksne fra 16 år og med stort fokus
på uddannelse og beskæftigelse.

Du bliver derfor en del af et miljø med stærk faglighed, tæt samarbejde og løbende sparring.

Hvem søger vi?
Du er dygtig til at koordinere på tværs af faggrupper, forvaltninger, andre myndigheder og samarbejdspartnere, og trives i at sætte dig for bordenden og være koordinator i sagen. Du er skarp på uddannelse og beskæftigelse, og har øje for, at der på vejen dertil kan være behov for indsatser på tværs
af lovgivninger for at skabe en målrettet sammenhængende og helhedsorienteret indsats.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver, socialformidler eller har tilsvarende relevant uddannelse
  • Har god erfaring med rådgivning og sagsbehandling
  • Har erfaring med jobcenterindsatser for unge og kendskab til relevant lovgivning på området
  • Har lyst til at arbejde tværfagligt og være myndighedssagsbehandler på Barnets Lov, Serviceloven og
    Lov om en aktiv beskæftigelsesindsats
  • Er god til at koordinere på tværs af afdelinger, andre myndigheder, eksterne samarbejdspartnere mm. og samtidigt kan lede et dynamisk teamarbejde omkring den enkelte borger
  • Kan bevare overblikket, så der bliver skabt sammenhængende og koordinerede forløb med optimal timing mellem tilbuddene
  • Vægter dialogen med borgerne og de pårørende højt, og kan håndtere pressede situationer og konflikter
  • Er engageret og struktureret og synes, det er sjovt at gå på arbejde
  • Har en god skriftlighed
  • Har kendskab til it på brugerniveau (vi arbejder blandt andet i DUBU, Fasit og Acadre.)

Hvorfor vælge os?
Allerød Kommune er en arbejdsplads med en høj social kapital. Vi vægter tværfagligt samarbejde, kompetence- og jobudvikling og ikke mindst medindflydelse på egen hverdag højt. Det vigtigste for os
er vores kerneopgave – at skabe værdi for borgeren.

Er du interesseret?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Omid Samadi på 23 49 62 19 eller Beskæftigelseschef
Jane Gottlieb Svendsen på 22474213 for yderligere oplysninger.

Du uploader din ansøgning sammen med dit CV og uddannelsesbevis via linket i annoncen senest
den 20. august 2026.

Vi indhenter referencer og straffeoplysninger forud for endelig ansættelse.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår vil blive fastsat efter gældende overenskomst.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

I Allerød Kommune arbejder vi ud fra vores Børne- og ungepolitik med dertilhørende underliggende børne- og læringssyn.

Kommunen har ca. 2.000 medarbejdere, der arbejder ud fra et fælles Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag, hvor værdier som dialog, samarbejde, respekt og faglighed er hjørnesten. Her kan du læse Allerød Kommunes Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag.

Organisationen baserer sig på flade strukturer, stor medindflydelse og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Allerød Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads med røgfri arbejdstid.

Vi tror på, at mangfoldighed hos vores medarbejdere styrker vores organisation og løsningen af den fælles kerneopgave. Vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge stillingen uanset køn, kønsidentitet, alder, handicap, etnisk baggrund eller seksuel orientering.

Allerød Kommune ligger i hjertet af Nordsjælland i en smuk og varieret natur. Kommunen har tæt på 26.000 indbyggere og byder på et aktivt forenings- og erhvervsliv med gode idræts- og fritidsmuligheder.

Der er flere gode transportmuligheder både til og fra kommunen, og der går S-tog hvert 10. minut fra Allerød Station.

title: KYC Services Analyst
description:
About Ontra
Ontra is the leader in AI-powered solutions for the private markets. Powered by industry-leading AI, data from over 2 million contracts, and a global network of legal professionals, Ontra automates critical private market workflows across the fund lifecycle. Ontra’s solutions transform unstructured data trapped in static documents into actionable intelligence, enabling firms to accelerate contracts, streamline compliance, and automate entity management. Trusted by more than 1,000 global GPs, investment banks, law firms, and advisors – including nine of the top ten PEI-ranked firms worldwide – Ontra helps firms focus on what’s important.

Our Culture
Ontra is built for people who want real ownership from day one in a remote-first environment that’s built to support it. Our customers are sophisticated, and our work reflects that. AI is engrained in how we work, and curiosity about it is part of who we are.

Ontranauts are sharp, genuinely collaborative, and invested in each other's success. They are excellent at what they do and even better to work with. That combination is rare, and we don't take it for granted. Learn more about our values.

<hr>

For this job, we are currently only hiring candidates based in the United States. For this role, we are prioritizing candidates in the US Eastern and Central Time Zones. For more information on where we employ, please see below.

About the Role

Ontra is seeking a KYC Services Analyst, reporting to our Managing Director, KYC, on our KYC Team.

We're looking for someone excited to support Private Investment firms Know Your Customer (KYC) screening processes, to help them facilitate loan closings, counterparty onboarding, and ongoing refreshes.

If you have a strong background in KYC processes, know the rules, regulations, and market norms, and have exceptional organizational and KYC diligence skills, we’d love to get to know you.

What You’ll Do

  • KYC Screening: Complete KYC Screening/Onboardings in accordance with customer-specific compliance playbook

  • Customer Relationships: Support Private Investment firms regularly, learning their policies and ways of working.

  • Customer Communication: Engage in customer interactions regularly, ensuring clear, efficient, and positive communication within a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience as a KYC professional or paralegal.

  • Industry Experience: Prior KYC experience at a bank or a private equity fund.

  • Customer Orientation: Ability to interface directly with customers and counterparties to collect information, answer questions, and ensure a smooth and responsive KYC experience.

  • Attention to Detail: Skill in accurately completing a high volume of KYC requests, including document collection, questionnaire responses, and stakeholder coordination.

  • Communication Skills: Maintains a high level of polish and responsiveness in external communications, representing the brand and commitment to service quality.

title: Norstat Danmark A/S søger telefoninterviewere til vores aftenhold i Odense centrum
description:

Har du flair for at tale med forskellige mennesker og er tryg ved telefonisk kontakt? Vil du indgå i et uformelt team, hvor du selv kan vælge dine arbejdsdage? Så har vi jobbet til dig!

Vi afholder jobsamtaler og oplæringer løbende, så ansøg hurtigst muligt.

title: Assistant Planning Analyst, Wholesale
description:
Job Description:

The Third Party Operations Assistant, will be responsible for the end-to-end management of wholesale orders, fostering strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. The Third Party Operations Assistant will be working closely with the Sales, Buying, Planning, DC and Finance Teams to provide operational support to our Wholesale partners across EMEA. This role requires a strategic mindset combined with a keen attention to detail and data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative team player with a passion for problem-solving and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

This job is located at our Global Home Office in Columbus, Ohio.

What Will You Be Doing?

  • Order Management: Manage the process for third-party orders, address and escalate any issues found in customer orders and ensure all order details are verified before entry.
  • Customer Support: Handle customer inquiries efficiently, ensuring appropriate measures are in place to safeguard against quality, cost, or delivery failures. Ensure timely and accurate processing of orders within agreed deadlines.
  • Orderbook Management: Maintain the Orderbook to support third-party purchasing and maintain product availability. Release orders based on allocation coverage, requested delivery dates, shipping requirements and month sales targets.
  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Serve as the primary liaison between Finance, Sales, Planning, Distribution Centers, and Product development teams, ensuring key updates and changes are communicated and managed promptly.
  • Issue Management: Resolve production issues by coordinating with stakeholders, credit teams, and supply chain to ensure order coverage, accurate VAS, and on-time delivery within SLAs.
  • Relationship Management: Foster strong partnerships with both internal teams and external customers to enhance collaboration and performance.
  • Reporting: Create and manage weekly reports to share with Sales and Planning teams, providing updates on Orderbook progress and identifying risks or opportunities.

What Do You Need To Bring?

  • Bachelor’s Degree or related experience
  • Experience in B2B/Wholesale operations in the fashion industry
  • Good understanding of production development timelines and calendars
  • Excellent math, organization, and time management skills
  • Proficient in MS Office and Excel, working knowledge of systems that house product information (i.e. PLM)
  • Strong ability to handle and understand analytical data, with keen attention to detail and accuracy
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a focus on continuous improvement and process implementation
  • Eagerness to creatively solve problems and drive business profitability and growth
  • EDI literacy would be highly advantageous

Benefits & Perks

As an Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) associate, you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A&F Co. is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward:

  • Incentive bonus program
  • 401(K) savings plan with company match
  • Annual companywide review process
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Associate assistance program
  • Paid parental and adoption leave
  • Access to fertility and adoption benefits through Carrot
  • Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace
  • Paid Caregiver Leave
  • Mobile Stipend
  • Paid time off and one paid volunteer day per year, allowing you to give back to your community
  • Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles and six work from anywhere weeks per year)
  • Seven associate wellness half days per year
  • Merchandise discount on all of our brands
  • Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within
  • Access to multiple Associate Resource Groups
  • Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU!

Company Description

Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.

The company operates a family of brands, including Abercrombie brands and Hollister brands, each sharing a commitment to offer products of enduring quality and exceptional comfort that support global customers on their journey to being and becoming who they are. Abercrombie & Fitch Co. operates stores under these brands across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East, as well as the e-commerce sites abercrombie.com, abercrombiekids.com and hollisterco.com.

Learn more about A&F Co. by visiting our corporate website here.

ABERCROMBIE & FITCH CO. IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

title: Data Specialist
description:
KPMG New Zealand is part of the international KPMG network and one of the world’s leading professional services organisations. We provide audit, tax and advisory services to individuals, SMEs, multi‑nationals and government agencies.

Locally, we’re known for our values‑driven culture and strong staff engagement, anchored in our purpose of fuelling New Zealand’s prosperity. This purpose drives everything we do, from our client work to internal practises, all guided by our shared values of Integrity, Courage, Excellence, Together, for Better.

The Opportunity:

  • The Data Specialist helps ensure that KPMG is a data-driven and insights-led firm. The role will help develop, modernise, and support data solutions that enable reliable reporting, business process automation, operational integrations, and analytics across the firm.
  • Our data platform supports a broad set of business-critical functions, including data engineering, cloud data platforms, operational data services, data integrations, semantic models, Power BI reporting, and trusted data products.
  • The role will support the ongoing modernisation of our data estate, helping us move from traditional style data operations & patterns towards a more cloud-enabled, governed and AI-ready data platform.
  • You will work across modern data technologies such as Azure SQL, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related cloud data services, while continuing to support the operational reliability of current data services.
  • The role will also contribute to improving data governance, data quality, lineage, security, and trusted consumption of data across reporting, integrations, automation, and future AI-enabled use cases.

Day to day you will:

  • Design, develop and maintain data pipelines, data integrations, databases, and models supporting analytical solutions.
  • Build and support modern ETL/ELT patterns across cloud data platforms, including Azure, Databricks, SQL and related Azure services.
  • Integrate and manage data from a range of internal and external source systems, including APIs, files, cloud services, operational applications, and vendor platforms.
  • Develop and support curated data products that can be used by semantic models, Power BI reports, downstream integrations, and future AI-enabled consumption patterns.
  • Support operational data workloads, business process automations, reference/master data needs, and integration persistence using relational data platforms where appropriate.
  • Produce and maintain BI reporting solutions, semantic models and analytics-ready datasets that provide accurate, consistent, and timely insights.
  • Contribute to data governance practices including data quality, lineage, access control, metadata, sensitivity classification, and documentation.
  • Use Azure DevOps and modern engineering practices to manage code, deployments, releases and change control.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, technology teams, data consumers, and external vendors to understand requirements and deliver reliable, scalable solutions.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot and improve existing data processes to ensure performance, reliability, security, and supportability.

What you will bring to the team:

  • Bring strong cloud data engineering experience and are comfortable working across modern data platforms, ideally within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • Have hands-on experience building and supporting data pipelines using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, PySpark, Python, SQL, SSIS or similar ETL/ELT tools.
  • Understand traditional SQL Server, SSIS, data warehouse and operational data patterns, but are equally interested in helping transition these workloads into modern cloud-based architectures.
  • Are confident working with SQL Server and Azure SQL, including T-SQL development, stored procedures, views, indexing, relational modelling, and performance tuning.
  • Have experience, or a strong interest, in modern platform capabilities such as Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI semantic models and governed data products.
  • Have experience integrating data from multiple sources including APIs, files, databases, cloud services, vendor platforms, and internal business systems.
  • Are comfortable working through platform transition, supporting existing operational processes while helping shape improved engineering, governance, and delivery practices.

title: Jeg søger én fuldtids-, og én deltidsassistent til mit stabile team på Djursland
description:
OMRÅDE: 8550 Ryomgård

LIDT OM MIG:

Jeg bruger meget af min hverdag hjemme i min lejlighed, hvor jeg blandt andet hygger mig med PlayStation, iPad, YouTube, serier og alt muligt andet, der hører den digitale verden til. Det betyder ikke, at vi bare sidder og kigger ind i en skærm hele dagen – der er masser af plads til gode snakke, humor og en afslappet stemning, mens dagens opgaver bliver klaret.

Når weekenden rammer, kan det til gengæld godt gå lidt stærkere. Jeg elsker fodbold og musik og nyder at tage på stadion, opleve koncerter og festivaler eller en tur i byen med venner. Derfor er det helt klart en fordel, hvis du også synes, den slags er hyggeligt. Du behøver ikke være den største fodboldfan eller festivalgænger, men det er fedt, hvis du har lyst til at være med, når vi tager af sted.

JOBBESKRIVELSE:

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

Hjælp ved toiletbesøg, bad, påklædning og ind og ud af sengen.

Madlavning, almindelig rengøring og praktiske opgaver i lejligheden.

Ledsagelse, når jeg skal ud. (Dette er oftest i manuel kørestol)

Muligvis hjælp til administrative opgaver. Det vigtigste for mig er ikke, om du har masser af erfaring – men at du er mødestabil, har humor og er et rart menneske at være sammen med.

Jeg sætter stor pris på en afslappet omgangstone, og jeg synes, at et godt grin gør selv de mest almindelige hverdage lidt bedre. Derfor håber jeg også, at du ikke er bange for at byde ind med lidt humor.

Du bliver som handicaphjælper en del af et godt, fleksibelt og nødvendigt team af handicaphjælpere, der i fællesskab dækker alle vagter året rundt. Jobbet foregår i borgerens eget hjem, til fritidsaktiviteter, sociale arrangementer og de udflugter borgeren skulle have lyst til at deltage i.

KVALIFIKATIONER:

  • Kørekort B

  • Fleksibel

  • Praktisk

  • Selvstændig

  • Have respekt- og forståelse for at arbejde i et privat hjem

  • Høj hygiejnestandard

  • Jævnaldrende hjælper

PRAKTISKE INFORMATIONER:

  • Startdato: Snarest muligt

  • Fuldtid

  • Sidste frist for ansøgning: 31.08.20266

  • Afholdelse af samtaler: Løbende

  • Vi forbeholder os retten til at fjerne jobopslag før sidste frist, såfremt den rette kandidat er fundet

  • Hvis ikke du har hørt noget inden sidste frist, må du gå ud fra at stillingen er besat til anden side

  • Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest ved ansættelsen

LØN:
Hos den pågældende borger aflønnes du efter stedtillæg 0 i henhold til følgende takstblad – LINK

Ved eventuel henvendelse, oplys da medlemsnummer: 200960

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge – uanset køn, seksuel orientering, etnisk baggrund, religion, handicap eller alder. Vi tror på, at vores forskellighed beriger vores organisation og hjælper med at nå vores mål i fællesskab.
