description:
We explore and discover the limitless possibilities of energy so we can all progress. We believe in the power of talent to shape the future. That’s why we’re looking for curious, bold individuals who are eager to grow and create new ways forward—people who want to join us in building a more sustainable, innovative, and inclusive world.
We strongly believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation. That’s why we welcome professionals who are ready to grow, learn, and bring their perspective to the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.
Here, you’ll find a place to grow and unlock your full potential.



Repsol is hiring a Division Order Analyst to support the Land Business Unit, to be based onsite from our office in The Woodlands, TX.

Position Title: Division Order Analyst

Department: Land

Reports to: Division Order Supervisor

Location: This role is to be supported onsite from the Repsol office located in The Woodlands, Texas. Following the initial training period, the position is eligible for our hybrid schedule, with manager approval. The schedule may be adjusted as needed based on business needs or individual performance.

Position Overview and Responsibilities

  • Review of Title Opinions, Title related documents, Agreements and Oil and Gas Leases.
  • Ensure curative requirements are met prior to distribution of revenue
  • Monitor and maintain Suspense files during resolution and release
  • Process conveyances and address updates
  • Create and maintain division of interests and corresponding joint interest billing and revenue (pay) decks including marketing burden groups and BPO and APO decks when necessary
  • Ensure all Division Order records are updated timely for infill wells and process unit reformations within Division Order Land system
  • Complex analysis of complicated calculations of interest, including but not limited to apportionment, ORRI, NRI, and DOI
  • Thorough review of Pooling Declarations, Unit Tabulations, and create working interest NRI/burden spreadsheets when required
  • Verify company owned interests on any outside operated division order
  • Ensure partners and landowners are sent appropriate land documents to support revenue/royalty interest
  • Assist with projects requiring research, analysis, and interface with different departments
  • Review of funds to be escheated and assist with unclaimed property audits when required
  • Respond to internal and revenue/royalty owner inquiry communications.
  • Workflow and Revenue Distribution Sheet (RDS) tracking; Monthly RDS processing by Division Order cutoff
  • Submit Master Data vendor requests and updates
  • Create, organize, and maintain electronic Division Order files
  • Provide updates to Supervisor for weekly and monthly department reports
  • Participate in weekly development and department meetings
  • Responsible for monthly monitoring of all Division Order data integrity reports

Required Education, Experience, Technical Qualifications

  • Full U.S. work authorization without restrictions, conditions, or current/future sponsorship.
  • High School Degree or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of relevant oil & gas experience
  • Professional certifications related to land management preferred, but not required
  • Strong technical acumen with MS Office suite
  • Experience working the Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania and an understanding of applicable laws within that State
  • Experience with SAP PRA and Quorum (QDO)
  • Experience with Power Bi preferable
  • Knowledge interpreting lease language for royalty provisions

Key Competencies

  • Demonstrates the Corporate Values
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Excellent organizational & communication skills both oral and written are required
  • Superior interpersonal and customer relationship skills.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize workload while working in fast-paced work environment
  • Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines

title: Occupancy Planning Senior Analyst
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Occupancy Planning Senior Analyst provides operational support for JLL’s Occupancy Planning and Management platform, helping coordinate workplace planning initiatives, client engagement activities, reporting, and team processes across multiple regions. This role supports day-to-day occupancy planning operations through strong organization, communication, and process management while delivering light reporting and analytical support.

The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, detail-oriented, and client-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This position requires strong operational coordination skills, proactive communication, and the ability to foster productive relationships with clients, teammates, and cross-functional partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Occupancy Planning Support (40-50%)

  • Facilitate onboarding of new hires to the Occupancy Planning team and maintain onboarding materials
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Space Sharing processes, including training, reporting, client coordination/ communication, and remediation protocols
  • Coordinate cross-regional workplace initiatives and operational tasks
  • Maintain and continuously improve occupancy planning tools and templates
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support development of new tools, templates, and process improvements
  • Establish and maintain document retention systems and team management protocols
  • Support monthly and quarterly reporting activities
  • Act as an Occupancy Planning representative for workplace systems and related operational processes
  • Support miscellaneous operational and client requests as needed

Change Management & Process Coordination (20–30%)

  • Support occupancy planning process consistency and adherence to account deliverables
  • Serve as a resource for client design guidelines impact to OP
  • Support development request processes and coordination related to workplace systems and reporting
  • Participate in annual Occupancy Planning Playbook updates to ensure current processes and standards are documented
  • Organize and facilitate training sessions and meetings for cross-regional teams
  • Maintain team distribution lists and communication resources

Client Support & Relationship Management (10-20%)

  • Function as a liaison for Lines of Business (LOB) client contacts and occupancy planning stakeholders
  • Coordinate and facilitate recurring stakeholder forums and any other communications
  • Maintain and update stakeholder guidance documentation and communication resources
  • Respond promptly to client inquiries and operational requests with a solution-oriented approach
  • Foster strong working relationships with clients, partners, and internal teams through proactive communication and dependable follow-through

Client Deliverables & Reporting (5–10%)

  • Support development and coordination of monthly and quarterly client deliverables
  • Assist with reporting, data validation, and presentation materials
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency across occupancy planning documentation and reporting outputs

SUCCESS BEHAVIORS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Communicate effectively across multiple levels of the organization
  • Demonstrate understanding of client business drivers and operational priorities
  • Anticipate client and team needs proactively
  • Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Demonstrate accountability and ownership of deliverables and outcomes
  • Build collaborative relationships across teams and stakeholders
  • Exercise sound judgment and problem-solving skills in fast-paced environments
  • Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and innovation
  • Adapt effectively to changing priorities and evolving operational needs
  • Deliver consistent, high-quality client service

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in occupancy planning, workplace operations, facilities management, move management, project coordination, or related fields
  • Strong understanding of occupancy planning and workplace operations best practices
  • Familiarity with design, project management, facilities management, or architecture concepts
  • Experience supporting client-facing operations within corporate real estate or workplace environments preferred
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, advanced functions, and reporting
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, SharePoint, Visio and Word
  • Experience working with space management systems, including FMS
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and customer service skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Estimated compensation for this position:

85,000.00 – 100,000.00 USD per year

This range is an estimate and actual compensation may differ. Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location:

Remote –Charlotte, NC, Chicago, IL, Dallas, TX, Jacksonville, FL, St. Louis, MO

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!


Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits may include:

title: English Language Copyeditor (Part Time, Independent Contractor)
description:
About Just Right Reader

Just Right Reader is a literacy publisher dedicated to helping children become confident, successful readers through engaging, research-based resources grounded in the Science of Reading. Our growing product line includes decodable and knowledge-building books, classroom resources, teacher guides, lesson plans, literacy games, family resources, and marketing materials designed for students from Birth through Grade 12.

We're looking for an experienced English-language copyeditor to support our Product team by ensuring all content is clear, accurate, consistent, and publication-ready.

About This Engagement

Just Right Reader is seeking an experiencedEnglish-language copyeditor. This is a part-time contract position ideal for an experienced copyeditor with a strong command of English grammar, style, and mechanics. You'll work closely with our Product team to review a variety of educational materials and provide high-quality copyedits within tight production timelines.

Turnaround Expectations

Projects vary in length and complexity, and quick turnaround times are essential. Please note that our production schedule often requires a quick turnaround (typically 24–48 hours, depending on the project scope). Applicants should be comfortable working within these timelines and communicating proactively about their availability to ensure deadlines are met.

Scope of Work

This contractor will provide copy-editing support, which may include:

  • Copyedit educational materials for grammar, spelling, punctuation, sentence structure, clarity, consistency, and readability.
  • Ensure consistency with company style guides and editorial standards (e.g., Chicago Manual of Style).
  • Maintain consistency in spelling, capitalization, terminology, formatting, and voice across products.
  • Flag inconsistencies, ambiguities, or potential errors while preserving the author's intent.
  • Meet fast-paced production schedules and agreed-upon deadlines.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, writers, editors, and designers throughout the publishing process.

This engagement does not include internal people management, HR responsibilities, or administrative duties.

Materials You May Review

  • Children's book manuscripts (Birth through Grade 12)
  • Decodable readers
  • Lesson plans
  • Teacher guides
  • Family resources
  • Literacy games
  • Marketing materials
  • Product packaging
  • Digital learning resources
  • Internal educational documents

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Professional copyediting experience (educational publishing preferred)
  • Exceptional knowledge of English grammar, punctuation, spelling, and usage
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Experience editing materials for children and educators is highly preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong organizational and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while meeting tight deadlines
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and Adobe Acrobat for reviewing and copyediting documents.

Preferred Experience

  • Children's publishing
  • Educational publishing
  • Science of Reading curriculum
  • Teacher resources
  • Decodable texts
  • Chicago Manual of Style (or similar editorial standards)

Engagement Details

  • This role is structured as an independent contractor (1099) engagement.
  • Duration - This will be an ongoing agreement that will be evaluated for continuation on a monthly basis per business need.
  • The contractor will determine their own work schedule, methods, tools, and approach, subject to agreed-upon milestones and deadlines.
  • The contractor may provide services to other clients during the term of this engagement.
  • Compensation will be provided on a monthly retainer or project-based basis, as outlined in a separate agreement.
  • Services will be performed remotely; occasional in-person collaboration may occur by mutual agreement.

How to Express Interest

Please submit:

  1. Your resume highlighting relevant copyediting experience.
  2. A brief summary of your experience editing educational or children's materials.
  3. Your typical turnaround time for copyediting projects.
  4. Your preferred rate structure (hourly, per page, or another pricing method) and your rates.

Applicants selected to move forward in the hiring process may be asked to complete a brief, one-page copyediting exercise.

title: Club Lead Coach / Pathway Lead for Hammer - UoB Sports and Fitness - 107574 - Grade 5
description:
Position Details

UoB Sports and Fitness

University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham UK

Full time starting salary is normally in the range £30,062 to £31,900, with potential progression once in post to £35,883

Grade: 5

Part Time (14 hours per week)

Fixed Term contract up to October 2027

Our offer to you

People are at the heart of what we are and do.

The University of Birmingham is proud to have been a part of the City of Birmingham and the wider region for over 100 years, and we are equally proud to be recognised as a leading global university. We want to attract talented people from across the city and beyond, support them to succeed, and celebrate their success.

We are committed to helping the people who work here to develop through our sector-leading Birmingham Professional programme which provides all professional services staff with development opportunities and the encouragement to reach their full potential. With almost 5,000 professional services jobs in a wide-range of functions in Edgbaston and in our campus in Dubai, there are plenty of opportunities for you to be able to develop your career at the University.

We believe there is no such thing as a typical member of staff and that diversity is a source of strength that underpins the exchange of ideas, innovation, and debate. We warmly welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where diversity is at the heart of who and what we are, and how we work.

Supporting our people to achieve a healthy work/life balance is important both to our employees and to the success of the University and, depending on the role, we offer a variety of flexible working arrangements. We therefore welcome discussions on all forms of flexible working. In addition, you will receive a generous package of benefits including 40 days paid holiday a year, one paid day a year for volunteering, occupational sick pay, and a pension scheme. We also have three high quality subsidised day nurseries.

The University is situated in leafy Edgbaston and there are excellent transport links to our beautiful campus, including main bus routes and a train station on site. On campus we have a state-of-the-art sports centre with pool, shops, places to eat and drink, our own art gallery, museum and botanical gardens.

Find out more about the benefits of working for the University of Birmingham

Background

This role will create a fresh and important dimension to the operations of both Athletics Talent Hub and University Athletics Club. The role would allow us to target specific elements of pathway growth but, at the same time, build wider impacts. In context:

  • Hammer Talent Event Lead
    • Co-ordinating regional and national athlete and coach development days
    • Work with the other England Athletics Technical Event Leads to agree content, dates, venues, deliverers & bookings
    • Female throws coach developer
  • Talent Hub hammer coach
    • Coach and POC for hub-based hammer athletes
    • Engaging and developing West Midlands regional athletics clubs and their coaching workforce
  • YTP hammer coach & throws co-ordinator
  • Potential for International team staff roles

Role Summary

Your role will be to plan, coordinate and deliver the Hammer coaching programme of the Athletics Hub, focusing on the development of a high performance culture for University of Birmingham Sport, optimising performance in competitions, as well as raising the profile of the University of Birmingham as a performance sport university and increasing increase sport participation. You will work with the Head Coach and club committee in order to lead the development of Hammer Coaching. In order to flexibly use resource you may be given the opportunity to work elsewhere in the department or the wider University.

Main Duties

Coaching - to work in collaboration with the Head of Athletics in order to coordinate and deliver high quality coaching sessions for the advancement of skill and performance of club individuals, teams or squads.

  • Planning the development, set-up and running of all event specific coaching sessions.
  • Promoting an enjoyable and inclusive atmosphere, by acting professionally and displaying good coaching conduct at all times.
  • Ensuring good practice is applied throughout all sessions by adhering to NGB and UOB policy and procedures where applicable.
  • Responsible for team selection and performance, determining selection and the standards required and providing constructive feedback where applicable.
  • Motivating and encouraging team members, showing commitment to the development of athletes and teams, and making recommendations for individual and team performance improvements.
  • Developing annual plans of competition/events including setting target objectives for the sport and individuals.
  • Keeping knowledge of BUCS and sports specific rules and regulations up to date, and using this knowledge to implement any changes to rulings, advising UBS of any implications on budget, team performance or club development.
  • Acting as a mentor, referring athletes to appropriate support services where necessary.

Club Management and Development

  • Supporting the development of student leadership skills, particularly in club committee members, through effective communication and support of club administration, and through ensuring an inclusive, professional culture both on and off the pitch.
  • Liaising with the Head of Athletics over the development of sessions, athletes and other coaches and club development, attending meetings where necessary.
  • Assisting in managing disciplinary issues raised with club members, liaising with the Club Development Manager and the University Discipline Manager where necessary.
  • Reviewing budgets and providing budget recommendations through working with the Head of Athletics.
  • Work with the UBS Marketing and Scholarship Team as appropriate in the effective promotion and publicity of the Hub’s event specific programme.
  • Assisting the UBS team in hosting events such as Open Days and Alumni Sports Days.

Other duties

  • You will be required to be conversant with and work to UBS'S Safeguarding Children and Vulnerable Adults Policy and Procedures
  • You will actively participate in job chats and personal development reviews on your own performance, and agree objectives and targets and work to achieve these within agreed timescales.
  • You will provide general progress reports, project updates and proposals to the Head of Athletics and Club Development Manager as required.
  • You will undertake any other duties that may reasonably be required and which can be accommodated within the postholder's grading.
  • Treats everyone with dignity and respect in line with current equality legislation.
  • Respond to equality and diversity issues in line with relevant university policies and procedures
  • Other relevant criteria from our equality and diversity duties document.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications, Experience

  • GCSE Maths and English (minimum Grade C/4) or equivalent level 2 qualifications.
  • UKCC Level 3 coaching award (or equivalent).
  • First aid qualification.
  • An in-depth understanding of coaching styles and practical delivery.
  • Knowledge of the sport's organisation at national & regional levels in the UK Knowledge/understanding of equity and diversity related to sporting provision.
  • Motivational and mentoring skills (especially in the context of performance players).
  • Ability and track record of working as part of a busy team and working effectively under pressure to tight deadlines.
  • A commitment to the development of your sport at all levels and understanding of the sports development process.
  • Effective problem solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain an environment of winning and success.
  • IT skills including competence in the use Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Positive attitude towards CPD.
  • Experience of managing a small team and its range of responsibilities.
  • Experience of successfully leading others, preferably in both direct supervision of other paid employees and of volunteers.
  • Understands the importance of equality and diversity in the workplace
  • Ability to identify and respond to equality and diversity issues in line with relevant university policies and procedures relating to equality and diversity.

Due to the nature of the work undertaken in this role all successful applicants will be subject to a satisfactory DBS clearance prior to appointment.

title: Front Office Team Lead
description:
Overview

Make a Difference. Grow in Your Career. Thrive with Us.

About the Role

At Mindpath Health, we’re on a mission to make mental health care more accessible and more human. As a national leader in mental health services, we empower our clinicians, support our teams, and prioritize care that helps people truly thrive.

The Front Office Team Lead serves as a trusted peer leader and operational support resource for Front Office Coordinators and Clinicians across one or more offices. This role performs the role of Front Office Coordinator and also supports peers with real-time guidance, reinforces standard processes, and helps ensure consistency, efficiency, and a positive patient and team experience at the front office level. The Lead, FOC supports day-to-day operations by monitoring workflow execution, assisting with onboarding and informal training, and serving as a point of escalation for front office questions and issues. This role partners closely with Operations leadership to identify process gaps, support new initiatives, and promote best practices, while remaining actively engaged in front office workflows. Perform the full range of FOC duties, including front desk operations, patient check-in, scheduling, and phone coverage, while serving as a peer lead. This role is ideal for someone passionate about serving university students, faculty, and staff in an outpatient setting and supporting our College Health Program.

This role is full-time (40 hours/week, Monday–Friday) onsite in our Isla Vista office.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Perform all responsibilities outlined in Front Office Coordinator job description
  • Serve as a real-time point of contact for Front Office Coordinators in one or multiple offices, providing guidance, answering questions, and supporting day-to-day operations.
  • Monitor completion of daily, weekly, and monthly front office checklists and designated operating reports to ensure timely and accurate execution of tasks.
  • Escalate operational concerns or workflow issues to the Operations Supervisor or other appropriate leaders.
  • Support the rollout of new initiatives by providing feedback during planning, implementation, and post-launch phases; help identify opportunities for improvement and share insights from the front office perspective.
  • Champion consistency and excellence in front office operations by modeling best practices and reinforcing standard operating procedures.
  • Assist with onboarding and informal training of new Front Office Coordinators, offering peer support and guidance to promote confidence and competence.
  • Collaborate with leadership to identify gaps in front office processes and contribute to solutions that enhance efficiency and service quality.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, encouraging open communication and mutual support among Front Office Coordinators.
  • Maintains compliance with company policies and regulatory standards and models professional conduct within the office.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Experience with EMR/EHR or practice management systems required.
  • Prior team lead or supervisory experience with strong leadership skills.
  • 2+ years of front office, administrative, customer service, or clerical experience; healthcare preferred.
  • Demonstrated customer service experience, including the ability to exercise sound judgment, independent thinking, and problem-solving when resolving issues
  • Working knowledge of general administrative and clerical procedures
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, which may include prior team lead or supervisory experience or informal leadership responsibilities
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective relationships with patients, clinicians, leadership, and peers
  • Ability to influence, support, and guide others without direct authority
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word)
  • Experience with multiline phone systems
  • Accurate typing and data entry skill
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to prioritize and multitask
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team

CompensationThe pay rate for this position is $24.75 per hour.

Why Join Mindpath Health?

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job, you’re stepping into a community built on support, inclusion, and growth.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Life & Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid time off starting at 15 days per year
  • Paid parental leave
  • Tuition reimbursement

About Us

Mindpath Health is redefining how mental health care is delivered. Today, we operate in more than 100 locations across six states, providing a full range of psychiatric and therapy services via in-person and telehealth appointments. Our team is deeply committed to supporting total health through compassionate, collaborative care.

If you're looking for a purpose-driven organization where your work truly matters, we’d love to meet you.

Mindpath Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Logistik- og forsyningsmedarbejder i Forsyningsenheden, Logistik- og projektafsnittet SUH Køge.
description:
Om Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital (SUH) er et førende hospital i Region Sjælland med fokus på høj faglighed, effektiv drift og moderne logistikløsninger. Vi befinder os midt i en spændende udviklingsfase med både nybyggeri, teknologiske implementeringer og organisatoriske forandringer. Derfor søger vi en Logistik- og forsyningsmedarbejder til at styrke forsyningsopgaven der primært omhandler varelogistik og logistiske nicheopgaver.

På SUH bestræber vi os på at leve op til et sæt ledelsesværdier i vores hverdag og det vil du kunne mærke fra dag ét. Vores værdier er følgeskab, fællesskab, nytænkning og ordentlighed. Du vil blive inddraget i processerne og være en del af at opretholde de værdier i måden vi sammen arbejder på.

Din arbejdsplads er på Sjællands Universitetshospital i Køge.

Udvikling af logistikkonceptet

Vi er midt i en spændende udviklingsproces, og du bliver en del af den udvikling. Du kan forvente at jobbet bliver formet i løbet af de næste par år, da vi fortsat er ved at blive udbygget, og der frem mod 2028 vil flytte flere kliniske afdelinger ind på universitetssygehuset. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er tilpasningsparat og imødekommende overfor dynamiske ændringer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som Logistik- og forsyningsmedarbejder får du en nøglerolle i forsyning og leverance af nødvendige forbrugsvarer, der skal sikre at kliniske specialister, sygeplejerske og øvrigt plejepersonale kan udføre deres kerneopgave på deres respektive afdelinger. Du spiller også en rolle i at kvalitetssikre værdikæden fra varemodtagelse til anvendelse i klinikken. Du vil bl.a. håndtere opgaver som:

  • Varebestilling via scanning.
  • Dato-tjek på forbrugsvarer.
  • Hygiejnemæssige rutineopgaver.
  • Opfyldning af varer i stueskabe og faste depotskabe på sengeafdelinger, kliniske specialer og ambulatorier.
  • Klargøring- og parathedsarbejde ift. indflytning af nye afdelinger på sygehuset.
  • Håndtering af logistiske niche-opgaver f.eks. håndtering af specifikke varer til bestemte formål.
  • Ad-hoc opgaver.

Kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er servicemindet og ansvarsfuld.
  • Tager ejerskab over opgaverne.
  • Sætter en ære i og er god til at overholde aftaler.
  • Kan følge retningslinjer og logistikkoncepter.
  • Kan læse, skrive og forstå dansk.
  • At du er en holdspiller og ikke er bange for at tage initiativ.

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig rolle med både drifts- og udviklingsopgaver i et hospital i udvikling.
  • En central position i arbejdet med moderne, effektive logistikløsninger.
  • Et engageret og tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø i Driftsafdelingen på SUH Køge.
  • Gode arbejdsforhold, gode kollegaer og fleksibilitet i opgaveløsningen.


Hvis det fanget din interesse og du har lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, så kan du kontakte Planlægningsassistent Emil Bjerge Frandsen på 21 39 05 59 eller mail, emiltha@regionsjaelland.dk

Skal du være med til at drifte fremtidens logistik på Sjællands Universitetshospital?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. august 2026

Ansættelsesdato: 1. oktober 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler: afholdes i uge 3

Arbejdssted: Sjællands Universitetshospital, Køge.

Stillingsbetegnelse: Logistik- og forsyningsmedarbejder

Ansættes som Specialarbejder på 3F overenskomst

Det er en 37 timers fuldtidsstilling.

Der kan forekomme weekend- og helligdagsvagter.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

The Construction Project Administrator (CPA) role is critical to ensuring outside plant (OSP) construction work is performed to industry standards and meets requirements for cost and engineering expectations. The CPA is responsible for both inspecting the work of Ziply Fiber OSP contractors and guiding the work efforts of contract inspectors in the CPA’s region to ensure all OSP work meets cost, timeline, and quality expectations for customers.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.


Field Inspections & Compliance

· Perform aerial and underground inspections along with audits of contractors performing inspections, corrections, and foreign pole transfers in accordance with the NESC and Ziply standards.

· Act as the first-level field approval for necessary changes found in field. Partner with Engineering and vendor team regarding potential solutions.


Contractor Oversight & Dispatch

· Assign and dispatch work to contract inspectors via email or through online database applications, with the ability to assist the contract inspectors in resolving NESC or FPT complex issues.

· Perform training of contract personnel in the accepted aerial plant inspection and correction methods used by Ziply, as well as the associated field software applications.


Process Improvement & Technology Enablement

· Involved in the development, trials, and implementation of new processes, process documentation, web applications, and field software involving NESC inspections and corrections, and pole transfer work.


Issue Resolution & Community Coordination

· Issue/dispute resolution: partner with vendor team to resolve issues that arise during the construction process. Bore-throughs, tree trimming, and other complaints with citizens impacted by the fiber deployment.

· Serve as a Municipality liaison, working with various municipalities regarding permitting, traffic control, and other concerns regarding the overall impact of OSP work within the community.


Financial & Cross‑Functional Support

· Perform invoice processing, work within project workflow databases to review and process vendor invoicing adhering to Ziply accounting guidelines.

· Support Ziply Fiber values, works with team members across several disciplines including Business and Consumer, Network Services, various customer groups including homebuilders, general contractors, and sub-contractors.


Other Duties

· Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.


Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum five (5) years’ experience in outside plant (OSP) construction and/or OSP engineering.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word, and PowerPoint; and proficient/comfortable with Microsoft Excel to include the development of forms, the use of internal and external hyperlinks, as well as simple functions and their structure (i.e. COUNT, COUNTIF, SUBTOTAL, SUM, etc.).

· Must possess and maintain a valid State Driver's License and satisfactory driving record.

· Must complete a pre-employment drug screening.


Preferred Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of the NESC, OSP construction techniques, telecom industry OSP best practices, and overall maintenance of a safe job site is a must; with the ability to determine cost effective solutions to bring into compliance complex aerial cable problems.
  • Ability to work with other team members to ensure timely completion, quality work and safe working practices throughout the labor and billing cycle.
  • Ability to learn the current Ziply construction unit coding is required in the contract inspection position.
  • Ability and desire to continuously learn new systems and applications.

Job Description:

Competitive Range works in partnership with the government to plan and deploy complex, IT-enabled and mission essential capabilities. It is our goal at Competitive Range to help you develop and expand your professional capabilities while working on challenging, interesting projects in a collaborative, congenial environment.

Competitive Range Solutions requires the expertise of a Senior Subject Matter Expert talented person to lead efforts supporting Federal Defense customers, under the direction of Senior and Executive management. The candidate must reference their ability and experience in working in a Department of War (DoW) customer environment and effective integration with a government multi-contractor team.

Duties:

Provide technical refreshment and senior engineering support for installation and integration of equipment for a Classified Satellite System for the Department of War program. This work shall be comprised of on and off-site engineering support and services locally and via temporary duty locations in support of the Secretary of Defense Communications Office. Tasks shall be of varying nature and includes troubleshooting, engineering design support, circuit status reporting, and integration support with DOW/DISA Classified programs support, operational test and evaluation, and network (including associated equipment) assessment to achieve operational status for the executive transport aircraft. The Contractor shall provide engineering recommendations to the Aircraft Management Offices (PMO’s) concerning network architecture issues and technology insertion initiatives to improve or upgrade network capabilities. The contractor shall track changes in classified DOW Classified Satellite System Network and/or system including but not limited to configurations of equipment, operational capabilities, and operating procedures. The contractor shall periodically update and publish associated engineering documents so the community of interest with the most up to date with the DOW system network configuration, system description or architecture. This task area may provide an evaluation of commercially available products that may be utilized to support the DOW system's network requirements.

Qualifications/Experience:

  • At least 5 years of experience
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Secret clearance required






    Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

    Competitive Range Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without

    regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other

    characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Experience Designer
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



The senior designer supports teams in the Experience Design & Research practice, envisioning digital and service experiences for BU products and initiatives. The Senior designer ensures that the design of a new or existing product or offering are elevating the experience of interacting with Northern Trust and meeting or exceeding the needs of the people who these experiences serve.

Senior Designers tactically contribute to design at varying stages of discovery, development, and delivery in collaboration with peers and stakeholders. They can work independently and collaborate with their peers and counterparts in business and technology teams, taking direction from their design leads and team. They are responsible for detailed design execution and functional level interactions.

Major Duties:

• Works within processes established by design leadership.
• Works toward improved user experiences with a team of technology and business collaborators
• Contributes to an open culture that enables employees’ development through direct but kind feedback, promotes diverse perspectives and fosters a sense of curiosity and optimism
• Works in an agile environment or on future experience projects
• Creates user experiences, from low-fidelity sketches to high-fidelity mockups and prototypes while applying the NT Digital Design System.
• Balances design decisions between research, technology, and business unit objectives
• Exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information
• Ensures deliverables are accessible (WCAG 2.1)

Knowledge:

• Strong design skills in one or more competency areas (visual, interaction, information architecture, product)
• Able to present work and decisions effectively, through presentation and storytelling skills
• Highly flexible, adaptable to change and comfortable with ambiguity
• Effective use of collaborative/communication tools
• Clear growth mindset, looking for opportunities to learn and motivated to approach challenges proactively

Experience:

• 5+ years demonstrated work experience delivering digital experiences
• Educated in design or related field, formally or though comparable training
• Working knowledge of Human-Centered Design and UI/UX best practices, as demonstrated in a portfolio of professional work.
• Experience working with a cross-functional team or large-scale software development lifecycle, preferably in an agile environment, is desired

#LI-HY

#LI-CL1

Salary Range:

$88,900 - 151,100 USD

Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component.


Work Authorization


Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa).


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Airside Experience Specialist
description:
As an Airside Experience Specialist, you are the face of our private aviation terminal, delivering a seamless, personalized, and welcoming experience for every guest, crew member, and aircraft in our care. In this dynamic role, you'll combine exceptional hospitality with hands-on operational support to ensure our guests feel cared for, from wheels down to wheels up.

You’ll operate ground service equipment and perform aircraft ground services while engaging guests with professionalism and a service-first mindset. This role requires schedule flexibility, including nights, weekends and holidays, and the ability to thrive in outdoor environments around active aircraft and in varying weather conditions.

If you enjoy creating memorable guest experiences in a fast-paced, luxury-driven environment – and you're excited by the energy of the runway – this is the role for you.

(Other duties may be assigned)

  • Work as part of a team to conduct airside operations safely and efficiently in accordance with established policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) ensuring efficient and accurate communication through various methods to accomplish operational tasks.
  • Collaborate, cooperate, and work closely with all team members, guests, clients, vendors, and aircraft crewmembers to ensure service needs are met. Services include, but are not limited to, fueling, de-icing, lavatory, ground power and potable water services, parking, marshalling, wing walking, delivering catering and towing.
  • Proactively prepare for arriving/departing aircraft, identify and perform open job tasks, and immediately speak up and/or point out observed safety concerns to all stakeholders.
  • Operate and drive ground service equipment such as fuel trucks, de-icing trucks, ground power units, tugs, stair trucks, etc.
  • Load and unload luggage and other cargo into/out of aircraft and from/into the PAT, guest vehicle, or other mode of transportation.
  • Provide professional and friendly guest service while exhibiting a positive and helpful attitude to everyone at all times ensuring guests always receive an exceptional experience.
  • Offer safe, convenient, and courteous transportation when driving shuttle vehicle to transport guests, luggage and cargo.
  • Maintain safe, clean, and secure ramps and operations.
  • Fuel handling, including fuel quality control, fuel receipt, inventory and maintaining accurate related documentation.
  • Understand, comply with, and enforce all operational, safety, and guest service requirements for all aspects of the job.
  • Stop work when an unsafe condition or act is likely to cause harm to people, the environment, Company or guest assets, or the Company’s reputation if the work continues. Report concerns to the appropriate manager and cooperate in addressing the unsafe act or condition.
  • Follow emergency response procedures during critical events.
  • Understand, comply with, and enforce all security (physical, cyber and data) protocols as dictated by both Signature Aviation and the airport.
  • Create accurate records pertaining to time worked and activities and services performed.

Minimum Education and/or Experience:

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
  • Minimum of 18 years of age.
  • Ability to pass company background checks (criminal and motor vehicle), drug tests, meet airport background check requirements to receive and maintain an airport security badge, and be insurable by the Company's applicable insurance policies.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the jurisdiction of employment.
  • Excellent vision and coordination to move and/or direct aircraft and visually inspect aircraft fuel. Ability to pass a color vision test for purposes of inspecting aviation fuel.
  • Must possess a valid state driver’s license. In some locations a commercial driver’s license (CDL) is required as dictated by local regulations and business needs.
  • Must be able to exercise good judgment and follow directions/directives from supervisor/management.
  • Preferred: Three (3) to six (6) months experience and/or training in aviation, customer service or other related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience and/or training.

Additional knowledge and essential skills:

  • Hospitality Skills: Excellent guest service skills with an energetic, outgoing, and guest-obsessed personality. Must be able to anticipate guest needs and prioritize guest requests and job responsibilities by exhibiting a keen ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. Must be able to maintain professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Language Skills: Ability to read and comprehend documents such as safety rules, operating instructions, and procedure manuals, and for safety-sensitive tasks, in English. Clearly communicate in English with others in person, via telephone, radio communicators, and in writing.
  • Math Skills: Ability to perform simple arithmetic (e.g., addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, fractions, angles, degrees, time).
  • Physical Ability: Must be able to physically enter/exit and operate motor vehicles and ground support equipment such as fuel trucks, vans, tugs, and cars. Must be able to perform various functions safely and efficiently (e.g., fueling, de-icing) from elevated heights.
  • Critical Thinking / Reasoning Ability: Ability to carry out multi-step instructions. Ability to deal with standardized situations with only occasional or no variables.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Ability to get along and work well with others. Excellent interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with team members and service to guests.
  • Multitasking: Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Computer Skills: Ability to use a computer and email, learn necessary company software, and pass computer-based training modules.
  • Task Management: Ability to successfully and timely complete Signature’s training programs.

Pay ranges vary based on multiple factors, including, without limitation, skill sets, education, shift worked, responsibilities, seniority, geographical market, merit, output, productivity, prior training or experience, and travel. The pay range for this position is $21.40 to $26.75 / hour.

title: Office Administrative Specialist
description:
Organizational Description
Dakota Woodlands is a nonprofit organization based in Eagan, MN. It is dedicated to creating a safe and supportive environment for families experiencing homelessness. Our mission is to help individuals achieve stability and independence through comprehensive support and compassionate care. We offer housing, resources, and programs designed to help families rebuild their lives and find success. Clients at Dakota Woodlands receive nutritious meals, private bedrooms, personal care products, seasonal clothing, and opportunities to develop essential life skills through targeted case management and family goal planning, which promote their ability to succeed independently.



Position Overview
The Office Administrative Specialist serves as the primary receptionist and first point of contact for Dakota Woodlands. This role helps create a welcoming, professional, and safe environment for clients, visitors, and staff. The Office Administrative Specialist manages visitor access, phones, mail, and front desk operations while ensuring confidentiality, professionalism, and compliance with organizational policies.

Working closely with the Operations & Facilities Supervisor and other staff, this position supports daily shelter operations by maintaining accurate documentation, assisting clients with basic needs, coordinating front desk logistics, and ensuring safety procedures are followed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates compassion, strong organizational skills, professionalism, and a trauma-informed approach when interacting with families experiencing homelessness.



Areas of Responsibility:

Front Desk Operations & Reception:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for clients, visitors, staff, and community partners.
  • Greet visitors and clients in a professional, welcoming, and respectful manner.
  • Answer phones, respond to inquiries, and route communications to appropriate staff.
  • Monitor visitor access to ensure building entry policies are followed.
  • Ensure individuals on the restricted list are not allowed access to the facility.
  • Maintain awareness of building activity and communicate concerns to appropriate staff.
  • Ensure all required licenses and postings are displayed at the front desk in accordance with regulations.
  • Order and maintain required workplace postings and labor law notices as required by Minnesota labor laws.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional front desk area.



Visitor Management & Safety:

  • Monitor and manage visitor entry during approved visiting hours.
  • Ensure visitors sign in according to organizational procedures.
  • Provide facility tours to approved guests during public hours with Executive Director approval.
  • Follow all safety procedures and communicate any concerns to leadership.



Client Support & Communication:

  • Assist clients with routine needs such as accessing supplies or information about available services.
  • Provide respectful guidance to clients navigating the facility.
  • Maintain a trauma-informed and compassionate approach when interacting with clients.
  • Maintain professional boundaries with both clients and staff.
  • Relay messages to clients and staff appropriately and confidentially.
  • Document relevant updates or operational notes in the live communication log used by staff.
  • Work with Case Managers to assist with secure storage of client medications when required.



Administrative & Documentation Duties:

  • Maintain accurate records of client interactions and operational updates as required.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing mail for staff and clients, ensuring it is distributed properly.
  • Receive and document donations using in-kind donation forms, providing copies to the Volunteer & Outreach Coordinator.
  • Properly secure cash or check donations by placing them in the designated black box and completing internal control documentation.
  • Maintain updated staff directories and front desk reference materials.
  • Update forms, signage, and information posted at the front desk as requested by leadership or department leads.



Supply & Resource Coordination:

  • Provide approved items or supplies to clients and maintain accurate logs of items distributed.
  • Maintain organized storage of front desk materials and resources.
  • Assist with ordering or restocking front desk supplies when needed.



Meeting & Facility Support:

  • Prepare conference rooms for meetings, including setting up tables, chairs, supplies, snacks, or beverages as requested.
  • Assist with maintaining cleanliness and organization in front entry areas and common spaces.
  • Ensure front desk and reception areas remain clean, tidy, and welcoming.
  • Coordinate holiday decorations or seasonal updates for front lobby and common areas.


Operational Coordination:

  • Ensure front desk coverage is maintained during scheduled hours.
  • Coordinate with supervisors, volunteers, or staff if temporary coverage is needed when stepping away.
  • Communicate important operational updates through the staff live log and internal communication channels.
  • Support other operational tasks that assist with the smooth functioning of the shelter.



Team Collaboration & Professional Expectations:

  • Maintain professionalism, punctuality, and strong communication at all times.
  • Protect confidential client information and follow privacy policies.
  • Follow Dakota Woodlands policies related to safety, boundaries, and client interactions.
  • Participate in staff meetings, trainings, and professional development opportunities.
  • Promote a respectful and welcoming environment for clients, staff, and visitors.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support Dakota Woodlands’ mission and operations.



Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; coursework in social work, human services, or related fields is a plus.
  • Experience in customer service, reception, or front desk operations preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work respectfully with diverse populations.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining a welcoming and professional environment.
  • Proficiency in basic computer applications including Microsoft Office and data entry systems.
  • Commitment to Dakota Woodlands’ mission and values.



Working Conditions

  • Position is based at Dakota Woodlands in Eagan, Minnesota.
  • Work is primarily performed at the front desk in a client-centered shelter environment.
  • Role may involve interacting with individuals experiencing crisis or sensitive situations and requires professionalism and empathy.
  • Requires sitting or standing for extended periods and performing light cleaning or organizational tasks.
  • May involve lifting items up to 25 pounds.
  • Regular use of computers, phones, and communication systems is required.



How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and interest in the position.

Dakota Woodlands is an equal opportunity employer. Opportunities for employment are available to all persons, regardless of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, marital status, or status with regard to public assistance. Dakota Woodlands’ facilities are accessible. Individuals who have experienced homelessness are encouraged to apply.

title: DII Haven, Dagtilbuddet Christiansbjerg søger en ny pædagogmedhjælper
description:
DII Haven, Dagtilbuddet Christiansbjerg søger en ny pædagogmedhjælper.

Har du mod på at lege og være en del af de 0-6-årige børns hverdag, er Haven måske stedet for dig?

DII Haven i Dagtilbuddet Christiansbjerg søger en ny medhjælper

Du vil komme til at have en særlig flyverstilling og derfor være sammen med både vuggestue- og børnehavebørn: Mariehønestuen, hvor de 0-2-årige boltrer sig, på Brumbassestuen holder de 2-4-årige til og hos Sommerfuglene flyver de 4-6-årige rundt. Vi er en personalegruppe, som hjælper hinanden meget i det daglige, og da vi arbejder på kryds og tværs af stuerne, vil der være dage, hvor du skal hjælpe til i en anden børnegruppe, end du regnede med. Vi tilbyder:

  • En levende institution
  • En personalegruppe med engagement og faglighed
  • Et kollegialt samarbejde og et arbejdsklima med humør og glæde
  • En engageret forældregruppe, der yder stor opbakning

Vi forventer:

  • At du har overblik
  • At du kan tage initiativ og ansvar (fx lave andre aktiviteter rundt i huset, både med kollegaer og alene)
  • At du har lyst til at være sammen med børnene i børnehøjde, vi sidder meget på gulvet, og det forventer vi også, du gør.
  • At du er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og har en positiv og anerkendende tilgang til børn, forældre og kollegaer.

Vi vil foretrække:

Du kan være god til at bygge huler, danse, synge og male, men det vigtigste er, at du er positiv og har lysten vil at være sammen med vores skønne børn.

Hvis du vil vide mere, kan du læse mere på vores hjemmeside: https://aarhus.inst.dk/Foresides/IntraForeside.aspx?Location=IP.1DB

Din ansøgning bedes du sende digitalt ved at benytte link.



Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. title: Malling: Madglæde til små maver med stor appetit – er du vores nye køkkenmedarbejder?
description:
Stor frihed i hverdagen, fleksibel planlægning af arbejdstid og ferie, faglig sparring med køkkenkolleger og mulighed for at sætte dit præg på måltiderne til 74 børn.

I Børnehuset Eghovedvej søger vi en køkkenmedarbejder, der har lyst til at skabe sunde og velsmagende måltider.
Stillingen er på 25 timer om ugen med opstart 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Vi er et børnehus med to vuggestuegrupper og to børnehavegrupper, hvor køkkenet er en vigtig del af livet i huset. Herfra sendes der hver dag mad ud til børn, som er nysgerrige, sultne og klar til at udforske nye smage.

Du bliver eneansvarlig i køkkenet med frihed til at tilrettelægge og strukturere din arbejdsdag inden for de givne rammer. Arbejdstid og ferie tilrettelægges i dialog med ledelsen, og vi har tillid til, at du som fagperson finder de løsninger, der fungerer bedst i hverdagen.

Selvom du er eneansvarlig i køkkenet, står du ikke alene. Du bliver en del af Beder-Malling Dagtilbuds køkkenteam med seks køkkenmedarbejdere, som sparrer, deler erfaringer og inspirerer hinanden. Vi sørger for en grundig introduktion, og i den første tid har du en erfaren køkkenkollega tæt på, så du kommer godt fra start. Der er også mulighed for faglig udvikling gennem relevante kurser.

OM JOBBET
Som køkkenmedarbejder skal du lave det daglige frokostmåltid til vores 29 vuggestuebørn og 45 børnehavebørn.

Dine opgaver er blandt andet at:

  • planlægge og strukturere arbejdsopgaverne i forbindelse med produktion, egenkontrol og indkøb
  • arbejde ud fra Aarhus Kommunes kostprincipper og Sundhedsstyrelsens anbefalinger til 0-6-årige
  • bidrage til, at frokostmåltidet bliver en del af børnenes hverdag og læring ved blandt andet at inddrage børn og personale, når det giver mening
  • arbejde med børnenes smagsoplevelser og mod på at prøve nye råvarer og retter
  • have fokus på sæsonens råvarer, mindst 60 % økologi og begrænsning af madspild
  • samarbejde og kommunikere med børn, forældre og kollegaer.

OM DIG

Vi forestiller os, at du har en kostfaglig baggrund – måske som kostfaglig eneansvarlig, ernæringsassistent, kok eller lignende.

Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket i en hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver. Samtidig har du økonomisk sans og kan planlægge indkøb og produktion inden for de givne rammer. Vi lægger vægt på, at du er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og motiveres af at skabe gode måltider, der giver børnene energi til leg, læring og udvikling.

Du har også lyst til at være en del af et børnehus, hvor relationer og samarbejde betyder meget. Derfor trives du med både planlægning, madlavning og de relationer, der følger med en hverdag i et børnehus.

EN VIGTIG ROLLE I HUSET

Som køkkenmedarbejder bliver du en del af hverdagen i hele børnehuset. Du er ikke gemt væk i et produktionskøkken, men et kendt ansigt for både børn, forældre og kollegaer. Børnene er nysgerrige på, hvad der er på menuen, og måltidet er en vigtig del af fællesskabet og dagen i huset.

MERE VIDEN

Du er meget velkommen til at ringe til pædagogisk leder, Mark, hvis du har opfølgende spørgsmål eller ønsker at komme på besøg for at se køkkenet og huset: 41 85 51 55

Du kan læse mere om os på vores hjemmeside: Børnehuset Eghovedvej

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen

Ugentligt timetal: 25 timer

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: 14/8-26

Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Software Engineer Intern

We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Software Engineer Intern to join our engineering team. This internship offers hands-on experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining modern enterprise applications while working alongside experienced software engineers.

The ideal candidate is passionate about software development, eager to learn new technologies, and excited to contribute to real-world projects using modern development frameworks, cloud technologies, and AI-powered solutions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the design, development, testing, and maintenance of enterprise web, mobile, and backend applications.

  • Learn and apply the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, to production support.

  • Learn how to leverage the latest AI technologies and AI coding assistants to accelerate software development, including AI-powered code generation, code review, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and automated testing.

  • Gain hands-on experience building applications using modern AI-driven software engineering practices, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI-assisted development workflows.

  • Develop new features and enhance existing applications using modern programming languages, frameworks, and cloud technologies.

  • Participate in coding, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting activities, while gaining hands-on experience with engineering best practices

  • Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, designers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Developing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating enterprise and third-party services.

  • Support database development, including writing SQL queries, data modelling, and application integration.

  • Learn and apply Agile methodologies, Git version control, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and cloud-native application development.

  • Explore the development of intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to automate software engineering tasks using AI and modern development tools.

.

Here's what you need:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

  • Basic understanding of object-oriented programming concepts and software engineering principles.

  • Familiarity with one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

  • Basic knowledge of web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or modern frontend frameworks is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.

  • Basic understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture.

  • Willingness to learn cloud technologies, modern development tools, and enterprise software development practices.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

  • Ability to commit for at least 6-months for this internship with the potential for perm conversion dependent on performance.

Bonus points if:

  • Experience with React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java Spring Boot, or React Native through academic or personal projects.

  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure or other cloud platforms.

  • Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, or GitHub.

  • Knowledge of mobile application development.

  • Exposure to SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.

  • Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Agentic AI through coursework, hackathons, or personal projects.

  • Participation in coding competitions, hackathons, or open-source software contributions.

title: Forløbskoordinator og vagtplanlægger søges til Center for Neurorehabilitering
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe sammenhængende patientforløb, sikre optimale arbejdsgange og understøtte driften i en specialiseret neurorehabiliteringsafdeling?

Center for Neurorehabilitering (CfN) på Epilepsihospitalet Filadelfia søger en forløbskoordinator og vagtplanlægger til en nyoprettet stilling, hvor koordinering, overblik og samarbejde er i centrum.

Stillingen er en nøglefunktion i afdelingen og kombinerer ansvar for forløbskoordination (ca. 30 %) og vagtplanlægning (ca. 70 %).


Du bliver en væsentlig del af CfN’s ansigt udadtil, igennem det tætte samarbejde med hospitaler, kommuner, pårørende og øvrige samarbejdspartnere, samtidig med at du bliver en central del af afdelingens maskinrum igennem hensigtsmæssig planlægning og dermed bidrager til en velfungerende drift og god trivsel blandt medarbejderne.

Om Center for Neurorehabilitering – Filadelfia

CfN yder intensiv, specialiseret neurorehabilitering til voksne med moderate til svære følger efter erhvervet hjerneskade, herunder stroke, hovedtraumer og tilgrænsende neurologiske lidelser.

CfN er det eneste ikke-offentlige hospital med regionsfunktion inden for neurorehabilitering og tilbyder sammenhængende rehabiliteringsforløb – inklusive fase 3, den nuværende kommunale specialiserede rehabilitering.

Centret råder over 22 sengepladser fordelt på to etager, og patienterne er typisk indlagt i 2–5 måneder. Det giver mulighed for længerevarende, individualiserede rehabiliteringsforløb med høj faglig kvalitet, kontinuitet og tæt opfølgning.

Tværfaglighed er et grundlæggende princip i arbejdet på CfN. De kliniske teams består af sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, ergo- og fysioterapeuter, neuropsykologer, læger, audiologopæder, socialrådgivere og administrativt personale. Samlet har CfN mere end 50 medarbejdere, som arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe de bedst mulige rehabiliteringsforløb for patienterne.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af CfN’s administrative og driftsmæssige fundament og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med afdelingsledelse, oversygeplejerske, overterapeut og afdelingens tværfaglige teams.

En væsentlig del af stillingen bliver at understøtte implementeringen af kommende krav og retningslinjer i forbindelse med overgangen af den specialiserede rehabilitering fra kommunalt til regionalt regi.

Du får blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Koordinering af patientforløb og tværfaglige møder
  • Planlægning, indkaldelse og opfølgning på patientrelaterede møder
  • Understøttelse af sammenhængende patientforløb
  • Understøttelse af arbejdsgange og driftsudvikling
  • Vagtplanlægning og feriekoordinering
  • Sikring af hensigtsmæssig faglig bemanding på tværs af afdelingens afsnit, herunder vikardækning


Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, planlægning eller administrative funktioner i sundhedsvæsenet
  • Har erfaring med vagtplanlægning, gerne erfaring med KMD OPUS.
  • Kendskab til relevante overenskomster
  • Har stærke organisatoriske kompetencer
  • Trives med mange kontaktflader og samarbejdsrelationer
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket i en kompleks hverdag
  • Har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner
  • Er struktureret, løsningsorienteret og serviceminded

Din faglige baggrund er mindre afgørende. Du kan eksempelvis være sundhedsfagligt uddannet, lægesekretær, sundhedsadministrativ koordinator eller have anden relevant erfaring.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En nyoprettet stilling med mulighed for at præge funktionens udvikling
  • En central rolle i en specialiseret neurorehabiliteringsafdeling
  • Et stærkt tværfagligt miljø med høj faglighed
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Engagerede kolleger og en afdeling i udvikling
  • Massageordning
  • Gratis træning i Filadelfias motionscenter
  • Mulighed for fordelagtig leje af feriehuse gennem Regions Sjællands Feriefond

Yderligere oplysninger eller aftale om et evt. besøg i afdelingen fås ved henvendelse til Cheflæge Nicole Frandsen tlf. 20727845 eller overterapeut Stine Jochumsen Schüder tlf. 58271268.

Læs mere om CfN, Filadelfia på hjemmesiden:

http://www.filadelfia.dk/epilepsihospitalet/neurorehabilitering

Eller find os på LinkedIn:

https://www.linkedin.com/company/center-for-neurorehabilitering-filadelfia/

Startløn

Filadelfia er forpligtet til at oplyse om startlønnen for stillingen. Der oplyses grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst.

Startlønnen kan variere afhængigt af anciennitet, relevant erfaring og uddannelse.

Startlønnen for denne stilling på fuldtid udgør:

  • HK

  • DSR

  • Danske fysioterapeuter og Ergoterapeutforeningen

Udover startlønnen kan der være:

  • Ret til tillæg efter lokale forhåndsaftaler
  • Ret til særydelser, fx tillæg for aften-, nat- og weekendarbejde
  • Mulighed for at forhandle individuelle tillæg afhængigt af stillingen samt erfaring og kvalifikationer.


Se stilling- og funktionsbeskrivelse Funktionsbeskrivelse.pdf i opslaget på vores hjemmeside.

Søg stillingen online via www.filadelfia.dk

Ansættelse: 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

description:
Er du bygningsmaler og vil du have firmabil og en makker på opgaven?

Vi mangler en bygningsmaler til facade og renovering i Nørresundby.

Du bliver en del af en større service- og håndværksforretning, hvor malerarbejdet er en fast del af pakken. Pladserne ligger omkring Nørresundby, og opgaverne lander både i bolig og erhverv. Du arbejder i makkerpar, så der er en at sparre med, når facaden driller eller renoveringen skal afleveres ordentligt.

Det særlige ved rollen er bredden. Du er ikke låst på én type maleropgave, for du skifter mellem udvendigt arbejde, nye byggesager og renovering. Firmabilen er med i pakken, og hverdagen er bygget til en erfaren maler, der kan tage ansvar sammen med sin makker.

Det får du

Løn: 200-250 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Nørresundby og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 75 ansatte

Faglig udvikling: Plads til kurser og opdatering

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Facader, nybyg og renovering i makkerpar

Din hverdag

På pladsen aftaler I rækkefølgen, før I går i gang. Du sørger for, at klargøring, afdækning og finish hænger sammen, så næste trin ikke står og venter. Når en opgave ændrer sig, siger du til, så planen ikke skrider.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Vedligeholder facader, så underlag og finish holder
  • Maler på nybyg, hvor arbejdet skal passe med resten af pladsen
  • Renoverer indvendige og udvendige flader
  • Spartler og grundbehandler før maling
  • Maler døre, vinduer og lofter

Når arbejdet kræver det, er der plads til kurser og opdatering på nye metoder. Det gør hverdagen bedre, hvis du gerne vil holde faget ved lige.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som bygningsmaler
  • Har kørekort
  • Møder stabilt og holder aftaler
  • Kan arbejde tæt med en makker
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet facadevedligehold eller renovering før. Men det vigtigste er, at du arbejder ordentligt sammen med din makker og får sagt til i tide.

Allerede i job?
