title: Founding Backend / Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Company & Mission

We are an early-stage (Seed), venture-backed cross-border neobank and retail brokerage built for global investors. Our mission is to bridge financial borders across the Pacific: building a single platform where US investors can directly access, trade, and hold high-growth Asian equities (such as Korean and Japanese markets) as seamlessly as trading domestic US stocks.

By combining an AI-native back end, real-time translated market research/filings, automated FX, multi-currency custody, and compliant clearing/settlement rails, we are removing the friction from international investing. Starting with a focus on cross-border retail brokerage, our long-term vision spans multi-currency banking, stablecoin-enabled instant cross-border settlement, and direct global market access on a single shelf.

We run on absolute trust: moving real capital across international borders requires rock-solid, auditable, and resilient infrastructure. We are actively expanding our founding engineering team to build out core systems on our path toward full brokerage self-clearing operations.

Why This Role Exists

As a modern retail brokerage, our backend is the core product. You will carry three of the company’s most critical technical deliverables:

  1. Build the financial foundation: Own the services driving order lifecycles, internal ledgers, multi-currency funding flows, and automated reconciliation from day one.

  2. Scale with precision: Build high-throughput, fault-tolerant infrastructure capable of expanding from early users to hundreds of thousands of active investors without compromising auditability or data integrity.

  3. Set engineering standards: Partner directly with the CTO to define company-wide standards for correctness, distributed system reliability, and production operational excellence.

This is a founding-stage seat offering deep technical ownership and high agency over architecture, product decisions, and system design.

What You Will Own

  • Core Financial Engine: Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end order routing, execution lifecycles, internal double-entry ledgers, and automated funding/reconciliation systems.

  • Resilient Architecture: Build production systems optimized for concurrency and partial network failures using idempotent handlers, durable event history, replayable state, and self-healing mechanisms.

  • Third-Party & Banking Integrations: Integrate directly with partner clearing broker-dealers, international brokers, banking rails (ACH, wires), FX mechanisms, and automated KYC/AML verification providers.

  • Production Excellence: Take end-to-end operational ownership—including sandbox testing environments, monitoring/alerting, incident response, on-call rotations, and postmortems.

  • Internal Operational Tooling: Build robust internal tools and dashboards for operations, compliance, and support teams to audit, investigate, and resolve issues proactively.

  • Data & AI Infrastructure Support: Support underlying data pipelines powering our real-time AI research and content-translation engines (no dedicated ML background required).

Who We Are Looking For

Must-Have:

  • Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining high-availability production backend systems.

  • Financial Data Rigor: Proven track record of owning mission-critical systems handling sensitive transactions (e.g., money movement, balances, orders, ledgering, or high-integrity financial data).

  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in a modern backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js, Rust, or Java) and production data infrastructure (relational DBs, distributed event queues/streams, caching layers).

  • System Design & Correctness: Strong instincts for distributed systems trade-offs—data modeling, transaction isolation, idempotency, failure domain isolation, and state reconciliation.

  • Production Maturity: Hands-on experience with on-call rotations, incident management, performance tuning, and writing thorough postmortems.

  • Startup Mindset: High comfort navigating ambiguity, making pragmatic engineering trade-offs, and contributing to both product strategy and technical architecture.

    • Strong Nice-to-Have:

    • Experience scaling consumer fintech, crypto, or brokerage platforms to 100k+ active users.

    • Domain knowledge in capital markets (Order Management Systems/OMS, market data, tax-lot accounting, corporate actions, post-trade settlement).

    • Experience integrating with partner broker-dealers, clearing platforms, or Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) APIs.

    • Hands-on experience with double-entry accounting ledgers, multi-currency FX rails, or stablecoin/on-chain settlement.

    • Cross-border regulatory awareness or language fluency relevant to East Asian markets (e.g., Korean or Japanese).

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools and workflows that accelerate shipping velocity without compromising correctness.

Who Is NOT the Right Fit

  • Engineers who prefer taking pre-written tickets rather than driving problem definition, system design, and execution from zero.

  • Engineers who view data correctness, logging, observability, and auditability as secondary considerations.

  • Engineers seeking a purely advisory role without willingness to carry operational and production on-call responsibilities.

    • This is a fully remote position in Taiwan.

title: Rapid Response Sr. Network Engineer
description:
Competitive Range partners with the government to plan and deploy complex, IT-enabled, and mission-essential capabilities. Our goal is to help you develop and expand your professional capabilities while working on challenging, exciting projects in a collaborative, congenial environment.

Competitive Range Solutions requires the expertise of a talented and experienced Rapid Response Sr. Network Engineer Management to assist in the direction and management of the program’s executive support group. The candidate must reference their ability and experience working in a Department of Defense (DoD) customer environment and effective integration with a government multi-contractor team.

Rapid Response Sr. Network Engineer has a pivotal role within the IT Operation team, focusing on ensuring the enterprise transport network's integrity, security, and efficiency. This role involves extensive collaboration with defense and government entities to ensure network assets are properly baselined, configured, and managed in the DoD standards, specifically adhering to the DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIG).

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure the baseline configuration of all network assets – including hardware, software, and documentation is thoroughly documented, configured according to DoD engineering standards, and accurately represented in the Government-provided system.
  • Develop and maintain the CMDB to support IT management practices such as Asset, Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Capacity, Operations, Project, and Security Management, ensuring compliance with MOAs/MOUs/SLAs.
  • Track warranty and licensing details for all hardware and software products across their lifecycle.
  • Ensure seamless integration of the configuration management system and database with systems for other services/agencies, providing necessary access to designated personnel.
  • Produce and submit monthly asset and configuration management reports detailing all changes to hardware and software baselines, including change status and funding details.

Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3+ years of primary role operating, troubleshooting, and installing network routers and switches.
  • 3+ years of primary role designing and architecting routed and switched networks.
  • 3+ years DoD environment
  • Outstanding mathematics and IT abilities
  • Configuring and installing various network devices and services
  • Monitoring network performance and resource utilization, trending, capacity planning
  • Use of current and emergent network design principles and protocols
  • Experience with network virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with multi-tenant network architectures.
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of network routing and switching equipment devices from multiple vendors.
  • Scripting languages and coding for network threshold events
  • Active TS/SCI Clearance

Education/Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information system, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • At least one nationally recognized certification for senior network administrations/engineers/architects tied to the proposed solution's routers and switches.
  • Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level III in accordance with DoD 8570.01-M http://iase.disa.mil/iawip/Pag... IAT Level III certification must be obtained within 120 days after the Pop.

title: Vil du være med til at skabe gode rammer for byggeri i Silkeborg Kommune?
description:
Silkeborg Kommune er i vækst, og det mærkes tydeligt på byggesagsområdet. Der er stor interesse for at udvikle, bygge og investere i kommunen – og derfor har vi brug for en dygtig administrativ medarbejder, der vil være med til at sikre et stærkt administrativt fundament for vores byggesagsbehandling.

Hos os bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at skabe gode og smidige forløb for borgere, virksomheder og samarbejdspartnere. Vi arbejder hver dag for at levere en kompetent, imødekommende og professionel myndighedsbetjening – og vi ved, at den administrative indsats er helt afgørende for, at det lykkes.

Du bliver en del af fagområdet Byggesag, hvor vi er 15 engagerede og fagligt stærke kollegaer fordelt på to teams: bolig og erhverv. Her får du en hverdag med høj faglighed, stor variation i opgaverne og gode kollegaer, der hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab.

Dine opgaver:

Du får en central rolle i den administrative understøttelse af byggesagsbehandlingen og bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at sikre smidige og korrekt oplyste sagsforløb. Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet oprettelse og forberedelse af sager, opfølgning på manglende oplysninger, dialog med ansøgere samt sikring af, at sagerne er tilstrækkeligt oplyst til videre behandling.

Du vil i tæt dialog med relevante teams på tværs af organisationen i Teknik og Miljø vurdere ansøgte projekter og hvis nødvendigt sende dem videre til behandling efter anden lovgivning. Der følges op på sagerne, inden projekterne er klar til at blive overdraget til byggesagsbehandling Du skal desuden vejlede ansøgere om kravene til en fyldestgørende ansøgning. Afhængigt af dine kompetencer kan der også blive tale om opgaver inden for lettere sagsbehandling.

Organisatorisk bliver du tilknyttet team Bolig, som primært behandler ansøgninger om byggetilladelse til boligbyggeri og sekundær bebyggelse. Her får du indsigt i et fagområde med stor betydning for både borgere og udviklingen i kommunen. Der må dog forventes perioder, hvor opgaverne løses på tværs af de to teams, afhængigt af den samlede opgaveportefølje og prioritering.

Stillingen indebærer løbende kontakt med borgere og virksomheder. Det er derfor væsentligt, at du kan vejlede klart og korrekt og bidrage til, at mødet med Silkeborg Kommune opleves som professionelt, tydeligt og serviceorienteret. Du får dermed en vigtig funktion i at skabe tillid og gode forløb i kontakten mellem myndighed og ansøger.

Du bliver en del af et velfungerende og medstyrende team, hvor administrative medarbejdere, ingeniører, bygningskonstruktører og arkitekter arbejder tæt sammen om en opgaveløsning med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og koordinering. Det giver dig en hverdag med både selvstændigt ansvar, faglig sparring og et tæt samarbejde med engagerede kollegaer.

Vi søger dig, der:

Vi leder efter en kollega, der trives med at skabe struktur, holde overblik og få ting til at glide. Du arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og motiveres af at være en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden og lykkes sammen. Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en relevant administrativ uddannelse, gerne fra en offentlig organisation eller tilsvarende
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for byggeloven og bygningsreglementet og kan arbejde sikkert i en kompleks lovgivning – gerne med kendskab til forvaltningsret og offentlighedslovgivning
  • arbejder struktureret, effektivt og selvstændigt og bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag
  • er stærk i både mundtlig dialog og skriftlig formidling til forskellige målgrupper
  • har erfaring med borgerkontakt, service og vejledning
  • bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og den gode stemning i hverdagen
  • har erfaring fra en lignende stilling eller lyst til hurtigt at sætte dig ind i byggesagsområdets særlige problemstillinger

Derfor skal du vælge os:

  • et meningsfuldt job, hvor du får en vigtig rolle i en central kommunal opgave
  • en hverdag med stor variation, ansvar og indflydelse på opgaveløsningen
  • gode kollegaer og et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor samarbejde og hjælpsomhed er en naturlig del af hverdagen
  • mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling
  • gode ansættelsesvilkår med 37 timers arbejdsuge inkl. frokost, flekstidsordning, kantineordning, sundhedsordning og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale

En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og plads til mennesker
Plan, Byg og Informatik er en del af Silkeborg Kommunes Teknik- og Miljøafdeling. Vi arbejder i medstyrende teams og tror på, at tillid, ansvar og samarbejde skaber de bedste resultater. Hos os får du indflydelse på din hverdag, gode muligheder for sparring og en uformel ledelsesstil med korte beslutningsveje.

Læs mere om vores organisering i Plan, Byg og Informatik her.

I Teknik og Miljø er det vigtigt for os, at vi løser opgaverne i fællesskab. Du kan læse mere om Teknik- og Miljøafdelingen her.

Stillingen er placeret i Plan, Byg og Informatik, som har cirka 60 medarbejdere. Du bliver en del af Byggesag, hvor vi er 15 kollegaer.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer om ugen. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt og senest 1. oktober 2026.

Yderligere information

Har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Jakob Kirkegaard, chef for Plan, Byg og Informatik, tlf. 2420 7062
  • Lone Bjørnholt, administrativ medarbejder og screener, tlf. 8970 2096

Ansøgningsfrist: søndag den 16. august 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes fredag den 21. august 2026. Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Klik på Ansøg og vedhæft din ansøgning samt relevante bilag.

title: 🔨 ER DU TØMRER... ELLER ER DU EN AF DEM, MESTEREN RINGER EFTER IGEN? 😎

title: Software Engineer – Backend Platforms, Assistant Vice President (Wealth Custody & Clearing)
description:
Who we are looking for

State Street’s Wealth Custody & Clearing business is seeking multiple Assistant Vice Presidents, Software Engineers to join our growing Technology organization. These are hands-on engineering roles responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting modern software capabilities across our wealth custody and clearing platform.

We are seeking engineers with experience in senior backend development, software development engineering, API-driven platforms, distributed systems, cloud-enabled development, and enterprise application delivery. Successful candidates will help build resilient, scalable, secure, and production-grade technology solutions supporting advisor, brokerage, custody, clearing, trading, onboarding, servicing, and operational workflows.

This role is intended to support multiple engineering needs across the platform. Final team alignment may vary based on candidate experience and business priorities, including backend engineering, full-stack development, API and integration engineering, platform engineering, or cloud-native application development.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is part of Wealth Custody & Clearing, a strategic growth initiative focused on building a modern, scalable, and highly integrated platform for RIAs, broker-dealers, and wealth management firms. Software Engineers are critical to delivering the digital capabilities, services, integrations, and operational workflows required to support a highly regulated, transaction-oriented wealth platform.

This role is important because WC&C requires strong engineering execution across core platform services, client and advisor experiences, third-party integrations, data movement, workflow automation, and production resiliency. The selected candidates will help ensure the platform is built with the right foundation for scale, security, reliability, observability, and long-term maintainability.

What you will be responsible for

As an Assistant Vice President, Software Engineer, you will:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy enterprise-grade software solutions supporting the Wealth Custody & Clearing platform

  • Build scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and platform capabilities that support custody, clearing, onboarding, trading, servicing, reporting, and advisor workflows

  • Develop cloud-enabled and API-first solutions using modern engineering practices, secure coding standards, and strong software design principles

  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into high-quality technical solutions

  • Contribute to technical design reviews, architecture discussions, engineering standards, and platform delivery decisions

  • Support integration initiatives with external fintech, custody, clearing, broker-dealer, and market infrastructure providers

  • Ensure solutions meet expectations for performance, resiliency, security, observability, auditability, data integrity, and operational readiness

  • Participate in Agile delivery processes, including estimation, sprint planning, development, testing, release readiness, deployment, and production support

  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, support root cause analysis, and contribute to continuous platform improvement

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with a focus on secure, scalable, maintainable, and well-tested solutions

  • Hands-on experience building production-grade applications, backend services, APIs, or distributed systems in complex enterprise environments

  • Ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and deliver practical solutions in a highly regulated operating environment

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and contributing to a fast-moving platform buildout

  • Ownership mindset with a commitment to resiliency, quality, documentation, and operational excellence

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered

  • 7+ years of software engineering, backend engineering, or application development experience with progressively increasing responsibility

  • Experience delivering business-critical applications in Agile software development environments

  • Hands-on experience with modern programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar technologies

  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns

  • Experience with cloud-enabled development, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and modern software delivery tooling

  • Experience with relational databases, NoSQL databases, messaging platforms, observability tools, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization preferred

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, or containerized application deployment preferred

  • Financial services experience preferred; wealth management, brokerage, custody, clearing, trading, fintech, advisor platforms, or transaction processing experience considered a plus

Additional requirements

We are seeking multiple engineers across senior backend engineering and software development engineering disciplines. Candidates may be aligned to backend services, full-stack application development, API and integration engineering, platform engineering, or cloud-native application development depending on business priorities and candidate experience.

Candidates should be comfortable working in an enterprise technology environment where accuracy, resiliency, security, controls, documentation, and operational readiness are critical. Experience supporting systems with high availability, fault tolerance, strong data integrity, and production support expectations is strongly preferred.

Work Requirement

  • Hybrid work requirement and hiring location to be confirmed based on business need, role alignment, and approved requisition details

  • Standard business hours are expected, with flexibility required to support delivery milestones, production needs, and collaboration across locations

Salary Range:

$90,000 - $157,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

Do you have experience in project management and a strong interest in optimizing service processes? Are you motivated by driving projects across a global organization where technology, processes, and collaboration go hand in hand?

At VIKING, we work every day to protect and save lives. As one of the world’s leading providers of safety products, solutions, and services for the maritime industry, safety is at the core of everything we do.

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our Service Excellence Department, where you will play a central role in developing and optimizing our global service business.

The Service Excellence Department has overall responsibility for the servicing of VIKING’s Marine Evacuation Systems (MES), liferafts, and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) worldwide. Your Responsibilities
As Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing projects that support the development of VIKING’s global service organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocations
  • Collaborating closely with internal and external stakeholders across countries and functions
  • Participating in the implementation of technical improvements and new service concepts
  • Analyzing and optimizing processes, systems, and ways of working
  • Conducting risk assessments and ensuring effective project execution
  • Following up on project objectives, milestones, and results

  • Contributing to the development of global standards and best practices within the service area

You will work closely with a broad range of stakeholders and become an important partner to technicians, specialists, product development teams, sales teams, and service organizations around the world.

Approximately 20 travel days per year should be expected.

Who Are You?
We imagine that you have experience from a similar role where you have worked with project management in a technically oriented company or organization.

Most importantly, you thrive at the intersection of technology, people, and processes, and you are motivated by understanding and working with complex technical products and solutions.

We would like you to have:

  • Experience in project management and coordinating cross-functional activities

  • A structured and analytical approach with a focus on data-driven decision-making
  • A proactive and independent working style

  • The ability to navigate effectively among multiple stakeholders in a global organization
  • The flexibility to work with both strategic and operational tasks

Experience with Power BI, SAP S/4HANA, ServiceNow, or other ERP systems will be considered an advantage.

You are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken.

Join VIKING?
At VIKING, you will become part of a global company with a strong purpose and a culture characterized by responsibility, collaboration, and professional excellence.

We offer:

  • An exciting role with extensive international exposure
  • The opportunity to work with technical products and solutions that make a real difference
  • Strong development and career opportunities
  • Skilled and dedicated colleagues

title: Electrical Controls Engineer
description:
Electrical Controls Engineer

Are you passionate about being part of a successful team?

Join Our Power Systems & Control Engineering Team!

Partner with the best

The Electrical Controls Engineer is responsible for driving the design and development of power converters, power inverters, associated gate drivers, and power control algorithms for Industrial Variable Speed Drives (VSDs) used in the energy extraction market.

This role requires deep expertise in power electronics, including AC-to-DC and DC-to-AC conversion technologies, power section architecture, fault management, and advanced control systems. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop innovative solutions that deliver reliable, efficient, and high-performance drive systems for demanding industrial applications.

As a Electrical Controls Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Defining and validating power converter and inverter architectures, subcomponents, and performance characteristics for industrial applications

  • Leading analytical and design activities using established power electronics methodologies and technologies

  • Developing gate driver designs to ensure optimal performance and reliability of power electronic systems

  • Creating fault detection, protection, and signaling schemes to enhance system diagnostics and fault mitigation capabilities

  • Supporting the design and development of advanced power control algorithms for industrial variable speed drive applications

  • Collaborating with engineering teams to validate power section performance, reliability, and manufacturability

  • Communicating technical strategies and recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional teams

  • Contributing to the development of technical documentation, white papers, and design guidelines related to power electronics systems

  • Working closely with supply chain and commercialization teams to support successful product introduction and lifecycle management

  • Driving innovation in power conversion technologies while ensuring compliance with quality, reliability, and performance requirements

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related engineering discipline

  • Demonstrate strong experience in power electronics design, including AC-to-DC and DC-to-AC conversion systems

  • Possess expertise in power converter and inverter architecture development and validation

  • Have experience developing gate drivers, fault detection systems, and protection schemes for power electronic applications

  • Demonstrate strong analytical, troubleshooting, and system-level design capabilities

  • Be able to effectively communicate technical concepts and influence cross-functional stakeholders

  • Have experience working collaboratively across engineering, product development, and supply chain organizations

Desired Characteristics

  • Proficiency with Altera FPGA design tools

  • Strong experience using MATLAB/Simulink and associated toolsets including:

    • SimPowerSystems

    • Simscape

    • Model Predictive Control Toolbox

    • Fuzzy Logic Toolbox

    • Stateflow Toolbox

    • Robust Control Toolbox

    • Neural Network Toolbox

  • Experience with LabVIEW and optimization tools such as AMPL and CPLEX

  • Knowledge of simulation and power systems analysis tools including:

    • PowerWorld Simulator

    • PSIM

    • PSCAD

    • ETAP

    • SABER

  • Proficiency in C programming language

  • Knowledge of intelligent, advanced, and model-based control techniques

  • Demonstrated ability to develop innovative solutions in complex power electronics and industrial drive applications

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours – flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

  • Comprehensive private medical care options

  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs

  • Tailored financial programs

  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

This position requires valid work authorization in the country of employment. The employer is unable to sponsor work authorization for this role at any time.

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

  • Udarbejde tilbud og sikre, at kundens ønsker bliver omsat til en stærk oplevelse.

  • Rekruttere og bemande dine events fra vores faste medarbejdergruppe – og supplere med samarbejdspartnere ved større arrangementer.

  • Lede afviklingen på dagen og sikre, at både gæster og medarbejdere får en god oplevelse.

  • Vi afvikler typisk 1-2 events om ugen – afhængigt af sæson – med alt fra 50 til 600 gæster.

Vi leder efter en person, der:

  • Har erfaring med at planlægge og afvikle events eller større arrangementer.

  • Har stået med det ledende ansvar under afvikling og trives med at træffe beslutninger, når tempoet er højt.

  • Det er en fordel at have erfaring med personaleledelse, da du kommer til at stå i spidsen for et team på en travl aften.

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt med blik for både detaljen og helheden.

  • Er en stærk samarbejdspartner over for kunder, køkken og kolleger.

  • Taler og forstår dansk og engelsk.

  • Det er et plus hvis du har kørekort

Arbejdstid

Din arbejdstid ligger primært på hverdage. Selve afviklingen af vores events foregår både i dagtid og om aftenen, men sjældent i weekenden.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fuldtidsstilling med stor frihed og ansvar.

  • En konkurrencedygtig løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

  • Pension.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Fleksible rammer.

  • Et lille, ambitiøst event-team med højt til loftet, korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på både arbejdsdagen og virksomhedens udvikling.

Rekrutteringsprocessen

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 16. august 2026.

Vi afholder 1. samtaler fredag den 21. august og mandag den 24. august, og kandidater, der går videre, inviteres til 2. samtale i slutningen af uge 35. 2. samtale omfatter en kort skriftlig case med relevante opgaver, som tager udgangspunkt i hverdagen hos Kombonation.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Marc@lasseaskov.com.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Construction Project Administrator
description:
Position Title: Construction Project Administrator


Base Salary: $78,000 to $126,000 annually DOE

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401k, flexible spending account, paid sick leave and paid time off, parental leave, quarterly performance bonus, training, career growth and education reimbursement programs.


Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.


As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.


Our Company Values:


  • Genuinely Caring: We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You: We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement: We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust: We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.


Job Summary

The Construction Project Administrator (CPA) role is critical to ensuring outside plant (OSP) construction work is performed to industry standards and meets requirements for cost and engineering expectations. The CPA is responsible for both inspecting the work of Ziply Fiber OSP contractors and guiding the work efforts of contract inspectors in the CPA’s region to ensure all OSP work meets cost, timeline, and quality expectations for customers.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.


Field Inspections & Compliance

· Perform aerial and underground inspections along with audits of contractors performing inspections, corrections, and foreign pole transfers in accordance with the NESC and Ziply standards.

· Act as the first-level field approval for necessary changes found in field. Partner with Engineering and vendor team regarding potential solutions.


Contractor Oversight & Dispatch

· Assign and dispatch work to contract inspectors via email or through online database applications, with the ability to assist the contract inspectors in resolving NESC or FPT complex issues.

· Perform training of contract personnel in the accepted aerial plant inspection and correction methods used by Ziply, as well as the associated field software applications.


Process Improvement & Technology Enablement

· Involved in the development, trials, and implementation of new processes, process documentation, web applications, and field software involving NESC inspections and corrections, and pole transfer work.


Issue Resolution & Community Coordination

· Issue/dispute resolution: partner with vendor team to resolve issues that arise during the construction process. Bore-throughs, tree trimming, and other complaints with citizens impacted by the fiber deployment.

· Serve as a Municipality liaison, working with various municipalities regarding permitting, traffic control, and other concerns regarding the overall impact of OSP work within the community.


Financial & Cross‑Functional Support

· Perform invoice processing, work within project workflow databases to review and process vendor invoicing adhering to Ziply accounting guidelines.

· Support Ziply Fiber values, works with team members across several disciplines including Business and Consumer, Network Services, various customer groups including homebuilders, general contractors, and sub-contractors.


Other Duties

· Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.


Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum five (5) years’ experience in outside plant (OSP) construction and/or OSP engineering.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word, and PowerPoint; and proficient/comfortable with Microsoft Excel to include the development of forms, the use of internal and external hyperlinks, as well as simple functions and their structure (i.e. COUNT, COUNTIF, SUBTOTAL, SUM, etc.).

· Must possess and maintain a valid State Driver's License and satisfactory driving record.

· Must complete a pre-employment drug screening.


Preferred Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of the NESC, OSP construction techniques, telecom industry OSP best practices, and overall maintenance of a safe job site is a must; with the ability to determine cost effective solutions to bring into compliance complex aerial cable problems.
  • Ability to work with other team members to ensure timely completion, quality work and safe working practices throughout the labor and billing cycle.
  • Ability to learn the current Ziply construction unit coding is required in the contract inspection position.
  • Ability and desire to continuously learn new systems and applications.
  • Intermediate understanding of the as-built process for closing out OSP construction projects.
  • Basic understanding of the NJUNS database and familiarity of joint use processes.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Possess strong leadership and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to influence others to meet project objectives.
  • Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.
  • Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work within critical deadlines.
  • Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Effective conflict resolution skills.


Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.


Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. This role involves driving up to 15%of the time within a specific region or territory and requires the ability to safely perform all functions of operating a motor vehicle.


Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.


Diverse Workforce / EEO

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, and the presence of a non-job-related handicap or disability or any other legally protected status.


Ziply Fiber requires a pre-employment background check as conditions of employment. Ziply Fiber may require a preemployment drug screening.


Ziply Fiber is a drug free workplace.

title: Køkkenmedarbejder søges til Børnehuset Damgården 32-27 timer om ugen
description:
Er du en engageret køkkenmedarbejder med hjertet på rette sted, som brænder for at lave mad til børn mellem 0-6 år.

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde.

Vil du være med til at lave god mad, der gør en forskel for vores børn hver eneste dag? Vi søger 1 engageret og fagligt dygtig kollega til vores køkken i Børnehuset Damgården med opstart den 15.august 2026.

Som en del af vores team vil du få en central rolle i produktionen og arbejde i alle køkkenets funktioner. Vi søger dig, der brænder for godt madhåndværk, arbejder effektivt og har sans for kvalitet i hver eneste servering.

Vi hører gerne fra dig, hvis du:

  • Er uddannet ernæringsassistent eller har en anden køkkenfaglig uddannelse - gerne med erfaring fra storkøkkenproduktion
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med mad i store portioner efter professionelle opskrifter
  • Primært ønsker at arbejde i det varme og kolde køkken samt øvrige kostformer
  • Har styr på produktionssystemer og aktivt kan indgå i kvalitetsudvikling af disse
  • Har forståelse for og lyst til at arbejde med IT i dit daglige arbejde
  • Er en teamplayer og har lyst til at tage initiativ og bidrage med forslag til køkkenets drift

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et køkken som bygger på professionelt arbejde
  • Sparring med 1 faguddannet kollega
  • En grundig introduktion og oplæring
  • En arbejdsplads hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af køkkenets teams for at lykkes i fællesskab
  • Et spændende og udviklende arbejdsmiljø
  • Gode kollegaer og en dejlig stemning med plads til humor

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen.

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 13/8 - 2026 kl. 12.00.

Samtaler: Vi afvikler samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at sende os din ansøgning.

Kontakt: Linda 24467528 (leder) Hvis du vil vide mere om jobbet.

Arbejdslokation: Børnehuset Damgården, Damgårdsvej 18-20-22, 2620 Albertslund

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Lønindplacering efter forhandling mellem kommunen og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Det er en del af Albertslund Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling.

Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse i Albertslund Kommune, at du har en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse.

Albertslund Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Ved ansættelse indhentes straffe- og børneattest.

Velkommen til Albertslund - den bæredygtige by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskaber. Albertslund Kommune har mange kvaliteter, som skaber fantastiske rammer for hverdagslivet – både for borgere og medarbejdere. Midt i naturen og med et rigt forenings- og kulturliv, som børn og voksne cykler til og fra på byens mange kilometer cykelstier, der er adskilt fra bilerne på vejene. Der er S-tog lige til døren og flere supercykelstier, bl.a. mellem Albertslund og Vesterport i hjertet af København. Desuden skaber letbanen gode forbindelser til hele hovedstadsområdet.

I Albertslund Kommune har vi samme tilgang til vores opgaver, som vi selv ville ønske at opleve som borgere. Vi er vidt forskellige, men er fælles om vores opgave for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder. Du kan møde nogle af vores dygtige medarbejdere på www.albertslund.dk/indefra og få et indtryk af bredden af arbejdsområder, opgaver og fagligheder i Albertslund Kommune.

I Albertslund Kommune er der højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Børnehuset Bindesbøll søger 2 pædagogmedhjælpere på 37 timer pr. 1. sept. eller 16. sept. 2026
description:
Drømmer du om at arbejde i et helt nybygget børnehus med fantastiske rammer, lys og mange kvadratmeter, tæt på naturen og hvor du sammen med børnene kan erfare og udforske verden? Har du lyst til at være en del af et nyt team og være medskaber af et fantastisk børnefællesskab?:

Om jobbet:
Vi er en nyopført institution (åbnede 1. nov. 2025) som har til huse i de gamle bygninger, der tidligere var psykiatrisk hospital i Risskov.

I Bindesbøll vil vi gerne være en farvet palet af mennesker i både alder og køn, hvor der er plads til både erfarne og uerfarne medarbejdere.

Du skal være bevidst om, at vi står i en ny opbygningsproces, hvor intet er givet på forhånd og der vil være ubekendte, som vi sammen skal gøre bekendte hen ad vejen.

Du vil få indflydelse på at bidrage til udviklingen af en pædagogisk hverdag samt skabe kvalitetsfyldte læringsmiljøer i samarbejde med pædagogerne.

Som medarbejder skal man kunne mærke din entusiasme, du skal kunne stå forrest og repræsentere huset udadtil og du skal brænde for at skabe det bedste børneliv.

Vi skal løbende fylde huset op med børn og personale.

Stillingerne er både til vuggestuen og børnehaven

Din profil:
Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper som:

  • Er fuld af gå-på-mod og klar til at indgå i dagligdagen fra første dag
  • Kan indgå i aktiviteter med børnene både inde og ude
  • Støtter børnenes legekundskaber ved selv at deltage i legen
  • Vil deltage aktivt i det praktiske arbejde
  • Kan arbejde efter pædagogernes anvisninger

Dine kompetencer:

  • Er anerkendende i sin tilgang til børn- også når de udfordrer
  • Har en positiv tilgang til børn, forældre og kolleger
  • Kan bevare overblikket i travle situationer
  • Er ansvarsfuld og stabil, nærværende og som kan samarbejde og arbejde selvstændigt
  • Vil være en del af en personalegruppe, der er bygger på gensidig respekt, åbenhed og daglig dialog og som har fokus på pædagogisk faglighed

Derfor skal du vælge os:
Vi kan tilbyde:

  • En institution som på sigt vil være normeret til 39 vuggestuebørn og 89 børnehavebørn
  • En institution hvor børneperspektivet skal være i fokus
  • En institution der skal give børnene de bedste forudsætninger for læring, leg og etablering af venskaber
  • At blive en del af en ny personalegruppe hvor engagement, høj faglighed, hjertevarme og plads til at være menneske skal etableres
  • At blive en del af at skabe et velfungerende hus med et godt samarbejde på tværs af alle stuer

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen

Ugentligt timetal: 37 timer.

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: den 13. august 2026

Vi forventer, at afholde samtaler løbende.

Om os
Risskov dagtilbud er placeret i skønne omgivelser 5 km fra Aarhus centrum. Dagtilbuddet består af 11 afdelinger, hvoraf Børnehuset Bindesbøll er den ene.

I dagtilbuddet arbejder vi ud fra en fælles pædagogisk retning og samarbejdsteams på tværs af dagtilbuddet.

I dagtilbuddet tager vores pædagogik udgangspunkt i det enkelte barns ressourcer med et helhedssyn på barnet og vi lægger vægt på, at man er anerkendende og kan samarbejde med kollegaer, forældre og børn.

Vi har fokus på, at børnene oplever glæde ved at være en del af et inkluderende fællesskab, og lærer at begå sig i fællesskabet. Vi vægter at børnene bliver livsduelig og robuste og oplever af at kunne mestre livet på en god måde.

Som pædagogmedhjælper i Risskov dagtilbud skal du assistere pædagogerne med den daglige praksis og deres arbejde med pædagogisk udvikling.


Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Transfer Agency Compliance, Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced leader responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance within North American Transfer Agency operations. This is an exciting opportunity to join the Institutional Transfer Agency leadership team and help shape our future-state model as we implement strategic enhancements.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

As a Transfer Agency Compliance, Vice President you will:

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Transfer Agency operational practices, ensuring ongoing compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Ensure compliance with Transfer Agency regulatory requirements and filings, including 17Ad-16 notices, lost shareholder searches, TA-2, and TA-1 filings, as needed.

  • Research the impact of new and pending regulations, communicate relevant updates to Transfer Agency management, and manage projects to track and implement required regulatory changes.

  • Act as the main point of contact between Transfer Agency and Corporate Compliance, Privacy, Risk, Legal, and Audit,

  • Oversee the delivery of compliance-related value-added services, including Rule 22c-2 monitoring.

  • Oversee the effective design and completion of operational control audits, including as-of audits, after-cut-off audits, certificate destruction audits, and related reviews.

  • Ensure proper oversight and governance of outsourced providers and international branches performing Transfer Agency operations.

  • Review and maintain the Transfer Agency Legal Manual and Regulatory Matrix, and support ongoing employee training to promote a strong culture of risk awareness and adherence to controls.

  • Recommend control enhancements, risk strategies, and process improvements that maintain a strong control environment while improving efficiency.

  • Participate in industry groups and provide documentation and updates on relevant topics.

  • Critically assess current- and future-state operations, recommend improvements, and drive change.

  • Maintain effective internal and external relationships with key stakeholders, serving as an escalation point as needed.

  • Ensure all team deliverables are met within assigned deadlines, maintain procedures and team checklists, and ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and controls.

  • Support other projects or tasks as assigned.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics to both senior management and operational teams.

  • Ability to influence others and drive execution.

  • Prior experience with registered transfer agency regulatory compliance practices.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

  • 10+ years’ experience

Salary Range:

$110,000 - $181,250 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

Read our CEO Statement

title: Land Rep III, Sr
description:
At Williams, we’re powering a cleaner, more connected future, and that starts with you. Here, your work fuels communities, drives innovation, and helps deliver reliable energy the world depends on. Join a Fortune 500 team that invests in your growth, values your contributions, and challenges you to make a lasting impact every day.


As a Land Representative Sr., you will be accountable for the protection, acquisition and negotiation of land and property rights for pipelines and facilities construction as you collaborate with company partners. You may lead teams or projects and will provide excellent customer service to resolve sophisticated problems that improve performance, efficiency and safety. title: Tømrer til service og spjæld i Vejle
description:
Er du tømrer og vil du have firmabil og frihed under ansvar?

Vi mangler en tømrer til service og spjæld i Vejle.

Du lander i en større tømrerafdeling, hvor serviceopgaver, forsikringssager og større byggeopgaver ligger tæt på hinanden. Kunderne spænder fra private boligejere og boligforeninger til erhverv, så hverdagen kan skifte fra hurtige reparationer til planlagte vedligeholdelsesopgaver. Arbejdet ligger i Vejle og omegn, og når opgaven passer til det, har du en lærling med dig.

Det særlige er, at du får ansvar for de opgaver, hvor kunden mærker det med det samme. Du får frihed under ansvar, men der er folk omkring dig, hvis noget driller. Mottoet er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Det får du

Løn: 190-210 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Vejle og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Service, spjæld og selvstændig planlægning

Din hverdag

Dagen handler om at få service og spjæld lukket ordentligt af. Du vurderer opgaven, får materialerne på plads og sikrer, at kunden ved hvad der er lavet. Når du har lærling med, er du den der viser rækkefølgen og holder kvaliteten hele vejen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Service og spjæld hos private og erhverv
  • Reparationer og vedligehold af træværk, døre og vinduer
  • Udskiftning af vinduer, døre og køkkener
  • Renovering og mindre ombygninger
  • Tagopgaver og efterisolering når de ligger i planen

Hvis noget viser sig større end først aftalt, siger du til i tide, så kunden og holdet ved hvor opgaven står. Det passer bedst til en tømrer, der kan arbejde ordentligt uden at nogen står over skulderen på dig.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring som tømrer
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt med service og spjæld
  • Kan tage ansvar for en lærling på opgaven
  • Er stabil, møder som aftalt og siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med forsikringsopgaver, vedligehold eller udskiftning af vinduer og døre. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan arbejde ordentligt og tage ansvar for det du afleverer.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: Deputy Representative, Haiti, P-5
description:
The Position:

UNFPA has been operating in Haiti since the 1970s. It contributes to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), including good health and well-being, the promotion of gender equality and the empowerment of women and adolescent girls, with an emphasis on poverty eradication. Its objective is to "achieve universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights and reduce maternal mortality with a view to accelerating progress in the implementation of the Program of Action resulting from the International Conference on population and development, in order to improve the living conditions of women, adolescents and young people, based on population dynamics, human rights and gender equality”.


In Haiti, UNFPA works in concert with national authorities, civil society - including the private business sector, academia, religious leaders and human rights organizations.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results

Job Purpose:

In close collaboration with the UNFPA Representative, the UNFPA Deputy Representative plays a leading role in strengthening the Country's capacity to implement the ICPD Programme of Action within the context of its national development efforts for the achievement of the MDGs, thus ensuring national ownership. S/He is primarily responsible for the formulation and delivery of the UNFPA Country programme, projecting the programme of the organization, promoting at the national level the goals of the programme and ensuring the integration of issues of population, sexual and reproductive health, and gender in the broader development agenda. The Deputy Representative plays a leadership role also within the UNFPA country team, providing an example of creative programme development and sharing knowledge and insights with staff to facilitate broad country programme management. Key activities include:

  • Programme Leadership
  • National Capacity Development
  • Partnerships and Advocacy
  • Resource Management

The Deputy Representative serves as OIC in absence of the UNFPA Representative; s/he serves on the Country Management Team, with the OM or other senior staff in programme and operations management

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:

  • Master's degree in any of the following disciplines: Public Health, Medicine, Sociology, Demography, Gender, International Relations, International Development, Economics, Public Administration, Management or other related field.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • 10 years of increasingly responsible professional experience in public administration and international development at the international level.
  • Experience leading and managing complex development and humanitarian programmes in civil society organizations and/or the United Nations
  • Good understanding of human rights, population and development, sexual and reproductive health and rights, gender equality, and their place in the development agenda;
  • Strong high-level negotiation skills;
  • Good knowledge and understanding of UN and International development frameworks and the sustainable development goals;
  • Proven ability to lead and manage teams to achieve demonstrable results;
  • Identify strongly with the United Nations values and principles, and the Mandate of the United Nations Population Fund, UNFPA, in particular;
  • Demonstrable management and field experience is essential, specifically in complex countries or humanitarian situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to sustain and advance current partnerships and to develop new partnerships with untraditional partners.
  • Demonstrated innovative thinking, creativity and calculated risk taking.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide strategic vision and focus by successfully communicating and implementing priorities based on clear deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate obstacles and successfully adapt team priorities in order to develop alternative plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to take responsibility for team decisions, providing the rationale as appropriate.
  • Demonstrated successful management of a complex and uncertain environment negatively affecting colleagues’ well-being.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide team managers with the needed direction to achieve results and hold them accountable.
  • Accepts hardship of living and working in substandard conditions (container based) in “E” duty station.
  • Handles high level work pressure and stress positively, is a strong team player.
  • Adopts humanitarian/emergency work modes in case of disasters and political crisis.
  • Coaches national staff.

Languages:

  • Fluency in French and English is required.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity,
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,
  • Embracing cultural diversity,
  • Embracing change

Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results,
  • Being accountable,
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,
  • Thinking analytically and strategically,
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,


Compensation and Benefits:

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

In this role, you will support integrated Test Leads by carrying out test development engineering activities by Blue Origin standards and practices. You will be acting as lead test engineer with overall responsibility for the test, the crew, and the procedure. You will be responsible for coordinating test crews, support equipment, and vehicle configurations for testing. You will be responsible for enforcing safety policies during test planning and operations and solving issues that come up during testing. title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Digital Solutions Center Manager

__

In this role, you will support the tendering, design, implementation, and commissioning of automation and digital electrical solutions for medium-voltage, CSS & RMU projects. You will analyze customer requirements, develop RTU and SCADA system architectures, and prepare technical documentation, drawings, and bills of materials. Each day, you will collaborate with engineering, sales, project management, and operations teams to deliver solutions that meet customer specifications and ABB standards. You will program and commission RTUs, SCADA systems, and protection relays while providing technical support throughout project execution and after-sales activities. You will also contribute to identifying innovative automation solutions, promoting ABB technologies, and enhancing customer experience through effective technical support and continuous improvement initiatives.

The work model for the role is: #onsite #onsite-Li

This role is contributing to the Solution Business within Electrification in Egypt. It reports to the Digital Solutions Center Manager in Egypt.

Main stakeholders are customers, consultants, utility companies, construction contractors, project managers, operations teams, planning teams, tendering and sales teams, and engineering management.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyzing customer requirements for RTU, SCADA, and automation systems and translating them into technical solutions

  • Designing system architectures and preparing bills of materials, schematics, and engineering documentation

  • Programming and commissioning RTU, SCADA, and protection relay systems using various communication protocols

  • Supporting project execution activities to ensure compliance with customer specifications and ABB standards

  • Collaborating with sales, tendering, project management, and operations teams to deliver successful project outcomes

  • Testing and validating automation solutions and providing technical support during implementation and commissioning

  • Delivering after-sales support and resolving technical issues to enhance customer satisfaction

  • Engaging with customers and stakeholders to provide technical guidance and promote ABB automation and digital solutions

  • Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives by monitoring quality, performance, and operational efficiency

  • Identifying opportunities to implement innovative technologies and enhance digital electrical solutions

You will join a dynamic, collaborative, and highly skilled engineering team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications:

  • You are highly skilled in automation systems including SCADA, RTUs, PLCs, communication networks, and protection relays within the electrical power and automation industry

  • You have 5–6 years of professional experience, including 1–2 years of experience working as an Automation Engineer

  • Possess enhanced knowledge of AutoCAD, Eplan, SAP, and Microsoft Office applications, with experience in engineering design processes

  • Extensive knowledge of IEC standards, ISO 9001 requirements, ABB processes, and automation systems, with RTU and Substation SCADA experience being essential

  • You are passionate about problem-solving, innovation, and customer satisfaction, with a strong collaborative mindset

  • Proven ability to independently resolve technical issues, prioritize tasks, and plan activities effectively

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with a proactive, self-motivated approach and ability to perform under pressure in team environments

  • Degree in Electrical Power Engineering, Communications Engineering, Control Engineering, or a related discipline

  • You are at ease communicating in English and Arabic (French is an advantage)

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward.

Meet the moment. This is where progress never stops, teams push boundaries, and we’re engineered to outrun the challenges ahead.
Run What Runs the World.

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Remote Visit Startup Lead
description:
At IQVIA, we're transforming clinical research through innovative hybrid and decentralized trial models that bring studies closer to patients. As a Startup Lead, Remote Research Clinicians (RRC), you will play a critical role in shaping and launching these innovative solutions across a portfolio of clinical studies.

In this role, you will lead startup strategy and execution for Remote Research Clinician services, partnering with sponsors and cross-functional teams to ensure studies are designed for operational success from the outset. You'll help translate complex study requirements into scalable, patient-centric solutions while driving quality, compliance, and efficiency throughout the startup lifecycle.

This is an exciting opportunity for a clinical research professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, collaborating across diverse teams, and contributing to the future of decentralized clinical trials.

What You'll Do

  • Lead startup strategy and execution for Remote Research Clinician services across multiple clinical studies and sponsors.
  • Partner with sponsors and internal stakeholders to design and implement hybrid and decentralized visit models that support patient-centered research.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and key point of contact for startup-related activities, ensuring alignment across project teams and operational functions.
  • Develop study startup plans, timelines, resource forecasts, and risk mitigation strategies to support successful study delivery.
  • Drive operational readiness by overseeing process implementation, documentation, training, and study launch activities.
  • Support business development activities by contributing operational expertise to proposals and strategic solution design.
  • Monitor startup progress, identify potential challenges, and proactively implement solutions to keep studies on track.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive consistency, quality, innovation, and continuous improvement across the startup portfolio.
  • Contribute to the evolution of remote and decentralized clinical trial delivery by sharing best practices and identifying new opportunities for innovation.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience within clinical research, including experience leading projects, programs, or complex initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial operations and applicable regulatory requirements, including ICH-GCP and local regulations.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Knowledge of hybrid, decentralized, or patient-centric clinical trial models. Strong understanding of protocol requirements and their operational implications.
  • Experience leading clinical trial startup activities.
  • Ability to develop practical solutions to complex operational challenges.
  • Experience supporting proposal development, strategic planning, or client-facing activities.
  • Understanding of project financials, budgeting, and resource planning.

Key Success Factors

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong leadership and influencing skills with the ability to drive results through collaboration.
  • Exceptional organizational, planning, and prioritization abilities.
  • Proven problem-solving mindset and ability to navigate ambiguity.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Learning agility and a passion for continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and diverse cultural environments.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.
