title: Master Data Management (MDM) Advisor
description:
At Suncor, we produce and provide energy.

When you join Suncor, you become part of a company that has built a solid foundation for both business and employee success. We are a place where talented people thrive. As part of our team, you play a vital role in delivering energy we all rely on, and you'll make a meaningful impact in the communities where we live and work.

At Suncor, we're strengthening how we manage and govern critical business data. As an Advisor, Master Data Management, you will work with various internal stakeholders to support the development and continuous improvement of master data processes, standards, and data quality practices. Your work will help ensure reliable, high-quality data that enables effective operations, compliance, and decision-making across the organization.

What we offer:

We recognize your contribution and offer a range of rewards and development opportunities designed to support your success. Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Suncor and the region where you work.

  • Strong compensation: we offer competitive compensation, regional-based uplifts, annual bonuses, and long-term financial rewards. We also help you save for your future by offering pension programs, and savings plans with company matching

  • Benefits: utilize an employee assistance program and comprehensive company-paid health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family to support your mental, physical, and financial well-being

  • Generous time-off: enjoy generous paid vacation time and personal time-off to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance

  • Talent development programs: Internal mobility, succession planning, and employee training and development programs are just a few ways we’re dedicated to your development

Minimum Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of experience in Master Data Management, Data Quality, Business Analysis, Process Improvement, or a related field

  • Experience supporting data governance, stewardship, process improvement, or business data initiatives

  • Working knowledge of SAP master data processes and related business applications

  • Experience analyzing data quality issues, identifying root causes, and supporting remediation efforts

  • Familiarity with enterprise data platforms, reporting tools, or data management solutions such as SAP or Snowflake

  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, documentation, and problem-solving skills

Don’t have all the qualifications listed? That’s ok! Apply anyway. We acknowledge the value of transferable skills.

Responsibilities

  • Support the assessment and improvement of master data processes, standards, and stewardship practices across business functions

  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify critical data elements, business rules, data quality requirements, and process improvement opportunities

  • Facilitate discussions and workshops to gather requirements and document business processes

  • Develop and maintain process documentation, standards, procedures, and governance materials

  • Monitor data quality metrics and support reporting, issue management, and remediation activities.

  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to help implement practical and sustainable master data solutions

  • Assist with testing, quality assurance, and deployment activities related to data and business process changes

  • Support compliance, controls, audit readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives that promote data integrity and business process effectiveness

Location and other Key Details:

  • This is an office-based role. You will work out of our Calgary head office, located in the Suncor Energy Centre at 150 – 6th Ave S.W

  • Hours of work are a regular 40-hour work week, Monday to Friday with occasional site visits

  • Our business professional roles follow internal compensation guidelines, and the pay band will generally be based on years of experience and scope of work

Think we are a fit? Apply now!

Suncor is committed to providing equal opportunities for employment and building an inclusive, results-oriented and high-performance culture where all members of our team feel safe, valued and respected.

title: Director, Forward Deployed Security
location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
description:
Overview

The Cloud & AI organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. Microsoft is one of the largest enterprise service companies in the world.

Forward-Deployed Security within CISO Leadership is responsible for bootstrapping and maturing security programs and addressing threats faced by Microsoft divisions with emerging, non-traditional-enterprise technologies. We work where the problems are least standardized and the stakes are real: new products, fast-moving platforms, uneven security maturity and teams that need practical help building an architecture that works for them - not abstract guidance and frameworks. We land, understand the environment, build roadmaps, develop recon and exposure tooling, and stay involved to land security improvements until the problem space is stable and an operational team is ready to stand on its own.

We are looking for a technical program leader to help turn complex security needs into clear decisions, executable programs, and measurable outcomes. You will shape a portfolio of security programs, and build the mechanisms that help security, engineering, product, and business teams deliver together. While this role does not require specific technical skills, the successful candidate will be able to develop enough technical depth to challenge assumptions, understand architecture and delivery tradeoffs, improve how work gets done, and stay accountable for adoption and risk reduction. AI will be part of how the team researches, analyzes, plans, and operates, and you will be responsible for the quality, limitations, and human oversight of AI-assisted outputs used in decision making.



Responsibilities
  • Turn ambiguous security needs into well-scoped programs with explicit goals, priorities, dependencies, owners, success measures, and decision paths.
  • Ensure alignment with CISO-mandated governance processes, including quarterly risk reviews, third-party risk, and PIR governance.
  • Partner deeply with engineering, architecture, product, and security leaders to identify risks, resolve planning misalignment, and drive technically sound decisions through delivery and adoption.
  • Build and improve the operating mechanisms behind security reviews, roadmap execution, risk prioritization, telemetry, and remediation so the organization can scale without adding unnecessary friction.
  • Use customer feedback, security telemetry, incident learning, exposure data, and other evidence to guide experiments, influence investment decisions, and continuously improve the portfolio.
  • Apply AI and automation to research, planning, analysis, and workflow orchestration while setting standards for validation, traceability, escalation, and responsible human judgment.
  • Establish patterns for security program management across forward-deployed divisions, setting clear objectives and improving execution quality.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
Additional or Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
  • 1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).
  • Experience leading complex technical programs across multiple organizational boundaries from problem definition through delivery, adoption, and outcome measurement.
  • Experience defining success measures and using customer, telemetry, operational, or business data to make program decisions including decisions with budget, headcount and organizational structure implications.
  • Experience managing at least one sustained security, privacy, or identity program.
  • Experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams on system design, technical tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery risks.
  • Experience applying AI or automation to research, planning, analysis, or operational workflows and setting standards for validating and communicating the limitations of AI-generated output.
  • Leading a portfolio of security, cloud, infrastructure, identity, data, AI, or developer-platform programs across multiple divisions.
  • Managing managers or building a technical program-management function.
  • Designing mechanisms for technical reviews, risk prioritization, roadmap delivery, remediation programs, or product and service health.
  • Experience managing a cross-functional roadmap with product deliverables, engineering platform constraints, and financial/revenue stakeholders.
  • Applying Responsible AI practices, evaluation methods, and human oversight to AI-assisted products or operational workflows.


Technical Program Management IC5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $142,800 - $274,800 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $188,000 - $304,200 per year.

title: Vil du udvikle pædagogik, fællesskaber og børneliv sammen med os? (genopslag)
description:
Det Grønne Børnehus i Herlev søger to engagerede pædagoger – én til vuggestuen og én til børnehaven.

Vi er en nyere institution, der åbnede i 2024, og vi er stadig i gang med at forme både vores kultur, læringsmiljøer og pædagogiske praksis. Derfor får du hos os mulighed for at få indflydelse og være med til at sætte dit præg på hverdagen.

Naturen er en vigtig del af vores profil. Vi bruger legepladsen, nærområdet og vores ture ud af huset som en naturlig del af børnenes læring, leg og fællesskaber. Hos os må børn gerne mærke vinden, hoppe i vandpytter, undersøge krible-krable-liv og få jord under neglene. Derfor søger vi også pædagoger, der har lyst til at være ude og ser natur, sanser og bevægelse som værdifulde læringsrum.

Vi er en mangfoldig medarbejdergruppe med forskellige kompetencer og perspektiver, men med en fælles ambition om at skabe stærke, trygge og inkluderende børnefællesskaber, hvor alle børn oplever at høre til.

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med Engskolen, hvilket giver os adgang til spændende fællesskaber, aktiviteter og faciliteter som gymnastiksal, bibliotek og legepladser. Samtidig har vi løbende juniormesterlære-elever hos os, som bidrager positivt til hverdagen.

Lige nu er vi optaget af

  • at styrke vores sproglige læringsmiljøer med fokus på flersprogede børn og familier
  • at skabe legende fællesskaber med fantasifulde temaer – hen over sommeren tager vi på sørøvereventyr med vind i sejlene og vand under kølen.

Vi leder efter jer, der vil være med til at udvikle vores grønne børnehus – med engagement, faglighed og kreative idéer. I har ambitioner på børnenes vegne og lyst til at gøre en forskel hver dag.


Vi tilbyder
  • Et hus med fokus på nærvær, leg og stærke relationer.
  • En hverdag med natur, sanser og legende samspil.
  • Engagerede kollegaer og fælles faglig udvikling.
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på fællesskab.
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på udviklingen.

Vi ønsker os

Vi ønsker os, at I:

  • bidrager aktivt til vores udvikling.
  • er fagligt engageret og nærværende i arbejdet med børnene.
  • ser værdi i sanselige oplevelser, nysgerrighed og undersøgende leg.
  • tør give og modtage feedback.
  • vægter forældresamarbejdet højt.
  • har noget på hjerte med børnene.

Praktisk
  • 37 timer/uge (lavere timetal kan aftales).
  • Personalemøde ca. 1 gang om måneden.
  • Ansøgningsfrist: onsdag den 26. august.
  • Vi holder samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning afsted.
  • Opstart 1. september eller snarest muligt derefter. Vi er tålmodige og venter gerne på de rette ansøgere.
  • Ansættelse efter gældende overenskomst. Løn aftales efter principperne om ny løn. Det konkrete lønudspil oplyses i forbindelse med en eventuel samtale.
  • Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest ved ansættelse i Herlev Kommunes dagtilbud.
  • Herlev Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Vi opfordrer til, at du kommer forbi til en rundvisning – vi vil meget gerne vise vores hus frem! Hvis du gerne vil det, så giv et kald til børnehusleder Maj-Britt Jørgensen på 2117 8369, så kan vi lave en aftale.

Vil du være med? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

Mød vores medarbejdere

På herlev.dk kan du møde nogle af vores medarbejdere fra forskellige arbejdspladser i kommunen. De fortæller hver især om, hvad de arbejder med, og hvorfor de er glade for deres arbejde.


Søg stillingen

Du søger stillingen online. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning, CV og andre relevante bilag. Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering. Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe ”Spam/uønsket post”.


Om Herlev

Herlev er placeret i hjertet af hovedstadsområdet med en velfungerende infrastruktur. Transportmulighederne til og fra Herlev er gode og bliver forstærket med den kommende letbane og de fire letbanestationer i byen. Samtidig byder Herlev på let adgang til grønne områder. Vi er i fuld gang med at udvikle byen, så den også i fremtiden har et levende handelsliv, en spændende bymidte og er attraktiv at bo og drive virksomhed i.

I Herlev Kommune arbejder vi ambitiøst og målrettet på at sikre, at vores tilbud til borgerne også i fremtiden er på et højt niveau. Det gør vi ved at indrette organisationen med et større fokus på at styrke fagligheden og understøtte dialogen med borgerne, samt forkorte afstanden mellem det lokale politiske niveau og kommunens medarbejdere.

title: Assistant Beamline Scientist - In Situ Nanoprobe
description:
The Microscopy Group of the X-ray Science Division (XSD) operates microprobe and nanoprobe beamlines with novel capabilities, develops advanced instrumentation and methods, and pursues collaborative research in the energy, life, materials, and quantum sciences.

In particular, the In Situ Nanoprobe (ISN) at 19-ID is a state-of-the-art nanoprobe designed specifically for in situ/operando studies with multi-scale and multi-modality capabilities. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented scientist to join our ISN team. The ideal candidate will play a key role in developing and operating the ISN for world-class scientific applications, as well as developing advanced methods & instrumentation for the ISN.

Responsibilities include:

  • Contribute to commissioning and operation of the ISN.

  • Collaborate with users to develop scientific applications and support user experiments, including x-ray data analysis to develop new insights and scientific knowledge.

  • Work with team members and other groups to develop advanced microscopy methods & instrumentation, targeting techniques using the upgraded APS source.

  • Present research findings at meetings, conferences, and journals.

  • May be required to perform other duties as assigned.

Position Requirements

  • Minimum Education and Experience Requirements: Bachelors and 5+ years’ experience, Masters and 3+ years’ experience, PhD and 0+ years’ experience, or equivalent.

  • Strong background in x-ray methods and techniques, including x-ray nanodiffraction, fluorescence, ptychography, spectroscopy, and tomography.

  • Experience in developing applications in energy, chemical, materials, or quantum science, and the associated in situ/operando sample environments are desirable.

  • Proficiency in deploying and developing relevant controls/analysis software and AI/ML tools.

  • In-depth knowledge of x-ray microscopy and associated instrumentation and methods.

  • Familiarity with x-ray optics and detectors, beamline controls, data acquisition and analysis, are highly preferred.

  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team-oriented environment.

  • Ability to model Argonne’s core values of impact, safety, respect, integrity, and teamwork.

  • Interpersonal skills, oral and written communication skills, and ability to interact with people at all levels both within and outside the laboratory.

If you are a passionate and driven scientist with a track record of success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your qualifications for the role.

Job Family

Research Development (RD)

Job Profile

Physics 2

Worker Type

Regular

Time Type

Full time

The expected hiring range for this position is $94,486.00 - $147,398.94.

Please note that the pay range information is a general guideline only. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, business considerations, internal equity, and external market pay for comparable jobs. Additionally, comprehensive benefits are part of the total rewards package.

title: Technicien en sécurité / Field Security Technician CCTV & EAS
description:
À propos de Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, un leader mondial en gestion thermique, en systèmes de bâtiments critiques, en efficacité énergétique et en décarbonisation, aide ses clients à utiliser l’énergie de manière plus productive, à réduire les émissions de carbone et à fonctionner avec la précision et la résilience requises dans des secteurs en forte croissance tels que les centres de données, les soins de santé, les produits pharmaceutiques, la fabrication avancée et l’enseignement supérieur.

Depuis plus de 140 ans, Johnson Controls offre des performances là où cela compte vraiment. Soutenue par des technologies avancées, des services sur le cycle de vie complet et une organisation de terrain de premier plan, l’entreprise améliore la performance de ses clients, transforme les objectifs en résultats concrets et contribue à faire progresser la société.

Ce que nous offrons:

• Salaire de départ compétitif

• Formation rémunérée

• Opportunités d'avancement mondial

• Primes de parrainage

• Avantages complets

• Assurance médicale/dentaire/optique

• Assurance-vie

• Invalidité de courte et de longue durée

• Régimes d'épargne-retraite compétitifs

• Programme d'aide aux employés

• Programme de bien-être

• Et plus encore!

Ce que vous devrez faire:

La personne devra s’occuper d’aller faire les installations et le service, selon les besoins, dans les commerces de ventes au détail. Les produits sont ceux spécifiques à Sensormatic (Surveillance Électronique d’Article : SEA), les systèmes de vidéo surveillance et autre selon ce qui est vendu au commerce de détail.

Sensormatic recherche un technicien en électronique ou équivalent avec ou sans expérience. Les formations sont fournies, ainsi qu’un véhicule, vêtements et outils nécessaire pour le travail.

Connaissance informatique et réseautique, tel que l’utilisation d’un ordinateur et savoir comment fonctionne un réseau de façon générale est un atout. Le domaine de la vidéosurveillance est de plus en plus sur réseau informatique et nous utilisons des switch PoE et serveurs ainsi que des caméras IP.

Le technicien devra :

  • Être situé dans la ville de Gatineau ou Ottawa.

  • Faire l’installation et service des produits SEA et autre.

  • Faire des relevés chez les clients pour soumettre aux ventes les produits que ceux-ci ont besoin.

  • Remplir la feuille d’installation ou service chez chaque client et la transmettre après chaque appel.

  • Programmer et ajuster les systèmes SEA et vidéo avec les outils fournis

  • Voyager vers le commerce, avec le camion fournis, pour faire l’installation ou service, avoir un permis de conduire Quebec.

  • Parfois, dormir à l’extérieur et travailler de soir lorsque l’installation le requiert.

  • Interagir avec le client et ces compagnons de travail de façon professionnel.

  • Compléter les cours obligatoires.

  • S’assurer que son véhicule est entretenu selon les recommandations.

  • S’assurer que son inventaire est à jour dans son véhicule et faire les demandes de remplacement après chaque client lorsqu’une pièce est utilisé.

  • Fournir une formation de base du produit installé au client lorsque nécessaire.

  • S’assurer de suivre les règles et procédures établies par Sensormatic Canada Inc.

Ce qu’on recherche :

Éducation :

  • Diplôme d’étude collégial

  • DEC en électronique/électrotechnique ou DEP Installation et entretien de systèmes de sécurité

Expérience :

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en réparation électronique et en réseautage

  • Expérience de la configuration et du dépannage de périphériques en réseaux

Talents :

  • Bonne compétence en informatique, réseautique et une bonne connaissance des systèmes d’exploitation

  • Doit être motivé et capable de travailler de manière autonome

  • Bonne aptitude mécanique et être capable d’utiliser des outils manuels et électriques

Échelle de rémunération horaire à l’embauche : 27.60$ -32.00$
(Le taux horaire sera établi en fonction de la scolarité, de l’expérience, des connaissances, des compétences et des aptitudes du candidat, de l’équité interne et des conditions du marché.) Ce poste comprend un programme complet et concurrentiel d’avantages sociaux.

L’échelle de rémunération affichée correspond à la rémunération globale cible du poste. Les candidatures présentant un profil exceptionnel peuvent être considérées au-delà de l’échelle indiquée.

L’employeur peut utiliser des outils technologiques d’aide à la sélection, incluant l’intelligence artificielle (IA), afin d’appuyer un processus d’embauche équitable et efficace. Les décisions finales sont prises par des évaluateurs humains.

Pour plus de détails, veuillez visiter l’onglet À propos de nous sur le site Johnson Controls Carrière à https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about-us

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive pay structure.
  • Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings—available on day one.
  • Professional Development: Continuous product, on-the-job, and cross-training opportunities, supported by excellent internal resources.
  • Supportive Culture: Encouraging, collaborative team environment and a modern work culture.
  • Safety Commitment: Zero Harm policy ensures your safety on the job.
  • Employee Perks: Access to JCI employee discount programs (The Loop by Perk Spot).
  • Equipment and training Provided: Company vehicle, tools, PPE equipment and training to support your work.
  • Operational Support: Scheduling and management assistance for all assignments.

What you will do and your role

Sensormatic Solutions is a fast-paced dynamic organization as part of JCI working closely with the worlds most recognized retailers. Your work environment will have full autonomy, it will be free flowing with a ton of flexibility and will require you to constantly think “outside the box.”

We promote a modern work culture, and we treat you like a professional. Your opinion and point of view always matter! If this sounds like something that interests you, we want you on our team.

We are seeking a talented and skilled Field Installation and Service Technician to install, service, survey, inspect and maintain inventory control and video equipment in retail environments.

How you will do it

  • Install, service, troubleshoot, repair, maintain and inspect retail products and equipment - including CCTV, access control systems, and Sensormatic products.
  • Manage your service calls and documentation via company systems (computer/mobile), including products serviced, work performed, hours, and parts utilized.
  • Maintain an accurate parts inventory at levels that ensure a first-time fix.
  • Demonstrate and train customers on proper use of installed equipment.
  • Communicate customer satisfaction feedback, potential sales opportunities, or recurring issues with your manager.
  • Conduct site surveys to support proposal generation.
  • Travel to customers locations as required. Occasional out of town travel, weekend and night work as required.
  • Interact with customers and internal employees in a professional manner.
  • Participate in ongoing training and maintain certifications.
  • Maintain company provided service vehicle as required.
  • Comply with all Sensormatic Canada Inc. policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional tasks as assigned.

What we look for

Required

  • Must reside in Gatineau or Ottawa.
  • Associate degree in Electronics and/or Networking, or technical equivalent required.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license
  • 2 years of prior work experience in a related field.
  • Basic training and certification in Video Management Systems (VMS).
  • Highly organized, strong interpersonal skills, and ability to work independently and in a team.
  • General electronics knowledge and mechanical aptitude to be able to use hand and power tools.
  • Provincial License, or willingness to obtain (as required).
  • Capable of performing physical labor to include carrying and moving equipment and tools up to 50-70 lbs.
  • Able to work in unusual and sometimes difficult positions such as climbing ladders, scaffolding, and high lift equipment up to 40 feet, working within ducts, crawl spaces, above ceilings, etc.
  • Experience interpreting blueprints, technical documents, scope of work and meet deadlines.
  • Asset: Knowledge of building construction and inventory management/EAS technology.
  • Network troubleshooting experience and solid understanding of operating systems.
  • Strong organizational skills, positive attitude, and an ability to learn quickly.
  • Proficient with MS Office and basic computer skills.
  • Ability to travel and work overtime as needed.
  • Fluent English language required. Excellent written and verbal communication, demonstrated superior people and telephone skills, excellent organizational skills and the ability to work well under pressure are essential

Preferred

  • Certified in Video Platforms, EAS & RFID solutions commonly installed and serviced by Retail
  • Networking Fundamentals knowledge; network certification is a plus.
  • TRS - Networking 101
  • Experience servicing integrated solutions.

description:

title: Salgstrainee
description:

Du behøver ikke kende alle modeller og udstyrspakker på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, har lyst til at lære og kan lide at tale med mennesker.

Du bliver tilknyttet enten Kia eller Zeekr og får gradvist mere ansvar, efterhånden som du bliver skarpere på salg, rådgivning og kundeoplevelser.


Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet:

  • Opfølgning på kundehenvendelser
  • Deltagelse i salgsprocessen fra første kontakt til levering

Risskov-afdelingen sælger også Nissan, Volvo og brugte biler. Du bliver derfor en del af et stort bilhus, hvor du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger på tværs af flere mærker.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har interesse for salg, biler og gode kundeoplevelser
  • Er udadvendt, positiv og god til mennesker
  • Har lyst til at lære og tage ansvar
  • Kan holde overblik i en travl hverdag
  • Har kørekort til personbil
  • Har afsluttet eller er ved at afslutte en relevant ungdomsuddannelse, eksempelvis HHX eller EUX


Det får du hos os

  • En målrettet 3 årig uddannelse til bilsælger på Århus Business College.
  • Grundig oplæring og løbende udvikling
  • Ansvar og praktisk erfaring fra starten
  • Et stærkt team med en uformel omgangstone
  • En varieret hverdag i en branche med fart på
  • Et godt fundament for din videre karriere


Klar til at tage første skridt?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Skriv gerne, om du er mest interesseret i elevpladsen hos Kia eller Zeekr.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Morten Holst Nielsen - Forretningschef, Risskov - Telefon: 87 46 60 06 / Morten.Holst.Nielsen@autohus.dk


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.


__


Om din nye arbejdsplads:

Pedersen & Nielsen Automobilforretning A/S er en multibrand forhandler med 11 afdelinger i Jylland. Som ansat hos os, bliver du en del af en virksomhed, der værdsætter ambitioner, ordentlighed samt passion for lokalmiljøet. Vi er stolte af vores høje serviceniveau, og du vil opleve, at vores medarbejdere er vores vigtigste aktiv.

title: Escrow Officer Representative - Upward Title - Salt Lake City, UT
location: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
description:
What you’ll do:

You are the key to home ownership. As an escrow officer, you’re the human link between our process and people. You’re there at the beginning, reviewing contracts and following instructions. You’re there in the middle, ensuring that all the associated paperwork is completed efficiently and accurately. You’re working with agents and their clients to keep the process moving forward, verifying that titles are clean, taxes are paid, and loans are funded. Finally, you’re there at the end, to assure that no funds or property will change hands until all terms have been carried to completion.

Who you are:

  • Trusted consultant, maintaining a positive, can-do attitude that gives agents and homebuyers alike the confidence that their transaction is in reliable, good hands and will be completed on time.
  • Problem solver, using your industry knowledge to identify potential issues; recognizing what’s wrong, knowing how to fix it, and avoiding unnecessary delays.
  • Constant learner, staying on top of changing rules and regulations to avoid setbacks and enable transactions to close on time.
  • People reader, recognizing and adapting to an agent’s or homebuyer’s personality and mood to make them feel comfortable, even when delivering bad news; showing empathy to ease their frustration and give them confidence that you’re in their corner.
  • Multi-tasker, highly organized, being able to work a large number of contracts with numerous agents, buyers, and sellers simultaneously under deadline pressure.

Your responsibilities:

  • Jack – or Jill – of all trades: Knowing the intricacies of the contract from beginning to end, ensuring that it is closed in a timely, efficient, and error-free manner.
  • Devoted to detail: Verifying all paperwork is complete so that escrow closes on time and correctly.
  • Following the money: Working with lenders and underwriters to ensure that all the I’s are dotted and T’s are crossed to fund and complete transactions.
  • Relationship building: Establishing and maintaining relationships with essential industry players – agents, attorneys, lenders, surveyors, and government agencies – that enable you to smoothly manage transactions.
  • Business builder: Reaching out to new agents, earning their confidence and trust, and creating opportunities to market our business; retaining agents by providing them with white-glove service.
  • Talent builder: Training escrow assistants to open opportunities for advancement; delegating, auditing work, answering questions, and giving direction.
  • Sealing the deal: Being present at closing and making it a positive, memorable experience for agents and buyers.

Qualifications:

What you must have:

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent; take continuing education courses as required.
  • Experience: Two to three years of escrow experience, both front- and back-end experience.
  • Certification: Notary public and escrow officer licenses.
  • Industry awareness: Technical knowledge of closing process.
  • Computer skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite.
  • Communications skills: Strong written and verbal skills to keep agents, buyers, sellers, and all other parties up to date with the process and work with them to resolve issues.

What we’d like you to have:

  • One year of escrow closing experience.

title: Multi Mission Industrial Engineer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

Job Description

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

As an Industrial Engineer for Blue Origin's multi mission fabrication shops in Florida, you will be at the forefront of creating a factory of the future. You will serve as the technical authority for factory flow, layout optimization, capacity modeling, and New Product Introduction (NPI). This role is foundational to establishing a world class production system capable of building satellite constellations that will connect the planet and support Blue Origin’s mission of benefiting Earth.

We are seeking an engineer who can blend systems level thinking with a hands-on, practical approach to problem solving. You will be responsible for translating product designs and rate targets into a physical and operational reality. This is a unique opportunity to design a production system from the ground up, implementing lean principles and advanced manufacturing concepts to build a key strategic capability for Blue.

Responsibilities:

  • Factory Design & Layout: Design, model, and implement optimal factory layouts for assembly lines, integration cells, and test areas, focusing on safety, ergonomics, and minimizing wasted movement and transportation.

  • Process Flow & Value Stream Mapping: Analyze and define the end to end flow of material and information. Create detailed value stream maps for current and future state operations to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, reduce lead times, and optimize process sequencing.

  • Capacity Modeling & Analysis: Develop and maintain detailed capacity models to determine production rate capabilities, identify constraints (equipment, labor, floorspace), and inform capital equipment and workforce planning.

  • New Product Introduction (NPI): Act as the primary IE liaison between the design engineering teams and production system teams. Assisting in Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFMA) analysis, and develop manufacturing plans, work instructions, and tooling/fixture requirements to ensure a smooth transition from design to full rate production.

  • Continuous Improvement & Lean: Champion and lead lean manufacturing initiatives (e.g., Kaizen events, 5S, standard work, material presentation strategies) to drive continuous improvements in quality, cost, and delivery.

  • Metrics & Data Analysis: Establish, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as cycle time, takt time, first pass yield, and labor hours per unit to drive data-informed decisions.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in an industrial or manufacturing engineering role.

  • Demonstrated experience with factory layout design.

  • Strong practical understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles and experience implementing them.

  • Proficiency in process modeling, data analysis, and using tools like Excel, and a demonstrated ability to create and present data driven business cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a relevant engineering or business field.

  • Experience in a low mix, high volume production system.

  • Experience with discrete event simulation software (e.g., FlexSim, Arena, Simio).

  • Experience with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) and ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) systems.

  • Green Belt or Black Belt certification in Lean Six Sigma.

  • Use of 2D/3D CAD (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Catia).

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. title: Børnehuset Spiloppen søger en engageret pædagogmedhjælper
location: N.J. Fjords Allé 15-17, 1957 Frederiksberg C, Danmark
description:
Vil du have en aktiv hverdag med søde spilopper og gode kollegaer? Og vil du være en del af en institution på det centrale Frederiksberg med høj faglighed, humor og en nærværende og synlig ledelse? Et sted hvor tryghed, ordentlighed og kommunikation er vigtige værdier? Så skal du søge en stilling som pædagogmedhjælper hos os.

Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper 30-35 timer ugentligt fra d. 1. september 2026.

Børnehuset Spiloppen er en kombineret institution med 36 vuggestuebørn og 76 børnehavebørn.

Vi har en naturafdeling i Værløse, hvor alle børnehavegrupper på skift bliver kørt til en uge ad gangen.

Hvem er vi – kom og vær med:

Børnehuset Spiloppen er en velfungerende og traditionsrig institution med en mangfoldig personalegruppe bestående af 28 engagerede og hjælpsomme medarbejdere, der kender alle børn og forældre. Spiloppen er et trygt og udviklende sted at være for børn og en god arbejdsplads for voksne. Vi ligger midt på Frederiksberg i en hyggelig bygning med mange små aktivitetsrum og direkte adgang til en stor grøn legeplads for hele huset.

Udover søde spilopper og godt pædagogisk samarbejde tilbyder vi:

  • et godt arbejdsfællesskab med plads til sjov
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor vi arbejder målrettet med at udvikle vores pædagogiske praksis
  • en høj grad af ansvar og indflydelse
  • gode rammer for et aktivt udeliv
  • mulighed for faglig udvikling
  • en nærværende og synlig ledelse, der tager hånd om både stort og småt

Spilopperne og deres voksne ønsker sig en pædagogmedhjælper som:

  • kan etablere gode samarbejdsrelationer med kollegaer og institutionens forældre
  • har et anerkendende menneskesyn
  • kan arbejde struktureret og har overblik
  • er ansvarlig, selvstændig og mødestabil

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn og ansættelse er efter gældende overenskomst. Der indhentes børneattest og straffeattest inden ansættelse i Frederiksberg Kommune.

Har du spørgsmål?

Så kan du finde flere oplysninger om Børnehuset Spiloppen på vores hjemmeside: Frb-spiloppen.aula.dk

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte os på tlf.: 3821 1514 og spørge efter leder Tina Søegaard. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Brandvagt
description:
Vil du være med til at forebygge brandfare og skabe tryghed på nogle af Danmarks største arbejdspladser?

TeamSafety ApS er en stærk og dynamisk, ISO-certificeret servicevirksomhed i vækst. Vi søger ansvarsbevidste, servicemindede og professionelle brandvagter, der vil være med til at sikre høj sikkerhed og forebygge brandrisici hos vores kunder på store byggepladser og industrielle anlæg.

Om stillingen

Som brandvagt hos TeamSafety får du en vigtig rolle i det daglige sikkerhedsarbejde. Din opmærksomhed, tilstedeværelse og evne til at reagere hurtigt kan være afgørende for at forebygge farlige situationer og sikre en tryg arbejdsplads.

Du vil primært arbejde med overvågning af varmt arbejde, brandforebyggelse, sikkerhedsrunderinger og kontrol af arbejdsområder, hvor der udføres opgaver med særlig brandrisiko. Du bliver en del af en kvalitetsbevidst arbejdsplads med ordentlige forhold og højt til loftet.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

· Brandvagt ved varmt arbejde og risikofyldte arbejdsprocesser.

· Overvågning og kontrol af brandfarlige områder og installationer.

· Forebyggelse og håndtering af brand- og sikkerhedsrisici.

· Udførelse af sikkerhedsrunderinger og dokumentation i digitale systemer.

· Reaktion ved alarmer, nødsituationer og evakueringer.

· Samarbejde med kundens sikkerhedsorganisation og øvrige beredskab.

Om dig

Vi forventer, at du arbejder selvstændigt, er opmærksom på dine omgivelser og bevarer roen i pressede situationer. Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

· Har erfaring med sikkerhedsarbejde, brandvagt eller lignende funktioner.

· Har gennemført relevante kurser inden for brandforebyggelse eller varmt arbejde (fordel, men ikke et krav).

· Kan fremvise ren straffeattest.

· Er en rutineret IT-bruger, der nemt kan sætte sig ind i nye systemer.

· Kommunikerer tydeligt og professionelt på dansk og gerne engelsk.

Personlige kompetencer

· Du er ansvarsbevidst og sikkerhedsorienteret.

· Du arbejder struktureret og følger faste procedurer.

· Du er handlekraftig og rolig i kritiske situationer.

· Du er mødestabil, fleksibel og en god holdspiller.

· Du udviser naturlig autoritet og professionel adfærd.

Vi tilbyder

· Løn jf. gældende overenskomst inkl. pension, sundhedsordning og fritvalg.

· Komplet arbejdsbeklædning og nødvendigt sikkerhedsudstyr.

· En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og et stærkt sammenhold.

· Spændende og varierende arbejdsdage på store projekter og anlæg.

· Mulighed for faglig udvikling og relevante kurser.

Praktisk

· Arbejdssted: Primært Kalundborg og omegn.

· Stillingsomfang: Deltid / Fuldtid (dag-, aften- og nattevagter kan forekomme).

· Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt / efter aftale.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en motiveret ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende og indkalder til samtale.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at der ved eventuel ansættelse søges om administrativ godkendelse til arbejde i vagtvirksomhed.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
Teamleder Lasse Christoffersen
tlf. 31 32 65 29 (mandag-fredag, i tidsrummet 07-15)

title: Data Scientist I (DSAP)
description:
About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within Insurance, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle – all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below. https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance

About our Team:

The Insurance Analytics team are the trusted leaders in analytics excellence, delivering innovative, data-driven solutions through cutting-edge data science and strategic risk solutions to drive market leadership, impactful change, and lasting value for our customers and stakeholders. The team is responsible for new product innovation, model development, and creating actionable insights for our customers. We work closely with the Vertical and Product teams to design and implement new solutions for the insurance and OEM markets. By harnessing the power of data, our analytics team empowers insurers to make informed decisions, optimize risk segmentation, and enhance underwriting strategies, ultimately driving success in an ever-evolving insurance landscape.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated data scientist to join the Data Science Accelerator Program (DSAP) that provides broad learning opportunities across the Data Science organization within the LexisNexis Insurance Division. Successful candidates will holistically learn our business during this two-year program while rotating through a series of Analytical product development related assignments and projects. The role will be Hybrid located at our headquarters in Alpharetta, GA and may include some travel.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with assembling, cleaning, and organizing large datasets to prepare them for analysis.
  • Support team members in merging and parsing data to uncover trends and patterns.
  • Learn to apply statistical and machine learning techniques under the guidance of senior data scientists.
  • Help document model code, track results, and contribute to validating predictive models.
  • Assist in creating attributes and rules from raw data to support analytic projects.
  • Contribute to data visualization efforts to communicate findings.
  • Participate in preparing responses to client inquiries regarding data, score calculations, or analytic outputs.
  • Document work clearly and practice presenting results in a team setting.

Requirements:

  • Hold a bachelor’s in data science/analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other degrees in fields like Engineering, Economics, and Business.
  • Coursework or project experience in Python or R; familiarity with SQL is a plus
  • Interest in data analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning.
  • Exposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn) is desirable.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a willingness to learn and adapt.
  • Ability to communicate ideas clearly and work collaboratively with others

Working for you:

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive, multi-carrier program for medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with match and an Employee Share Purchase Plan

Working within a collaborative, product-focused environment, you will contribute to architectural decisions, partner closely with product and engineering teams, and help shape innovative solutions that prioritize security, automation, and developer experience.   • Develop secure, cloud-native applications that integrate with container technologies, Kubernetes environments, and modern software supply chain tooling.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges while balancing product requirements, performance, maintainability, and security.

    • Experience designing, building, and securing modern CI/CD pipelines and software delivery platforms.
    • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang), or the ability to become productive quickly with the language.
    • Experience working with AI development tools, automation technologies, or intelligent software systems.
    • Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, and secure software engineering practices.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional, remote teams.
    • Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities.

Performs imaging examinations for both ambulatory or acute care environments. Performing multi-modality procedures based on ARRT certification level, utilizing a variety of technical aspects that require judgement, ingenuity, and initiative in applying ionizing radiation to obtain diagnostic images. Promotes a cooperative and professional atmosphere with emphasis on patient care. The Technologist is required to work with patients in age group specific environments: pediatric, geriatric, febrile, and acute care; adjusting technique and positions for optimal examinations. The Technologist is responsible for exam room presentation, patient transportation, entering exams into the Radiology Information System, scheduling radiology exams, educating patients on exam prep instructions, obtaining correct orders and paperwork for records, billing, and communicating with Medical Staff as requested. Technologist will obtain and maintain the knowledge needed for the PACS. The Technologist may share on call duties. Depending on the needs of the care environment may be responsible for evenings, weekends and holidays as directed by the department leader. The Technologist reports equipment malfunctions/failures to their immediate Supervisor, Maintenance staff, or Bio-med service as appropriate. The Technologist follows all policies and procedures as set by the Medical Imaging Department, the facility and the organization

Job Description

Essential Functions:

·Documents appropriate information in patients’ charts.

·Ensures the procedure and related supplies are billed correctly.

·Presents high quality images to Radiologists.

·Competently works within required computer programs (i.e. PACs, RIS, Vrad) as well as manual downtime processes

·Prepares and administers correct amount of contrast, using aseptic techniques as outlined in the Infection Control manual. Able to start and maintain IV lines

·Consistently demonstrates a thorough knowledge to operate all radiological equipment in the proper setting, patient positioning, principles of radiation exposure/ safety, quality control, image processing, specialized protocols and demonstrates the ability to plan own work.

·Will work as a team with other imaging departments to coordinate patient care and flow throughout care environment.

·Monument Health is a teaching organization; all radiology technologists will provide a learning environment for the students completing their clinical rotation.

·Consistently demonstrates the ability to efficiently perform multiple complex tasks and to assist with the continuing technical education of imaging staff, physicians, and radiography students.

·Protects patients and employees by adhering to infection-control policies and protocols.

·Understands and uses radiologic safety to minimizes radiation to patient and staff by practicing radiation protection techniques, using beam restrictive devices, patient shielding, and knowledge of exposure factors and monitored by radiation badges.

·Focuses on patient satisfaction by scheduling appointments promptly and courteously. Obtains accurate information and properly documents on patient scheduling system. . Has positive attitude and customer service mind set. Friendly, cheerful and helpful to patients and others. Ability to meet patients and others needs while following office policies and procedures in person and on the telephone.

·Proficient with safe handling and moving of patients using ceiling and other lifts.

·Participates in upkeep of department, i.e, cleanliness of work area, preventive maintenance, stocking of supplies, reports all malfunctioning equipment.

·As appropriate, prepares and administers correct amount of contrast, using aseptic techniques as outlined in the Infection Control manual. Documents appropriately in patients chart. Completed injector training.

·Reviews patient’s condition, history, and physicians order; consults radiologist with any questions. Determines proper positioning, and selects correct patient from work list.

·Routinely prepares the patient and the equipment for the upcoming procedure. Educates the patient and/ or family regarding the procedure to be performed. Provides professional age-specific interaction with patients.

title: Sundhedsfaglig medarbejder søges til almen praksis, Taastrup
description:
Brænder du for at hjælpe patienterne, og sætter du en ære i at give patienterne den bedst mulige oplevelse, så er stillingen måske lige noget for dig?

Vores lægehus ligger centralt på Taastrup Hovedgade og har omkring 3.500 patienter tilknyttet. Vi har en god og alsidig patientpopulation, som giver en spændende og varieret hverdag med mange forskellige typer konsultationer og opgaver.

Du bliver en del af et mindre og tæt team bestående af 2 læger, 3 sygeplejersker og en praksisleder. Vi lægger stor vægt på, at vi hjælper hinanden, samarbejder på tværs og har det godt sammen i hverdagen.

For os er det vigtigt, at der også er plads til smil, godt humør og en hyggelig pause sammen. Vi prioriterer derfor også at arrangerer sociale aktiviteter et par gange om året. Vi tror på, at et godt arbejdsmiljø og stærkt kollegaskab er med til at skabe både arbejdsglæde og gode patientoplevelser.

Hos os får du dermed ikke bare en arbejdsplads, men bliver en del af et nært og velfungerende team, hvor vi passer på hinanden og løfter opgaven sammen.

Vi mangler en sundhedsfaglig kollega til følgende opgaver::

  • Telefonvisitationer dagligt mellem kl. 08.00-11.00.
  • Kalenderstyring.
  • Oprettelse af nye patienter og kollegaer.
  • Overvejende administrative opgaver, såsom fakturering, kodning, behandling af XMO m.m.
  • Patientopgaver som f.eks. blodprøver og halspodninger. Erfaring med disse kan være en fordel, dog ikke et krav.
  • Indflydelse på dit eget job og muligheden for at udvikle dig indenfor det sundhedsfaglige område.
  • Sparring med både sygeplejersker og læger i teamet.
  • En spændende hverdag med alsidige opgaver, hvor patienten er i fokus.

Der vil være en forventning il at du kan arbejde med en høj grad af selvstændighed, men også i et samarbejde med klinikkens øvrige personale. Dine opgaver vil overvejende være telefonvisitation og administrative opgaver samt lette patientopgaver.

Vi forventer at:

  • Du kan arbejde struktureret, effektivt og selvstændigt.
  • Du har en sundhedsfaglig baggrund, som social- og sundhedsassistent, sygeplejerske eller anden relevant uddannelse. Gerne med erfaring fra lægepraksis eller tilsvarende job.
  • Du udviser en høj grad af respekt og medmenneskelighed.
  • Du har erfaring med brug af Office-pakken og har flair for IT. Kendskab til XMO er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Du kan medvirke til at skabe et positivt og konstruktivt arbejdsmiljø.

Derudover er du imødekommende og åben overfor nye ideer og tiltag. Du har lyst til at have indflydelse på din egen hverdag og gøre en forskel for patienterne. Du arbejder målrettet og trives i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold efter aftale. Den ugentlig arbejdstid er 16-20 timer i tidsrummet 08.00-12.00.

Opstart pr. 01.10.2026 eller gerne tidligere efter nærmere aftale.

Har du spørgsmål til indholdet i stillingen eller hverdagsstrukturen er du velkommen til at kontakte Praksisleder Ditte Bek på telefon +45 4412 1128 eller Regionschef Beth Fabricius på telefon +45 4880 0995.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i stillingen, så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Upload din ansøgning samt CV samt ansøgning senest d. 21.08.2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 27.08.2026.

title: Sygeplejerske til Hjemme- og sygeplejen Aften
description:
Bliv en del af vores team!

Er du en passioneret sygeplejerske, der brænder for at gøre en forskel i det nære sundhedsvæsen? Så er du måske vores næste kollega!
Timetal er efter aftaler og vi er åben for dialog herom – weekendvagt hver 4. weekend. Stillingen er en fast aftenvagt, med mulighed for enkelte andre vagttyper hvis dette ønskes.

Hvem er vi?
Hjemme- og sygeplejen er placeret på 4 baser – Fjerritslev, Brovst, Aabybro og Pandrup.
Aften- og nattevagten har base i Brovst. Disse er bemandet med henholdsvis 3 sygeplejersker i aftenvagt og 2 i nattevagt.
Sygeplejen har én indgang og denne er bemandet med 4 koordinerende sygeplejersker.
Derudover består sygeplejen af 3 demenskoordinatorer samt 5 centersygeplejersker, en borgernær sygeplejerske og psykiatrisk sygeplejerske.
Vi varetager også akutfunktionen som primært varetages af én sygeplejerske i dagvagten. Aften og nat varetages funktionen af de sygeplejersker der er i vagt.
I sygeplejen har vi en del specialfunktioner – sår, kompression, klinisk vejleder og derudover nøglefunktion indenfor diabetes og palliation.

Vi er uddannelsessted for sygeplejerskestuderende på 3., 4. og 6. semester, hvor det er et fælles arbejde mellem kliniske vejledere og de resterende sygeplejersker at sikre at vores fremtidige kollegaer får den bedst mulige kliniske periode.

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med rusmiddelcenter omkring substitutionsbehandling derudover inddrages vi meget bredt da vi kan tilkaldes på skæve tidspunkter på såvel bosteder og plejecentre.

Hjemme- og sygeplejen har fælles lokal ledelse men det ledelsen af det sundhedsfaglige område ligger hos leder i Brovst. Dette betyder også at du som aftenvagt vil have indmøde og ledelsestilknytning til Brovst.

Din hverdag som sygeplejerske
Med et stadig større ansvar for opgaver, der tidligere blev varetaget af sygehusvæsenet, vil du få spændende og komplekse opgaver som IV-behandlinger, akutte vurderinger, sårpleje og palliation. Vi prioriterer kompetenceudvikling og tilbyder løbende sparring og vidensdeling.

Vi har sygeplejeklinikker, hvor de mest mobile borgere får behandling og opfølgning, og en akutfunktion, som varetages af sygeplejersker med specialkompetencer. Du vil også få mulighed for at arbejde på plejecentrene da de udekørende klarer de komplekse opgaver der i weekend, aften og nattevagter, sammen med et team af dedikerede kollegaer.

Hvem er du?
  • Du er uddannet sygeplejerske og har klinisk erfaring
  • Du trives med at dele viden, sparre og støtte dine kollegaer
  • Du arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik
  • Du er positiv overfor forandringer og tager dem konstruktivt op
  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men trives også som en del af et team
  • Du er interesseret i velfærdsteknologiske løsninger og ser dem som en mulighed for at optimere arbejdet
  • Har du andre specialkompetence er vi åben for dette, idet vi har forskellige nøglefunktioner i sygeplejen

Vi tilbyder:
  • En grundig introduktion med et skræddersyet introduktionsprogram, der giver dig indsigt i de forskellige opgaver
  • Et spændende og udfordrende job med mulighed for stor indflydelse og udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads i konstant udvikling, hvor din faglige og personlige vækst er vigtig
  • Et engageret og selvstændigt kollegateam, der støtter hinanden
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer både fagligt og personligt
  • Løn efter overenskomst samt lokale aftaler

Ønsker du yderligere oplysninger
er du meget velkommen til at ringe til Jette Simonsen, Leder af det sundhedsfaglige område på telefon 41 91 23 04.

Der vil blive afholdt samtaler løbende så skynd dig at komme til tasterne.

Department:

Department's Website:


Summary of Job Duties:

This person will work under the supervision and direction of the Flow Cytometry supervisor. Duties include processing, staining and analyzing routine specimens. They will be expected to keep all instrumentation in good working order and identify and notify the supervisor of instrument malfunctions. They should be able to aid in instrument repair. They should be able to identify abnormal or discrepant results. They will have limited participation in student teaching and assisting of other personnel rotating through the section. They will have limited administrative duties.


Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Technology or Medical Laboratory Sciences OR an approved ASCP discipline (30 semester hours in biology and chemistry, which may be obtained within, or in addition to, the Bachelor's).

  • ASCP or another accrediting agency-certified or eligible (Certification must be obtained within one year of employment).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous clinical laboratory experience; flow cytometry experience preferred

  • ASCP certification or equivalent


Additional Information:

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze blood, bone marrow, body fluids, and tissues to screen for abnormal cell populations.

  • Enter test results into LIS and appropriate information systems.

  • Provide technical information e.g., specimen requirements and collection, test methods etc., to RN, physicians, and other clients.

title: Quality Assurance Business Analyst - Patient Access & Support Services (Remote)
location: New Providence, New Jersey, United States of America
description:
Role Summary

The Quality Assurance Analyst supports Quality Monitoring activities across Patient Access & Support Services programs by providing objective, data-driven assurance that patient services interactions meet regulatory, contractual, and program expectations. The role evaluates interactions for quality and compliance, documents defensible scoring decisions, and contributes to risk identification, escalation, calibration, where applicable, and quality trend reporting in partnership with Operations and Training.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate patient services interactions using approved Quality Monitoring frameworks and program-specific quality rubrics.
  • Apply quality standards consistently and document clear, defensible scoring rationales.
  • Identify, document, and escalate compliance risks, including Adverse Events, Product Complaints, and privacy concerns, contractual compliance concerns, and other reportable issues in accordance with established procedures.
  • Contribute actionable insights to support agent coaching and operational improvement, aligned to quality findings.
  • Participate in calibration activities, as applicable, and apply alignment updates to ensure scoring consistency.
  • Identify and trend repeat compliance, quality, or process risks and escalate systemic issues to Operations and Training.
  • Support monthly quality trend reporting and contribute to client-facing and internal quality summaries as required.
  • Maintain accurate documentation to support audit readiness, inspections, and client review requests.

Reporting and Trend Support

  • Contribute accurate quality monitoring data, evaluation findings, and trend observations for monthly program reporting.
  • Validate assigned evaluation details, comments, scoring rationale, and supporting documentation before reporting inputs are submitted for review.
  • Summarize recurring quality, compliance, documentation, or process trends in a clear, actionable format.
  • Support internal and client-facing quality summaries by providing source details and examples tied to completed evaluations.
  • Escalate reporting inconsistencies, missing data, or potential systemic issues to the Quality Assurance Supervisor or Quality Monitoring leadership.

Calibration Support

  • Prepare for calibration sessions by reviewing selected interactions, completing preliminary scoring, and documenting rationale using the applicable rubric.
  • Participate in internal and program-specific calibration discussions to support scoring alignment and consistent application of quality standards.
  • Present call or interaction examples, scoring rationale, and quality observations during calibration sessions, as assigned.
  • Lead portions of calibration discussions when appropriate based on program maturity, assignment, and supervisor direction.
  • Apply calibration updates, alignment decisions, and feedback to future evaluations and documentation.

Workload and Capacity Expectations

  • Manage assigned monitoring workload across programs, channels, and deadlines based on program volume, client requirements, quality risk, and business priorities.
  • Balance evaluation completion, documentation, calibration preparation, trend identification, and reporting support activities within assigned capacity.
  • Communicate capacity concerns, competing priorities, or workload risks to the Quality Assurance Supervisor or Quality Monitoring leadership.
  • Adjust focus as needed when program risk, channel mix, required monitoring volume, or client requirements change.

Required Qualifications

  • HS Diploma.
  • 2+ years experience in Quality Monitoring, Quality Assurance, or a related oversight or compliance function.
  • Demonstrated understanding of regulatory and contractual requirements and established escalation pathways.
  • Ability to clearly explain, justify, and defend quality assessments and scoring decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage workload across multiple programs, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Must reside in country where the job is posted.

Core Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing interactions, applying rubrics, documenting findings, and validating reporting inputs.
  • Sound judgment when identifying quality concerns, compliance risks, coaching opportunities, and items requiring escalation.
  • Documentation discipline, including clear comments, consistent scoring rationale, and accurate support for audit readiness or client review.
  • Ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, and connect evaluation findings to operational improvement opportunities.
  • Professional communication with Operations, Training, Quality Monitoring leadership, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to receive feedback, apply calibration alignment, and adjust evaluation approach when standards or program expectations are clarified.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree or bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience supporting client-specific or program-specific calibration activities.
  • Experience contributing to quality trend analysis and program oversight reporting.
  • Ability to independently handle complex or ambiguous quality or compliance scenarios.
  • Familiarity with centralized quality platforms or reporting tools, such as NICE, Verint, dashboards, or data-driven reporting environments.

title: Mechanical Systems Engineer II - New Glenn
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

This role supports the production and upgrades of New Glenn, a single-configuration heavy-lift launch vehicle capable of carrying payloads to Earth’s orbit and beyond. Engineered with a reusable first stage and a seven-meter payload fairing, New Glenn is building the road to space.

As part of a small, hard-working, and accomplished team of experts you will lead the design, development, and test various spaceflight systems. You will share toward the team’s impact on all aspects of structures, mechanical, and fluid systems. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your dedicated commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities:

  • Applies engineering techniques to design, install, modify, analyze, repair structural, mechanical, and fluid systems hardware.
  • Role will have a strong emphasis on supporting production activities.
  • Experience in 3D CAD programs (Creo preferred)
  • Experience in Finite Element Analysis (FEA) tools to analyze pressurized systems and primary/secondary structures (ANSYS preferred)
  • Specifically identifying available work and resolving roadblocks to facilitate production tasks.
  • Release, and support of engineering artifacts across the product life cycle to support hardware fabrication, assembly, verification, test and operations. Implements’ operating procedures, resolves system malfunctions, and provides technical information.
  • Specifies system components or directs modification of products to ensure conformance with engineering design and performance specifications.
  • Lead Root Cause and Corrective action investigations into hardware failures to facilitate smooth production operations across the launch vehicle.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. degree or higher in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering
  • Recent experience managing aerospace or equivalent type mechanical systems elements within aircraft, spacecraft, or launch vehicles. Candidates with various levels of experience are welcome to apply.
  • Strong mechanical design and integration skills using 3D modeling tools
  • Experience with GD&T (ASME Y14.5)
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion
  • Knowledge of fabrication, integration processes, and quality control relative to tubes/piping and machined components
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of recent experience managing aerospace or equivalent type mechanical systems elements within aircraft, spacecraft, or launch vehicles.
  • 2+ years direct project management experience; including schedule, cost, risk, performance, change and configuration management, and supplier relations
  • Experience across the full product development lifecycle: concept definition, architecture, requirements capture and development, implementation, verification, system integration, qualification and release
  • Experience in primary flight control actuator design
  • Experience in aerospace hydraulic system component design or system architecture design
  • Experience in aerospace deployable devices design such as doors, landing gear or sensors
  • Experience in spacecraft separation systems design
  • Experience in Creo (Pro-E) and Windchill PLM
  • Experience in structural FEA using ANSYS, NASTRAN or similar tools.

title: Faglærte salgsassistenter og materialister til Matas i København og omegn
description:
Er du faglært salgsassistent, og brænder du for salg, rådgivning og gode kundeoplevelser? Så har du nu mulighed for at blive en del af Matas i en af vores butikker i København eller omegn.

Vi søger både uddannede materialister fra Matas og faglærte salgsassistenter, som har gennemført deres elevuddannelse i en anden virksomhed eller branche. Det vigtigste er, at du har en faglært salgsuddannelse og lyst til at bruge og udvikle din faglighed inden for beauty, hudpleje, helse og sundhed.

Når du søger, kan du fortælle os, hvilke områder, butikker og timetal der passer bedst til dig.

Brug din faglighed til at gøre en forskel for kunderne
Som faglært salgsassistent i Matas får du en vigtig rolle i mødet med vores kunder. Du bruger din erfaring og faglige viden til at rådgive og inspirere og hjælper den enkelte kunde med at finde de produkter, der passer til kundens behov.

Har du ikke tidligere arbejdet med alle vores produktområder, sørger vi for, at du får mulighed for at opbygge den nødvendige produktviden gennem oplæring, kurser og løbende faglig udvikling.

Vi lægger stor vægt på kompetent rådgivning, god kundeservice og et stærkt sammenhold. Derfor søger vi dig, der både har blik for den gode kundeoplevelse og motiveres af at skabe resultater sammen med dine kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • rådgive og inspirere vores kunder inden for beauty, hudpleje, helse og sundhed
  • bruge og videreudvikle din salgsfaglighed i kundemødet
  • have ansvar for egne områder i butikken
  • bidrage til, at butikken når sine salgs- og servicemål
  • sikre, at butikken altid fremstår præsentabel og inspirerende
  • hjælpe med vareopfyldning, oprydning og øvrige driftsopgaver
  • deltage i events, kampagner og salgsaktiviteter.

Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab
Det er vigtigt for os, at du trives både fagligt og socialt. Hos os får du:

  • et stærkt team med fælles passion for rådgivning, salg og gode kundeoplevelser
  • grundig oplæring i Matas’ sortiment og produktområder
  • løbende kurser og efteruddannelse inden for produkter, rådgivning og salg
  • en alsidig hverdag med ansvar, selvstændighed og medbestemmelse
  • mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt
  • engagerede kolleger, der hjælper hinanden og spiller hinanden gode
  • mulighed for bonus, når butikken sammen når sine salgsmål
  • helbredssikring og attraktive personalerabatter
  • gode muligheder for videre udvikling og karriere i Matas.

Vi søger dig, der er faglært salgsassistent
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har gennemført en elevuddannelse som salgsassistent – enten i Matas eller i en anden virksomhed eller branche
  • har erfaring med salg, kundeservice og rådgivning
  • har interesse for beauty, hudpleje, helse og sundhed og lyst til at lære mere om områderne
  • sætter en ære i at give kunderne den bedste service og købsoplevelse
  • trives med at rådgive og inspirere i en travl hverdag med højt tempo
  • er positiv, selvstændig, fleksibel og en udpræget holdspiller
  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til løbende at udvikle din faglighed.

Er du uddannet materialist fra Matas, er din produkt- og branchefaglighed naturligvis meget relevant. Har du taget din salgsassistentuddannelse et andet sted, er vi også interesserede i at høre fra dig. Du behøver derfor ikke allerede at have erfaring med alle Matas’ produktområder.

Arbejdstid og arbejdssted
Vi søger aktuelt til butikker i:

  • København K
  • Østerbro
  • Nørrebro
  • Amager
  • Rødovre

Der kan være mulighed for forskellige timetal afhængigt af den enkelte butik. I ansøgningen beder vi dig derfor oplyse:

  • hvilke butikker eller områder du foretrækker
  • hvor mange timer om ugen du ønsker at arbejde
  • hvornår du kan begynde.

Vi forsøger så vidt muligt at matche dine ønsker med behovet i vores butikker.

Vagterne vil ligge på både hverdage og i weekender. Mødetiderne afhænger af den enkelte butik og dens åbningstider.

Er du vores nye kollega?
Lyder det som noget for dig, så send os dit CV og ansøgning via jobopslaget.

Vi inviterer løbende kandidater til samtale og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og forhåbentlig snart byde dig velkommen i Matas.
