title: Activities Assistant (Part Time)
description:
Job Description

The Activities Assistant @ Drake Terrace is responsible for implementing and supporting aspects of the community’s Art of Living Well philosophy and the multi-dimensions of Art of Living Well through interaction with residents, presenting classes and instruction, coordinating events, and assisting with transportation as needed. Assist in promoting a healthy, activity-enriched lifestyle for residents and associates.

This is a part time position, Sunday-Tuesday, 9am-5:30pm

Pay range: $22-23/hr

Hiring bonus: $500

**This role does require resident transportation - Valid driver’s license and proof of good driving record is required**

What will I do every day?

  • Assist Life Enrichment Director to present programs that meet the emotional, intellectual, social, spiritual and vocational needs of the residents and staff
  • Promote and monitor resident attendance and participation in all Art of Living Well programs
  • Teach and facilitate programs as appropriate
  • Monitor residents’ well-being in a general way and report any changes in condition to the appropriate associate/department immediately
  • Assist residents with requests as needed or find appropriate associate to assist
  • Learn resident preferences for opportunities to provide exemplary customer service, exceed resident expectations and enhance resident satisfaction
  • Implement a variety of group and individual Art of Living Well programs that meet the varying needs of the residents and staff
  • Respond to residents individually to meet their Life Enrichment needs based on activity level, acuity, interests, and feedback
  • Work with volunteers and community groups as needed to implement various programs and events
  • Assist in setting up/tearing down Life Enrichment and community events as needed
  • Work as part of the team within your department and across the community
  • Perform function ability assessments and quality of life indexes for participants, as requested
  • Assist with scheduling transportation as required
  • Drive vehicles as necessary
  • Support open and honest communication with and between all associates
  • Represent the company PVBs and The Art of Living Well on a daily basis
  • Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which includes wearing the proper uniform and name tag when working
  • Look for ways to reduce costs and create efficiencies on a daily basis
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and report any issues or concerns immediately
  • Support continuous improvement
  • Comply with company standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient community operations
  • Adhere to all regulations, laws and company standards, including the Associate Handbook
  • Understand and support the community sales process
  • Perform other related duties as required

What will I need to be successful in this role?

  • Bring a smile to work every day
  • Be a great team player
  • High school graduate
  • One to two years’ experience in Life Enrichment programs (preferably with seniors)
  • Background in different dimensions of Art of Living Well is beneficial
  • Experience leading exercise classes and assisting with exercise equipment
  • Basic competency in the use of multiple forms of technology, including: Microsoft Office applications, internet-based and custom applications
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends and holidays as needed

Special Requirements/Certifications I may need?

  • Valid driver’s license and proof of good driving record required
  • First Aid Certification

What’s in it for me? (Great Question!)

  • Competitive pay
  • A free meal per shift
  • Healthcare Benefits including Vision & Dental (Full-time only)
  • Matching 401k (Full-time only)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Rewards and Bonus Opportunities
  • Continuous Training and Growth Opportunities

What do we do?

We create a great place to live for our residents and a great place to work for our associates. Kisco Senior Living has been a dynamic, award-winning leader in the senior living industry for over 30 years.

All offers of employment are subject to satisfying our pre-employment process, which includes successfully passing a drug screen, a job specific-related physical, a TB test, and a background check. If selected for employment, the company will cover the cost of these pre-hire requirements

*Kisco Senior Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Psykolog eller kandidat i pædagogisk psykologi søges til barselsvikariat
description:
Vi er endnu engang i lykkelige omstændigheder i Psykologteamet og søger derfor en barselsvikar på fuld tid i et begivenhedsbestemt barselsvikariat. Er du nyuddannet er det ingen hindring for at søge stillingen. Vi er en arbejdsplads med god erfaring i at tage imod nyuddannede, så ønsker du en tryg start på arbejdslivet med tæt sparring, supervision og mulighed for faglig udvikling, så er dette barselsvikariat måske noget for dig. Du bliver en del af et psykologteam med 15 psykologer og pædagogiske psykologiske konsulenter, som alle glæder sig til at tage imod dig.

En tryg start på dit arbejdsliv

Vi ved, at overgangen fra studie til praksis kan være stor. Derfor har vi særligt fokus på at understøtte nyuddannede medarbejdere:

  • Fast introduktionsforløb med mentor
  • Ugentlig supervision
  • Løbende faglig sparring i teamet
  • Mulighed for løse opgaver i fællesskab med dine kolleger
  • Struktureret supervision, herunder muligheden for at nyuddannede psykologer opnår titlen af Psykolog med Praksisuddannelse indenfor tre år.

Hos os bliver du ikke overladt til dig selv – vi prioriterer oplæring og et trygt læringsmiljø.

Dine opgaver

Vi søger en kollega til varetagelse af PPR-opgaver primært på skoleområde med særligt fokus på unge. Arbejdet foregår i tæt og praksisnært samarbejde med medarbejdere og ledelse på skolerne.

Opgaverne omfatter bl.a.:

  • Rådgivning og vejledning af mono- og tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere
  • Deltagelse i praksisnære forløb
  • Understøttelse af læringsmiljøer
  • Afklarende samtaler med børn og unge
  • Udarbejdelse af psykologiske vurderinger og udredninger

Vi søger en kollega, der

  • Har interesse for arbejdet i PPR, særligt på skoleområdet
  • Er nysgerrig, reflekteret og har lyst til at lære
  • Har blik for relationer og kontekstens betydning for børn og unges udvikling
  • Har gode samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner og trives i samarbejde med andre faggrupper
  • Tør stille spørgsmål og bede om sparring

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb
  • Et stærkt psykologfagligt fællesskab
  • Fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdslivet
  • Høj grad af kollegial sparring og tilgængelighed
  • Fokus på trivsel, arbejdsglæde og humor
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling
  • Kantineordning (mandag–torsdag)

Om os

Psykologteamet er en del af PPU – en tværfaglig enhed med 36 medarbejdere bestående af psykologer, pædagogisk-psykologiske konsulenter, logopæder, to-sprogskonsulenter og ressourcepædagoger, faglige koordinatorer og ledelse og administrative medarbejdere.

Vi er organisatorisk placeret i Dagtilbud, Sundhedspleje og PPU og har base på Områdekontoret i Brørup. Her indgår vi i et tværfagligt fællesskab med bl.a. skole-, familie- og socialområdet.

Kontakt

Vil du høre mere, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Koordinator for psykologteamet Camilla Thygesen, tlf. 21 44 54 48
  • Leder af PPU Rasmus Schmidt, tlf. 24 79 52 64

Løn og ansættelse

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Lønramme oplyses i forbindelse med ansættelsessamtalerne.

Ansættelse er betinget af, at der kan indhentes tilfredsstillende straffe- og børneattest.

Arbejdsstedet er Områdekontor Brørup, Stadionvej 15, 6650 Brørup.

title: Senior Software Development  Engineer, DevOps (US Federal)
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

Once a Workday application is built by our developers it is handed over to the Tenant Lifecycle Engineering (TLE) team. This is the team that supports the operations of our applications and services. They run all environments from production, sandbox, sales and implementation. This team pushes new code to our existing customers, handles the health, performance and reliability of the Workday stack, and in general, "keep the lights on" with 24/7 coverage.

About the Role

This role will support one or more direct or indirect contracts with the U.S. Federal Government which, due to federal government security requirements, mandates that all Workday personnel working on the contracts be United States citizens (naturalized or native).

You will be a key contributor on the TLE Public Cloud Team. You will help the team in building a user friendly, scalable, and reliable tool framework. You will work closely with others from TLE to help automate tenant management and other operational tasks while being part of on-call and patch rotations.

About You

This role may require a security clearance at the TS/SCI w/CI Poly level. Applicants must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance. An active TS/SCI w/CI Poly is preferred.

You are a highly organized, technically fluent program leader who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments, managing ambiguity, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution. You balance technical understanding with program management expertise to anticipate risks and maintain momentum. You break down complex problems into actionable plans and possess a proactive, ownership-driven, and results-focused mindset.

May be required to be on site at client locations in the DC, MD, and VA (DMV) area

You have excellent analytical skills for solving and problem determination. You love solving the complexities of running a deployment. You dislike doing things twice, so you automate each step along the way. You strive to make things self-healing, elastic, automatic, repeatable, and well tested. Have a high degree of comfort in Object Oriented, and Functional Programming. You are passionate about automation and motivated by writing fast, scalable code with test-ability in mind and exhilarated by working in a fast-paced environment!

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years using, deploying, and applying: AWS, Google Cloud Platform

  • 5+ years working with one or more of the following languages: Python, Ruby

  • 5+ years with SQL and MySQL

​Other Qualifications:

  • Experience in crafting, analyzing, and fixing large-scale distributed systems

  • Experience implementing, crafting, deploying: Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless (Lambda’s)

  • Experience with orchestration, deployment tools e.g CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible, Chef

  • Experience with CI tools e.g Jenkins, TeamCity, Bamboo, Artifactory

  • Strong background in Linux and Shell Scripting

  • MS in Computer Science or related field and 3 years validated experience or BS in Computer


Workday Pay Transparency Statement

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location: USA.VA.Reston


Primary Location Base Pay Range: $163,800 USD - $245,800 USD


Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $148,200 USD - $264,000 USD



Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

title: Handicaphjælpere søges til aktiv mand på 34 år i Aarhus
description:
Er du udadvendt og trives du godt med ansvar?

Så er jobbet, som min nye hjælper måske noget for dig. Jeg hedder Mads Georgi, er 34 år og har muskelsvind og får respiratorisk hjælp hele døgnet. Du vil i jobbet som min hjælper få et stort ansvar for, at min hverdag fungerer så problemfrit som muligt. Jeg har brug for hjælp til alt praktisk hjælp i og omkring hjemmet samt alt personlig pleje, men ellers er der ikke forskel på dig og mig.


Helt grundlæggende går jobbet ud på at være mine arme og ben i det daglige, at være chauffør, holde hjemmet rent og ordentligt, vaske tøj, give mig tøj af og på, børste mine tænder, vaske mig – ja, you name it. Dét fylder dog måske kun 20 procent af tiden, så den resterende tid er der plads til at lave andre ting – for det meste sammen, men også hver for sig.


Jeg flyttede fra Viborg til Aarhus for et år siden for at prøve noget nyt og udfordre mig selv. Det har jeg bestemt ikke fortrudt. Jeg nyder både naturen og nærheden til vandet i sommermånederne samt de mange kulturelle muligheder, som Aahus tilbyder. Både comedy, koncerter, festivaler og især sport er blandt mine y-aktiviteter.


Sport fylder generelt meget i min hverdag. Jeg er assistenttræner for et seriehold i JAI Håndbold, som træner to gange i ugen, men hvor det sociale udenfor banen fylder mindst lige så meget. Derudover bruger jeg også en del tid på at se både håndbold, fodbold og tennis i tv, eller tager ud og ser det live, hvis det er muligt. Alt går dog ikke op i sport. Jeg sætter også pris på at hygge mig med at lave noget god planetarisk mad eller se et dokumentarprogram eller hvad der ellers er aktuelt.


Generelt er jeg en meget åben person, der gerne snakker om stort og småt. Aktuelle samfundsrelevante emner, sport eller noget mere jordnært og personligt. Jeg lægger stor vægt på at engagere mig i hjælpernes liv udenfor jobbet, da hjælperne automatisk bliver en stor del af mit liv. Et hjælperjob er dermed ikke ligesom nogen andre jobs og jeg kalder derfor ofte jobbet som min hjælper for et professionelt venskab, fordi det er uundgåeligt, at vi kommer tæt på hinanden. Det er derfor også vigtigt for vores samarbejde, at vi har en god kemi, da vi kommer til at tilbringe rigtig mange timer sammen hver uge.



LIDT OM DIG:

  • Du har kørekort kategori B, da det er en nødvendighed i jobbet
  • Du kan have vågne nattevagter, da det kræves med respiratorisk overvågning
  • Du udviser stor fleksibilitet ved sygdom hos kollegaer, da det er meget vigtigt for, at jeg kan have en uhindret hverdag
  • Du er ikke-ryger
  • Du har en god ordenssans og en høj hygiejnestandard
  • Du er udadvendt og har et godt humør
  • Du har en høj selvdisciplin og kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • Du er helst en mand, dog er alle velkomne til at søge
  • Du vil modtage oplæring, så erfaring er ikke et krav


FAKTA:

Vagterne fordeler sig således, at der er skiftende dagvagter, som enten kan ligge kl. 06-14 eller kl. 14-22 plus/minus nogle timer afhængig af mine aktiviteter. Derudover er der et rul af nattevagter fra mandag til fredag hver fjerde/femte uge.


Jeg har på nuværende tidspunkt et meget velfungerende og homogent hjælperteam på 10 unge mænd. Nogle er på fuld tid og andre har det som studiejob, men nogle flytter og andre starter studie henover sommeren, så jeg leder efter to til tre nye hjælpere på fuld tid til teamet.


Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling, men timetallet vil være lavere på papiret, da der også skal være luft til at dække ind ved sygdom og ferie hos kollegaerne.

Grundlønnen er på 159,94 kr./time med tillæg om natten, om aftenen og i weekender.


Jeg foretrækker hjælpere, som har mulighed for at varetage jobbet i mindst et år, da det tager noget tid at opbygge et godt samarbejde.

Så har du lyst til at være en del af mit meget velfungerende team? Så vil jeg glæde mig til at læse en ansøgning fra dig!

title: GovCon Billing Specialist
description:
**Must have SECRET clearance, proficiency in QuickBooks and experience working within a government contracting environment**

Job Description:

Competitive Range works in partnership with the government to plan and deploy complex, IT-enabled and mission-essential capabilities. It is our goal at Competitive Range to help you develop and expand your professional capabilities while working on challenging, interesting projects in a collaborative, congenial environment.

The Billing Specialist will support CRS corporate operations by managing the preparation, submission, and reconciliation of government contract invoices and project cost reporting, with a primary focus on Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) and other cost-reimbursement contracts supporting, but not limited to, DoD clients. This role works closely with Finance, Contracts, Program Management, and Operations to ensure invoices are accurate, compliant, and audit-ready, and will report to the Finance leadership team.

Role and Responsibilities:

Government Contract Billing

  • Prepare, review, and submit CPFF cost vouchers and other cost-reimbursement invoices in accordance with contract terms, FAR/DFARS, and agency billing requirements
  • Submit invoices through WAWF and other applicable government billing systems
  • Ensure billed costs are allowable, allocable, reasonable, and properly supported

Accounting and Reconciliation

  • Reconcile invoices to the QuickBooks general ledger and job cost reports
  • Utilize QuickBooks job costing to track costs by contract, task order, and CLIN
  • Ensure proper segregation of direct, indirect, and unallowable costs with assistance from our Senior Finance Managers
  • Support month-end close activities related to contract billing, travel and expense-related transactions and reconciliations

Funding and Financial Tracking

  • Monitor funded ceilings, burn rates, billing limitations, and periods of performance as part of a project control team
  • Coordinate with Program Managers and CRS’ Director of Contracts to address funding actions, billing issues, and invoice rejections

Compliance and Audit Support

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready billing documentation
  • Support DCAA/DCMA audits, invoice reviews, and government billing inquiries
  • Respond to government questions and assist with invoice corrections or resubmissions

Process and Controls

  • Support the maintenance and improvement of billing procedures, trackers, cost reporting and internal controls
  • Identify opportunities to enhance billing accuracy, efficiency, and compliance

Desired Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in billing or finance within the government contracting (GovCon) industry
  • Demonstrated experience supporting DoD contracts
  • Hands-on experience preparing and submitting CPFF cost vouchers
  • Strong working knowledge of FAR Part 31 cost principles and cost-reimbursement billing preferred
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks within a government contracting environment, including job costing and general ledger reconciliation required
  • Experience with WAWF invoicing required
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple billing cycles, reporting and deadlines

A 4-year course of study leading to a bachelor's degree with a major in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Argano

Argano is a digital consultancy that specializes in high-performance business operations, digital transformation, and AI-driven solutions. We help enterprise and mid-market organizations modernize their core systems, streamline supply chains, and improve financial, data, and workforce operations to exceed customer expectations and fuel commercial growth.

About the Practice

Argano’s Pigment Practice is redefining business planning consulting by combining deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. As a Solution Architect, you are the engine of our delivery — you design and build the Pigment solutions that transform how our clients plan, forecast, and make decisions. You work within our pod model alongside experienced Pod Leads, Delivery Managers, and Consultants.

The Role

As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing Pigment solutions for mid-market and enterprise clients. You will work closely with clients to gather requirements, design models, build solutions, and support go-live. You will be mentored by senior architects while progressively taking on more complex design challenges and client leadership responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build Pigment planning models including data structures, calculation logic, input forms, dashboards, and reporting
  • Lead requirements gathering workshops and translate business needs into technical specifications
  • Develop integration solutions connecting Pigment with ERP, data warehouse, and other enterprise systems
  • Conduct unit testing, user acceptance testing support, and solution documentation
  • Participate in solution design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions
  • Build and maintain solution accelerators, templates, and reusable components
  • Mentor and guide Consultants on technical development and Pigment best practices
  • Support pre-sales with technical input for proposals and effort estimation
  • Contribute to client training and change management activities
  • Obtain and maintain Pigment platform certifications

Qualifications & Experience

  • 4–8 years of experience in EPM, business intelligence, or enterprise planning technology
  • Hands-on experience with Pigment, Anaplan, Oracle PBCS/EPBCS, Workday Adaptive, or SAP BPC (Pigment experience preferred)
  • Strong technical skills in model design, calculation logic, and data integration
  • Understanding of financial and operational planning processes (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, scenario planning)
  • Client-facing communication skills with the ability to lead workshops and present to business stakeholders
  • Experience in consulting or professional services environment preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver quality output under deadline pressure
  • Experience with data transformation tools, SQL, APIs, or ETL processes a plus
  • Industry experience in Life Sciences, CPG, or Technology a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree required

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically strong planning consultant who wants to work at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You have built models in at least one EPM platform and understand the underlying planning processes. You are a self-starter who can run workstreams independently while collaborating effectively within a team. You are hungry to learn Pigment if you don’t already know it, and you see this as a career-defining opportunity to grow with a practice from early stage to market leader.

How You Embody Our Guiding Principles

  • Become an Expert: You pursue mastery of Pigment and planning best practices
  • Stay Curious: You are always learning, always asking “why” and “what if”
  • Be a Team Player: You succeed as a pod, not as an individual
  • Own Your Growth: You seek feedback and take on stretch assignments

Argano is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: PO Management Specialist
description:
Are you ready for what’s next?

Come explore opportunities within Brunswick, a global marine leader committed to challenging conventions and innovating next-generation technologies that transform experiences on the water and beyond. Brunswick believes “Next Never Rests™,” and we offer a variety of exciting careers and growth opportunities within united teams defining the future of marine recreation.

Location: Suzhou, China

Workplace Category: Hybrid

Travel Required: N/A

Visa Sponsorship: Applicants must possess current authorization to work in the country for which they are applying. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship at this time or in the future.

Relocation: Not available

Innovation is the heart of Brunswick. See how your contributions will help transform vision into reality:

Position Overview:

As part of the talented Navico Group Purchasing team, you will be responsible for managing end-to-end procurement execution to ensure material availability, cost effectiveness, and compliance with company standards. This role manages purchase orders, MRP exceptions, and supplier coordination to support uninterrupted production. Key responsibilities include inventory optimization, excess and obsolete (E&O) reduction, and cost control through PPV and MOQ management. The position also ensures accurate item master data and regulatory compliance, while driving operational excellence, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement across procurement processes.

At Brunswick, we have passion for our work and a distinct ability to deliver.

Primary Responsibilities

Purchase Order Management

  • Generate and manage accurate purchase orders aligned with MRP and approved requisitions.
  • Ensure completeness of specifications, pricing, delivery terms, and supplier details.
  • Confirm supplier acknowledgment and delivery commitments; proactively resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor open POs, expedite as needed, and manage changes (reschedules, quantity adjustments, cancellations).
  • Communicate updates cross-functionally and ensure timely PO closure.

MRP Exception Management

  • Review and prioritize MRP exception messages (e.g., shortages, delays, excess inventory).
  • Collaborate with planning, production, and suppliers to resolve issues and align supply with demand.
  • Execute changes to POs based on validated requirements.
  • Analyze recurring exceptions and recommend improvements to MRP parameters (lead times, safety stock, reorder points).

Invoice Management

  • Validate invoices against POs and receipts to ensure accuracy.
  • Resolve discrepancies in collaboration with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Track invoice status and support timely payment to maintain supplier relationships.

MRB & Supplier Quality Support

  • Participate in MRB reviews and support disposition decisions (return, rework, scrap).
  • Manage supplier claims, credits, and replacements for nonconforming materials.
  • Escalate recurring quality issues and minimize financial impact.

Inventory Optimization (E&O)

  • Monitor inventory to identify excess and slow-moving items.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement reduction strategies.
  • Coordinate disposition actions (scrap, resale, transfer) and maintain reporting.

Compliance (EH&S)

  • Ensure materials meet environmental and safety regulations (e.g., RoHS).
  • Obtain and maintain required supplier certifications and documentation.

Cost Management (PPV & MOQ)

  • Track and analyze purchase price variances; identify drivers and corrective actions.
  • Partner with Finance and Commodity teams on cost validation.
  • Optimize Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ) to balance cost, demand, and inventory risk.

Inventory Planning Support

  • Review and adjust safety stock levels based on demand variability and supplier performance.
  • Support alignment to service level targets while minimizing excess inventory.

Item Master Data Management

  • Maintain accurate and standardized item master data in ERP systems.
  • Validate attributes (lead times, units, specifications) and communicate updates to stakeholders.

Job Specifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of purchasing or procurement experience
  • Strong working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Syteline, MS Dynamics).
  • Solid understanding of inventory management and forecasting principles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing environment preferred
  • Professional certifications (CPIM, CPSM, CPP, or equivalent).
  • Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt).

Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods (e.g., at a desk or workstation).
  • Constantly operates a computer and other standard office equipment.
  • Must be able to regularly move about the facility.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with team members and vendors.
  • Working hours will vary to support global organization

The actual base pay offered will vary depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, relevant experience, business needs, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

At Brunswick, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the salary range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent upon the specifics of the candidate’s qualifications and the business context.

Why Brunswick:

Whatever tomorrow brings, we’ll be at the leading edge. As the clear leader in the marine industry, we’re committed to our values and supporting our exceptional people. We offer and encourage growth opportunities within and across our many brands. In addition, we’re proud of being recognized for making a splash with numerous awards!

About Navico Group:

Navico Group is a stand-alone division of Brunswick, the world’s largest recreational marine business.

Navico Group is the global leader in technology, systems and solutions for a variety of industries, from Marine & RV to Specialty Vehicles and beyond. Our broad portfolio consists of the industry's leading brands in Power Systems, Digital Systems, Fishing Systems, and Performance Components including Ancor, Attwood, B&G, BEP, Blue Sea Systems, C-MAP, CZone, Garelick, Lenco, Lowrance, Marinco, MotorGuide, Mastervolt, ProMariner, RELiON, Simrad and Whale.

Our team is committed and driven, every day, to be the most trusted supply partner to the marine and mobile industries...and beyond.

title: Sygeplejerske til E4 – Nyremedicin og Reumatologi, Aalborg Universitetshospital
description:
Det handler ikke om perfektion. Det handler om ambition.

Vi kommer ikke til at love dig den perfekte arbejdsplads.

For den findes ikke.

Vi kommer heller ikke til at love, at hverdagen aldrig bliver travl, eller at vi aldrig må prioritere mellem gode faglige intentioner.

Det er et vilkår i et moderne sundhedsvæsen.

Men vi lover dig noget andet.

Vi lover dig en arbejdsplads, hvor vi tager vores faglighed alvorligt.

Hvor vi bliver ved med at diskutere, hvordan vi kan gøre sygeplejen endnu bedre.

Hvor vi hjælper hinanden med de svære prioriteringer.

Og hvor vi tror på, at høj faglighed skabes sammen.

For ingen bliver en dygtig sygeplejerske alene.

Vi udvikler sygeplejersker

På E4 møder du patienter med komplekse nefrologiske og reumatologiske sygdomsforløb.

Det kræver klinisk dømmekraft.

Det kræver overblik.

Det kræver stærke relationer til patienter og pårørende.

Og det kræver kolleger, som tør dele deres viden.

Vi arbejder ud fra Fundamentals of Care, fordi vi tror på, at den gode sygepleje både handler om avanceret klinisk behandling og om at se mennesket bag sygdommen.

Vi arbejder målrettet med primærpleje, palliation, supervision og faglig udvikling, fordi vi tror på, at god sygepleje hele tiden kan udvikles.

Hos os er faglig udvikling ikke noget, der foregår ved siden af driften.

Den er en del af driften.

Måske er du ny. Måske er du erfaren.

Er du nyuddannet, får du et grundigt introduktionsforløb, ansvar i et tempo, hvor du kan følge med, og kolleger, som forventer, at du spørger, når du er i tvivl.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele.

Vi forventer, at du har lyst til at lære.

Er du erfaren, håber vi, at du har lyst til at bringe din faglighed, dine idéer og din nysgerrighed med ind i afdelingen.

Vi leder ikke efter nogen, der har set det hele.

Vi leder efter mennesker, der stadig har lyst til at udvikle sig – og som samtidig har lyst til at udvikle andre.



Hvorfor bliver vi?

Hvis du spørger nogle af os, hvorfor vi stadig arbejder på E4, vil svarene lyde nogenlunde sådan:

"Fordi jeg bliver fagligt udfordret hver eneste dag."

"Fordi der er plads til mine idéer."

"Fordi jeg har kolleger, jeg både kan grine og være alvorlig sammen med."

"Fordi vi hjælper hinanden, når arbejdet bliver svært."

"Fordi der også bliver taget hensyn til, at jeg har et liv uden for hospitalet."

"Fordi jeg kan fordybe mig i det, jeg brænder for."

"Fordi vi lægger vægt på sygeplejen."

"Fordi jeg gennem primærplejen får lov til at lære mine patienter rigtigt at kende."

"Fordi jeg begyndte som den, der stillede spørgsmålene – og en dag opdagede jeg, at jeg var blevet én af dem, de andre kom til."



Det tror vi på

Vi tror på høj faglighed.

Vi tror på ordentlighed.

Vi tror på humor.

Vi tror på respekt.

Vi tror på, at de bedste patientforløb bliver skabt, når forskellige fagligheder arbejder tæt sammen om én fælles opgave.

Derfor betyder det noget for os, at læger, sygeplejersker, SOSU-assistenter, sekretærer og studerende oplever sig som betydningsfulde bidragydere til den samme kerneopgave.

Vi kan noget forskelligt.

Det er netop derfor, vi lykkes sammen.



Vi håber, du kan genkende dig selv

Du er nysgerrig.

Du har ambitioner på patienternes vegne.

Du tager ansvar for din egen faglige udvikling.

Du ved, at de bedste løsninger sjældent bliver skabt alene.

Og du har lyst til at være en del af et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi stiller høje krav til hinanden – fordi vi tror på, at vi alle bliver dygtigere af det.



Praktisk

Vi tilbyder en fast stilling med skiftende vagter. Timetallet aftaler vi sammen. Vi håber, at du ønsker fuld tid eller tæt på. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på Sundhedskartellets område indgået med de relevante organisationer.

Vi er åbne for dine vagtønsker. Hos os arbejder man som udgangspunkt enten dag/aften eller dag/nat. Vi arbejder hver 3. weekend.

title: Moves, Adds, and Changes (MAC) Lead
description:
Competitive Range partners with the government to plan and deploy complex, IT-enabled, and mission-essential capabilities. Our goal is to help you develop and expand your professional capabilities while working on challenging, exciting projects in a collaborative, congenial environment.

Competitive Range Solutions requires the expertise of a talented and experienced MAC Lead to assist in directing and managing the program’s executive support group. The candidate must reference their ability and experience working in a Department of Defense (DoD) customer environment and effective integration with a government multi-contractor team.

The experienced MAC lead will oversee equipment activations/deactivations, installations, relocations, and upgrades, ensuring seamless operations and minimal service disruption. This role involves developing and maintaining a team dedicated to executing MACs within DoD.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a proficient team capable of executing up to 20 WAOs, including necessary ports and equipment configurations.
  • Manage simple to complex MAC tasks within the DoD accreditation boundary, including hardware moves, port activations/deactivations, VLAN extensions, and VPN configurations.
  • Ensure adherence to SLAs and user agreements for Home Kits, Flyaway Kits, and JSP-managed Travel Kits, maintaining alignment with the correct scope of actions.
  • Collaborate with the COR or ACOR to approve technical solutions and cost estimates for MAC actions.
  • Follow change management process to track and execute MACs via service request tickets, covering installations, activations, modifications, upgrades, or deactivations to meet voice, video, and data requirements.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis on recurring problems and provide insights in the Monthly MAC Report.
  • Track MAC requests and make the tracking system accessible to customers and government oversight, ensuring transparency and progress monitoring.
  • Coordinate and manage all change requests (CRQs) for additions, removals, and modifications, ensuring compliance with established change and configuration management policies.
  • Prepare monthly summary reports detailing the Moves, Adds, and Changes performed, including location, timeline, and status.
  • Address customer requests that are out of scope, such as new project Engineering Change Proposal (ECP) requests.
  • Provide additional efforts for Voice MACs, including line provisioning, phone deployment, and migration from TDM to VoIP services as required.

Qualifications/Experience:

  • Active TS/SCI Clearance
  • 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong understanding of network infrastructure, including VLANs, VPNs, VoIP, and traditional voice services.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple projects simultaneously.

Education/Certifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field (required)
  • Registered Communications Distribution Designer Certification (required)

title: Assistant Administrator | Long Term Care
description:
Location:

Avera Marshall Hospital

Worker Type:

Regular

Work Shift:

Primarily days with night, weekend and holiday on-call involvement (United States of America)

Position Highlights


You Belong at Avera


Be part of a multidisciplinary team built with compassion and the goal of Moving Health Forward for you and our patients. Work where you matter.


A Brief Overview

The Assistant Administrator - LTC is a position that supports the Administrator in the daily operations, staffing, regulatory compliance, quality outcomes, resident and family relations, financial performance, and administrative functions of a long-term care facility. This position may spend time in multiple facilities or regions to gain varied operational exposure, work with other Administrators and facility leaders, and support organizational succession planning. The role provides leadership consistent with Avera's mission, values, strategic goals, and commitment to safe, high-quality, resident-centered care. This position may travel to and work within multiple facilities or regions, as assigned.

What you will do

  • Assists with day-to-day long term care operations to ensure safe, efficient, resident-centered services in compliance with organizational policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Supports the Administrator and facility leadership in developing and implementing operational strategies, goals, staffing plans, and performance expectations.
  • Coordinates and supports department managers and service areas, including nursing, dietary, housekeeping, maintenance, activities, therapy, social services, and administrative support.
  • Monitors compliance with CMS, state, federal, licensure, and organizational requirements, including survey readiness, audits, inspections, complaint investigations, and corrective action plans.
  • Participates in quality assurance and performance improvement activities, including monitoring quality measures, resident outcomes, incident trends, customer satisfaction, and operational metrics.
  • Responds to resident, family, employee, and operational concerns with professionalism, empathy, confidentiality, sound judgment, and timely follow-up.
  • Participates in staffing, recruitment, onboarding, employee coaching, performance management, employee relations, retention efforts, and leadership meetings.
  • Completes administrative responsibilities, including reports, documentation, budget support, policy implementation, correspondence, meeting preparation, regulatory documentation, and operational planning.
  • Provides direct supervision to assigned positions, which may include Social Worker, Activities, and Administrative Coordinator, with responsibility for assigning work, coaching, developing staff, evaluating performance, and addressing concerns.
  • Communicates effectively with residents, families, employees, department leaders, regional leadership, human resources, finance, billing/CBO, regulatory agencies, physicians, hospitals, pharmacies, and community partners; may support multiple facilities or regions as assigned.
  • Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, developing, training, and retaining employees; planning, assigning, and leading work; appraising performance; rewarding and coaching employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Essential Qualifications

The individual must be able to work the hours specified. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job function satisfactorily including having visual acuity adequate to perform position duties and the ability to communicate effectively with others, hear, understand and distinguish speech and other sounds. These requirements and those listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential job functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions, as long as the accommodations do not cause undue hardship to the employer.

Required Education, License/Certification, or Work Experience:

  • Associate's in Business, Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Long-Term Care Administration, or related field. Minimum of Bachelor's degree may be required based on state of practice.
  • Nursing Home Administrator - Licensing Board Current Nursing Home Administrator license active in state of practice or ability to obtain licensure with the required timeframe through the applicable state licensing board process. within 2 Years
  • Minimum of one year long-term care, skilled nursing, nursing facilitated or related healthcare experience.

Preferred Education, License/Certification, or Work Experience:

  • Previous leadership experience in a long-term care or a related healthcare program, including operations, finance, staffing, quality improvement, or regulatory compliance.
  • Knowledge of long-term care operations, CMS and state regulatory expectations, survey readiness, QAPI, residents rights, budgeting, and service recovery.

Expectations and Standards

  • Commitment to the daily application of Avera’s mission, vision, core values, and social principles to serve patients, their families, and our community.
  • Promote Avera’s values of compassion, hospitality, and stewardship.
  • Uphold Avera’s standards of Communication, Attitude, Responsiveness, and Engagement (CARE) with enthusiasm and sincerity.
  • Maintain confidentiality.
  • Work effectively in a team environment, coordinating work flow with other team members and ensuring a productive and efficient environment.
  • Comply with safety principles, laws, regulations, and standards associated with, but not limited to, CMS, The Joint Commission, DHHS, and OSHA if applicable.


Benefits You Need & Then Some

Avera is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to qualifying part-time and full-time employees. We support you with opportunities to help live balanced, healthy lives. Benefits are designed to meet needs of today and into the future.

  • PTO available day 1 for eligible hires.

  • Career development guided by hands-on training and mentorship

Avera is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, Veteran Status, or other categories protected by law. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation for help with your online application, please call 1-605-504-4444 or send an email to talent@avera.org.

title: Principal Data Analyst
description:
Principal Data Analyst

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms

  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers

  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization

  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions

  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance

  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)

  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)

  • Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or, a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.

  • At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language

  • At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool

  • At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

  • At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL

  • At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.

title: Coordinator, Referrals
description:
It's rewarding to be on a team of people that truly believe in making an impact!

We are committed to building the best primary care environment for patients and are seeking healthcare enthusiasts to join us.

Job Summary

The Referral Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting patient care coordination by managing insurance pre-verifications, referral processing, appointment scheduling, and communication between patients, providers, and health plans. This individual ensures timely and accurate handling of all internal and external referrals, authorizations, and follow-up activities. The Referral Coordinator serves as a key liaison among clinics, specialists, and insurance carriers, while upholding a patient-centered and service-oriented approach.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Referral Management & Coordination:

  • Process outgoing referrals promptly based on provider orders (e.g., specialty care, diagnostics, therapy).
  • Review, validate, and document referral orders, input referrals and authorizations into the appropriate data systems.
  • Schedule appointments with specialists or service providers, prioritizing high-quality, in-network, and cost-effective options.
  • Track referral status, follow up on incomplete referrals, and ensure timely receipt of consultation reports.
  • Close the referral loop by ensuring reports and documentation are routed to the appropriate provider.

Patient Communication & Navigation:

  • Educate patients on the referral process, insurance requirements, and expectations.
  • Assist patients in overcoming logistical or administrative barriers (e.g., transportation, language, scheduling).
  • Notify patients of appointment details and authorization status.
  • Provide compassionate, professional support in person and over the phone, reinforcing a positive patient experience.

Insurance & Authorization Processing:

  • Verify insurance eligibility and determine referral and authorization requirements.
  • Obtain prior authorizations and approvals from health plans as needed.
  • Collaborate with payers and specialists to expedite authorizations and respond to denials or appeals.

Value-Based Care Alignment:

  • Proactive schedule referrals related to key quality metrics, including HEDIS, STAR, and Quality Improvement (QI) measures (e.g., mammograms, colonoscopies, diabetic eye exams).
  • Support accurate and timely documentation to meet risk adjustment and quality reporting requirements.
  • Track referral patterns and help guide patients to in-network or preferred providers aligned with Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs) and narrow network strategies.
  • Identify, address, and escalate referral delays or barriers that may impact clinical outcomes or contractual performance metrics.

Administrative Support & Documentation:

  • Maintain accurate documentation of all referral activities in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.
  • Log referral status, actions taken, and communications in a timely manner.
  • Generate and distribute referral forms, notifications, and supporting documents.

Care Team Collaboration:

  • Work closely with physicians, nurses, medical assistants, and care managers to coordinate care.
  • Participate in daily huddles to proactively address upcoming referral needs.
  • Share referral status updates with clinical team members in real-time.

Compliance & Data Privacy:

  • Uphold HIPAA guidelines and clinic protocols related to data handling and patient confidentiality.
  • Ensure secure communication of patient records to external entities.

Clinic Support & Environment:

  • Provide clerical support to the clinical team, including managing lobby areas and assisting with PPE protocols.
  • Collaborate with front desk and clinic staff to monitor scheduling and patient flow.
  • Maintain a welcoming and organized patient experience environment.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in a medical office, hospital, or clinical setting handling referrals.
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology and insurance processes.
  • Experience with scheduling systems, EHRs (e.g., eClinicalWorks), and insurance authorization procedures.
  • BLS certification required; must be able to respond appropriately in emergencies.

title: Lunar - Technician - Assembly & Integration
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

As an Assembly & Integration Technician at Blue Origin, you will provide hands-on technical support to engineering, production, and manufacturing teams by performing activities such as assembly, integration, testing, modification, and checkout of aerospace systems and hardware. Working from engineering drawings, schematics, and detailed work instructions, you will build, integrate, and troubleshoot prototype and production electro-mechanical systems, avionics, and specialized test equipment. You will perform operational tests, fault isolation, and assist in remedying malfunctions, ensuring all systems meet rigorous quality and safety standards. This role requires proficiency using a wide range of manufacturing and diagnostic tools, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to supporting Blue Origin’s mission of safe and reliable spaceflight.

Position Specific Details:

  • Shifts: A | Mon-Fri (6am-2:30pm), B | Mon-Fri (2pm-10:30pm), C | Fri-Sun (6am-6:30pm), D | Fri-Sun (6pm - 6:30am)
  • Location: Space Coast, FL
  • Relocation: Available

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assemble and integrate subcomponents and final assemblies of all major structural, mechanical, fluid, and avionics systems according to engineering specifications.
  • Configure production work areas with necessary tooling and equipment to ensure efficient workflow and minimize delays during high-rate manufacturing transitions.
  • Operate precision calibrated tools (e.g., torque wrenches, micrometers) to maintain high safety and quality standards.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for safety, efficiency, and productivity.
  • Perform operational tests, troubleshooting, and fault isolation to ensure the integrity and reliability of assembled systems.
  • Support the transition from development to production, performing preventative maintenance as needed.
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas following 5S principles to promote safety and operational efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience Levels with aerospace manufacturing, integration, or another related field. (0-3 years Level I Technician, 3+ Level II Technician, 5+ Level III Technician, 8+ Sr Level Technician)
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications accurately.
  • Hands-on experience with assembly and integration of structural, mechanical, fluid, and avionic systems.
  • Proficient with precision calibration tools (torque wrenches, micrometers, calipers).
  • Capable of lifting 50 lbs and working at heights (work stands, ladders, lifts) and/or in confined spaces.
  • Experience with adhesives, sealants, and fasteners.
  • Basic proficiency in computer usage, including Windows and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry certification, trade school training, and/or degree in related field.
  • Direct experience with cryogenic fluid systems, avionics integration, and aerospace launch vehicle or spacecraft assembly.
  • Knowledge of precision assembly processes, especially for large aerospace components.
  • Strong technical and leadership skills with attention to detail, especially when leading teams on complex integration tasks.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Continuous improvement mindset and curiosity for optimizing processes.

title: Escrow Assistant - Exton, PA
description:
Real Life. Real Importance.

What You'll Do

You'll be the behind-the-scenes force that keeps real estate transactions moving. Working closely with the Escrow Officer, you'll coordinate documents, manage deadlines, and support agents, buyers, sellers, lenders, and attorneys to help ensure every closing is accurate, on time, and stress-free. From preparing closing packages to supporting funding, recording, and post-closing activities, your attention to detail and customer service will make a real difference.

Who You Are

  • Customer-focused – You enjoy helping people and creating a positive experience during an important life event.
  • Detail-oriented – You catch missing information, resolve issues, and ensure accuracy every step of the way.
  • Highly organized – You can manage multiple files, deadlines, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communicator – You build trust through clear, professional communication with clients and business partners.
  • Proactive problem-solver – You take initiative, find solutions, and keep transactions moving forward.
  • Reliable team player – Others know they can count on you to follow through and support the team.

Your work helps turn contracts into closings and helps clients move into their next chapter with confidence.

Key Responsibilities

Transaction & Document Management

  • Prepare closing packages, including settlement documents and checks for scheduled closings.
  • Assemble, review, and maintain escrow files and closing documents for accuracy and completeness.
  • Review contracts and assist in obtaining information and documentation needed to process transactions.
  • Scan, upload, index, and maintain digital and physical files in accordance with company standards.

Escrow Processing & Post-Closing Support

  • Support transactions from contract through post-closing, ensuring timely file progression and adherence to deadlines.
  • Assist with title clearance, funding conditions, loan package returns, recording, and post-closing activities.
  • Resolve recording issues, document corrections, and other transaction-related matters as needed.

Team & Client Support

  • Partner closely with the Escrow Officer to provide exceptional administrative and transaction support.
  • Communicate effectively with agents, buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, and other parties to keep transactions moving forward.
  • Deliver outstanding customer service and build positive relationships with clients and industry partners.
  • Perform general administrative duties as needed to support escrow operations.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • One to four years of escrow processing experience, depending on the team supported.
  • Prior experience in escrow, title, mortgage, real estate, or related transaction services preferred.
  • Strong administrative and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and Excel, as well as document management systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with agents, buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, and internal team members to resolve issues and keep transactions moving forward.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to problem-solving and issue resolution.
  • Demonstrated commitment to quality work, accuracy, and customer service.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate industry, including title, escrow, settlement services, real estate, mortgage, or property management.
  • Knowledge of front-end and back-end escrow processing procedures.
  • Familiarity with closing document preparation, funding, recording, and post-closing processes.

title: Senior Algorithm Engineer - Sensing Algorithms
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

This is where a desire to make a difference in people's lives meets a passion for algorithm development and data science. The Algorithms team is at the very heart of what we do at Dexcom. Join us if building models, developing signal processing approaches, and transforming emerging sensing technologies into impactful healthcare solutions excites you.

As a Senior Algorithm Engineer, you will play a key role in developing advanced sensing algorithms that power next-generation continuous glucose monitoring and health sensing technologies.

Where you come in:

  • Lead development of advanced algorithms supporting next-generation glucose sensing technologies.

  • Develop physics-based, mechanistic, and data-driven models to characterize sensor behavior and improve measurement performance.

  • Design and implement signal processing, estimation, calibration, detection, and predictive algorithms.

  • Apply statistical modeling, machine learning, and data analytics techniques to extract insights from bench, preclinical, clinical, and real-world datasets.

  • Drive clinical performance assessments and algorithm maturation in collaboration with sensor, systems, hardware, firmware, clinical, and product teams.

  • Evaluate algorithm performance through simulation, modeling, and experimental analysis.

  • Provide technical insights on algorithm architecture, design tradeoffs, verification strategies, and implementation approaches.

  • Identify opportunities to optimize overall system performance and resource utilization.

  • Facilitate algorithm design transfer activities with firmware, verification, and validation teams.

What makes you successful:

  • PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Biophysics, Statistics, or a related field with 2 years of industry experience; or a Master's degree in a related field with 2-5 years of relevant experience.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or similar technical computing environments.

  • Deep expertise in statistical estimation, signal processing, optimization, and mathematical modeling.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning techniques and practical model development.

  • Demonstrated experience developing algorithms for sensing technologies, measurement systems, medical devices, or related disciplines.

  • Experience analyzing large and complex datasets with multiple signals and dependencies.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced technical environments.

Preferred:

  • Experience with biosensors, physiological sensing, wearable systems, or analytical instrumentation.

  • Experience with calibration, estimation, filtering, or measurement system algorithms.

  • Experience transitioning algorithms from research into commercial products.

  • Experience applying strong software engineering practices in data-driven application development.

  • Knowledge of design controls, verification and validation processes, and product development lifecycles.

  • Publication, patent, or demonstrated record of innovation.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 0-5%

Education and Experience:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 5-8 years related experience or Master’s degree and 2-5 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 0-2 years experience.

Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About the Team

Do you want to build AI-powered software that impacts millions of people every day? The Context and Retrievals team, part of Workday’s AI Platform organization, tackles challenging problems at the intersection of machine learning, agentic reasoning, and enterprise-scale systems. Our work delivers critical AI platform capabilities and differentiated, deep-value agent applications.

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the AI Platform Context and Retrievals team, you will develop tailored user experiences using advanced Agentic AI, LLMs and RAG. You will collaborate with other engineers to deliver ML solutions across Workday’s product ecosystem and use current software and data engineering stacks to enable training, deployment, and lifecycle management of a variety of ML models; supervised and unsupervised. Additionally, you will develop and deploy new APIs/services using Docker/Kubernetes at scale and leverage Workday’s vast computing resources on rich datasets to deliver transformative value to our customers. Sound like your kind of challenge?

You are a strong technical leader with deep Python expertise and solid software engineering skills, capable of writing beautiful, well-designed code while delivering solutions efficiently. Specifically, you will:

  • Own exploration, design and implementation of features for our sophisticated ML platforms, pipelines and services.

  • Be responsible for evaluation, scalability and observability of these features.

  • Apply machine learning techniques including LLMs and natural language understanding to analyze large sets of HR and Finance-related text data, and design and launch pioneering cloud-based machine learning architectures

  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI, LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents and orchestration frameworks to drive innovation

  • Serve as a technical role model for more junior engineers

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s (Master’s or PhD preferred) degree in engineering, data/computer science, physics, math or equivalent

  • 3+ yrs experience as a member of a data science, machine learning engineering, or other relevant software development team building applied machine learning products at scale, including taking products through applied research, design, implementation, production, and production-based evaluation

  • 3+ years of professional experience with Python and supporting numeric libraries, with experience in shipping production code and models

  • 3+ years of professional experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, etc.)

Other Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in building information retrieval systems and/or graph-based recommendation systems.

  • 3+ years of hands-on professional experience in developing large language models (LLMs), text generation models, or graph-based machine learning models for production, including data processing, model fine-tuning, model deployment and model evaluation

  • 3+ years of professional experience building services to host machine learning models in production at scale

  • 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning and deep learning frameworks & toolkits such as PySpark, Pytorch, TensorFlow, and Sklearn

  • 3+ years of professional experience with data engineering and data wrangling using e.g. Pandas and PySpark and other industry tools used to build scalable machine learning systems, such as Kubernetes and Docker

  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, unsupervised and supervised machine learning algorithms, and natural language processing for information retrieval and/or recommendation system use cases

  • Professional experience in independently solving ambiguous, open-ended problems and technically leading team

title: IG Desk Analyst - Director
description:
Job Description:

Job Title IG Desk Analyst

Corporate Title Director

Location New York, NY

Overview

The Investment Grade Credit desk is part of Credit Flow Trading, sitting within the Global Financing & Credit Trading (GF&CT) business unit. The trading desk acts as a market maker in Investment Grade Bonds and derivatives to provide liquidity to our clients. You will hold the position of Investment Grade Credit Desk Analyst (Director level) and will be responsible for critically analyzing specific sectors/credits to generate profitable trading ideas for the Deutsche Bank trading desk & our clients. You will partner closely with Trading, the Institutional Client Group (ICG), and Capital Markets to assess opportunities within the market & enable effective risk positioning.

What We Offer You

  • A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration

  • A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days

  • Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement

  • Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits

  • Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct deep fundamental credit analysis to identify profitable trading opportunities for the desk & our clients in IG and cross-over cash bonds and single-name CDS. Monitor relative value to identify mis-pricings among cash bonds and single-name CDS

  • Maintain sector expertise and contacts to facilitate the identification of key trends and trade ideas

  • Develop thoughtful content to communicate analysis and ideas to sales and clients. Build relationships with clients through discussing market trends & trading ideas

  • Work closely with Deutsche Bank traders to ensure sensible risk positioning in trading books
