title: Aarhus Kommune søger snarest muligt en engageret timeafløser til en dreng på 15 år bosiddende i Åbyhøj, Aarhus Kommune
description:
Som timeafløser er din opgave at afløse forældrene i hjemmet. Samværet med drengen vil derfor primært foregå i hjemmet, men også i forhold til transport til skole eller andre aktiviteter, hvor drengen har behov for at blive kørt.

Drengen har en knoglesygdom, der giver ham mange fysiske smerter. Dette gør, at han har reduceret skoleskema, kan have brug for at blive hentet før skoledagen slutter og ikke altid kan komme afsted i skole. Derfor er der brug for en timeafløser, der kan være sammen med ham, når han ikke kan være i skolen. Samværet kan bl.a. bestå af hygge, let fysisk aktivitet og lektielæsning.

Drengen kan godt lide at spille brætspil, computerspil, rollespil, musik, se naturfilm, hygge og snakke. Han kan også godt lide at lave kulturelle ting, som at gå på museum m.v. Han er glad for dyr og synger i drengekor. Han er en sød og imødekommende dreng, der har det fint med nye mennesker. Gode byggesten i relationen til drengen er, at man er pålidelig og overholder aftaler, samt at man deler interesser med ham.

For at komme i betragtning til jobbet, skal du kunne arbejde på følgende tidspunkter: tirsdag fra ca. 9.45-13.45 og fredag fra ca. 9.30-15 og have kørekort. Forældrene stiller bil til rådighed, når timeafløseren skal køre med drengen. Der er faste arbejdsdage, men der kan være brug for noget fleksibilitet i arbejdstiden, hvis aftaler omkring drengen ændres.

Forventninger:

• Du kan se dig selv i jobbet i en længere periode (gerne min. 1 år).

• Du er pålidelig og god til at overholde aftaler.

• Det er en fordel, hvis du er en ung mand.

• Du er tydelig, rummelig og god til at motivere.

• Du kan støtte drengen med lektielæsning svarende til 8. og 9. kl.

• Du kan arbejde tirsdag fra ca. 9.45 -13.45 og fredage fra ca. kl. 9.30- 15.00.

• Det er en fordel, hvis du kan starte i jobbet hurtigst muligt.

• Du har kørekort og kan køre i Åbyhøj / Aarhus området.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Timelønnen er: normaltimer 145,97 kr.

Du er omfattet af ferieloven og optjener feriegodtgørelse på 12,5 % af lønnen. Lønnen er ikke pensionsgivende.

Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest og anmærkningsfri børneattest.

Yderligere oplysninger:

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til socialrådgiver Ane Norup ved Team Afløsning, Kontakt- og Støttepersoner, Aarhus Kommune på telefon: 21 35 89 14.



Om Sociale Forhold og BeskæftigelseVi ved, at det gode liv går gennem uddannelse, job og selvforsørgelse for langt de fleste – og meningsfulde fællesskaber for alle. Derfor er vi mere end 7000 mennesker, der går på arbejde hver dag for aarhusianere med et handicap, et integrationsbehov, dem, der lever socialt udsatte liv og dem, der har brug for at finde vej til det næste job. Vi arbejder med alt det, der er svært, men også med det vigtigste, der findes: aarhusianernes kernevelfærd. Vi er årligt i kontakt med omkring 100.000 aarhusianere, der får vores støtte til et liv med håb og handlekraft.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Pædagogmedhjælper til Gadekæret
description:
I Gadekæret i Risskov leder vi ikke bare efter en men to pædagogmedhjælpere.

Nogle der brænder for af arbejde med børn og for at være en aktiv del af deres hverdag.

Nogle, der er nysgerrig på relationer og fællesskaber – og som har lyst til at bidrage til et miljø, hvor alle børn oplever, at de hører til.

Hos os handler det ikke kun om det, vi gør. Det handler også om måden, vi er sammen på.

Hvem er vi?
Gadekæret er en mindre integreret daginstitution med 17 vuggestuebørn og 30 børnehavebørn. Der er en stilling i begge grupper, men vi er ét hus, og vi hjælpes ad på tværs og du skal derfor have mod på arbejdet med alle børn (0-6 år).

Vi organiserer os i mindre grupper fremfor klassiske stuer, fordi det giver os bedre mulighed for at:

  • se det enkelte barn
  • skabe gode deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • tilpasse vores hverdag, når noget kalder på nye løsninger

Vi har et spændende hus i to plan med gode fysiske rammer, blandt andet gymnastiksal, atelier, vandleg og mange varierede legerum. Udenfor har vi en dejlig legeplads, og vi arbejder løbende med at udvikle vores læringsmiljøer både inde og ude.

Kom gerne forbi og oplev huset – ring og aftal en tid.

Det, vi er optagede af

Vi er optagede af børns trivsel, udvikling og fællesskaber.

Vi er nysgerrige på:

  • Hvad prøver barnet at fortælle os?
  • Hvordan kan vi støtte barnet bedst muligt?
  • Hvordan skaber vi deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn?

Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når vi undrer os sammen og tør dele vores tanker med hinanden.

Det kalder vi på hos dig

Vi håber, du kan genkende dig selv i noget af dette:

  • Du har lyst til at arbejde med børn og være en vigtig del af deres hverdag.
  • Du er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og kan skabe gode relationer.
  • Du tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.
  • Du kan lide en hverdag med både leg, aktivitet og struktur.
  • Du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nyt.
  • Du deltager aktivt i legen og møder børnene i deres perspektiv.
  • Du kan samarbejde med både kolleger og forældre og deltager på møder mv.
  • Erfaring fra dagtilbud er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at være sammen med børn og bidrage til et trygt, udviklende og inkluderende miljø.

Hos os får du

Et hus hvor vi:

  • hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab
  • tager vores arbejde med børn alvorligt – uden at tage os selv alt for alvorligt
  • giver plads til spørgsmål, refleksion og nye idéer
  • arbejder målrettet med børnefællesskaber og læringsmiljøer
  • har fokus på både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet

Vi arbejder med Bredere Børnefællesskaber som en central del af vores udvikling. Du bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

Forældresamarbejde

Forældrene er en vigtig del af barnets liv – og dermed også af vores arbejde.

Derfor er det vigtigt, at du:

  • møder forældrene venligt og professionelt
  • deler de gode historier fra barnets hverdag
  • bidrager til et tillidsfuldt samarbejde

Du står aldrig alene – men du skal have lyst til at være en aktiv del af samarbejdet.

Til sidst – det vigtigste

Hvis du har lyst til at være en del af et hus, hvor vi:

  • tænker sammen
  • hjælper hinanden
  • udvikler os sammen
  • og hver dag arbejder for at skabe de bedste rammer for børnene

så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Du bliver samtidig en del af Risskov Dagtilbud, hvor vi arbejder ud fra fælles pædagogiske værdier og et stærkt fokus på børns trivsel, udvikling og fællesskaber.

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så skriv en motiveret ansøgning og fortæl, hvorfor vi skal vælge dig og hvad du brænder for i samarbejdet og i arbejdet med børn.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt.

Tiltrædelse: 1. september 2026 eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Care Champion
description:
Bolton Clarke Group one of Australia’s largest independent, not-for-profit providers of home care, retirement living and residential aged care, operating nationally and internationally. Bolton Clarke Residential group now has 88 Aged Care Homes across QLD, NSW, VIC, SA & WA, with the inclusion of the Allity, McKenzie & Acacia Living Group.

About the Role

As the Care Champion, you will be the frontline person, and advocate for resident’s wellbeing, through checking in with all residents to ensure their comfort, care and support needs have been addressed. You will solve problems, fill gaps in planned care and support, serve as a touch point for families, keep them up to date with the care and wellbeing needs of the resident. You will help residents live a life of fulfilment and support the recruitment and training of care staff.

Tantula Rise is a Residential Aged Care Home located in Alexandra Headland on the Sunshine Coast of Queensland

Responsibilities include:

  • Provides exceptional personalised care to residents and their families, ensures regular check-ins to address their needs, fosters open communication with all staff and maintains a comfortable environment.

  • Understands each resident's unique needs and preferences, provides personalised care and support, addresses any gaps in service delivery and collaborates with the care team to ensure optimal service delivery.

  • Communicates any changes in resident status to the Registered Nurse or Care Manager for timely intervention and delivers compassionate care aligned with the resident’s personalised plan.

  • Welcomes new residents, facilitates introductions, ensures they are seated with peers in the dining room, follows up with families to provide updates on the resident’s first day, and oversees compliance with documentation and reporting requirements.

About You

To be successful in this role, our preferred candidate will have:

  • Min 2 years' experience within Aged Care and a Certificate III of Individual Support/Disability/Aged Care/Home and Community Support, CHCCS011 Module (Meet Personal Support Needs), HLTAID003 Current First Aid Certificate (Provide First Aid) is prescribed.

  • CHCC305C Module (Assist with Medication) is preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of Person-Centred Practice, Activities of Daily Living, Case Management, Legal & Regulatory Compliance and Health & Safety Programs and Policies.

  • Excellent Communication, Customer Experience and Cross-Functional Team Working skills.

Our Benefits

  • Generous salary packaging and not-for-profit tax benefits – claim up to $15,900 tax free plus additional $2650 in entertainment per year

  • Management and clinical support at all times

  • Buddy programs to set you up for your success within specific homes

  • Career progression and leadership development opportunities via continuous internal training opportunities.

  • We provide a work culture that values diversity and inclusion.

  • An Employee Assistance Program for staff and family

  • Free annual flu shots

  • Work across all Bolton Clarke homes and opportunities to transfer if relocating.

About this location:

Bolton Clarke’s Tantula Rise Home provides high-quality aged care in a friendly, secure and comfortable residential environment.

Why Work For Bolton Clarke:


  • Excellent work/life balance with shifts that suit your personal needs
  • A caring team environment with strong clinical and allied health support
  • Career progression and development opportunities
  • Generous salary packaging and not-for-profit tax benefits – claim up to $18,550 tax free
  • Private health insurance and gym discounts
  • An Employee Assistance Program for staff and family

Apply Now: Our application process takes 10 minutes to apply, please follow the below link to start your application.

Our commitment to diversity: At Bolton Clarke we expect our staff to respect and value differences in age, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, intersex status and family or marital status.

Appointment to this position and ongoing employment is subject to your commitment to supporting diversity and inclusion.

title: Pædagog søges til Flintebjerg Øst, Center for Handicap
description:
Er du pædagogen, der brænder for at være med til, at understøtte den enkeltes mulighed for at leve et så aktivt og selvstændigt liv som muligt på egne præmisser, så er du måske Flintebjerg Øst nye pædagog!

Flintebjerg Øst er et botilbud under §105/§85, som rummer 8 lejligheder. Der bor 7 borgere fast. Derudover er der en aflastningslejlighed, som lige nu bliver delt mellem 3 borgere.
Borgergruppen ligger i alderen 18-39 år.

Borgerne der bor på Flintebjerg Øst, er multiple borgere med fysiske og psykiske funktionsnedsættelser som har brug for varig støtte og vejledning omkring almindelige daglige funktioner, såsom personlig pleje, måltider, økonomi, sociale relationer med medborgere, samt kognitiv støtte og vejledning efter behov.
For at sikre et godt fysisk arbejdsmiljø er der tilknyttet en forflytningsvejleder, da der er mange forflytninger.

På Flintebjerg Øst arbejder vi ud fra en struktureret og anerkendende tilgang, hvor vi lægger vægt på relationsarbejde, forudsigelighed og udvikling – altid med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ønsker, behov og forudsætninger.

Vi benytter metoden LA2U, hvor vi arbejder målrettet med borgerens inde-fra-perspektiv.

Metoden bidrager til at udvikle og styrke vores fælles faglige fundament til gavn for både borgere og personale.

Til dagligt er nogle af borgerne i Aktivitetshus, nogle på fuldtid, andre på halv tid. Vi kører selv borgerne i Aktivitetshus, og har en bus til rådighed. De dage borgerne ikke er i Aktivitetshus tilbydes de forskellige individuelle aktiviteter såsom: Gangsejl, ståstativ, gåtur, svømning, ridning, Snoezelhus, indkøbstur eller restaurant/cafe besøg.

Du vil komme til at arbejde i en tværfaglig personalegruppe bestående af pædagoger, pædagogiske assistenter, social og sundhedsassistenter, social og sundhedshjælpere og omsorgsmedhjælper. Vi modtager løbende pædagogiske assistentelever samt pædagogstuderende og er et sted med plads til at være i det lærende rum.

Vi kan tilbyde:
  • En grundig introduktion til opgaver og arbejdsplads
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor din faglighed og dit engagement gør en forskel
  • En tydelig pædagogisk tilgang baseret på LA2u, med fokus på læring og faglig udvikling
  • Stor indflydelse på den daglige planlægning.
  • Et arbejdsmiljø præget af tillid, åbenhed og samarbejde
  • En inddragende ledelse, hvor værdier som åbenhed, tillid og samarbejde vægtes højt.

Vi forventer, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:
  • Er uddannet pædagog og har interesse for målgruppen
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og evner at dokumentere fagligt på skrift
  • Har kørekort

Vi forventer at vores nye kollega:
  • Kan arbejde med respekt og indlevelse i den enkelte borger.
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner, er ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel.
  • Har lyst samt evner at arbejde med den individuelle tilgang til borgeren.
  • Kan arbejde struktureret.
  • Kan se muligheder frem for begrænsninger.

Center for Handicap

Center for Handicap er en decentral enhed under Social, Psykiatri og Handicap i Lolland Kommune. Vi yder støtte og vejledning til borgere med særlige behov. Der ydes støtte i eget hjem, botilbud, beskyttet beskæftigelse, aktivitets- og samværstilbud, klub samt ’Særlig Tilrettelagt Ungdomsuddannelse’. Tilbuddene er geografisk placeret i hele Lolland Kommune.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Lønintervallet for en socialpædagog er 32.863 kr./ md. – 37.424 kr./ md. 6 års erfaring - 34.430 kr./ md. og ved 10 års erfaring - 37.424 kr./ md.

Hertil kommer 14,95% i pension.

Den endelige lønindplacering vil ske efter gældende overenskomst og principperne for lokal løndannelse.

Arbejdstid: 37 timer pr. uge.

Opstart: 1. september 2026, eller efter aftale.

Arbejdstider: Skiftende dag- og aftenvagter samt weekend og helligdage

Ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfrist: 18.8.2026.

Samtalerne finder sted den 24.8.2026

Stillingen kan kun søges online via linket " Søg stillingen" i opslaget.

Yderligere oplysninger?

Kontakt: Teamleder Louise Rasmussen – Louir@lolland.dk / 29603071 eller Teamleder Lene Folmann Petersen- Leet@lolland.dk/ 21172988

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

Læs mere om at arbejde og bo i Lolland Kommune på Lolland Kommune som arbejdsplads

title: AI Strategy & Product Management - Data and AI, Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for:

This is a leadership position in Chief Data and Artificial Intelligence Office (CDAIO) team. Our primary objective is to lead & drive transformational AI efforts across STT’s processes and functions; partner with business and technology teams to design and implement transformational AI across people, process and technology.

As a member of the CDAIO Team, the incumbent will partner with technology teams, third parties, and with stakeholders across different business teams, corporate functions & regions, to identify opportunities & work with business units and various other stakeholders to design and implement transformational Artificial Intelligence, using world class tools and techniques.

What you will be responsible for:

As a VP - AI Strategy & Product Management you will:

Enterprise Data & AI Strategy:

  • Lead and partner with the business leads to design, assess and address strategic opportunities: from framing up-front work plans to crafting and executing on the analyses and steps outlined in those plans
  • Identify high-value opportunities by understanding what drives value for clients and a particular Business unit / functional area
  • Translate strategy into clear product-aligned roadmaps that support design of an end-state that relies on the latest AI offerings
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of business processes, functions, teams, and incumbent technology

Product & Portfolio Management and Execution Tracking:

  • Drive rollout & deployment of “self-service” technology platforms; to enable faster adoption of our AI Capabilities
  • Anchor all phases and aspects of AI opportunity identification, such as data & requirements gathering, (e.g. user stories) baselining, root cause analysis, quantitative and qualitative analysis, data modeling & future state AI designs
  • Support creation of technology MVPs that support business and technology outcomes. Assess the feasibility and drive the AI strategy, to include all aspects of automation, AI and ML across STT’s footprint.
  • Conduct core project management activities including facilitating meetings, interviewing stakeholders, hosting workshops, documenting findings, and creating stakeholder presentations
  • Enable detailed evaluation of proposed solutions / changes by creating business case details; cost vs. benefits, ROI, and tradeoffs (build vs. buy)

Executive & Client (Internal & External) Communication:

  • Liaise with Investor Relations to proactively support the CDAIO strategy and address key questions
  • Create materials required to support future state socialization and execution (eg: Strategy presentations, detailed Requirement & process flow diagrams, job aids, POC’s etc.)

Portfolio Governance:

  • Ensure our delivery team has the highest likelihood of success, and all risks are managed by demonstrating consistent and proactive ownership of assigned responsibilities for standard work products, version control, model lifecycle, and Quality Control

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and develop a global team (1- 5) to capture and express AI strategy execution and requirements & design in business services by fostering a culture of precision and clarity, strong execution discipline, and high-quality output.

Skills:

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Experience with strategy, product management, or portfolio leadership and support
  • Strong background in data platforms and data strategy, as well as AI/ML and Generative AI
  • Being comfortable with ambiguity and the ability to work well with teams, particularly ones that span different reporting lines, cut across multiple functions and geographies
  • Strong analytical skills, critical thinking, problem solving, and decision making

Education & Preferred Qualifications:

  • AI Capability & Product Management experience
  • Business Consulting experience leading large-scale implementation programs in consulting or financial services industry
  • Business Process Re-Engineering – Workflow, AI & Process Automation experience (from current state thru target state and implantation)
  • 12+ years of experience
  • Knowledge of AI / automation technologies and/or a master’s degree will be an added advantage
  • Ability to build stakeholder networks, effective collaboration and partnership capabilities and ability to influence at all levels of the organization
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to meet deadlines and proven experience in working with large cross functional teams will be a plus

Salary Range:

$120,000 - $217,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Assistant Teachers
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

We have an exciting opportunity for Assistant Teachers working in our State-of-the-Art facility. title: Technician
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.

title: NextGen Leader - Northeast Columbia, SC
description:
If you are currently on Young Life staff, please do not apply through this external jobs board. To apply for internal job opportunities, log in to Workday and use the Jobs Hub. Applying externally may delay your application and require you to resubmit internally.

Young Life requires all​ employees to sign a Statement of Faith. We recommend you read this statement before applying​ for any position.

Because of Young Life’s exclusive Christian purposes of evangelism and discipleship as set forth in its Articles of Incorporation and in these Bylaws, and to reflect what has always been and will continue to be the position of Young Life, specifically the Christian belief that each and every employee and volunteer of the corporation should minister as a servant of God with the primary responsibility of proclaiming the gospel of Jesus Christ and, as such, is an integral part of the Christian mission and ministry of the corporation,
Young Life shall only employ individuals or enlist volunteer leaders who: (a) profess a belief in Jesus Christ as their personal Savior and Lord; and (b) subscribe to the statements and policies required of all Young Life staff, including the Young Life Statement of Faith. Therefore, employees and volunteers of Young Life, during working and nonworking hours, shall: (i) be ready, willing and able to fulfill such ministry functions as may be required by the organization; (ii) refrain from conduct and statements that detract from the biblical standards taught and supported by Young Life, and (iii) abide by all policies and practices of Young Life including, without limitation, those related to religious belief or ministry activities.

Mission Staff

  • Seek and maintain relationships and disciplines, in the context of active participation in a church community.

title: SOSU-assistent søges til plejehjemmet Sønderskovhus i Lystrup.
description:
Om jobbet:

Vi søger en SOSU-assistent, der – sammen med engagerede kollegaer – vil være med til at skabe et trygt, meningsfuldt og værdigt hverdagsliv for vores beboere. Hos os står du aldrig alene. Vi hjælper hinanden, vi sparrer, og vi tænker os selv som ét fælles hus.

Vi ved, at arbejdsliv og privatliv skal hænge sammen. Derfor tilbyder vi fleksible muligheder, så vi sammen kan finde den løsning, der passer bedst til dig.

Vi tror på, at de bedste rammer for vores beboere skabes af medarbejdere, der trives, og derfor er vi åbne for dialog om, hvordan dit arbejdsliv kan tilpasses bedst muligt.

Vi arbejder personcentreret med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov, og vi er meget bevidste om at træde respektfuldt ind i deres liv og hjem. Hvis du drømmer om at gøre en reel forskel og være med til at forme det gode hverdagsliv på Sønderskovhus, så er det her, du skal være.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område. P.t. forventes tjenesten fortrinsvis at være i dag- og aftenvagt.


Din profil:

Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og fælles ansvar er fundamentet for hverdagen. Med naturligt engagement bidrager du til at styrke og udvikle den faglige kvalitet, både i samarbejdet med kolleger og i den nære kontakt med beboerne.

Som person er du stabil, fleksibel og handlekraftig. Du arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, også når hverdagen byder på mange forskellige opgaver. Du formår at planlægge og prioritere, så kvaliteten i plejen altid er i fokus.

Du kommunikerer anerkendende og konstruktivt og har let ved at skabe tillidsfulde relationer til både beboere, pårørende og kolleger. Erfaring med Cura er en fordel, og du trives i en dynamisk hverdag, hvor forandringer og mange bolde i luften er en naturlig del af arbejdet.

Vi forventer, at du møder mennesker med stor empati, respekt og forståelse for den enkeltes livssituation. Du arbejder sundhedsfremmende og rehabiliterende med fokus på at understøtte beboernes ressourcer, livskvalitet og selvbestemmelse.

Du arbejder selvstændigt, reflekterer over din praksis og har lyst til løbende at udvikle dine kompetencer, så du altid kan yde den bedst mulige pleje og behandling. Samtidig er du en holdspiller, der tager ansvar for fællesskabet og bidrager aktivt til at finde de bedste løsninger sammen med dine kolleger.


Derfor skal du vælge os:

Sønderskovhus Plejehjem er hjem for 38 beboere fordelt på tre huse, herunder flere ægtepar boliger. Vi ligger i skønne omgivelser midt i Lystrup og danner rammen om et hjem med nærvær, tryghed og hjerterum.

Hos os får du ikke blot et arbejde – du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel hver eneste dag. Vi tilbyder et arbejdsmiljø præget af høj faglighed, humor, varme og en anerkendende tilgang til hinanden. Du får mulighed for at præge din rolle, bringe dine idéer i spil og udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Vi prioriterer trivsel, arbejdsglæde og et stærkt kollegaskab højt. Derfor står du heller ikke alene. Du bliver en del af en medarbejdergruppe med dygtige og engagerede kollegaer, som vil gøre deres bedste for at give dig en tryg introduktion, værdifuld sparring og en god start på Sønderskovhus.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt den 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation.

Ugentligt timetal: 37 timer


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til forstander Tina Fangel – tlf. 4187 3984 / tiif@aarhus.dk
Vi giver gerne en kop kaffe og viser dig rundt på vores skønne plejehjem.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. august 2026

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler den 20. august 2026

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.


Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Supply Chain Inventory Anaylst
description:
Company Overview

Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description

This position will be responsible for the day to day wave planning, reporting, KPI and productivity tracking, and trend analysis for the site. The position will also manage the queue, post receipts, and manage the administration of Safety and Training reports. Required data will come from multiple sources including the Warehouse Management System, SAP, Tableau, Power BI, Rebus and Coupa.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand customer requirements, operator productivity, transportation schedules, and inventory flow to create an efficient daily wave plan for the facility
  • Develop and analyze reports on operations methods, processes and equipment for current operational needs and future objectives
  • Develop audit reports to ensure data integrity and process compliance
  • Track KPI metrics and analyze trends, understand and report on the operational activities driving the data
  • Manage the queue control for the site and process system transactions as required
  • Provide daily, weekly, monthly productivity reports, including trend analysis, as required
  • Maintain positive, professional, and timely communications, within various internal customers, as well as with external contacts
  • Actively participate in the continuous improvement process
  • Manage the administration of Safety & Training reports, follow up with shift managers if required data is missing

Qualifications

  • 5+ years’ experience in Distribution/Warehouse Logistics, Supply Chain Operations, Finance, or other data driven environment. BA/BS Degree preferred.
  • APICS Certification Preferred
  • Must have the ability to integrate information and data from a variety of sources to develop an optimized work plan
  • Must have strong organization skills and be detail oriented with the ability to multi-task and prioritize work responsibilities with sense of urgency to meet deadlines
  • Self-Directed & demonstrates the ability to proactively identify and resolve discrepancies or potential issues
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent problem identification & follow through to issue resolution
  • Demonstrates the ability to work well with a variety of individuals
  • High analytical ability and advanced Excel reporting skills (vlookup, pivot tables, & macros)
  • Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS); JDA (Red Prairie) and/or SAP a plus
  • Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning Systems (ERP); SAP a plus

Benefits

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

Community Engagement

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

Training and Development

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

title: Coordinator, Referrals
description:
It's rewarding to be on a team of people that truly believe in making an impact!

We are committed to building the best primary care environment for patients and are seeking healthcare enthusiasts to join us.

Job Summary

The Referral Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting patient care coordination by managing insurance pre-verifications, referral processing, appointment scheduling, and communication between patients, providers, and health plans. This individual ensures timely and accurate handling of all internal and external referrals, authorizations, and follow-up activities. The Referral Coordinator serves as a key liaison among clinics, specialists, and insurance carriers, while upholding a patient-centered and service-oriented approach.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Referral Management & Coordination:

  • Process outgoing referrals promptly based on provider orders (e.g., specialty care, diagnostics, therapy).
  • Review, validate, and document referral orders, input referrals and authorizations into the appropriate data systems.
  • Schedule appointments with specialists or service providers, prioritizing high-quality, in-network, and cost-effective options.
  • Track referral status, follow up on incomplete referrals, and ensure timely receipt of consultation reports.
  • Close the referral loop by ensuring reports and documentation are routed to the appropriate provider.

Patient Communication & Navigation:

  • Educate patients on the referral process, insurance requirements, and expectations.
  • Assist patients in overcoming logistical or administrative barriers (e.g., transportation, language, scheduling).
  • Notify patients of appointment details and authorization status.
  • Provide compassionate, professional support in person and over the phone, reinforcing a positive patient experience.

Insurance & Authorization Processing:

  • Verify insurance eligibility and determine referral and authorization requirements.
  • Obtain prior authorizations and approvals from health plans as needed.
  • Collaborate with payers and specialists to expedite authorizations and respond to denials or appeals.

Value-Based Care Alignment:

  • Proactive schedule referrals related to key quality metrics, including HEDIS, STAR, and Quality Improvement (QI) measures (e.g., mammograms, colonoscopies, diabetic eye exams).
  • Support accurate and timely documentation to meet risk adjustment and quality reporting requirements.
  • Track referral patterns and help guide patients to in-network or preferred providers aligned with Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs) and narrow network strategies.
  • Identify, address, and escalate referral delays or barriers that may impact clinical outcomes or contractual performance metrics.

Administrative Support & Documentation:

  • Maintain accurate documentation of all referral activities in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.
  • Log referral status, actions taken, and communications in a timely manner.
  • Generate and distribute referral forms, notifications, and supporting documents.

Care Team Collaboration:

  • Work closely with physicians, nurses, medical assistants, and care managers to coordinate care.
  • Participate in daily huddles to proactively address upcoming referral needs.
  • Share referral status updates with clinical team members in real-time.

Compliance & Data Privacy:

  • Uphold HIPAA guidelines and clinic protocols related to data handling and patient confidentiality.
  • Ensure secure communication of patient records to external entities.

Clinic Support & Environment:

  • Provide clerical support to the clinical team, including managing lobby areas and assisting with PPE protocols.
  • Collaborate with front desk and clinic staff to monitor scheduling and patient flow.
  • Maintain a welcoming and organized patient experience environment.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in a medical office, hospital, or clinical setting handling referrals.
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology and insurance processes.
  • Experience with scheduling systems, EHRs (e.g., eClinicalWorks), and insurance authorization procedures.
  • BLS certification required; must be able to respond appropriately in emergencies.

Education Requirements

Knowledge, Skills & Proficiencies

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Teams, PowerPoint).
  • Familiarity with insurance portals, including Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial payers.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Strong customer service, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems including:
  • eClinicalWorks (eCW).
  • Availity.
  • Cano.Net (ticketing system).
  • Workday (timekeeping/HR platform).

Behavioral Expectations:

  • Actively collaborate with clinic teammates to foster a supportive work environment.
  • Engage with patients respectfully, using preferred names and offering assistance as needed.
  • Promote a culture of compassion, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements

This position works under usual office conditions. The associate is required to work at a personal computer as well as be on the phone for extended periods of time. Must be able to stand, sit, walk and occasionally climb. The incumbent must be able to work extended and flexible hours and weekends as needed. Physical demands include ability to lift up to 50 lbs. title: Facilities Design Structural Engineer III
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

Job Summary: The Level 3 Structural Engineer will lead structural design for infrastructure and building projects. This role requires a professionally licensed engineer with the capability to acquire additional licenses in other states as needed to meet project requirements. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, reviewing, and coordinating structural solutions that align with project goals and adhere to relevant regulations and standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead structural design for infrastructure and building projects, ensuring alignment with project goals and objectives.
  • Prepare and review structural drawings, plans, and specifications to ensure accuracy and compliance with project standards.
  • Ensure all designs comply with local, state, and federal regulations, as well as industry standards and best practices.
  • Assist in the acquisition of professional engineering licenses in other states as required for project needs.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior engineers and team members on best practices and design principles.
  • Contribute to the development of design standards, templates, and processes to enhance project efficiency and quality.
  • Collaborate with clients, project teams, and stakeholders to ensure design alignment with project requirements.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, technologies, and advancements to inform design practices and strategies.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
  • Professional engineering license (e.g., PE) in good standing.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in structural engineering, with a focus on infrastructure and building projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to acquire and maintain professional engineering licenses in multiple states.
  • Strong knowledge of local, state, and federal regulations pertaining to structural engineering.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in structural engineering software (e.g., STAAD, SAP2000, ETABS).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
  • Experience with sustainable design principles and practices.
  • Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and other advanced engineering technologies.


Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $121,023.00 - $169,432.20

Other site ranges may differ

title: Representative, Cameroon, D-1
description:
The Position:

The Representative leads complex business units and country offices’ teams in the design and implementation of population and development and sexual and reproductive health country programmes in humanitarian-development-peace and security nexus contexts, where applicable. Through alliances and partnerships with governments, UN and bilateral agencies, development partners, civil society, academia, and the private sector, the programme aims to realize the 2030 Agenda in order to make a positive difference in the lives of millions of people; especially those furthest behind.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results

Job Purpose:

Under the guidance of a Regional Director, you will lead a Country team in the development and management of an innovative Country Programme of Cooperation focused on population and development and universal access to sexual and reproductive health and rights, including maternal health, family planning, gender, and adolescent and youth empowerment. You are accountable for the effective implementation of the Country Programme, playing the lead role in promoting the mandate of the organization, and ensuring the integration of issues of sexual and reproductive health and rights in the broader national development agenda. Through engagement with national counterparts, UN Country Teams, compelling advocacy, and delivery of effective programmes, including in emergency settings, you serve on the frontline of the organization, validating both the mandate of the organization and its ability to deliver high quality support and results. Your ultimate accountability is to the people that you serve; the most vulnerable, excluded, or marginalized and for the causes that you serve; human rights, sustainable development and humanitarian relief.

You would be responsible for:

A) Strategic direction, planning and management

  • Lead the positioning of UNFPA on strategic issues in the country on the basis of global, regional and national policies and strategies
  • Build institutional relationships with government counterparts, civil society, the private sector, the UN community, other international/national organizations, academia and bilaterals that galvanize support for UNFPA’s mandate
  • Promote UNFPA’s role in the national development agenda, and in the changing aid environment
  • Establish priorities for the work of the Country Office in line with regional and global UNFPA corporate priorities
  • Ensure that policies, programming tools, state-of-the-art knowledge and sound business practices are incorporated into UNFPA country operations
  • Lead and coordinate the development of a strategic plan for UNFPA’s humanitarian and preparedness actions in-country

B) Management of resources

  • Manage international and national staff providing them with direction and motivation; fostering empowerment, learning and career management
  • Demonstrate performance appraisal and transparent leadership approaches that support a culture of growth and development, where good performance is incentivized and underperformers are held to account
    Attract and retain the highest calibre of staff for the Country Office
  • Set standards of performance, and assign responsibilities for achieving results according to the Country Office Strategic Information System
  • Drive the formulation and implementation of a comprehensive resource mobilization and partnership strategy including donor relations and effective mobilisation of funds; securing and efficiently using mobilised funds and assigned budget allocations for the country programme
  • Ensure the safety, security and wellbeing of staff by driving compliance with Minimum Operating Security Standards (MOSS) and Minimum Operational Residential Security Standards (MORSS)

C) Programme leadership and representation

  • Advise senior management of UNFPA on country level issues
  • Provide leadership in the development and execution of the organization’s country level policy dialogue and programme, including delivery of technical assistance for capacity development and for humanitarian situations
  • Engage national counterparts through effective advocacy on UNFPA’s agenda; build support for programme objectives and create awareness of the role of ICPD issues in the overall development agenda and achievement of the Sustainable
  • Development Goals Represent UNFPA within the inter-agency United Nations Country Team (UNCT) and the UN Humanitarian Team; support the UN Resident Coordinator (RC) as UNCT leader, promoting integration of population and development, and sexual and reproductive health issues in the development and humanitarian agenda; contribute to the UN reform process including the triple nexus (Development,Humanitarian and Peace) within the UNCT context
  • Drive UNFPA accountability for the UN Flash Appeal/ Humanitarian Response plan and contribute actively to the achievement of the United Nations Development Assistance Framework (UNDAF) common results, including through chairing/co-chairing UNCT Results Groups
  • Initiate programme and technical support opportunities for South to South collaboration with other countries.

D) Programme oversight and coordination

  • Drive the application of results-based management and quality assurance frameworks for the work of the Country Office;
    Enforce financial and monitoring processes to ensure the Country Office complies with UNFPA policies and procedures, corporate requirements and audit recommendations;
  • Carry out any other duties as may be required by the Regional Director for whom you report to.

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:

  • Postgraduate university degree in any of the following disciplines: Public Health, Medicine, Sociology, Demography, Gender, International Relations, International Development, Economics, Public Administration, Management or other related field.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • 15 years of increasingly responsible professional experience in public administration and international development of which at least 10 years in the field of population and development, sexual and reproductive health or humanitarian at the international level;
  • Current knowledge of issues of population and development, sexual and reproductive health, and their place in the development and humanitarian agenda;
  • Proven ability to lead teams to achieve demonstrable and high quality results
  • Experience at national and international level in advocacy and policy dialogue
  • Experience in media/communication with partners, and public information
  • Experience in international development, particularly in the mandate of UNFPA and dedication to the principles of the United Nations;
  • Field experience is essential; experience from a developing, humanitarian or crisis context is an asset.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English and French. Any other UN language is desirable.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity,
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,
  • Embracing cultural diversity,
  • Embracing change


Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results,
  • Being accountable,
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,
  • Thinking analytically and strategically,
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Managerial Competencies:

  • Providing strategic focus,
  • Engaging in internal/external partners and stakeholders,
  • Leading, developing and empowering people, creating a culture of performance
  • Making decisions and exercising judgment

Compensation and Benefits:

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

title: Hardware Engineering Project Manager
description:
Job Description

Revelyst Golf Technology brings together some of the most trusted names in golf innovation — Foresight Sports, Bushnell Golf, GolfLogix, and PinSeeker — under one platform dedicated to helping golfers play smarter and improve faster. Our teams design and build the launch monitors, rangefinders, sensors, and connected software that golfers and coaches rely on at every level of the game, from the driving range to the PGA Tour.

We are looking for an experienced Hardware Engineering Project Manager to lead the planning and execution of hardware development programs across our golf technology portfolio, including launch monitors, rangefinders, and wearables. You'll own the program schedule and cross-functional coordination from concept through mass production, driving hardware, firmware, mechanical, and industrial design teams — along with contract manufacturers and component suppliers — through each stage gate (EVT, DVT, PVT, and MP) on time, on budget, and at the quality bar our brands are known for.

The Hardware Engineering Project Manager is a highly cross-functional, execution-focused role responsible for driving hardware programs from concept through production. This position is ideal for someone who has successfully led hardware development programs end-to-end, is comfortable managing detailed build plans, schedules, and bring-up issue lists, and can effectively communicate program status, risks, and tradeoffs to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

Working in close day-to-day partnership with Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Firmware/Embedded Software, Industrial Design, Quality, Supply Chain/NPI, Manufacturing, and Product Management, the Hardware Engineering Project Manager also coordinates with external contract manufacturers (CMs) and component suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

This position reports to the Manager of Project & Program Management within the Hardware Engineering organization and is based out of our Carlsbad, CA headquarters.

As the Hardware Engineering Project Manager, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end program plan for one or more hardware products, from concept and feasibility through EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production (MP), including schedules, milestones, budgets, and exit criteria for each stage gate.

  • Drive weekly cross-functional build reviews and design reviews, tracking action items, engineering changes (ECOs/ECNs), open issues lists, and risk registers to closure.

  • Partner with Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, and Industrial Design leads to build integrated master schedules that reflect real engineering dependencies and proactively resurface schedule risk before it becomes schedule slip.

  • Manage relationships and day-to-day execution with contract manufacturers (CMs) and key component suppliers, including build planning, line-side support during EVT/DVT/PVT builds, and issue triage.

  • Lead pilot and mass-production ramp planning in partnership with Supply Chain and Operations, including yield tracking, capacity planning, and first-article inspection sign-off.

  • Manage program budget and BOM cost tracking against target cost, flagging cost or margin risk to product and finance stakeholders.

  • Own program-level risk management: identify technical, schedule, cost, and supply chain risks early, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners and dates.

  • Coordinate compliance, certification, and regulatory testing timelines (e.g., FCC, CE, UL, IC) to avoid downstream schedule impact.

  • Communicate program status, risks, and decisions needed to engineering leadership and executive stakeholders through regular program reviews, dashboards, and milestone readouts.

  • Travel to contract manufacturer and supplier sites as needed to support critical builds, bring-up, and issue resolution.

  • Continuously improve program management processes, templates, and stage-gate criteria across the hardware engineering organization.

You have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 7+ years of experience as a project manager or program manager leading hardware product development, with direct, hands-on ownership of EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production (MP) stage gates.

  • Demonstrated track record shipping consumer electronics, connected devices, or precision hardware products (e.g., optics, sensors, wearables) from concept to volume production.

  • Working knowledge of hardware development fundamentals: PCBA/electrical design, mechanical/tooling development, DFM/DFA, BOM management, and reliability/compliance testing.

  • Experience managing contract manufacturers and overseas suppliers, including on-site build support in Asia.

  • Proven ability to build and manage integrated program schedules) and track issues/risks across multiple concurrent workstreams.

  • Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting program status and trade-offs to senior leadership.

You might have:

  • Experience in the golf, sports technology, optics, or consumer wearables industries.

  • Familiarity with GPS, laser rangefinding, radar, or camera-based sensor systems.

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent project/program management certification.

  • Experience with PLM/PDM systems (e.g., Arena, Windchill, PTC) and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP) for BOM and change management.

  • Background partnering with regulatory/compliance teams on FCC, CE, IC, or similar certifications for connected hardware.

  • Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or DFSS training.

  • Experience standing up or improving hardware NPI/stage-gate processes at a growing company.

title: Malling: Pædagog til vuggestuen i Børnehuset Serinedalen – vær med til at give de mindste børn en tryg begyndelse
description:
Serinedalen er et ungt børnehus, hvor de store byggesten er lagt. For et år siden åbnede vi dørene til vores nye børnehus, og siden da har vi bygget relationer, fællesskaber og pædagogik op – skridt for skridt.

Nu søger vi en pædagog til vuggestuen, som har lyst til at blive en del af et hus, hvor nærvær, faglig nysgerrighed og et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab danner rammen om hverdagen. Et sted, hvor du både bliver en del af noget, der allerede fungerer godt, og får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på det, vi udvikler sammen.

INTRODUKTION OG VORES DNA

Vi bygger videre – sammen

Som pædagog bliver du en del af et hus, hvor medarbejdere tager ansvar, deler idéer og hjælper hinanden med at skabe de bedste dage for børnene. Vi tror på, at god pædagogik udvikles i et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi tør være nysgerrige på vores praksis, deler vores erfaringer og gør hinanden dygtigere.

Børnehuset Serinedalen er vokset frem sammen med et nyt boligområde i Malling og er allerede blevet et naturligt samlingspunkt for mange familier. Mange forældre er tilflyttere og engagerer sig aktivt i børnehusets hverdag, fordi de ser det som en vigtig del af deres børns liv. Derfor møder du også en forældregruppe, som bakker op om huset og ønsker et tæt samarbejde om børnenes trivsel.

Vi er samtidig i gang med at udvikle en naturprofil. Vores CO₂-neutrale børnehus og de grønne omgivelser giver os et oplagt afsæt for at lade natur, leg og nysgerrighed fylde mere i hverdagen.

En vuggestue med blik for de første fællesskaber

Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af de tre stuer og ser hinanden som ét vuggestueteam, der deler ansvar for alle børn og hjælper hinanden i hverdagen. Vi ved, at de første år i et barns liv har stor betydning. Derfor lægger vi vægt på stabile relationer, genkendelige rammer og voksne, der har tid og lyst til at være nærværende.

Vi arbejder bevidst med at styrke børnenes selvhjulpenhed og understøtte deres mod på at deltage i fællesskaber – altid med afsæt i det enkelte barns udvikling og behov.

Du får kolleger, der glæder sig til at dele deres erfaringer, og et introduktionsforløb, der tager udgangspunkt i dig – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller har mange års erfaring.

HVEM ER DU – OG HVAD BLIVER DIN OPGAVE?

Som pædagog i vuggestuen er du med til at skabe den trygge base, hvor børnene får mod på at udforske verden. Du skaber læringsmiljøer, hvor omsorg, leg og udvikling hænger naturligt sammen, og hvor børnene oplever, at de bliver set, hørt og mødt med nærvær.

Du bliver samtidig en vigtig del af udviklingen af vores pædagogiske praksis. Vi forventer ikke, at du har alle svarene, men at du har lyst til at bidrage med dine refleksioner, være nysgerrig på egen og andres praksis og være med til at udvikle vores fælles praksis sammen med os.

Vi håber, at du...

  • møder børnene med nærvær, omsorg og blik for deres individuelle udvikling
  • understøtter børnenes relationer, nysgerrighed og begyndende selvhjulpenhed gennem leg og hverdagsrutiner
  • er nysgerrig på pædagogik og bidrager aktivt til at udvikle vores fælles praksis
  • ser forældresamarbejdet som en vigtig del af barnets trivsel
  • tager ansvar for arbejdsfællesskabet og bidrager aktivt med idéer, initiativ og faglige refleksioner

DET FÅR DU

Hos os får du blandt andet:

  • et introduktionsforløb, der tager udgangspunkt i dine erfaringer
  • engagerede kolleger med lyst til faglig sparring og fælles refleksion
  • mulighed for at sætte dit præg på et børnehus, der fortsat udvikler sig
  • et vuggestueteam, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og løfter opgaven i fællesskab
  • et lyst og moderne børnehus med fantastiske udeområder
  • gode muligheder for at arbejde med natur, udeliv og bæredygtighed
  • en hverdag med struktur, arbejdsglæde og plads til grin

KOM OG MÆRK STEMNINGEN
Du er altid velkommen til at ringe til vores pædagogiske leder Tina Fosgrau Stage på 29 34 23 43.
Tina giver gerne en rundvisning, en snak – og en kop kaffe, hvis du har lyst.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at finde ud af, om Serinedalen kan blive din næste pædagogiske hjemmebane.

Tag et kig på vores hjemmeside og få et indtryk af hverdagen, samarbejdet med forældrene og vores læringsmiljøer: Børnehuset Serinedalen

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen

Ugentligt timetal: Fuldtid

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Tina Fosgrau Stage på telefon.


Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16-08-2026

Samtaler afholdes: uge 34

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

title: Senior Secretary
description:
The Senior Secretary provides comprehensive administrative and operational support to the Office of Housing. This position serves as a contact for departmental communications, coordinates human resources and payroll processes, and performs a wide variety of clerical, organizational, and logistical tasks. Additionally, this role includes direct responsibility for managing key aspects of the apartment assignment process for University Courts Apartments, supporting resident services, and overseeing associated records and compliance tasks.

• Maintain paper and electronic filing systems. Assist with general correspondence and support departmental communications.
• Provide secretarial and front-line office support for the Office of Housing. Places and receives telephone calls and greets visitors; provides information or routes callers to appropriate staff members; takes messages as needed. Evaluates issues to determine appropriate referral needed; forwards emergency calls to the proper person immediately or determines who can respond to emergencies.
• Coordinate all human resources-related processes for the Office of Housing including paperwork, new hire onboarding, employee status changes, time and leave entry, and employment file management. Submit payroll for full-time, part-time, and student employees using the DASH system.
• Manage the application, assignment, and resident communication processes for University Courts Apartments. Maintain accurate apartment rosters in RMS and coordinate room changes and updates.
• Oversee resident move-in and move-out procedures for University Courts. Communicate expectations, key dates, and ensure forms and records are submitted accurately.
• Manage University Courts key control, including key distribution and collection, coordinating lock changes, and maintaining records for compliance and security. Assist residents with questions and enforce departmental and university policies.
• Ensures security, integrity, and confidentiality of data.
• Procure supplies and materials for the purpose of maintaining the availability of required items for Housing central staff. (office supplies, printer cartridges, batteries, etc.)
• Maintains inventory of supplies and materials for the Housing central staff (ex. office supplies, appliances, etc.)
• Assist Housing personnel with questions regarding payroll and timesheet entry.
• Adds charges to student accounts for lost keys and damaged property.
• Performs other related duties as assigned for the purpose of ensuring the efficient and effective functioning of the work unit.
• Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications: Candidates must have a High School Diploma or GED, and 2 to 3 years office experience.
• Skill in using Microsoft Office Suite, email systems, and database entry.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
• Knowledge of or ability to learn housing software systems.
• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with students, staff, and outside parties.
• Skill in maintaining confidentiality and working with sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications: Professional experience in office administration and basic human resources processes.


Application Process: Qualified candidates should apply online. Attached resume is required for consideration.
Application Deadline: Review of applications is expected to begin on August 13th, 2026, and will continue until the position has been filled.
Minimum hiring rate $16.48 per hour (Market Range MR06) – Salary commensurate with education and experience.

title: Omsorgsfuld hjælper søges til lange vagter hos ung mand i Hellerup
description:
Har du plejeerfaring? - er du aktiv og god til at tage ansvar for dit arbejde? Kunne du tænke dig et job med fokus på en ung mand på 22 år, hvor du kan yde den bedste omsorg? Så har vi brug for dig!

Om opgaven
Vi søger omsorgsfulde medarbejdere med plejeerfaring, der vil gøre dagene for en ung mand gode og alsidige. I er 2 på vagt, hvor I hjælpes ad om opgaverne. I jobbet har du gode muligheder for at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer.

Den unge mand bor i Hellerup sammen med sin familie og sine hunde. Som følge af en sjælden sygdom har han børnedemens og er med tiden blevet blind og immobil. Han er kørestolsbruger og har brug for hjælp til alt i hverdagen.

Han har ikke et verbalt sprog og kommunikerer via kropssprog/mimik. Efterhånden som du lærer ham at kende, lærer du at aflæse ham.

Han har altid været stor fan af alt, hvad der har med Pokémon og Harry Potter at gøre. Han har også altid været rigtig glad for LEGO Star Wars og diverse spil på PS3. Disse ting fylder mindre nu, idet han gradvist er blevet dårligere af sin sygdom. Ved at tale med ham om hans interesser og f.eks. høre lydspor og musik, kan han genkalde sig det, han interesserer sig for og holder af.

Det er et rigtigt hyggeligt hjem, med søde forældre og gode forhold. Der er indrettet egen ”lejlighed” med køkken og bad til manden. Du sørger for omsorg, pleje, aktiviteter og al praktisk hjælp. Dette er noget, du vil få grundig oplæring i.

Om dig
Du har godt med omsorgserfaring og er vant til arbejde med pleje- og lift.

Som person er du omsorgsfuld, glad for at være aktiv og god til at tage ansvar.

Det er vigtigt, at du har kørekort, da han har sin egen handicapbil. Herudover er det afgørende at du er ikke-ryger, da hjemmet er 100 % røgfrit, pga. astma i familien.

Arbejdstider
Stillingen er på 2 - 4 vagter om ugen.
Mødetider:
kl. 6:45 - 19
kl. 7 - 22
kl. 19 - 7

Du bliver en del af et team hos borgeren og det er derfor vigtigt at du er fleksibel og kan hjælpe med at dække vagter, ved ferie og sygdom i teamet.

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en familieejet virksomhed med en masse engagerede medarbejdere. Du har en fast rådgiver, som du altid kan få sparring hos. Udenfor kontorets åbningstid er der altid en bemandet vagttelefon, så du er aldrig alene. Løn og pension i henhold til Landsoverenskomst indgået mellem FOA og Dansk Erhverv. Du er dækket af DUOS’ ansvars- og arbejdsskadeforsikring og sundhedsforsikring er en del af din pensionsordning. Vi tilbyder en bred variation af kurser, og du modtager relevant introduktion og løbende opkvalificering som medarbejder hos DUOS. Og så kan du slet ikke undgå at udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt, når du arbejder med mennesker hos os i DUOS.

Vil du være vores nye kollega?

Så send en ansøgning via linket. Du skal have en profil på mit.duos.dk og være logget ind for at søge. Vi holder samtaler løbende, send derfor gerne din ansøgning med det samme. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Har du yderligere spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte rekrutteringskonsulent Trine-Emilie Lyberth på 3634 4990. Du kan altid finde svar på generelle spørgsmål her: FAQ

Vi er mennesker, der hjælper mennesker

I DUOS hjælper vi mennesker i hverdagen, støtter dem i svære situationer og bidrager til deres trivsel og livskvalitet. Som en af Danmarks største og ældste velfærdsleverandører stræber vi efter at være til stede der, hvor behovet er. Vi kender betydningen af den rette empati og den rette faglige viden, og vi ved, at det er afgørende at sikre det rette match mellem medarbejder og borger, hvis vores ydelser skal have værdi.

Kom og vær med på DUOS-holdet. Og gør en vigtig forskel for et andet menneske.

Læs mere om DUOS på www.duos.dk
